# 2017: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 3,791 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2017.sqlite](2017.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `75e28959e2e4a4880f5b06a17d265f27a1a0ec5c90bb5242634c6ae5c19dac7a`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.1`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 17. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 10; partial: 7; without a full-event review: 3,774. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2017-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091452586](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%201&oldid=1091452586>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Istanbul nightclub attack.

**Archived source account.** A gunman opens fire in a nightclub in Istanbul, on the European coast of the Bosphorus, killing at least 39 people with an additional 69 wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38481521#>); [AP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-01-01/at-least-35-dead-in-attack-on-istanbul-nightclub%3A-governor/8156276>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2016/12/31/39-killed-nearly-70-wounded-in-new-years-attack-on-istanbul-night-club.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suicide car bomb explosion and gunmen attack in Iraqi al-Qadisiya town situated in west of Najaf, kills at least 7 people and injures more than 17 others. Yesterday, 29 people were killed in a bomb explosion at a busy market in Iraq’s capital Baghdad. ISIS claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-attack-idUSKBN14L0X3?il=0>); [Tasnim News Agency](<https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2017/01/01/1284497/multiple-casualties-as-bombing-rocks-neighborhood-in-iraqi-holy-city>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A gunman shoots dead Burundi's environment minister Emmanuel Niyonkuru in the nation's capital, Bujumbura.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20170101-burundi-minister-assassinated-police>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A ferry catches fire en route to Indonesia's Thousand Islands, killing at least 23 people and injuring 17 others.

Source citations (as archived): [The Melbourne Age](<http://www.theage.com.au/world/23-dead-17-injured-in-fire-on-indonesian-ferry-in-thousand-islands-20170101-gtkhkt.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-01-01-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** Kim Jong Un, the leader of North Korea, claims that the country is close to developing an intercontinental ballistic missile.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-kim-idUSKBN14L0RN?>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-2-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council unanimously votes in favor of the Russian and Turkey-backed ceasefire currently in effect in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/12/adopts-resolution-supporting-syria-ceasefire-161231182457975.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-2-5"></a>

Context: 2016 United Nations Secretary-General selection.

**Archived source account.** Portugal's António Guterres begins his term as United Nations Secretary-General, replacing South Korea's Ban Ki-moon.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<http://indiatoday.intoday.in/story/ban-ki-moon-un-secretary-antonio-guterres/1/846567.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/12/ban-ki-moon-leaves-regrets-conflicts-161231141724783.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0795f0eee7f048779ffd428957e228e3/ban-ki-moon-buoyed-climate-accord-laments-conflicts>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-2-7"></a>

Context: 2016 United Nations Security Council election.

**Archived source account.** Bolivia, Ethiopia, Italy, Kazakhstan, and Sweden begin their terms on the United Nations Security Council, replacing Angola, Malaysia, New Zealand, Spain, and Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Inter Press Service News](<http://www.ipsnews.net/2016/06/ethiopia-kazakhstan-sweden-among-new-members-of-un-security-council/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-2-9"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the Gambia, Gambian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Gambian President Yahya Jammeh accuses the West African regional bloc, ECOWAS, of "declaring war" after it said it was putting forces on alert in case he refused to step down at the end of his mandate on January 19.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gambia-politics-idUSKBN14L15P>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Campinas massacre.

**Archived source account.** A gunman shoots dead at least 11 people, including his former wife, and then himself in a murder–suicide at a New Year's Eve party in the southeast Brazilian city of Campinas. Several others reportedly remain in critical condition.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-shooting-idUSKBN14L13V>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Spanish and Moroccan authorities clash with migrants on the Moroccan-Spanish border along Ceuta, as they attempt to climb and rush the border fence.

Source citations (as archived): [Express](<http://www.express.co.uk/news/world/741773/video-migrants-storm-spanish-enclave-over-border-fence-ceuta>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police arrest Anthony K. Boisvert after a foot chase in Lebanon, New Hampshire, charging him in the setting a fire which destroyed an abandoned building on January 2016, and two other fires, one which destroyed the historic First Baptist Church on December 2016 and stabbing two at a condominium complex December 29.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Hampshire Union Leader](<http://www.unionleader.com/crime/lebanon-man-charged-with-setting-church-fire-stabbing-pair-20170102>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities seek three men after they rob $6 million on New Year's Eve from the offices of high-end jewelry designer Gregg Ruth in New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC NYC](<http://abc7ny.com/news/watch-police-searching-for-3-men-involved-in-$6-million-midtown-jewelry-heist/1683131/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Church of Norway officially ceases to be the state church of Norway after almost 500 years.

Source citations (as archived): [The Christian Daily](<http://christiandaily.com/article/norways-church-and-state-to-divorce-after-almost-500-years/59710.htm>).

<a id="event-2017-01-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Quirino Ordaz Coppel is sworn in as Governor of the Mexican state of Sinaloa.

<a id="event-2017-01-02-1-3"></a>

Victim was identified as Scottsdale attorney Eric Falbe along with his wife, Carrie, and his two daughters from a previous marriage.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/01/03/news/economy/ford-700-jobs-trump/index.html>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2017/01/03/ford-to-scrap-mexico-plant-invest-in-michigan-due-to-trump-policies.html>).

Over 250 people are said to have been arrested so far while blockades to PEMEX installations potentially lead to critical situations in some states.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-gasoline-idUSKBN14P0HP>).

<a id="event-2017-01-05-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States President-elect Donald Trump indicates that he will nominate former Indiana senator Dan Coats as Director of National Intelligence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-38543124>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-01-07-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Free University of Berlin chemists confirm that carbon can bond with more than four atoms, previously seen as its limit because carbon has only four shareable electrons. The researchers used X-rays to, for the first time, map the molecule — a carbon atom bonded to six other carbon atoms.

Source citations (as archived): [Science News](<https://www.sciencenews.org/article/carbon-can-exceed-four-bond-limit>); [ZME Science](<https://www.zmescience.com/science/news-science/carbon-six-bond-molecule/>).

### 2017-01-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1089060465](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%208&oldid=1089060465>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-08-0-1"></a>

Context: January 2017 Jerusalem vehicular attack.

**Archived source account.** A truck rams into a group of Israeli soldiers in a deliberate attack in East Jerusalem, killing four and wounding 21. The perpetrator was previously convicted of terrorism and was jailed for 10 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/08/middleeast/jerusalem-vehicle-attack/index.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jan/08/truck-rammed-into-pedestrians-jerusalem?CMP=Share_AndroidApp_%ED%81%B4%EB%A6%BD%EB%B3%B4%EB%93%9C%EC%97%90_%EB%B3%B5%EC%82%AC>).

<a id="event-2017-01-08-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two suicide bombings, one using a car bomb and another with an explosive belt, take place in vegetable markets in eastern Baghdad, killing at least 20 people and injuring more than 50. The Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters AP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-01-08/baghdad-car-bomb-kills-at-least-12-people/8168740>); [AP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/reuters/article-4098738/Car-bomb-eastern-Baghdad-kills-12-wounds-dozens--police-medics.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/iraq-suicide-attacks-rock-baghdad-killing-20-170108131406836.html>).

**Archived source account.** The 74th Golden Globe Awards are held in Hollywood.

Source citations (as archived): [News Limited](<http://www.news.com.au/entertainment/awards/golden-globes/golden-globes-2017-winners-speeches-and-highlights-from-the-show/news-story/e4d42e9e7f3910cba07a371a9b67f44a>).

<a id="event-2017-01-08-1-2"></a>

<a id="event-2017-01-08-1-3"></a>

Context: The 74th Golden Globe Awards are held in Hollywood..

**Archived source account.** La La Land becomes the single most winning film in Golden Globes history, winning all seven awards out of its seven nominations and becomes the seventh film to achieve all the awards it was nominated for, the others being Doctor Zhivago (1966), Love Story (1971), The Godfather (1973), One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest (1976), A Star is Born (1977) and Midnight Express (1979).

Source citations (as archived): [Golden Globes](<http://www.goldenglobes.com/trivia-0>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/la-et-golden-globes-2017-live-la-la-land-breaks-record-for-most-1483935005-htmlstory.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-09-3-4"></a>

Context: Cyprus dispute.

**Archived source account.** Greek and Turkish local leaders of Cyprus resume talks to end the division of the island before a high level multilateral conference takes place in Geneva this week in the latest effort to reunify the island.

<a id="event-2017-01-09-3-7"></a>

Context: Renewable Heat Incentive scandal.

**Archived source account.** Martin McGuinness of Sinn Féin resigns as the NI deputy first minister in protest of handling by the Democratic Unionist Party of a failed energy scheme that cost Northern Irish taxpayers £490 million. His decision will likely lead to a snap election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-38561507>).

<a id="event-2017-01-09-3-9"></a>

Context: 115th United States Congress.

<a id="event-2017-01-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Radio in Norway.

**Archived source account.** Norway becomes the first country to start a complete switch-off of national FM radio stations. Some, such as the Norwegian Local Radio Association, are concerned about the impact on motorists and the elderly.

#### Arts and culture

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-01-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** President Barack Obama announces the end of the wet feet, dry feet policy, which previously allowed undocumented immigrants from Cuba to become permanent residents.

Context: Operation Atlantic Resolve.

**Archived source account.** 3,000 U.S. troops are deployed in Poland as part of NATO's Operation Atlantic Resolve. Poland says that the deployment is a necessary response to Russian military exercises near its border and its intervention in Ukraine while Russia condemns the move as a "threat to national interests and security".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38592448>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/troops-poland-threat-russia-security-170112144005610.html>).

Context: European migrant crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/germany-return-refugees-greece-starting-march-170112123822339.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-13-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the United States Barack Obama signs an order to ease sanctions against Sudan, citing the country's efforts to "reduce internal conflict, improve humanitarian access to people requiring aid and curtail terrorism".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-38612616>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-13-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six more people have been charged in relation to the armed robbery of American celebrity Kim Kardashian in Paris last year.

Source citations (as archived): [9 News](<http://www.9news.com.au/world/2017/01/13/05/12/three-investigated-over-kardashian-robbery>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Cyprus dispute.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan vows that the Turkish Armed Forces will stay on Cyprus "in perpetuity" and that the proposal of a rotating presidency for a unified island is unacceptable, casting doubts on an eventual solution to the dispute. The remarks come as the latest round of unity talks end, with them to restart on January 18.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jan/13/cyprus-talks-turkish-troops-will-remain-on-island-vows-erdogan>).

<a id="event-2017-01-13-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives votes in favor of legislation that approves preliminary budgetary measures for the United States Congress to begin repealing the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, colloquially known as Obamacare.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/jan/13/congress-house-affordable-care-act-obamacare-repeal>).

<a id="event-2017-01-13-4-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Gambian presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** The African Union says it will cease to recognize Yahya Jammeh as President of The Gambia on January 19, the date he is to hand power over to his opponent Adama Barrow, who won last year's election.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/au-cease-recognising-jammeh-gambia-president-170113160749764.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-01-13-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A UCLA research team, analyzing lunar minerals brought back during the Apollo program, reports that the moon is at least 4.51 billion years old, up to 150 million years older than previous estimates.

Source citations (as archived): [Sci Tech Daily](<http://scitechdaily.com/ucla-study-shows-the-moon-is-older-than-previously-thought/>); [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/moon-age-how-old-earth-planet-satellite-science-scientists-ucla-a7524071.html>).

The Prime Minister of Kosovo Isa Mustafa says the train had been stopped "to protect the country's sovereignty".

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-18-1-1"></a>

Context: January 2017 Central Italy earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** Four earthquakes of magnitude 5.1 or higher strike near Amatrice, Italy, forcing evacuation of some schools and the Rome Metro. No deaths are reported from the quakes.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/18/europe/italy-earthquake-rome-amatrice/index.html>); [Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/news/news/amatrice-italy-earthquake-swarm>).

<a id="event-2017-01-18-1-3"></a>

Context: Rigopiano avalanche.

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Italy’s Civil Protection account records the January 18 Rigopiano avalanche, 29 deaths and eleven people rescued. It does not equate rescued survivors with an injury total.

Editorial date: 2017-01-18. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: the source’s eleven injuries and historical deadliest-avalanche comparisons remain unverified.

Evidence: [Italian Civil Protection Department](<https://emergenze.protezionecivile.it/it/sismiche/terremoto-centro-italia-2016/>).

Original source account: On the afternoon of 18 January 2017, a major avalanche occurred on Gran Sasso d'Italia, a mountain in Rigopiano, a tourist destination in the province of Pescara, in Southern Italy's Abruzzo region. The avalanche struck the luxury resort Hotel Rigopiano, killing twenty-nine people and injuring eleven others. The avalanche is the deadliest in Italy since the White Friday avalanches in 1916, and the deadliest avalanche in Europe since the Galtür avalanche in 1999.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-18-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least four people are killed in a shootout between Mexican Police and unknown gunmen after the latter opened fire on the Quintana Roo state attorneys' office in Cancún.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-38661590>).

<a id="event-2017-01-18-3-2"></a>

Context: Colegio Americano del Noreste 2017 shootings.

**Archived source account.** A student wounds four people in a school shooting and then kills himself in Monterrey, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-38667946>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-18-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Gambian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The National Assembly of the Gambia approves extending Yahya Jammeh's term as President of the country for 90 more days.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-38662000>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/gambia-mps-extend-president-jammeh-term-170118082031908.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-18-4-2"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Gambian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of British tourists are evacuated from the Gambia as West African states prepare to take military action to remove President Yahya Jammeh from power as his term ends.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-38659120>).

<a id="event-2017-01-18-4-4"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two Israeli Bedouins and one Israeli police officer are killed in a clash during a home-demolition operation in the Bedouin village of Umm al-Hiran. Israeli police claim to have found evidence that the Bedouins were supporters of the Islamic State.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/palestinian-killed-israeli-home-demolition-170118043846949.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-18-4-5"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Fatah-dominated Palestinian Authority agrees to form a unity government with Hamas following a three-day delegation in Moscow.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/fatah-hamas-form-unity-government-170118031339203.html>).

#### Science

<a id="event-2017-01-18-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Global temperatures rose to the hottest level on record for 2016 for a third successive record according to NASA and the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/9962f3c0-dda2-11e6-86ac-f253db7791c6>).

### 2017-01-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1285439966](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%2019&oldid=1285439966>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** ISIL militants execute 12 people in Palmyra, according to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-38678189>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Second Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** U.S. B-2 stealth bombers strike two ISIL camps, south of the city of Sirte, Libya, killing more than 80 militants, according to United States Secretary of Defense Ash Carter.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/bombers-strike-isis-camps-libya/story?id=44882627>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-libya-strike-idUSKBN15320U>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2017-01-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Uber agrees to pay $20 million to settle U.S. Federal Trade Commission claims the company exaggerated prospective earnings and downplayed the costs of buying/leasing a car when recruiting new drivers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-uber-ftc-idUSKBN15334C>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** A small plane carrying Brazilian Supreme Court Justice Teori Zavascki crashes into the sea near the tourist town of Paraty in the state of Rio de Janeiro, killing the magistrate and two other people. Zavascki had been handling the politically-charged Operation Car Wash corruption trials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-crash-idUSKBN1532WH?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 17-story Plasco Building collapses after a blaze in Tehran, Iran. The building was evacuated but 30 firefighters have been killed in the collapse.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/irans-oldest-high-rise-tower-collapses-in-fire/a-37186503>); [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2017-01-19-ML-Iran-Fire/id-8fc552ddb97a4e0b88ba3971650b1eee>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An eruption on Bogoslof Island of the Aleutian Islands disrupts air transportation routes, distributing tephra over populated areas, including Kodiak Island, 660 mi away from the volcano.

Source citations (as archived): [Alaska Dispatch News](<https://www.adn.com/alaska-news/aviation/2017/01/19/another-bogoslof-eruption-sends-ash-over-alaska-peninsula-kodiak-island/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Rigopiano avalanche.

**Archived source account.** An Italian rescue official says a number of people have been killed by an avalanche, possibly connected to Wednesday's earthquakes, that buried a ski resort on a slope of the Gran Sasso mountain in Italy's Abruzzo region. About 30 guests and staff were at the hotel. The only survivors are two men who had been outside when the disaster struck.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38674788>); [Daily Express](<http://www.express.co.uk/news/world/756018/italy-avalanche-pescara-hotel-staff-guests-missing-rome-earthquake>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-quake-avalanche-idUSKBN1530TR>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 children are killed and 45 more are injured after a school bus collides with a truck in Etah, India.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-38673715>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least six Britons from Manchester and Glasgow are killed in a bus crash in Saudi Arabia while they were on pilgrimage.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2017/jan/19/seven-britons-killed-in-saudi-bus-crash>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-19-3-1"></a>

Context: 2016 South Korean political scandal.

**Archived source account.** A court in South Korea strikes down a request by prosecutors to issue an arrest warrant for Samsung vice chairman Lee Jae-yong, who is accused of bribery and embezzlement, in connection to a corruption scandal involving impeached President Park Geun-hye.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-38660128>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexican drug lord Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán is extradited to the United States, where he will face charges for his role as leader of the Sinaloa Cartel.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/mexico-extradites-joaquin-el-chapo-guzman-sinaloa-cartel-kingpin-2017-1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-19-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Gambian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Adama Barrow is sworn in as the Gambia's new President at the Gambian embassy in Dakar, Senegal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-38675741>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-4-2"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Gambian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Senegalese forces enter the Gambia as a military operation to end Yahya Jammeh's 22-year rule begins following the inauguration of Adama Barrow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-38682184>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-4-4"></a>

Context: Presidential transition of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Former Georgia Governor Sonny Perdue is named Secretary of Agriculture, the last open seat in President-elect Donald Trump's cabinet.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/18/politics/donald-trump-sonny-perdue-for-agriculture-secretary/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-19-4-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sinn Féin politician Martin McGuinness retires from politics for health reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nireland-politics-mcguinness-idUSKBN1532RM>).

### 2017-01-20

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Syrian Civil War.

<a id="event-2017-01-20-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An airstrike kills more than 40 Jabhat Fateh al-Sham fighters at a jihadist camp west of Aleppo. It is currently unknown whether American or Russian planes carried out the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-raid-idUSKBN1540RV>); [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/01/20/more-than-100-core-al-qaeda-fighters-killed-in-u-s-strike-in-syria.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-20-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Woody Harrelson biopic Lost in London makes history as the first full-length feature film to be filmed and theatrically released simultaneously.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-38686697>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/film/2017/jan/20/lost-in-london-review-woody-harrelson-live-movie>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/films/2017/01/20/lost-london-woody-harrelson-breaks-boundaries-supercharged-allen/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2017-01-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Toilets in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Japanese toilet industries agreed to standardize the iconography of electric toilet seat controls in order to make them less confusing for users.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2017/01/17/national/symbols-toilet-functions-unified-japan/#.WIHGWDUbvcs>); [BBC](<http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p04q0qk0>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jan/18/japan-to-end-tourists-toilet-trouble-with-standardised-buttons-olympics>); [Japan Sanitary Equipment Industry Association](<http://www.sanitary-net.com/news/news1142>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Search continues for missing firefighters in Tehran's Plasco Building site after the building's deadly fire and collapsing last day.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/01/20/middleeast/iran-tehran-building-fire-collapse/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-20-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Rigopiano avalanche.

**Archived source account.** Italian emergency crews rescue 10 people, including four children, from 16½ feet of snow and wreckage from the luxury Hotel Rigopiano following yesterday's Gran Sasso mountain avalanche. Searchers find four bodies, while families of at least 16 people still missing wait for news.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/avalanche-italy-hotel-five-pulled-put-five-being-saved/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-20-3-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Verona bus crash.

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying Hungarian students crashes near Verona in northern Italy with at least 18 people dead and 50 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/01/21/least-seven-feared-dead-italian-coach-crash/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38703536>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-01-20-4-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump nominates New York Jets owner Woody Johnson to be the next United States Ambassador to the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/new-york-jets-owner-woody-johnson-set-to-be-us-ambassador-to-uk-10735264>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-20-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed and twenty injured after a man drove a car into the Bourke Street Mall in the CBD of the Australian city Melbourne. A man has been arrested and Victoria Police say the incident is not terror related. In the next few weeks, the death toll would rise to six.

Source citations (as archived): [Nine Network](<http://www.9news.com.au/National/2017/01/20/13/41/Number-of-pedestrians-injured-in-Melbourne-cbd>); [AAP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170202070531/https://au.news.yahoo.com/a/34233875/man-kills-three-injures-20-in-bourke-st/#page1>).

<a id="event-2017-01-20-5-2"></a>

Context: Inauguration of Donald Trump protests.

**Archived source account.** Some protesters of the inauguration smash windows, damage cars, and clash with the police. Six police officers and at least one civilian are injured. DC police say 217 protesters have been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/19/politics/trump-inauguration-protests-womens-march/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-20-6-2"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump / Inauguration of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump is officially sworn in as the 45th President of the United States, and Mike Pence is sworn in as 48th Vice President of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/01/19/donald-trumps-inauguration-countdown-barack-obama-preparing/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-20-6-4"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump / Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate confirms the first two members of President Donald Trump's Cabinet: retired Marine General James Mattis as Secretary of Defense, and retired Marine general John F. Kelly as Secretary of Homeland Security.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/20/politics/senate-trump-cabinet-confirmations/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-20-6-6"></a>

Context: 2016–2017 Gambian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Lieutenant General Ousman Badjie, chief of the Gambian army, recognizes Adama Barrow as the new commander-and-chief of the armed forces and says that his troops will not fight ECOWAS soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gambia-politics-army-idUSKBN154269>).

<a id="event-2017-01-20-6-7"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** At least five Egyptian Army soldiers are killed by unknown gunmen in the Sinai Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/egypt-attackers-kill-soldiers-sinai-peninsula-170123082907692.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-01-23-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** John D. Bates, United States federal judge for the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, blocks a proposed merger by health insurance companies Aetna and Humana.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/23/business/dealbook/aetna-humana-deal-blocked.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016–2017 Gambian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** According to an advisor to Gambian President Adama Barrow, more than 500 million dalasi, equivalent to US$11.3 million, are reported missing from state coffers after former President Yahya Jammeh left the country in exile.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-38714007>).

<a id="event-2017-01-23-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following a joint police operation by Europol and Interpol last October and November across much of Europe, dubbed "Operation Pandora", more than 3,500 stolen artwork and artifacts are recovered, with 75 people arrested and 48,588 more being investigated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38723099>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump issues executive orders to withdraw the United States from the Trans-Pacific Partnership, and reinstates the Mexico City Policy, a policy banning U.S. aid to foreign organizations that use funds from other sources to perform or discuss abortions, which Barack Obama scrapped in 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/mexico-city-policy-donald-trump-reimposes-abortion-a7542216.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2017/01/23/trump-reverses-abortion-related-policy-to-ban-funding-to-international-health-groups/>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/01/23/politics/trans-pacific-partnership-trade-deal-withdrawal-trumps-first-executive-action-monday-sources-say/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Syrian peace process.

**Archived source account.** Peace talks in Astana, Kazakhstan, between the Syrian opposition and the Syrian Government, meant to build on a fragile ceasefire currently in effect in the Syrian Civil War, end with no breakthrough reported.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/syria-cease-fire-talks-astana-preparations/28249616.html>).

### 2017-01-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256030636](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%2024&oldid=1256030636>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-01-24-0-1"></a>

Context: 89th Academy Awards.

**Archived source account.** Nominations for the 2017 Academy Awards are announced, with La La Land, Moonlight and Hidden Figures among the favorites.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/entertainment/la-et-oscar-nominations-2017-live-watch-the-oscar-nominations-1485237557-htmlstory.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mashhad in northeastern Iran was officially named the capital of the Islamic culture in 2017 by the ISESCO.

Source citations (as archived): [Tasnim](<https://www.tasnimnews.com/en/news/2017/01/24/1306527/mashhad-officially-becomes-2017-capital-of-islamic-culture>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** California Governor Jerry Brown declares a state of emergency in 50 counties, as winter storms kill four and cause millions of dollars in damage.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/winter-storm-leo-impacts>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-1-2"></a>

Context: Rigopiano avalanche.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the avalanche which buried the four-star luxury resort Hotel Rigopiano on 18 January rises to seventeen, with twelve others still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170124194342/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/italy-avalanche-death-toll-climbs-12-17-missing-45002214>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Italian rescue helicopter, carrying an injured skier from Gran Sasso d'Italia, crashes amid thick fog, killing six people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38733593>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fire destroys a kennel in Wasilla, Alaska, killing 46 Labrador Retrievers. Thirty-two other dogs survive the fire in the licensed shelter.

Source citations (as archived): [KTUU-TV](<http://www.ktuu.com/content/news/Fire-at-Mat-Su-dog-kennel-kills-dozens-of-puppies-411704875.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police discover US$20 million in a bed frame under a mattress at a Massachusetts home. The cash is believed to be linked to Telexfree, a pyramid scheme disguised as a company that claimed to provide internet phone services. A Brazilian man that police were following was charged in connection to the money.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-38735399>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-24-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ken Wyatt is sworn in as the first Indigenous Australian ever to serve as a Federal minister, becoming the Minister for Indigenous Health and Aged Care.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-01-24/ken-wyatt-to-be-sworn-in-as-first-indigenous-minister/8207676>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-3-2"></a>

Context: R (Miller) v Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United Kingdom rules that the Government of the United Kingdom may not begin the formal Brexit process until Parliament votes in approval of the move.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-38720320>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-3-4"></a>

Context: Israeli settlement.

**Archived source account.** Israel approves the construction of 2,500 more new settlement homes in the West Bank, the most in years and the second time new homes were approved since Donald Trump was inaugurated as President of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jan/24/israel-announces-2500-more-west-bank-settlement-homes>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-3-6"></a>

Context: Syrian peace process.

**Archived source account.** The second day of peace negotiations in Astana, Kazakhstan, end with the sponsors of the talks, Russia, Turkey and Iran, agreeing to set up commission between the three to monitor and enforce the fragile ceasefire to the Syrian Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jan/24/syria-talks-astana-russia-turkey-iran-ceasefire>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-3-8"></a>

Context: 2016–2017 Gambian constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Gambian President Adama Barrow names Fatoumata Tambajang as Vice-President of the Gambia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/gambia-adama-barrow-names-fatoumata-tambajang-vp-170124055357537.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-24-3-10"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs documents approving the construction of both the Keystone XL and Dakota Access Pipelines.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-38734450>).

### 2017-01-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256030652](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%2025&oldid=1256030652>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Twenty-eight people are killed in a coordinated attack on the Dayah Hotel in central Mogadishu. The terrorist group Al-Shabaab claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\!](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/least-seven-killed-mogadishu-hotel-attack-police-084256456.html>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/somalia-car-bomb-attack-targets-mogadishu-hotel-170125061508189.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-01-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dow Jones Industrial Average breaks 20,000 for the first time ever.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/01/25/us-markets.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-25-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Over 800 homes are destroyed or flooded in Tahiti, French Polynesia, following severe storms over the weekend, with at least 4,000 people affected.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/323047/800-homes-destroyed-or-flooded-in-tahiti-storms>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-01-25-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Mexico–United States diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto rejects the idea, announced by U.S. President Donald Trump, that Mexico would pay for any border wall between the United States and his country.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/01/25/donald-trump-order-construction-border-wall-crackdown-refugees/>); [NBC news](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/mexican-president-vows-protect-immigrants-inside-united-states-n712321>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Mexico–United States diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Mexican senior officials say President Peña Nieto may cancel his plans to visit the White House next Tuesday, January 31, because of President Trump's actions.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/25/world/americas/trump-mexico-border-wall.html?&amp;hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=b-lede-package-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news>); [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2017/01/25/mexico-president-us-trip-trump-wall/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-3-4"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Taiwan.

**Archived source account.** Burkina Faso and Swaziland refuse to break relations with Taiwan and recognize the One-China policy despite being offered aid from China.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2017-01-24/chinese-billions-fail-to-sway-taiwan-s-last-two-allies-in-africa>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-25-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The German government decides it will abolish the crime of lèse-majesté, almost one year after the Böhmermann affair.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP by Digital Journal](<http://www.digitaljournal.com/news/world/germany-to-scrap-lese-majeste-law-after-turkey-row/article/484394>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-4-2"></a>

Context: Domestic violence.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Duma backs a law decriminalizing a first instance of domestic violence that does "not seriously injure" the person, making it an administrative offense. The bill also includes violence against children.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/01/25/europe/russia-domestic-violence-bill/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-4-4"></a>

Context: Women's rights.

**Archived source account.** Belgium supports a plan by Dutch minister Lilianne Ploumen to launch a fund compensating worldwide for the United States' newly-reinstated Mexico City policy.

Source citations (as archived): [De Standaard](<http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20170125_02694576>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-netherlands-usa-abortion-idUKKBN159189>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-25-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Vatican City State announces that Pope Francis will name a Pontifical Delegate to head the Sovereign Military Order of Malta after Prince and Grand Master Matthew Festing's unexpected forced resignation in a spat over condoms.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-knights-idUSKBN159001>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-5-2"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** United States President Donald Trump announces that he intends to seek an investigation into possible voter fraud from last year's election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-election-idUSKBN1591FP>); [FOX News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2017/01/25/trump-promises-major-investigation-into-alleged-voter-fraud.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-5-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** President Trump signs two executive orders related to immigration, one to take federal grant funding away from sanctuary cities, and another to build a wall along the U.S.–Mexico border.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/25/politics/donald-trump-build-wall-immigration-executive-orders/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-01-25-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The International Olympic Committee says that sprinter Nesta Carter took the banned substance methylhexaneamine while competing in the 2008 Olympic 4 × 100 metres relay. As a result, the Jamaican team is disqualified and Usain Bolt loses his ninth Olympic gold medal.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<https://www.espn.com/olympics/story/_/id/18550754/usain-bolt-loses-2008-olympic-relay-gold-teammate-doping-case>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** With a victory in the second stage of the Vuelta a San Juan, Tom Boonen becomes the first professional road cyclist to win a race on a bike equipped with disc brakes.

Source citations (as archived): [RoadCyclingUK](<https://roadcyclinguk.com/gear/tom-boonen-becomes-first-pro-win-using-disc-brakes.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-25-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** In sumo wrestling, Kisenosato Yutaka becomes the 72nd yokozuna. He is the first Japanese national to effect the promotion to the highest rank in 19 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4646441/japan-sumo-kisenosato-yokozuna/>).

### 2017-01-26

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-26-4-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-01-26-5-0"></a>

Context: 2016–2017 Gambian constitutional crisis.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-01-26-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Bulletin of the Atomic Scientists moves the Doomsday Clock thirty seconds forward, to two and a half minutes before midnight.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab militants attack a remote AMISOM base in southern Somalia, claiming to have killed dozens of Kenyan troops.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-01-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Harvard scientists report, in the peer-reviewed journal Science, the first creation of metallic hydrogen in a laboratory, using a diamond anvil cell. Other researchers did not agree with this finding when it was first posted on the arXiv preprint server in October 2016, and have not yet changed their positions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-38768683>); [Scientific American](<https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/doubts-cloud-claims-of-metallic-hydrogen/>); [Chemistry World](<https://www.chemistryworld.com/news/metallic-hydrogen-claim-faces-fiery-scrutiny/2500300.article>).
