#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A boat with 31 people on board, including more than 20 Chinese tourists, goes missing after sailing from the eastern Malaysian port of Kota Kinabalu to visit the island of Pulau Mengalum.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170129130302/http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_MALAYSIA_CHINA_MISSING_BOAT?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-01-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis takes de facto control of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta (the entity retains sovereignty under international law), forcing its leader Prince and Grand Master Matthew Festing to resign.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/28/world/europe/ten-centuries-later-a-pope-and-knights-do-battle.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=second-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-01-28-2-2"></a>

Context: Turkey–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Theresa May and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan sign a £100 million defense deal to build new fighter jets. Under the deal, BAE Systems will collaborate with Turkish companies to build the TAI TFX.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2017/jan/28/theresa-may-signs-100m-fighter-jet-deal-with-turkeys-erdogan>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** Travelers from Iran, Iraq, Libya, Somalia, Sudan, Syria, and Yemen are blocked from entering the United States as the executive order takes effect.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/28/us/refugees-detained-at-us-airports-prompting-legal-challenges-to-trumps-immigration-order.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-28-3-2"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** Iran says it will take reciprocal action after U.S. President Donald Trump signed the executive order which limits immigration from seven Muslim-majority countries, including Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/01/28/middleeast/iran-will-ban-us-citizens/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Judge Ann Donnelly in New York grants a stay of the executive order that allows people with valid visas who landed in the U.S. to temporarily remain in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://live.reuters.com/Event/Election_2016>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/01/28/aclu-mounts-legal-challenge-to-trumps-refugee-ban-calling-it-unlawful.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/1b76c00a59a64cc78e23cc2dec7762ff/us-judge-bars-deportations-under-trump-travel-ban>).

<a id="event-2017-01-28-3-5"></a>

Context: Silvio Berlusconi prostitute trial.

**Archived source account.** An Italian court orders former Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi to stand trial on April 4 on charges of allegedly bribing witnesses with €10 million (US$11 million) in order to silence them over accusations he paid for sex with young women.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-berlusconi-idUSKBN15C0HO>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2017-01-28-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Australian Open.

**Archived source account.** Serena Williams defeats her sister Venus Williams 6-4, 6-4 to win the women's singles and an Open era-record 23rd Grand Slam singles title.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2017/jan/28/serena-williams-venus-australian-open-record-23rd-grand-slam-title>).

### 2017-01-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1089146827](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%2029&oldid=1089146827>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-29-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present) / Yakla raid.

**Archived source account.** A U.S. military raid takes place in Yemen's southern Al Bayda Governorate. According to medics on the scene as reported by Reuters, "around 30" were killed, among which were at least three senior Al-Qaeda members, at least one U.S. service member, and 10 women and children.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-yemen-qaeda-idUSKBN15D08J>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jan/29/al-qaida-suspects-yemen-killed-raid-us-commandos>).

<a id="event-2017-01-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Siege of Wadi Barada.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Army recaptures all of the towns and villages in the Barada river valley near Damascus from rebel forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/syrian-army-captures-wadi-barada-170129131830656.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-29-0-6"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the North Caucasus.

**Archived source account.** At least three suspected militants are killed by Russian security forces during a firefight in Khasavyurt, Dagestan.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/three-suspected-militants-killed-daghestan/28265863.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-29-0-8"></a>

Context: Quebec City mosque shooting.

**Archived source account.** A gunman opens fire at a mosque in Quebec City, Canada, during evening prayers. At least five people were killed. Two suspects were apprehended; one was later released.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/quebec-city-mosque-gun-shots-1.3957686>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-mosque-shooting-idUSKBN15E04S?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** U.S. federal judges in the states of Massachusetts, Virginia, and Washington sign orders halting implementation of parts of the executive order.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/politics/federal-judges-pile-orders-opposing-trump-travel-bans-article-1.2958793>); [Reuters](<http://www.news.com.au/world/breaking-news/trumps-ban-to-stay-homeland-security/news-story/cf3f80c08778592a6b90b66ac80c70a4>).

<a id="event-2017-01-29-1-2"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** White House Chief of Staff Reince Priebus states that people from the affected countries who have been lawfully admitted for permanent residence, i.e. have a green card, will not be prevented from returning to the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/29/us/politics/white-house-official-in-reversal-says-green-card-holders-wont-be-barred.html?&amp;hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=span-ab-top-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-01-29-1-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** In the largest protest since the 1989 Revolution, more than 90,000 people march through Romania's capital and other cities against a government proposal to pardon thousands of prisoners.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Review](<http://www.business-review.eu/news/massive-protests-in-romania-over-draft-pardon-bill-changes-to-penal-code-for-second-sunday-in-a-row-129252>); [Digi24](<http://www.digi24.ro/stiri/actualitate/justitie/legea-gratierii/proteste-anuntate-in-bucuresti-si-in-alte-5-orase-658415>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-29-2-1"></a>

Context: French Socialist Party presidential primary, 2017.

**Archived source account.** In the second round run-off to select the Socialist Party's candidate in this year's spring presidential election, the leftist candidate, former Minister of National Education Benoît Hamon, topped former Prime Minister Manuel Valls, a centrist, with 58.65 percent of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170129180500/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/valls-hamon-french-socialists-presidential-primary-45120240>); [Yahoo\! News](<https://sg.news.yahoo.com/leftwinger-hamon-wins-french-socialist-primary-party-sources-194618879.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2017-01-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Australian Open.

**Archived source account.** In tennis, Roger Federer of Switzerland defeats Rafael Nadal of Spain in the final of the men's singles.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-01-29/australian-open-federer-vs-nadal-tipped-as-biggest-ever/8221504>).

### 2017-01-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1210193260](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%2030&oldid=1210193260>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-30-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** The Ukrainian military says seven soldiers have been killed by pro-Russian separatists since Sunday. The separatists report over 5 days of artillery attacks on them by the Ukrainian side.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukriane-crisis-casualties-idUSKBN15E0QS>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Russian military intervention.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Defence Ministry says six Russian bombers hit ISIL positions in Syria's Deir ez-Zor Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-russia-bombers-idUSKBN15E1KN>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the North Caucasus.

**Archived source account.** At least two police officers and three suspected militants are killed during a gunfight in Shali, Chechnya.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/chechnya-police-militants-killed-kadyrov-rashidov-shali/28267313.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A suspected U.S. drone strike kills two al-Qaida militants in central Shabwa province, according to Yemeni security and tribal officials.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/84826a60ddb1489199ac6ed1458afa25/suspected-us-drone-kills-2-alleged-al-qaida-yemen-fighters>); [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/united-states-yemen-suspected-drone-1.3957800>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-0-8"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces attack a Royal Saudi Navy frigate off the coast of Yemen in the Red Sea, killing at least two sailors and wounding three others.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/01/30/iran-backed-houthi-rebels-attack-saudi-warship-in-red-sea.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-0-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people, including politicians and activists, gather for the funeral of Ko Ni, Myanmar leader Aung San Suu Kyi's longtime adviser, who was assassinated yesterday as he walked out of the Yangon International Airport.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/dd5865de5474411397939cb1d3b59ffc/myanmar-ruling-party-mourns-assassination-suu-kyi-adviser>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/mourners-gather-funeral-myanmar-lawyer-shot-dead-170130112227798.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-0-11"></a>

Context: Quebec City mosque shooting.

**Archived source account.** French-Canadian student Alexandre Bissonnette is charged with six counts of murder and five counts of attempted murder in relation to an attack on a mosque in Quebec City.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters/AP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-01-31/quebec-city-mosque-shooting-lone-wolf-attack-student-charged/8225294>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-01-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Miss Universe 2016.

**Archived source account.** Iris Mittenaere, winner of Miss France 2016, is crowned as the winner of Miss Universe 2016 at a ceremony in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_MISS_UNIVERSE_PAGEANT_ASOL-?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2017-01-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Walgreens Boots Alliance reduces its offer price for Rite Aid and defers the expected closing date by six months due to concerns about regulatory approval.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/30/business/dealbook/walgreens-rite-aid-merger.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-rite-aid-m-a-walgreens-boots-idUSKBN15E1HU>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-01-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Several avalanches in Gorno-Badakhshan, Tajikistan, caused by heavy snowfall over the weekend, leave at least seven people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-avalanches-7-dead/28267476.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-01-30-4-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A petition, launched Sunday to cancel U.S. President Donald Trump's state visit to the United Kingdom later this year, tops 1 million signatures, passing the threshold for British Parliament debate. A British government spokesman says the state visit is going ahead as planned.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/petition-ban-trump-s-state-visit-uk-reaches-1m-signatures-n714021>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-4-3"></a>

Context: Iraq–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi Parliament votes in favour of a reciprocal travel ban on U.S. citizens if U.S. President Donald Trump's executive order barring citizens of Iraq and six other Muslim-majority countries is not reversed. The Iraqi travel ban will not be implemented while tens of thousands of U.S. soldiers and contractors are involved in the fight against ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-4171940/Iraq-parliament-votes-favour-travel-ban-US.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte suspends the war on drugs so resources can focus on ridding “corrupt” officers from the Philippine National Police. The cause célèbre is the kidnapping and strangulation of South Korean businessman Jee Ick-joo last October.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/01/30/duterte-has-suspended-war-drugs-can-hunt-corrupt-police-officers/>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-5-3"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian police arrest EBX Group CEO Eike Batista for allegedly bribing officials in Rio de Janeiro, including former Governor of Rio de Janeiro Sérgio Cabral Filho.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-38796393>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-5-5"></a>

Context: 2016 Turkish coup d'état attempt.

**Archived source account.** In Ankara, the Turkish government opens the trial of 270 suspects charged in July's failed coup in Ankara. The defendants include, in absentia, the alleged mastermind Fethullah Gülen, former NATO Chief of Staff Major General Salih Sevil, and other high-ranking military officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/turkey-puts-gulen-269-others-trial-over-coup-110730149.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-30-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Gambian President Adama Barrow removes "Islamic" from the country's official name. The Gambia will now officially be called The Republic of The Gambia. Barrow also vows to reform the National Intelligence Agency, accused by human rights groups of forced disappearances and torture under Yahya Jammeh.

Source citations (as archived): [All Africa](<http://allafrica.com/stories/201701300021.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-6-2"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** White House Press Secretary Sean Spicer, during the daily press briefing, says State Department officials should follow the President's program or get new jobs.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.reviewjournal.com/news/politics-and-government/us-diplomats-challenge-trump-travel-ban>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/30/politics/career-diplomats-dissent-memo/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/30/us/politics/trump-immigration-ban-memo.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-01-30-6-3"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** Sally Yates, the acting Attorney General of the United States, is fired after ordering employees of the United States Department of Justice not to enforce the President's ban due to personal doubts over its legality. Dana J. Boente becomes the new acting attorney general.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-38805944>).

### 2017-01-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256519613](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20January%2031&oldid=1256519613>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-01-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian opposition agrees to surrender their remaining villages in the stretch between the Wadi Barada area and the Lebanon-Syria border, as well as the Rankous borderange for transportation of at least 250 rebel fighters to their stronghold in the Idlib Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/jihadist-rebels-surrender-lebanese-border-points-syrian-army/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-01-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** agrees to ban the full-face veil (burqa and niqāb) in public spaces, part of a larger deal struck by the center-left Social Democratic Party and the center-right Austrian People's Party to avoid the collapse of the ruling coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38808495>); [The Christian Science Monitor](<http://www.csmonitor.com/World/2017/0131/Why-Austria-joins-other-European-nations-in-banning-the-full-face-veil>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2017-01-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Consultancy PwC says that global banks with business both in London and on the European continent must plan for a hard Brexit that entails a break with many of the benefits of the Euro system, and a short transition period.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-banks-idUSKBN15F1XQ>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-01-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Enlargement of the African Union.

**Archived source account.** Morocco rejoins the African Union after a 33-year absence, despite opposition from several member states over the political status of Western Sahara.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/morocco-rejoins-african-union-33-years-170131084926023.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-31-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** White House National Trade Council director Peter Navarro says Germany exploits other countries with a "grossly undervalued" euro. German Chancellor Angela Merkel rejects the allegation.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2017-01-31/trump-adviser-blasts-germany-for-exploiting-undervalued-euro>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/01/31/euro-spikes-after-trumps-trade-adviser-tells-ft-that-germany-is-using-grossly-undervalued-currency.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-01-31-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Susan Kiefel is sworn in as the first female Chief Justice of Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio National](<http://www.abc.net.au/radionational/programs/lawreport/2017-01-31/8222950>).

<a id="event-2017-01-31-4-2"></a>

Context: Alan Turing law.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom posthumously pardons around 49,000 gay and bisexual men found guilty of decades-old sodomy laws in England and Wales. Those still living can apply for a statutory pardon.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-38814338>).

<a id="event-2017-01-31-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Kremlin arrests four people, Kaspersky Lab's Ruslan Stoyanov, and three officials in the Federal Security Service (FSB previously KGB) Center for Information Security, reportedly on treason charges for passing information to America's CIA.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/russian-spy-officials-accused-treason-working-cia-article-1.2960651>); [The Washington Times](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2017/jan/27/russian-treason-probe-results-arrests-fsb-official/?>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2017/01/25/world/europe/ap-eu-russia-cybersecurity.html>); [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/5355936ae6824ef4aaa045b9475065c3/reported-treason-arrests-fuel-russian-hacking-intrigue>).

<a id="event-2017-01-31-4-5"></a>

Context: 2008 Mumbai attacks.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan detains Hafiz Muhammad Saeed, the suspected mastermind of the 2008 attacks in the Indian city. Saeed, co-founder of the active terrorist organization Lashkar-e-Taiba, is being held under house arrest in Lahore in Pakistan's Punjab Province. Four other men are also under house arrest in the area.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/31/asia/hafiz-saeed-house-arrest-pakistan/>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/01/pakistan-hafiz-saeed-house-arrest-170130190123170.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-01-31-5-2"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump / Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate confirms former U.S. labor secretary and deputy transportation secretary Elaine Chao as Secretary of Transportation. Chao is married to Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/trafficandcommuting/trumps-transportation-secretary-pick-elaine-chao-confirmed-in-senate-with-some-top-democrats-balking/2017/01/31/a15c7604-df42-11e6-ad42-f3375f271c9c_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-31-5-4"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump / Supreme Court of the United States.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump has nominated Judge Neil Gorsuch to fill the vacant seat on the Supreme Court of the United States. Neil Gorsuch is the youngest nominee to the court in 25 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/01/31/politics/donald-trump-supreme-court-nominee/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-31-5-6"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump / Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** The State Department memorandum about concerns with this travel ban is submitted to acting Secretary of State Tom Shannon through the federal government's Dissent Channel. This protest memo had between 900-1,000 signatures. Department officials said these signatures are far more than any dissent cable in recent years, adding more diplomats want to add their names to it.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/01/31/world/americas/state-dept-dissent-cable-trump-immigration-order.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=a-lede-package-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;_r=0>); [Reuters and AFP-JIJI](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2017/02/01/world/politics-diplomacy-world/900-state-department-officials-sign-unprecedented-protest-memo-travel-ban/#.WJGG0oWcHIU>); [Voice of America](<http://www.voanews.com/a/over-a-thousand-state-dept-personnel-officially-dissent-to-immigration-order/3700399.html>).

<a id="event-2017-01-31-5-8"></a>

Context: 2017 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** Despite massive protests in recent days, Romania's government adopts an emergency ordinance to decriminalize some graft offences.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-romania-government-corruption-idUSKBN15F29F>).


## February

### 2017-02-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1173402141](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%201&oldid=1173402141>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2017-02-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four alleged extremists planning terror attacks in Azerbaijan are killed in a shootout with the country's security forces; one suspect is arrested. The State Security Service says the group was connected to an unspecified religious extremist group abroad.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-azerbaijan-security-idUSKBN15G40H?il=0>); [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/azerbaijan-four-terrorists-killed-shootout/28271554.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-02-01-1-1"></a>

Context: European Union roaming regulations.

**Archived source account.** Negotiators reach a preliminary deal on capping mobile phone intercarrier (wholesale) tariffs. Roaming charges on voice and data calls for consumers within the EU are expected to be terminated on June 15, 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-telecoms-roaming-idUSKBN15G2YB>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-02-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** According to a report released by Malegapuru William Makgoba, 94 mentally ill patients in South Africa died from starvation, dehydration and diarrhea between March and December 2016 because of a "reckless" government attempt to save money by transferring the patients from a specialized institution to care centres with "invalid licenses".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/38826196>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-02-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iranian Minister of Defence Hossein Dehghan confirms Iran tested a new missile, claiming that the test did not violate the 2015 nuclear deal nor UN resolution 2231.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-iran-missiles-idUSKBN15G3ZO>); [PressTV](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170203220446/http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2017/02/01/508673/Iran-Dehqan-Resolution-2231-JCPOA>).

<a id="event-2017-02-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel announces it will build an entirely new settlement in the West Bank for the first time in about twenty years. Many in the international community believe that such settlements are illegal but Israel disputes that. The settlement program is illegal under international law.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/02/01/middleeast/israel-settlements-approved/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's House of Commons backs the Brexit bill by 498 votes to 114.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/british-lawmakers-give-theresa-may-the-go-ahead-to-trigger-brexit-talks/2017/02/01/3476cbfc-e825-11e6-903d-9b11ed7d8d2a_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israeli security forces begin evicting people from the illegal Amona, Mateh Binyamin, outpost built on private Palestinian-owned land near Ramallah in the central West Bank. The Supreme Court ordered residents to leave the area last year.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/02/01/middleeast/israel-settlements-approved/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-01-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A jury finds in favor of video game publisher ZeniMax Media after the trial of its copyright lawsuit against Oculus and Facebook, regarding virtual reality coding..

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/facebook-lawsuit-idUSL1N1FM229>).

<a id="event-2017-02-01-4-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Berkeley protests.

**Archived source account.** Police cancel a scheduled appearance of right-wing provocateur Milo Yiannopoulos on UC Berkeley due to hundreds of violent protesters on campus.

Source citations (as archived): [San Francisco Chronicle](<http://www.sfgate.com/bayarea/article/Protesters-storm-Milo-Yiannopoulos-event-at-UC-10901829.php>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Formation of Donald Trump's cabinet.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate, in a 56–43 vote, confirms Rex Tillerson's nomination as United States Secretary of State.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/rex-tillerson-secretary-of-state-senate-confirms-exxon-mobil-russia-oil-climate-change-sanctions-a7558231.html>).

### 2017-02-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076115682](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%202&oldid=1076115682>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-02-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Georgia–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament unanimously approves visa-free regime in the Schengen zone for Georgia.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/georgia-european-parliament-approves-visa-liberalization/28275007.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-02-0-3"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of the Treasury eases some sanctions on the Federal Security Service (FSB), allowing for limited transactions with the intelligence agency. The sanctions were put in place last year by Barack Obama over alleged Russian interference in the 2016 U.S. election.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cyber-russia-idUSKBN15H244>).

<a id="event-2017-02-02-0-5"></a>

Context: Australia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Citing unnamed U.S. officials, The Washington Post reports that U.S. President Donald Trump berated Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull. Trump claimed it was "the worst call by far" and criticized a refugee settlement deal organised between the Turnbull Government and the Obama administration in late 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/no-gday-mate-on-call-with-australian-pm-trump-badgers-and-brags/2017/02/01/88a3bfb0-e8bf-11e6-80c2-30e57e57e05d_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-02-0-6"></a>

Context: Australia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** White House Press Secretary Sean Spicer says the U.S. is still planning on carrying through with the refugee resettlement deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg Politics](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2017-02-03/trump-sends-top-aides-to-placate-australia-after-testy-call>).

<a id="event-2017-02-02-0-8"></a>

Context: Israel–United States relations, Israeli–Palestinian peace process.

**Archived source account.** The White House cautions Israel that building new settlements or expanding existing settlements in the West Bank, "... may not be helpful in achieving (peace)."

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/u-s-warns-israel-stop-announcing-new-west-bank-settlements-n716231>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-38850975>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former HBOS manager Lynden Scourfield and other bankers and consultants are found guilty of corruption and abuse of power in stealing £245 million from the bank and small businesses in a loans scam, which was spent on personal luxuries. Scourfield was sentenced to 11 years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2017/feb/02/hbos-manager-and-other-city-financiers-jailed-over-245m-loans-scam>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Colombian peace process.

**Archived source account.** The National Liberation Army releases former congressman Odin Sanchez, who had been held hostage by the rebel group since April 2016, paving the way for peace talks to begin between the rebels and the Colombian government next week in Ecuador.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-38846925>).

### 2017-02-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1340238060](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%203&oldid=1340238060>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-03-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** According to Afghan Police, eight of their forces have been killed by the Taliban at a checkpoint in Faryab Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/afghanistan-taliban-attacks-faryab/28277153.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** At least 47 ISIL militants have been killed by Turkish and U.S.-led bombing raids by fighter jets on the town of al-Bab in the last 24 hours, with the Turkish Armed Forces attacking 135 other ISIL targets in northern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/turkey-coalition-jets-kill-47-isil-fighters-170203064906271.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** Activists say U.S.-led coalition aircraft has destroyed the main pipeline supplying the de facto ISIL capital Al-Raqqah with water.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2017/02/03/world/middleeast/ap-ml-syria.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-0-6"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Rohingya persecution in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Human Rights Council releases a report detailing mass atrocities by the military and police forces against Myanmar's Rohingya minority, including gang-rapes, mass killings, and possible ethnic cleansing, which could amount to crimes against humanity.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-38858655>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/rohingyas-killed-myanmar-crackdown-170203101817841.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-02-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster.

**Archived source account.** According to Tokyo Electric Power Company, radiations levels within one of the reactors of Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, damaged by an earthquake and tsunami in 2011, are at its highest level since experiencing a meltdown, with a reading of 530 sieverts an hour.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2017/feb/03/fukushima-daiichi-radiation-levels-highest-since-2011-meltdown>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations and various humanitarian groups call on the international community to help prevent a possible famine in Somalia as rising food prices and drought have left over six million people at risk of starvation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2017/feb/03/somalia-famine-fears-un-call-immediate-massive-reaction>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-02-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of the Treasury announces new sanctions against Iran in response to the latter's recent ballistic missile test. Thirteen people and twelve entities with ties to Iran have been affected.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/iran-us-new-sanctions-treasury-missile-test/28277671.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-2-2"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** In retaliation for the recent travel ban, Iran bars the United States' athletes from the 2017 Wrestling World Cup - Men's freestyle tournament to be held in Kermanshah.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/iran-bars-us-wrestlers-from-tournament-in-response-to-trumps-travel-ban/2017/02/03/234c4e88-ea28-11e6-80c2-30e57e57e05d_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-2-4"></a>

Context: Peru–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Peruvian President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski's government creates a temporary visa for thousands of Venezuelans whose country is mired in a deep economic crisis. Visa holders will be able to study, work, and receive health services in Peru for a year. "This is part of our migratory policy that aims to build bridges not walls", says Interior Minister Carlos Basombrio.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-peru-venezuela-idUSKBN15I2OL?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Per the Afghan government's request, the United Nations drops sanctions against Hezb-e Islami party leader and former Prime Minister Gulbuddin Hekmatyar. This potentially sets up his return to Afghanistan, which is part of the country's peace deal with its second largest militant group, signed in September 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-hekmatyar-idUSKBN15J08C>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-37438674>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Australia rules that Rod Culleton was ineligible for election as a candidate for Pauline Hanson's One Nation Party in Western Australia in the Federal election and is ineligible to serve in the Senate of Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [Canberra Times](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170202235508/http://www.canberratimes.com.au/federal-politics/political-news/rodney-culleton-was-never-elected-to-senate-high-court-rules-20170202-gu4kfu.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Paris machete attack.

**Archived source account.** A French Army soldier shoots and wounds a man armed with a knife who was trying to enter an underground shopping area near the Louvre in Paris. The museum was evacuated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38853841#>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-4"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension.

**Archived source account.** United States federal judge James Robart temporarily blocks the so-called travel ban nationwide pending a legal challenge by the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-immigration-idUSKBN15I1CM?il=0>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/u-s-judge-temporarily-blocks-trump-immigration-order-nationwide-n716706>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-5"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension / United States federal judge James Robart temporarily blocks the so-called travel ban nationwide pending a legal challenge by the government..

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Customs and Border Protection agency tells U.S. airlines that they should board travelers who had been blocked by the executive order addressed in Judge Robart's ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<http://globalnews.ca/news/3227202/us-airlines-free-to-board-travellers-previously-barred-by-trump-travel-ban/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/02/03/us/visa-ban-legal-challenge.html?_r=0>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/feb/03/trump-travel-ban-temporarily-blocked-nationwide>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-6"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension / United States federal judge James Robart temporarily blocks the so-called travel ban nationwide pending a legal challenge by the government..

**Archived source account.** The justice department says it will not file for an emergency stay on Friday night.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/feb/03/trump-travel-ban-temporarily-blocked-nationwide>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-immigration-justice-idUSKBN15J06Y>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-7"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension.

**Archived source account.** A lawyer for the Justice Department, in a federal court in Virginia, says 100,000 visas have been revoked this week. A State Department spokesperson says the actual number is fewer than 60,000.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/over-100-000-visas-have-been-revoked-immigration-ban-justice-n716121>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-8"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension.

**Archived source account.** Former Norwegian Prime Minister Kjell Magne Bondevik says he was detained at Dulles Airport earlier this week because he had visited Iran in 2014. A Lutheran minister, Mr. Bondevik was in Washington for meetings associated with the National Prayer Breakfast.

Source citations (as archived): [The Nordic Page](<http://www.tnp.no/norway/panorama/5453-former-prime-minister-of-norway-held-back-at-us-airport>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/02/03/world/europe/kjell-magne-bondevik-norway-dulles.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-10"></a>

Context: Political appointments of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** West Point graduate, billionaire businessman, and philanthropist Vincent Viola withdraws his name from consideration as Secretary of the Army because of Defense Department rules concerning his family businesses.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-army-idUSKBN15J06G>); [Military Times](<http://www.militarytimes.com/articles/trump-viola-withdraws-army-secretary>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-army-idUSKBN15J06G>).

<a id="event-2017-02-03-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Citing court rulings and privacy laws, the United States Department of Agriculture stops making its records of animal abuse available to the public online, which makes them available exclusively through Freedom of Information Act requests. It has not yet been revealed whether another Agency will now be responsible for the keeping and public hosting of such records.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/animalia/wp/2017/02/03/the-usda-abruptly-removes-animal-welfare-information-from-its-website/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Australia–United States relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-australia-refugees-idUSKBN15J0AG?il=0>); [The Washington Examiner](<http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/australia-sticking-to-refugee-deal-despite-trumps-criticism/article/2613913>).

<a id="event-2017-02-04-1-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** Romanian Prime Minister Sorin Grindeanu announces that his government will scrap its proposed decree of decriminalizing some graft offenses on Sunday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-romania-corruption-pm-decree-idUSKBN15J0SG>).

<a id="event-2017-02-04-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations drop sanctions on Gulbuddin Hekmatyar after his Hezb-e Islami faction and the Afghan government reached a deal in September. Hekmatyar is granted immunity in exchange for his abandoning violence and supporting the Constitution of Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-38867280>).

<a id="event-2017-02-04-2-4"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension, State of Washington v. Trump.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Homeland Security says it has stopped enforcing the executive order per Judge James Robart's ruling in State of Washington v. Trump. The State Department activates visas that had been previously suspended because of this order.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/judge-halts-trump-travel-ban-banned-countries-citizens-able-board-n716801>).

<a id="event-2017-02-04-2-5"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension, State of Washington v. Trump.

**Archived source account.** The federal government notifies the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals that it will appeal Judge Robart's ruling that has halted enforcement of the executive order. The filing contained no legal arguments.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2017/02/04/trump-blasts-so-called-federal-judges-block-travel-ban/97484556/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-04-2-6"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension, State of Washington v. Trump.

**Archived source account.** Late Saturday, the Justice Department files a request to "immediately stay" Friday's court ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/justice-dept-appeals-have-court-restore-trump-travel-order-n716891>).

<a id="event-2017-02-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The cave squeaker (Arthroleptis troglodytes), a critically endangered species of frog, is located and captured for the first time since 1962. Scientists announce plans to breed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-military-strikes-idUSKBN15K0S9>); [Military Times](<http://www.militarytimes.com/articles/airstrikes-unreported-syria-iraq-afghanistan-islamic-state-al-qaeda-taliban>).

<a id="event-2017-02-05-2-7"></a>

**Editorial account; source review partial.** Official results give FBP nine seats, VU eight, DU five and FL three, with the listed seat changes and FL’s 1.5-point vote-share gain.

Editorial date: 2017-02-05. Checked: 2026-10-21. Partial: numerical results checked; the government-formation portion is not established by the results table alone.

Evidence: [Liechtenstein official election results](<https://www.landtagswahlen.li/resultat/10>).

Original source account: The Liechtenstein general election, 2017 took place in Liechtenstein resulting in a Progressive Citizens' Party and Patriotic Union coalition government under Prime Minister Adrian Hasler. The election left the Progressive Citizens' Party with only nine seats, one less than the previous election. The Patriotic Union kept all eight seats during the election. Gaining stature in the Landtag of Liechtenstein the Free List or FL held on to all three seats but rose 1.5%pp. With the Independents gaining one seat from the previous election leaving them at five.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-02-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Super Bowl LI.

**Archived source account.** The New England Patriots defeat the Atlanta Falcons 34–28, in the first game in Super Bowl history to go into overtime.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/02/05/sports/super-bowl-score-patriots-falcons.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-02-05-3-2"></a>

Context: Super Bowl LI.

**Archived source account.** Tom Brady, the quarterback for the New England Patriots, wins his fourth Most Valuable Player award, the most won by any player. Brady joins Charles Haley as the only players to be on five Super Bowl-winning teams.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC Sports](<http://profootballtalk.nbcsports.com/2017/02/05/tom-brady-wins-his-fourth-super-bowl-mvp-award/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-05-3-4"></a>

Context: In association football.

**Archived source account.** Cameroon wins the 2017 Africa Cup of Nations with a 2–1 victory over Egypt.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2017/feb/05/cameroon-v-egypt-afcon-2017-final-live-africa-cup-of-nations>).

### 2017-02-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076115526](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%206&oldid=1076115526>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** An Egyptian Army raid in central Sinai kills at least 14 ISIL militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-insurgency-sinai-idUSKBN15L154>).

<a id="event-2017-02-06-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Afghan diplomat is shot dead at the Afghan consulate in Karachi, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-afghanistan-shooting-idUSKBN15L0RN>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-02-06-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Queen Elizabeth II marks her 65th anniversary as sovereign, making her the only British monarch to commemorate a Sapphire Jubilee.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-royals-queen-sapphire-idUSKBN15L005>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-02-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** South Korea's Agricultural Ministry confirms a case of foot-and-mouth disease at a dairy farm in Boeun County. This is the first instance of this disease in the country since March 29, 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [The Korea Times](<https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/www/nation/2017/02/119_223321.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Brazilian President Michel Temer deploys the Brazilian Army to the southeastern state of Espírito Santo, where a police strike has led to a wave of violence and looting, including dozens of murders in the state capital, Vitória.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-violence-espirito-santo-idUSKBN15L26A>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/feb/06/brazil-police-strike-crimewave-troops-espirito-santo>).

<a id="event-2017-02-06-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel passes the Regulation Law which retroactively legalizes 4,000 housing units in 16 settlements on Area C West Bank occupied Palestinian territories.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/02/06/world/middleeast/israel-settlement-law-palestinians-west-bank.html?_r=0>); [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/Politics-And-Diplomacy/Knesset-passes-historic-Settlements-Bill-480768>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Representative Matt Gaetz proposes a bill to eliminate the United States Environmental Protection Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/energy-environment/317203-lawmaker-to-propose-abolishing-epa>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-02-06-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A herd of Plains bison are successfully reintroduced to the Banff National Park in Alberta, Canada, more than 100 years after they were nearly hunted out of existence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-38888269>).

### 2017-02-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1363907797](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%207&oldid=1363907797>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-07-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing at the Supreme Court of Afghanistan in Kabul kills at least 20 people and injures 41 others, 10 of whom are in critical condition.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-38893926>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/suicide-bomber-strikes-afghan-supreme-court-killing-19-people-n718126>).

<a id="event-2017-02-07-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A report by Amnesty International states that between 5,000 and 13,000 people, most of them civilians, were hanged at the military-run Sednaya Prison near Damascus between September 2011 and December 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-38885901>).

<a id="event-2017-02-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, airstrikes on the rebel-held city of Idlib kill at least 26 people, with the death toll expected to rise.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/intense-raids-kill-dozens-syria-idlib-170207131816939.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-07-0-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Coalition troops take control of the strategic Yemeni port city of Mocha after driving out Houthi forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-idUSKBN15M2FI>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-02-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Multiple tornadoes tear through New Orleans, Baton Rouge, and other parts of southeastern Louisiana, injuring at least 20 people; no deaths have been reported. The severe weather also delivers heavy rain and hail in Mississippi and Alabama.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/a4d2d8f9dd0e45c6bb94321dbe109ce7/tornado-warnings-issued-louisiana-and-mississippi>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/louisiana-tornado-idUSL1N1FS1GZ>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former President of France Nicolas Sarkozy is ordered to stand trial for alleged campaign finance fraud during his failed 2012 presidential election campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/02/07/former-french-president-sarkozy-to-face-trial-for-fraud.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-07-2-2"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension.

**Archived source account.** The Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals holds a hearing, by telephone, for the U.S. Justice Department and plaintiffs (states of Washington and Minnesota) arguments whether or not to reinstate the travel ban suspended on Friday by U.S. District Court Judge James Robart. Judge Michelle Friedland states the court will work to deliver its decision quickly.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/opposition-to-trump-travel-ban-grows-as-key-court-decision-looms/2017/02/06/d766ec7c-ec74-11e6-9662-6eedf1627882_story.html>); [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/appeals-court-travel-ban-trump-live-updates/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-07-2-4"></a>

Context: Women in Russia.

**Archived source account.** President of Russia Vladimir Putin signs into law the decriminalization of domestic violence.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/02/07/europe/russia-domestic-violence-bill-putin>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Australian Senator Cory Bernardi defects from the centre-right Liberal Party of Australia to establish his own minor party, the Australian Conservatives.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-02-07/cory-bernardi-formally-quits-liberal-party/8247402>).

<a id="event-2017-02-07-3-2"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate confirms, via Vice President Mike Pence's unprecedented tie-breaking vote, Betsy DeVos as Secretary of Education.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/ed/2017/02/07/513739920/betsy-devos-confirmed-as-education-secretary>); [NPR²](<https://www.npr.org/2017/02/07/513836576/pence-becomes-first-vp-to-break-senate-tie-over-cabinet-nomination>).

<a id="event-2017-02-07-3-3"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate votes, along party lines (49-43), to not let Senator Elizabeth Warren participate in the debate about Senator Jeff Sessions's nomination to be the Attorney General in President Donald Trump's Cabinet because she violated Senate rule XIX when she was reading letters from the late Coretta Scott King and the late Senator Ted Kennedy that were critical of Sen. Sessions, thereby impugning his character.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/powerpost/wp/2017/02/07/republicans-vote-to-rebuke-elizabeth-warren-for-impugning-sessionss-character/?tid=a_inl>).

### 2017-02-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256519631](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%208&oldid=1256519631>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-08-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Donetsk People's Republic commander Mikhail Tolstykh, better known by his nom de guerre "Givi", is killed in a bomb blast in Makiivka, Donetsk Oblast. DPR officials blame the Security Service of Ukraine for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-38905110>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Six Afghan Red Cross workers are shot dead by suspected ISIL militants in the northern Jowzjan Province. Two other Red Cross workers are reportedly abducted.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-38908312>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-0-5"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** Unknown gunmen storm a hotel in Bosaso, leaving at least four guards and two militants dead. It is unclear who carried out the attack. An official blames Al-Shabaab, though the group denies having any involvement.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/gunmen-kill-guards-attack-somalia-puntland-170208094641090.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian rebels, with backing from the Turkish Armed Forces, advance on ISIL-held al-Bab, capturing the outskirts of the town.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-albab-idUSKBN15N0RO>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-0-9"></a>

Context: Yemeni War.

**Archived source account.** Yemen reassesses its permission to the United States to run special operations ground missions against suspected terrorist groups because of the civilian deaths in the January 29 raid. Earlier reports indicated permission had been suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/02/07/world/middleeast/yemen-special-operations-missions.html?_r=0>); [The New York Times²](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/02/08/world/middleeast/yemen-raid-american-military.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-02-08-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists from the Hebrew University of Jerusalem announce the discovery of another cave that used to have Dead Sea Scrolls.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/new-dead-sea-scroll-cave-found-near-qumran-but-scrolls-are-gone/>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2017-02-08-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia blocks health insurer Anthem Inc.'s proposed $54 billion merger with rival Cigna because it would have exacerbated an already highly concentrated market and likely raised prices.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/cigna-ma-anthem-idUSL1N1FU057>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-02-08-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 10,000 people are left homeless after a fire ravages a densely populated neighborhood of the Philippines capital Manila.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/02/08/shanty-town-fire-philippines-leaves-15000-homeless/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-08-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Turkish purges.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish government dismisses more than 4,400 public servants from their jobs in the latest purge within the country following a failed coup attempt last year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/feb/08/turkey-dismisses-4400-public-servants-erdogan-trump-phone-call>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** The government of Prime Minister of Romania Sorin Grindeanu survives a no-confidence motion over proposed decriminalisation of certain corruption offences, with 161 MPs voting in favor of the motion, short of the 232 votes needed for it to pass.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_ROMANIA_POLITICS?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/sdp-led-government-survives-confidence-vote-170208140726449.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-5-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** Also that day, the Constitutional Court rejected two pleas made by President Iohannis and the Supreme Council of the Magistracy (CSM) that claimed an institutional conflict between the Parliament, respectively the CSM on one hand, and the Government on the other, in a move that surprised the critics of the PSD-led cabinet and the protesters. The next day it rejected the final plea made by the Ombudsman on reasons of inadmissibility.

Source citations (as archived): [The Romania Journal](<https://web.archive.org/web/20171014133909/http://www.romaniajournal.ro/constitutional-court-rejects-ombudsmans-appeal-over-eo-13/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-5-4"></a>

Context: Somali presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Somali politicians gather inside a high-security compound at Aden Adde International Airport in Mogadishu to elect a President for the country, with current president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud running for a second term.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/feb/08/somalia-goes-to-polls-president-mohamud>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-5-5"></a>

Context: Somali presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** In a surprise result, former Prime Minister Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed is chosen as President.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-38904663>).

<a id="event-2017-02-08-5-7"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate, in a 52 to 47 vote, confirms the nomination of Jeff Sessions as United States Attorney General.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/feb/08/jeff-sessions-confirmed-attorney-general-senate>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-02-08-6-1"></a>

Context: Intermediate-mass black hole and 47 Tucanae.

**Archived source account.** New strong evidence supporting the existence of an intermediate-mass black hole is announced.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky &amp; Telescope](<http://www.skyandtelescope.com/astronomy-news/best-evidence-yet-for-an-intermediate-mass-black-hole/>); [Science Daily](<https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2017/02/170208131755.htm>); [Nature](<http://www.nature.com/nature/journal/v542/n7640/full/nature21361.html>).

### 2017-02-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076115400](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%209&oldid=1076115400>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Battle of al-Bab.

**Archived source account.** At least three soldiers of the Turkish Armed Forces are accidentally killed by a Russian airstrike near al-Bab in northern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/russia-turkey-air-strike-soldiers-killed/28300387.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–present).

**Archived source account.** The International Committee of the Red Cross announces it will be temporarily halting some of its operations in Afghanistan after gunmen killed six of its workers yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/afghanistan-icrc-halts-operations-workers-killed-170209062643029.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An airstrike hits a tunnel in the Gaza Strip near the Egyptian border, killing at least two people and injuring five more. It is unclear who launched the airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/airstrike-gaza-strip-tunnel-kills-palestinians-170209080209947.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-02-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at the Flamanville Nuclear Power Plant in northwest France caused an explosion in a "non-nuclear" part of the station. One reactor was taken offline and five people were affected by fumes. The accident did not cause a radioactive leak.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/france-nuclear-plant-explosion-flamanvil-idINKBN15O16X>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-1-2"></a>

Context: February 2017 North American blizzard.

**Archived source account.** A major blizzard hits the northeastern United States, cancelling more than 2,400 flights.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/news/news/winter-storm-niko-impacts>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A power outage plunges the Belgian capital of Brussels into darkness.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-38927000>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-02-09-2-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump, the President of the United States, agrees to continue the One China Policy after a discussion with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/world/wp/2017/02/09/trump-agrees-to-follow-one-china-policy-in-a-call-with-president-xi-jinping-earlier-trump-questioned-that-bedrock-policy/?wpisrc=al_alert-COMBO-world%252Bnation>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-2-3"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** When Russian President Vladimir Putin, during the January telephone conversation with President Donald Trump, raised the possibility of extending the 2010 New START treaty that caps U.S. and Russian deployment of nuclear warheads, President Trump declined, stating that this treaty is a bad deal for the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-putin-idUSKBN15O2A5>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/national-security/318733-trump-denounced-arms-reduction-treaty-in-putin-call-report>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-09-3-1"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension.

**Archived source account.** The appeal of the Trump administration is denied as the 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals said it would not block a lower-court ruling that brought the president's executive order to a halt.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-38927175>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A high court in Kenya blocks a government bid to close the Dadaab refugee camp and repatriate over 260,000 Somali refugees back to Somalia. The government said it will appeal against the ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-38917681>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-4-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** Romanian Justice Minister Florin Iordache resigns after losing the support of Prime-Minister Sorin Grindeanu.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-romania-corruption-idUSKBN15O2HN?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-4-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** President of the Senate Călin Popescu-Tăriceanu notifies the Constitutional Court claiming a judicial conflict of a constitutional nature between the Government of Romania and the Public Ministry, through the National Anticorruption Directorate (DNA).

Source citations (as archived): [actmedia](<http://actmedia.eu/daily/president-of-the-senate-notifyed-the-constitutional-court-on-a-judicial-conflict-between-the-government-and-dna/67999>).

<a id="event-2017-02-09-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Democrat Congressman Jerrold Nadler files a Resolution of Inquiry motion aimed at clarifying Donald Trump's relationship to Russia as well as potential conflicts of interest arising from his businesses.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/powerpost/wp/2017/02/09/democrat-moves-to-force-house-debate-on-trumps-alleged-business-conflicts-and-russia-ties/>).

### 2017-02-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1355907446](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20February%2010&oldid=1355907446>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-10-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** French police arrest three men and a 16-year-old girl found with bomb-making materials in a Montpellier flat. The female suspect had been spotted online saying she wanted to either leave for the Syria-Iraq conflict or mount an attack in France, and recorded a video in which she pledged allegiance to ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-38930201>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In Hong Kong, over 16 were injured, and an incoherent man was charged with arson after an alleged firebomb attack on a rush hour Hong Kong metro commuter train. The man set fire to himself and others with a flammable liquid for an unspecified personal reason, but officials found no evidence of a terrorist motive.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/hong-kong-firebomb-arson-metro-commuters-rush-tsim-sha-tsui-cheung-kam-fai-a7576306.html>).

#### Business and economics

<a id="event-2017-02-10-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British consumer goods company Reckitt Benckiser agrees to buy U.S. baby formula maker Mead Johnson Nutrition for $16.6 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mead-johnson-m-a-reckitt-benc-grp-idUSKBN15P0MV>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-02-10-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least seven people have been killed in the Bangli Regency of Bali after a landslide caused by torrential rain.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-02-10/at-least-seven-killed-in-bali-landslide/8260104>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Volunteers are working to save the remaining live pilot whales beached at Farewell Spit on New Zealand's South Island. Project Jonah reports that 75 percent of the more than 400 stranded whales are dead.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/rescuers-fight-save-hundreds-pilot-whales-beached-new-zealand-n719206>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 6.5 magnitude earthquake strikes 14 kilometers (8 miles) northwest of Surigao City on the Philippines island of Mindanao and kills four people, injures more than 100 others, and damages multiple buildings.,

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fea9a634fc9e4c71897978beadc5de9f/67-magnitude-earthquake-shakes-southern-philippines>); [9news](<http://www.9news.com.au/world/2017/02/11/05/01/strong-6-5-magnitude-quake-shakes-southern-philippines-usgs>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-quake-philippines-damage-idUSKBN15Q01I?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 17 people are killed with dozens injured in a crowd stampede at a football stadium in Uíge, Angola.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/fdb15e13dbdb46dabf51307599ced9b2/17-killed-stampede-angolan-football-stadium>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Polish Prime Minister Beata Szydło is injured in a car crash in her hometown, Oświęcim, Poland. Mrs. Szydło is in good condition in a Warsaw hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/4e4e6e2e850040f3956d4137cd48854c/polish-pm-szydlo-car-accident-being-checked-doctors>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-02-10-3-1"></a>

Context: European Union–The Gambia relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union pledges to give the Gambia €225 million in aid to assist the country following the departure of former president Yahya Jammeh, whose 22 years of misrule left the country "virtually bankrupt".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2017/feb/10/european-union-eu-pledges-225m-rescue-package-newly-democratic-the-gambia-adama-barrow>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-02-10-4-1"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension legal challenges.

**Archived source account.** Aboard Air Force One, President Trump tells reporters he is considering issuing a revised policy banning citizens of certain countries traveling to the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-immigration-court-idUSKBN15O2XS>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-4-2"></a>

Context: U.S. immigration suspension legal challenges.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration decides to not immediately appeal the Ninth Circuit's decision, which continues the travel ban suspension, to the Supreme Court.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/02/10/politics/immigration-executive-order-white-house/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A judge in Peru issues an arrest warrant for former President Alejandro Toledo for allegedly receiving US$20 million in bribes from Odebrecht, a Brazilian construction company, in exchange for a contract deal to build a transoceanic highway between Brazil and the Peruvian coast. Toledo denies any wrongdoing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/feb/10/peru-ex-president-alejandro-toledo-faces-arrest-on-bribery-charges>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-02-10-5-1"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate, in a 52 to 47 vote, confirms physician and U.S. Representative Tom Price to be Secretary of Health and Human Services.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/tom-price-confirmed-as-secretary-of-health-and-human-services/>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran marks its 38th anniversary of the Iranian Revolution with nationwide rallies and ceremonies. The ceremony also contains some anti-Trump protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/02/10/world/middleeast/iran-revolution-anniversary.html?_r=0>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-iran-anniversary-idUSKBN15P0QV>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2017-02-10-6-1"></a>

Context: Doping in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian track and field athlete Mariya Savinova is banned by the Court of Arbitration for Sport from partaking in any sporting events for four years and is stripped of her gold medal that she won in the 800 metres at the 2012 Summer Olympics for doping between 2010 and 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<http://www.rferl.org/a/russia-runner-banned-loses-london-gold-800-meters/28302329.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-10-6-3"></a>

Context: Iditarod Trail Sled Dog Race.

**Archived source account.** The Iditarod Trail Committee announces the race's March official start has been moved from the Anchorage area northeast to Fairbanks, Alaska, due to low-snow conditions in the Alaska Range.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://bigstory.ap.org/article/37c6c7b162d84adf862cd0b0ee8fa0d5/low-snow-prompts-iditarod-move-races-start-fairbanks>); [Iditarod.com](<http://iditarod.com/restart-moved-to-fairbanks/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-02-11-0-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/02/syrian-rebels-turkish-troops-enter-isil-held-al-bab-170211141026318.html>).

<a id="event-2017-02-11-0-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Istanbul nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** Abdulkadir Masharipov is charged with murder in relation to the shootings in Istanbul that killed 39 people and is remanded in custody. Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant has claimed responsibility for the shootings.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-02-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Severe flooding following five days of incessant rain causes landslides that have killed 13 people in Indonesia's West Nusa Tenggara Province.
