Context: Shooting of Robert Godwin.

**Archived source account.** Steve Stephens, the suspected "Facebook killer" accused of killing 74-year-old Robert Godwin, kills himself after a brief pursuit with the Pennsylvania State Police.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/04/18/us/cleveland-facebook-killing-video/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-18-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people die in a shooting spree in downtown Fresno, California. The suspected gunman, who was already wanted for another murder four days earlier, and who expressed hatred of whites and the government, is arrested.

A two-thirds majority of the House of Commons is needed to approve this, eventually tomorrow. The Labour and Liberal Democrats party leaders have expressed their support.

The Russian Federal Security Service says the native 18-year-old perpetrator was a known member of a neo-nazi group.

### 2017-04-22

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-04-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis, while honoring Christians killed under Nazism, communism, dictatorships, and terrorism at Rome's Basilica of St. Bartholomew, adds to those named the wife of a Muslim he met in Lesbos, Greece, who was killed by terrorists because she wouldn't throw down her crucifix. Francis referred to the Lesbos camp as a 'concentration camp' noting, despite the good will of local communities, many refugee camps are overcrowded and little more than prisons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-martyrs-idUSKBN17O0MI>); [Catholic News Service](<http://www.catholicnews.com/services/englishnews/2017/pope-pays-tribute-to-modern-martyrs-calls-for-witnesses-of-gods-love.cfm>).

The American Airlines employee has been suspended.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/dr-gridlock/wp/2017/04/22/american-airlines-suspends-flight-attendant-after-video-captures-confrontation/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-american-airline-passenger-idUSKBN17O04Y>).

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia's King Salman issues a number of royal decrees, one which restores financial allowances for civil servants and military personnel that had been cut seven months ago in response to the drop in oil prices. \{\{Dead link\|date=May 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-economy-idUSKBN17O0NL>); [Yahoo\! Finance](<http://finance.yahoo.com/news/saudi-king-restores-bonuses-allowances-212846475.html>).

**Archived source account.** Dutch businessman Guus Kouwenhoven is found guilty of war crimes and arms trafficking for using his lumber business to sell weapons to Liberia's former president Charles Taylor during the country's civil war between 2000 and 2003 and is sentenced to 19 years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/law/2017/apr/22/dutch-arms-trafficker-to-liberia-guus-kouwenhoven-given-war-crimes-conviction>).

Context: 2017 French presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/france-presidential-campaigning-ends-with-security-concerns-after-shooting/a-38541530>); [UPI](<http://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2017/04/22/Overseas-polls-open-ahead-of-presidential-election-in-France/8301492882685/>).

Context: 2017 French presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/40196d9f917840aeb6efaf06b3300c78/Social-media-timeout-as-French-election-reaches-final-stage>).

<a id="event-2017-04-22-3-5"></a>

Context: Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** Dressed in white, the Venezuela opposition march, in silence, to the headquarters of the country's Catholic archdiocese to honor the more than a dozen people killed in three weeks of protests. For the first time, protesters were able to cross from the east to the western side of Caracas without being confronted by state security.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2017-04-22/venezuelans-march-in-memory-of-those-killed-in-unrest>); [AFP](<http://www.straitstimes.com/world/americas/venezuelans-stage-silent-protest-in-wave-of-unrest>).

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/today-is-britains-first-coal-free-day-since-industrial-revolution-10844972>).

**Archived source account.** The USS Michigan docks at Busan, South Korea, amid growing concerns over North Korean weapons development.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-39701481>).

<a id="event-2017-04-25-4-4"></a>

Context: Germany–Israel relations.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/newswires/news/national/israel-pm-cancels-talk-german-fm-rare-spat-ally-article-1.3097615>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-04-25-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** India is to provide every cow with a biometric dog tag, in an effort to prevent cattle smuggling.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/soon-aadhaar-like-id-for-cattle/articleshow/58352347.cms>).

<a id="event-2017-04-25-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States announced it will end a six-year Central-African hunt for Joseph Kony the following day.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170426143322/http://pulse.ng/world/joseph-kony-us-troops-end-hunt-for-lra-warlord-after-6-years-id6579489.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-25-5-3"></a>

Context: Gun politics in the United States.

**Archived source account.** An affiliate of the NRA sues California for alleged discrimination.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/04/25/nra-sues-california-over-gun-control-laws-that-demonize-firearm-owners.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-25-5-5"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Court Judge William Orrick rules that President Donald Trump's executive order withholding federal funds from sanctuary cities is unconstitutional.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/the-fix/wp/2017/04/25/california-is-in-a-war-with-trump-on-sanctuary-cities-and-it-just-won-its-first-major-battle/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-04-25-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In auto racing, longtime NASCAR Cup Series star Dale Earnhardt Jr. announces that he will retire at the end of the 2017 season.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/racing/nascar/cup/story/_/id/19238738/dale-earnhardt-jr-retire-2017-season>).

### 2017-04-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090241580](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20April%2026&oldid=1090241580>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-04-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** The pro-government Popular Mobilization Forces militia takes control of the mostly destroyed ancient city of Hatra in Iraq's Nineveh Governorate, following clashes with ISIL, who seized the ruins in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-39726244>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-0-3"></a>

Context: Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency.

**Archived source account.** At least ten Iranian border guards are killed in an ambush in the southeastern Sistan and Baluchestan Province on the border with Pakistan. Sunni militant group Jaish ul-Adl claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/apr/26/militants-kill-ten-iranian-border-guards-in-attack-on-frontier-with-pakistan>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-0-5"></a>

Context: Kamwina Nsapu rebellion.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations MONUSCO reports that 20 Chowe-Pende community members have been killed in clashes with the Lulua-Luba community in Kasaï-Central, Democratic Republic of Congo. \{\{Dead link\|date=August 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP by KoamTV](<http://www.koamtv.com/story/35254158/20-more-deaths-in-volatile-central-congo-un-mission-says>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/04/20-dead-kasai-lulua-luba-chowe-pende-feud-170426160217397.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-04-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** American film director Jonathan Demme, winner of the Academy Award for Best Director for The Silence of the Lambs, dies of complications from esophageal cancer.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/04/26/entertainment/jonathan-demme-death-trnd/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-04-26-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States deploys parts of its Terminal High Altitude Area Defense in South Korea amidst high tension caused by North Korea's escalation of its missile and nuclear weapons programs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/apr/26/us-installs-missile-defence-in-south-korea-site-amid-tensions-with-north>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-2-2"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** China's foreign minister Wang Yi calls for restraint and urges all sides to take part in the resumption of negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-china-idUSKBN17S1Y1>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-2-4"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-test-missile-launched-vandenberg-california-20170426-story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Venezuela says it will withdraw from the Organization of American States after the organization decided to call a meeting without Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/04/venezuela-organization-american-states-170426225132076.html>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/04/26/venezuela-quitting-oas-anger-pressure-political-crisis/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-04-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States ended a six-year Central-African hunt for Joseph Kony.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170426143322/http://pulse.ng/world/joseph-kony-us-troops-end-hunt-for-lra-warlord-after-6-years-id6579489.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in Anchorage, Alaska, confirm that James Dale Ritchie, killed by an Anchorage police officer whom Ritchie had tried to kill in the fall of 2016, was a serial killer who had used the same gun to kill 5 people, apparently at random. Two of the murders were double homicides, with some of the deaths occurring along Anchorage's expansive Tony Knowles Coastal Trail.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/alaska/articles/2017-04-26/police-link-anchorage-man-who-shot-officer-to-5-homicides>); [Alaska Public Radio Network](<http://www.alaskapublic.org/2017/04/26/anchorage-police-determine-one-man-responsible-for-5-killings-last-summer/>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** David Hittner, U.S. District Court Judge for the Southern District of Texas, rules ExxonMobil Corporation should pay a $19.95 million penalty for pollution from its Baytown, Texas, refining and chemical plant complex for 16,386 days of violations and 10 million pounds (4.5 Gg) of pollutants that were released in violation of operating permits between 2005 and 2013.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-refinery-pollution-exxon-penalty-idUSKBN17T08H>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-04-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two political parties with federal representation in Australia merge as the Australian Conservatives absorbs the Family First Party.

Source citations (as archived): [News.com.au](<http://www.news.com.au/national/politics/cory-bernardis-fledgling-australian-conservatives-party-to-merge-with-family-first/news-story/c63ca905b7d338ab2f3a0579f94253f3>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Moroccan Assembly of Representatives votes 208 to 91 in favor of approving of a coalition cabinet led by Saadeddine Othmani.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/04/26/morocco-parliament-approves-new-government-after-crisis.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-04-26-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A speculative study hypothesizes that a species of Homo may have lived in California 130,000 years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<http://news.nationalgeographic.com/2017/04/mastodons-americas-peopling-migrations-archaeology-science/>); [Ars Technica](<https://arstechnica.com/science/2017/04/unknown-humans-were-in-california-130000-years-ago-say-scientists/>).

<a id="event-2017-04-26-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Results, published in The Lancet medical journal, of the WOMAN (World Maternal Antifibrinolytic) international study that began in 2010, finds use of a cheap and widely available drug, tranexamic acid (Lysteda in the U.S. and Australia), could save the lives of thousands of women who die in childbirth from excessive bleeding. The medication is already in use for blood loss from major trauma, surgery, tooth removal, nose bleeds, and heavy menstruation.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/04/26/health/inexpensive-drug-prevents-deaths-in-new-mothers-study-finds.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2017/apr/26/cheap-widely-available-drug-could-stop-thousands-of-mothers-bleeding-to-death-tranexamic-acid#img-1>); [The Lancet](<http://thelancet.com/journals/lancet/article/PIIS0140-6736(17)30638-4/fulltext?elsca1=tlpr>).

### 2017-04-27

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports a large explosion near Damascus International Airport followed by a fire. The Syrian government says Israel struck the military site with several missiles. Israeli Intelligence Minister Yisrael Katz states that the strike "corresponds completely with Israel's policy".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-39728682>); [Wires](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/damascus-explosion-large-blast-fire-at-airport-20170427-gvtp9p.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-27-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Israeli Air Defense Command shoots down a Syrian Air Force drone using a MIM-104 Patriot missile.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<http://www.timesofisrael.com/patriot-missile-intercepts-drone-over-golan-heights/>).

<a id="event-2017-04-27-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-04-27-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Russian Navy spy ship sinks off the coast of Turkey after colliding with a Togo-flagged freighter. All 78 crew aboard the ship were safely evacuated, according to Turkish officials.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-39734998>).

<a id="event-2017-04-27-4-1"></a>

Context: South Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A South Korean adviser says it is "impossible" for South Korea to purchase the THAAD missile complex since control of its operation would remain with the United States. The remarks come after United States president Donald Trump suggested that South Korea pay for the $1 billion system.

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

<a id="event-2017-04-27-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenneth Williams is executed at the Cummins Unit, Arkansas, by injection of midazolam, marking the state's fourth execution within eight days before the drug passes its expiration date.

<a id="event-2017-04-27-5-3"></a>

Context: 2017 storming of Macedonian Parliament.

**Archived source account.** The Macedonian Parliament is stormed by protesters opposing the election of Talat Xhaferi, an ethnic Albanian, as Speaker of the Assembly.

### 2017-04-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090246514](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20April%2028&oldid=1090246514>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-04-28-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 6.8 earthquake strikes off the coast of Mindanao, Philippines triggering tsunami warnings.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/04/28/earthquake-measuring-72-hitsoff-mindanao-philippines/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-04-28-1-1"></a>

Context: Western Sahara conflict.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council extends the MINURSO mission for another year and attempts to restart Western Sahara peace process negotiations after both sides retracted their military from a standoff position in Guerguerat, near the border with Mauritania.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-western-sahara-idUSKBN17V05C?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-04-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2011 Helmand Province incident.

**Archived source account.** Sergeant Alexander Blackman, also known as Marine A, a Royal Marine who shot dead a wounded Taliban insurgent in 2011 during Operation Herrick, is released from HM Prison Erlestoke after serving more than three years of a seven-year sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-39740931>).

<a id="event-2017-04-28-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Richard Vallières, convicted of stealing 3,000 tonnes of maple syrup from a Federation of Quebec Maple Syrup Producers warehouse in 2012, is sentenced to eight years in prison and fined $9.4 million, adjustable to fourteen years on non-payment of the fine.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/montreal/richard-vallieres-sentencing-1.4090811>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-04-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Albanian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Ilir Meta is elected the new President of Albania, winning 87 votes out of 140 members of the Assembly.

<a id="event-2017-04-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Accession of Montenegro to NATO.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Montenegro votes 46–0 to ratify Montenegro's membership of NATO, while opposition politicians boycott the vote and hold protests.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170428155745/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/montenegro-vote-membership-nato-47076849>).

Context: Iranian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The first six-man televised debate is held, which focused mostly on social issues.

Source citations (as archived): [PressTV](<http://www.presstv.com/Detail/2017/04/28/519772/Iran-presidential-election-debate>); [Radio Free Europe](<http://www.rferl.org/a/iran-first-presidential-debate/28456950.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-28-3-7"></a>

Context: French presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Jean-François Jalkh, who replaced current presidential finalist Marine Le Pen as leader of the National Front, steps down from this role after three days following the reemergence of his comments questioning the logistics of Holocaust extermination camps, and is replaced by Steeve Briois.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2017-04-28/national-front-president-steps-down-after-death-camp-remarks>).

<a id="event-2017-04-28-3-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A general strike is held in Brazil, the first one in twenty years.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/mexico-americas/la-fg-brazil-strike-20170428-story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-04-28-3-10"></a>

Context: Georgia's 6th congressional district special election, 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2017/04/28/donald-trump-nra-speech-237759>).

<a id="event-2017-05-12-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A shooting attack at a nursing home in Kirkersville, Ohio, kills four people, including a police chief and the shooter.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170513015611/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/police-officer-shot-man-opens-fire-nursing-home-47370142>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Iranian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Candidates debate on live television with the rivals of frontrunner and current president, Hassan Rouhani, taking aim at his economic policies.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/politics/articles/2017-05-12/rouhani-fires-away-at-leading-rival-a-week-before-iran-election>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-05-12-5-1"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Premier League.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Chelsea have secured the Premier League title after winning away against West Bromwich Albion.

### 2017-05-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1366039205](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20May%2013&oldid=1366039205>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-05-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Balochistan.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen open fire on construction workers at Gwadar Port, Pakistan, killing at least 10 people. The Balochistan Liberation Army claimed responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/05/gunmen-kill-10-labourers-balochistan-gwadar-170513111330168.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-13-0-3"></a>

Context: WannaCry ransomware attack.

**Archived source account.** A ransomware cyberattack continues to infect computers of private and public organisations around the world, and demand payment in bitcoin. The method used by the program, EternalBlue, was originally developed by the National Security Agency to exploit a vulnerability in Microsoft Windows, and was leaked by The Shadow Brokers in April.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC/Reuters/RNZ](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/news/world/330677/nz-computers-caught-up-in-global-cyberattack>).

<a id="event-2017-05-13-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ivorian soldiers block access to Bouaké, the second-largest city in Ivory Coast amid a dispute over pay. The town of Odienné is also reported to be under mutineer control.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-39908545>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-05-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis canonizes Jacinta and Francisco Marto, two of the three Fátima children who reported seeing the Virgin Mary in the spring and summer of 1917. The Martos, who died during the post-World War I international influenza pandemic, are the Catholic Church's youngest saints who did not die as martyrs. The other child, Lúcia de Jesus dos Santos, survived until the year 2005, when she was 97 years old.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/pope-francis-canonizes-children-behind-three-secrets-fatima-n758531>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/13/world/europe/in-portugal-pope-proclaims-two-fatima-siblings-saints.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-05-13-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Venice Biennale awards its top prize, the Golden Lion for best national participation, to German artist and choreographer Anne Imhoff for her total totalitarianism exhibition "Faust."

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/13/arts/anne-imhof-fierce-young-artist-and-choreographer-wins-venices-top-prize.html>); [Art News](<http://www.artnews.com/2017/05/13/golden-lions-in-venice-for-anne-imhof-and-franz-erhard-walther-silver-for-hassan-khan/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-13-1-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Eurovision Song Contest.

**Archived source account.** Salvador Sobral of Portugal wins the Eurovision Song Contest with the song Amar pelos dois. While the country debuted in the 1964 edition of the contest, this marks the first win by a Portuguese entrant.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<http://www.irishtimes.com/culture/music/eurovision-portugal-s-sweet-number-ends-49-year-losing-run-1.3082548>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-05-13-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying tourists crashes near the resort town of Marmaris in southwest Turkey, killing at least 17 people and leaving 13 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-tourism-crash-idUSKBN1890CQ>).

<a id="event-2017-05-13-2-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Adendro train derailment.

**Archived source account.** A TrainOSE passenger train derails near the Greek village of Adendro, leaving at least four people dead and five seriously injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/at-least-four-dead-after-train-derails-in-greece-10876695>).

<a id="event-2017-05-13-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 5.7 magnitude earthquake kills at least three people in the town of Pish Qaleh in northeast Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/latest-news/quake-in-northeast-iran-leaves-3-dead/news-story/ef2ca5e175dfce4305ebacbee22e6b56>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/05/deadly-earthquake-hits-iran-north-khorasan-province-170514094725070.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-13-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Palestinian local elections.

**Archived source account.** Tayseer Abu Sneineh, who was convicted by Israel for his role in the 1980 Hebron attack, is elected mayor of the West Bank city of Hebron.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-terrorist-in-killing-of-6-jews-elected-hebron-mayor/>); [The Jerusalem Post](<https://www.jpost.com/arab-israeli-conflict/convicted-murderer-of-six-israelis-elected-as-palestinian-mayor-of-hebron-490664>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-05-13-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In motorsports, Monster Energy NASCAR Cup Series driver Aric Almirola is cut from his vehicle and airlifted to a local hospital with undisclosed injuries after a crash late in the Go Bowling 400 at Kansas Speedway.

Source citations (as archived): [FOX Sports](<http://www.foxsports.com/nascar/story/danica-patrick-joey-logano-aric-almirola-violent-fiery-crash-kansas-speedway-nascar-051317>).

### 2017-05-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090250705](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20May%2014&oldid=1090250705>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-05-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to the International Committee of the Red Cross, a cholera outbreak has since April 27 killed at least 115 people and left another 8,500 ill across Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/05/icrc-cholera-kills-115-people-late-april-170514101552638.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-14-0-3"></a>

Context: WannaCry ransomware attack.

**Archived source account.** Shortly after the attack began a researcher found an effective kill switch, which prevented many new infections, and allowed time to patch systems. This greatly slowed the spread. Cyber security authorities discover new versions that lack the kill switch.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hacker News](<http://thehackernews.com/2017/05/wannacry-ransomware-cyber-attack.html>); [Der Spiegel](<http://www.spiegel.de/netzwelt/web/ransomware-wannacry-experten-fuerchten-neue-cyber-attacken-a-1147610.html>); [Tech Crunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2017/05/14/companies-governments-brace-for-a-second-round-of-cyberattacks-in-wannacrys-wake/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-05-14-1-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction, 2017 North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** U.S. and South Korean officials confirm that North Korea launched a test missile from the west coast city of Kusong. The projectile travelled to the east for 30 minutes and 435 mi reaching an altitude of more than 1245 mi before landing in the Sea of Japan, 60 mi south of the Russian city of Vladivostok.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170517021105/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/north-korea-fires-unidentified-projectile-south-korean-military-says/ar-BBB6eP3>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-39911530>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-idUSKBN1890UO>).

<a id="event-2017-05-14-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Government of China begins a two-day summit in Beijing, in an attempt to raise international support for its Belt and Road Initiative.

Source citations (as archived): [Australian Broadcasting Corporation](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-05-14/china-plans-new-silk-road-to-dominate-world-trade/8522682>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-14-2-1"></a>

Context: North Rhine-Westphalia state election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia head to the polls, with the media suggesting a victory for Angela Merkel's CDU over the SPD, who have lead the state for all but five years since 1966.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/05/germans-vote-north-rhine-westphalia-state-elections-170514065342750.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-14-2-3"></a>

Context: French presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** France swears in Emmanuel Macron as the 25th President of France.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-05-14/macron-takes-power-as-president-of-france/8525506>).

### 2017-05-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1354016677](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20May%2015&oldid=1354016677>).

#### Business and economy

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-05-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed and eight are severely injured after a truck and a bus collided head-on in Jiangxi Province, China.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://en.people.cn/n3/2017/0516/c90000-9216043.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-15-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Akron, Ohio fire kills seven people, including five children and two adults.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News 8](<http://fox8.com/2017/05/15/fire-investigators-multiple-victims-in-akron-house-fire-include-both-children-and-adults/>).

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed after a Beechcraft Super King Air crashes Assabu, Hokkaido, Japan.

<a id="event-2017-05-15-1-3"></a>

<a id="event-2017-05-15-1-4"></a>

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-05-15-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A small study shows that two known carcinogens, o-toluidine and 2-naphthylamine, were found in greater amounts in the urine of e-cigarette users than in nonusers. Previous studies of traditional cigarette smokers have identified o-toluidine and 2-naphthylamine as the two most carcinogenic molecules for the bladder.

Source citations (as archived): [Medscape Medical News](<http://www.medscape.com/viewarticle/880004>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-05-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Donald Trump revelation of classified information to Russia.

**Archived source account.** According to a current and a former unnamed U.S. government official, President Donald Trump revealed classified information that jeopardized a critical source of intelligence on the Islamic State during his Oval Office meeting with the Russian Foreign Minister and Ambassador on May 10.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/trump-revealed-highly-classified-information-to-russian-foreign-minister-and-ambassador/2017/05/15/530c172a-3960-11e7-9e48-c4f199710b69_story.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/15/us/politics/trump-russia-classified-information-isis.html?_r=0>); [Reuters](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/15/us/politics/trump-russia-classified-information-isis.html?_r=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-05-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Papua New Guinean media reports confirm that 17 people were fatally shot by prison officers during a prison escape in Lae on May 12.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/05/prison-guards-kill-inmates-jailbreak-lae-170515043956679.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-15-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A trial at a court in Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso, opens to try former President Blaise Compaoré and members of his cabinet in absentia. Burkina Faso accuses Compaoré, who is in exile in the Ivory Coast, of ordering the killing of protesters during the uprising that ousted him in 2014.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/05/trial-leader-blaise-compaore-170515111857706.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-15-4-3"></a>

Context: Voter ID laws in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court rules that the North Carolina state legislative members do not have standing to request an appeal of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit ruling against a law which it found discriminated against black voters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-court-election-idUSKCN18B1QB>).

<a id="event-2017-05-15-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Moors murderer Ian Brady, one of a pair of killers whose victims from 1963–65 were five children aged between 10 and 17, dies at the age of 79.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/2017-05-15/moors-murderer-ian-brady-dead-at-age-79/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-15-4-6"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** An unknown gunman shoots and kills veteran journalist Javier Valdez Cárdenas, who is noted for his investigative reporting on Mexico's war on drugs, in Culiacán, Sinaloa.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/05/15/veteran-journalist-javier-valdez-killed-in-mexico-sinaloa.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-15-5-1"></a>

Context: Iranian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Tehran Mayor Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf withdraws his candidacy.

Source citations (as archived): [Tehran Times](<http://www.tehrantimes.com/news/413460/Tehran-mayor-Ghalibaf-withdraws-candidacy-in-Iran-s-presidential>).

### 2017-05-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090267308](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20May%2016&oldid=1090267308>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-05-16-0-1"></a>

Context: WannaCry ransomware attack.

**Archived source account.** The cybersecurity firms Kaspersky Lab and Symantec report that technical evidence connects the WannaCry ransomware attack to the North Korean-backed Lazarus Group. North Korea is also believed to be responsible for previous cyberattacks on the SWIFT banking system and against Sony Pictures.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2017/may/15/wannacry-ransomware-north-korea-lazarus-group>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/16/world/asia/north-korea-cyber-sleeper-cells-ransomware.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-05-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Office for National Statistics in the United Kingdom states that consumer prices in Britain rose by an annualized 2.7% in April, the highest level of inflation in almost four years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-economy-idUSKCN18C0TE?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-05-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Minister of Construction Yoav Galant states that Syrian President Bashar al-Assad should be assassinated. Yesterday, the United States Department of State accused the al-Assad government of using a crematory at Sednaya Prison to cover up the mass murders of thousands of political prisoners. The Syrian government denies the accusations.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/05/16/israeli-lawmaker-assassinate-syrias-assad.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/16/world/middleeast/syria-negotiations-prison-crematory.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-16-2-3"></a>

Context: Donald Trump revelation of classified information to Russia.

**Archived source account.** In a series of tweets, President Donald Trump acknowledges that he shared classified information with Russian envoys, contradicting earlier White House denials.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2017/05/16/trump-acknowledges-facts-shared-with-russian-envoys-during-white-house-meeting/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-16-2-4"></a>

Context: Donald Trump revelation of classified information to Russia.

**Archived source account.** U.S. intelligence officials had warned Israel not to share sensitive information with President Trump, out of fear that it could be leaked to Russia, and then from Russia to Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/us-officials-warned-israel-not-share-sensitive-intel-trump-609782>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Comey memos.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times reports that a memo from James Comey, read in part to a reporter by a Comey associate, revealed that President Donald Trump asked him to end the F.B.I. investigation of Michael T. Flynn. The White House denies the version of events in the memo.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/16/us/politics/james-comey-trump-flynn-russia-investigation.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-16-3-2"></a>

Context: Comey memos.

**Archived source account.** Jason Chaffetz, the Chairman of the United States House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, sends a letter to the Federal Bureau of Investigation demanding all documents related to correspondence between President Trump and former FBI Director James Comey.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/oversight-chairman-jason-chaffetz-demands-all-fbi-documents-trump-comey-n760556?cid=eml_nbn_20170516>).

<a id="event-2017-05-16-3-4"></a>

Context: Iranian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** In an expected event, Eshaq Jahangiri withdraws his candidacy and urges his supporters to vote for incumbent president Hassan Rouhani.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-39939619>).

**Archived source account.** The first synchrotron in the Middle East, SESAME, opens in Jordan, marking a rare cooperation between Iran, Israel, Turkey, and the Palestinian Authority.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-39927836>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-05-22-2-0"></a>

The two primary producers, Amphastar and Pfizer, indicate that supplies will not increase until late June.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/21/health/sodium-bicarbonate-solution-critical-shortage-hospitals.html?module=ArrowsNav&amp;contentCollection=Health&amp;action=keypress&amp;region=FixedLeft&amp;pgtype=article>); [FiercePharma.com](<http://www.fiercepharma.com/pharma/hospitals-scramble-for-sodium-bicarbonate-1-8-drugs-pfizer-says-it-currently-has-a-shortage>).

The United Nations Security Council will hold a closed-door session Tuesday to discuss the test.

### 2017-05-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1351182481](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20May%2023&oldid=1351182481>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-05-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Manchester Arena bombing.

**Archived source account.** Campaigning in the United Kingdom general election is suspended after the bombing at the Manchester Arena. The death toll is 22 with 59 injured. ISIL claims responsibility. Singer and actress Ariana Grande suspends her Dangerous Woman Tour.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2017-05-22-US-Ariana-Grande-Concert-Blast-The-Latest/id-8010069d42e94d5282ebdd7fe7f991f2>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-manchester-40010124>); [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/05/23/media/ariana-grande-tour-suspended/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-23-0-2"></a>

Context: Manchester Arena bombing.

**Archived source account.** The man suspected of carrying out the Manchester attack is identified as 22-year-old Salman Abedi, who died at the scene. Abedi was born in Manchester to Libyan parents.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/manchester-attacker-identified-22-year-salman-abedi-police/story?id=47578302>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-40020168>).

<a id="event-2017-05-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Manchester Arena bombing.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Theresa May says the government has raised its terrorism threat level to critical, the highest level, which indicates another attack may be imminent.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/23/world/europe/manchester-arena-attack-ariana-grande.html?_r=0>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/lone-attacker-detonated-device-at-manchester-concert-killing-22-including-children/2017/05/23/027d414c-3f57-11e7-b29f-f40ffced2ddb_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-23-0-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Marawi clash.

**Archived source account.** President Rodrigo Duterte declares martial law in the island of Mindanao after Maute militants clash with army troops in Marawi, Lanao del Sur.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/170745-philippines-duterte-declares-martial-law-mindanao>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/amphtml/world/asia_pacific/philippine-troops-battle-is-linked-gunmen-in-southern-city/2017/05/23/0d481914-3fa5-11e7-b29f-f40ffced2ddb_story.html&amp;freshcontent=1>).

<a id="event-2017-05-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Al-Qaeda insurgency in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Navy SEAL Team Six's raid on an Al Qaeda in Yemen compound in the Ma'rib Governorate kills at least seven militants. SEAL Team Six also suffered unspecified injuries that were treated at the site.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/23/world/middleeast/navy-seals-yemen-raid.html>); [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/usa-yemen-raid-idINKBN18J2NF>).

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The White House releases a proposed budget that includes an increase in spending for the military but a decrease in healthcare and welfare.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-40015958>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-05-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed and 14 injured after a van falls into a ditch Sudhnoti district, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1334935/six-dead-14-injured-as-passenger-van-plunges-into-ditch-in-azad-kashmir>).

<a id="event-2017-05-23-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indian Air Force Sukhoi Su-30 goes missing near the border with China and is presumed to have crashed along with its two pilots.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-newark-idUSKBN18K06X>); [CBSNewYork](<http://newyork.cbslocal.com/2017/05/23/newark-airport-engine-fire/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-05-23-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The World Health Organization (WHO) elects former Ethiopian Foreign Minister and Health Minister Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus as the international organization's new Director-General succeeding Dr. Margaret Chan, who has been in office since 2006. Tedros is the first African Director-General and the first non-medical doctor; he has a PhD in Community Health from the University of Nottingham.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/who-assembly-set-to-choose-next-chief-among-3-candidates/2017/05/23/a632e046-3faa-11e7-b29f-f40ffced2ddb_story.html>); [Time](<http://time.com/4790283/world-health-organization-director-tedros-adhanom-ghebreyesus/>); [World Health Organization](<http://www.who.int/mediacentre/news/releases/2017/director-general-elect/en/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-05-23-5-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Two Indonesian men are publicly caned by local authorities in Aceh on accusation of illegal homosexual intercourse.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/two-men-publicly-caned-indonesia-having-gay-sex-n763511>).

<a id="event-2017-05-23-5-3"></a>

Context: Wikimedia Foundation v. NSA.

**Archived source account.** The United States Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals rules that Wikimedia Foundation has the legal right to challenge the National Security Agency Upstream program of mass online surveillance. This decision reinstates the suit that had been dismissed by a Federal district judge in Baltimore, Maryland. Eight other organizations, including Amnesty International USA and the Global Fund for Women, are also plaintiffs in this case.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-wikipedia-nsa-idUSKBN18J206>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-23-6-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Former CIA Director John Brennan tells the House Intelligence Committee he knew of contacts between Trump associates and Russian officials, but is not sure collusion existed. Brennan said he warned the Russian intelligence service last August against meddling in the U.S. election.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/coats-won-t-say-whether-trump-asked-him-push-back-n763551>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-05-23-7-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2017-05-scientists-million-year-old-pre-human-balkans.html>).

**Archived source account.** A landslide at Big Sur blocks off a portion of California State Route 1 just south of Gorda; no injuries have been reported.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Legality of cannabis.

**Archived source account.** Vermont governor Phil Scott vetoes a bill legalizing marijuana in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/334958-vermont-governor-vetoes-marijuana-legalization>).

<a id="event-2017-05-24-4-3"></a>

Context: 2018 United States federal budget.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump's proposed budget for fiscal year 2018, titled "America First: A Budget Blueprint to Make America Great Again," has a $2 trillion accounting error over 10 years because it uses the same money twice for two different purposes.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/business/economy/trump-team-stands-budget-s-2-trillion-math-error-n763996>).

<a id="event-2017-05-24-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protestors set fire to the Ministry of Agriculture headquarters in Brasília amid calls for the impeachment or resignation of Michel Temer as President of Brazil over allegations of corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-40038650>).

<a id="event-2017-05-24-4-6"></a>

Context: Montana's at-large congressional district special election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Republican Greg Gianforte bodyslams a reporter from The Guardian who then reports the situation to police. Gianforte is running against Democrat Rob Quist.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/may/24/greg-gianforte-bodyslams-reporter-ben-jacobs-montana>).

<a id="event-2017-05-24-4-8"></a>

Context: American Health Care Act of 2017.

**Archived source account.** The Congressional Budget Office predicts that in the next decade, the new health care bill recently approved by the U.S. House of Representatives will reduce the federal deficit by $120 billion and leave 23 million more Americans uninsured, as opposed to current law.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2017/05/24/529893114/cbo-releases-score-for-house-approved-american-health-care-act>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/24/upshot/cbo-has-clear-message-about-losers-in-house-health-bill.html>).

### 2017-05-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273651686](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20May%2025&oldid=1273651686>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-05-25-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Greek Prime Minister Lucas Papademos is injured when a booby-trapped package explodes inside his vehicle in Athens. Authorities report his injuries are not life threatening.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40052213>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-bomb-papademos-idUSKBN18L28G>).

<a id="event-2017-05-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Battle of Mosul.

**Archived source account.** The United States military reports that their investigation found 105 civilians were killed and 36 people are still missing from the bombing of a Mosul building on March 17.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News and AP](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/pentagon-officials-say-u-s-airstrike-killed-over-100-civilians-n764541>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-05-25-1-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations, 2017 Brussels summit.

**Archived source account.** British police suspend sharing intelligence with the United States in connection with Monday's Manchester bombing attack for most of the day, after U.S. officials allegedly leak "sensitive information" to The New York Times. British Prime Minister Theresa May emphasized the sensitive nature of said information when she met with U.S. President Donald Trump during their meeting at the NATO summit in Brussels. Trump calls for an investigation into the leaks.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/05/25/europe/manchester-terror-attack-uk/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-security-manchester-idUSKBN18L0QU>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/25/world/europe/trump-may-leaks-manchester.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=first-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news&amp;_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-05-25-1-3"></a>

Context: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

**Archived source account.** The USS Dewey sails within 12 nautical miles of the disputed Mischief Reef in the South China Sea.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-40040231>).

#### Law and crimes

<a id="event-2017-05-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit refuses to reinstate Executive Order 13780 on the basis of religious discrimination, upholding the District Court for Maryland's March 7 ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/05/25/us/politics/trump-travel-ban-blocked.html?hp&amp;_r=0>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-court-idUSKBN18L2IO>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-05-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Montana's at-large congressional district special election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Montana pick between Republican Greg Gianforte and Democrat Rob Quist in the special congressional election to replace Ryan Zinke, who is now President Trump's Secretary of the Interior.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2017/05/24/529862697/republican-s-altercation-with-reporter-shakes-up-montana-race-on-eve-of-voting>).

<a id="event-2017-05-25-3-2"></a>

Context: Montana's at-large congressional district special election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Gianforte is officially charged with misdemeanor assault for allegedly body slamming reporter Ben Jacobs from The Guardian; the Missoulian, Billings Gazette, and Independent Record newspapers rescind their endorsements of Gianforte.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2017/05/25/greg-gianforte-look-at-congressional-candidate-accused-assaulting-reporter.html>); [CNN](<http://ktla.com/2017/05/25/montana-gop-congressional-candidate-charged-after-allegedly-body-slamming-reporter-night-before-special-election/>); [Billings Gazette](<http://billingsgazette.com/news/government-and-politics/greg-gianforte-cited-for-body-slamming-reporter-on-eve-of/article_3a6bf896-6c25-5dd9-a4b8-d7e097a950e4.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-25-3-3"></a>

Context: Montana's at-large congressional district special election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Gianforte wins the election with over 50% of the vote to Quist's 44%. The political fallout if any is unknown as many voters cast unchangable absentee ballots before the incident took place.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/montana-house-special-election>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/view/articles/2017-05-25/montana-s-surprise-is-just-one-strike-against-early-voting>).

<a id="event-2017-05-25-3-5"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Jared Kushner, son-in-law of and Senior Advisor to the President of the United States, is identified as a main focus of investigations into Russian ties by the Federal Bureau of Investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/jared-kushner-now-a-focus-in-russia-investigation/2017/05/25/f078db74-40c7-11e7-8c25-44d09ff5a4a8_story.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-05-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration says warm ocean waters could fuel an above-normal Atlantic hurricane season. The forecast calls for 11 to 17 named storms with five to nine hurricanes, warmer-than-average waters across the tropical Atlantic Ocean and Caribbean Sea, and a weak or nonexistent El Niño.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/2017-hurricane-forecast-calls-above-normal-season-atlantic/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-25-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Results of the Juno mission are announced by NASA researchers, revealing new and unexpected information concerning Jupiter's poles, meteorology, and magnetic and gravitational fields.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/05/25/us/nasa-jupiter-juno-mission-observations-first-results/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-25-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Rocket Lab launches its 3D-printed Electron rocket on a test flight from Māhia Peninsula in New Zealand. This is the first launch from New Zealand and the first from a private facility. Electron is 17 meters high, is intended for frequent launches of small payloads, and costs $5 million per liftoff. SpaceX's Falcon 9 stands at 70 meters, carries up to 22,800 kilograms to the ISS, and costs $62 million per launch.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-39971843>); [Smithsonian](<http://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/new-zealand-sent-3d-printed-rocket-space-180963463/#6DCX5PYvcesgUC6b>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-05-25-5-1"></a>

Context: NCAA Division I conference realignment.

**Archived source account.** The Missouri Valley Conference officially announces that Valparaiso University will join the conference on July 1. The Crusaders will move from the Horizon League to replace the Wichita State Shockers, departing for the American Athletic Conference on the same date.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/suburbs/post-tribune/sports/ct-ptb-mens-basketball-valparaiso-missouri-valley-st-0526-20170525-story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-26-0-6"></a>

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-05-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Constitutional Convention of Aboriginal Australians and Torres Strait Islanders at Mutitjulu concludes with Indigenous leaders calling for a treaty and reforms to the Constitution of Australia, beyond the proposed written recognition, including entrenchment of representative bodies and commissions for Indigenous rights.

Source citations (as archived): [Aus. Broadcasting Corp.](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-05-26/constitutional-recognition-rejected-by-indigenous-leaders-uluru/8563928>).

<a id="event-2017-05-26-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Right-wing media personality Katie Hopkins is to leave LBC with "immediate effect" after Hopkins posted on Twitter calling for a so-called "final solution" to the United Kingdom's Islamic terrorism problem following the Manchester Arena bombing which left 22 people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/tv/news/kate-hopkins-lbc-radio-sacked-fired-manchester-attack-final-solution-daily-mail-muslims-racism-a7756776.html>).

<a id="event-2017-05-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Sri Lankan flood and landslide.

**Archived source account.** Disaster Management Centre of Sri Lanka reports that 91 people are killed and 110 people from 14 districts are missing due to flood and landslide.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-40063400>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-05-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Turkish government issues an arrest warrant for NBA Oklahoma City Thunder player Enes Kanter suspected of being a member of a "terror group." Kanter, a vocal supporter of Fethullah Gülen, was returning to the U.S. from a charity tour when, last Saturday, he was detained in Bucharest, Romania, because his Turkish passport had been revoked. Kanter says he plans on becoming a United States citizen.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/19472840/turkish-government-issues-arrest-warrant-enes-kanter-oklahoma-city-thunder-newspaper-reports>).

<a id="event-2017-05-26-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A spokesman for the Chipotle Mexican Grill restaurant chain reveals that hackers stole customer payment data from most of their stores over a span of three weeks starting from the end of March.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chipotle-cyber-idUSKBN18M2BY?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-05-26-4-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Portland train attack.

**Archived source account.** Two men are stabbed to death in a train in Portland, Oregon, after they attempt to intervene while a man shouts racial slurs at two teenage girls, one of them wearing a hijab.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/ricky-john-best-taliesin-namkai-meche-named-as-victims-in-deadly-portland-stabbing/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-26-5-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/president-carters-national-security-adviser-zbigniew-brzezinski-has-died/2017/05/26/38ae678c-4286-11e7-b29f-f40ffced2ddb_story.html>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/politics/zbigniew-brzezinski-top-carter-adviser-dead-89-article-1.3199611>).

<a id="event-2017-05-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President of the Philippines Rodrigo Duterte tells soldiers fighting in Mindanao, where he proclaimed martial law earlier this week, that he will accept responsibility for abuses they commit, and jokes that "\[i\]f you had raped three, I will admit it, that's on me."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-05-27/duterte-jokes-to-soldiers-about-raping-women/8565896>).

**Archived source account.** Police search for a driver who witnesses believe was driving aggressively around campers in Grays Harbor County, Washington, and deliberately backed over two campers while yelling racial slurs, killing one and injuring a second. Both victims are from the Quinault Indian Nation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<http://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/young-father-run-down-killed-in-grays-harbor-county-campground-confrontation>).

<a id="event-2017-05-27-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police announce charges of attempted murder against 150 protestors from Dhaka University over a protest to restore a statue of Lady Justice outside the Supreme Court. Protestors and police clashed near the High Court, with police firing tear gas and water cannons after protestors breached a barricade. Police claim protestors wielded sticks and stones in a bid to murder on-duty officers.

Source citations (as archived): [Dhaka Tribune](<https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/2017/05/27/case-filed-supreme-court-statue-removal-protest/>).

<a id="event-2017-05-31-4-1"></a>

Context: Iranian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Guardian Council officially confirmed the result of the election which saw Incumbent President Hassan Rouhani reelected for another four years in office.

Source citations (as archived): [PressTV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2017/05/30/523687/Iran-Guardian-Council-Hassan-Rouhani-presidential-election>).


## June

### 2017-06-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273651702](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%201&oldid=1273651702>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Marawi crisis.

**Archived source account.** Philippine Defense Secretary Delfin Lorenzana announces the deaths of ten soldiers in Marawi as a result of a "friendly fire" airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-40116042>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-01-1-1"></a>

Context: China–Germany relations.

**Archived source account.** Chinese Premier Li Keqiang and German Chancellor Angela Merkel vow to expand their partnership in combating global climate change.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-china-idUSKBN18S4CC>).

<a id="event-2017-06-01-1-3"></a>

Context: United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump confirms that the United States will withdraw from the 2015 Paris Agreement on climate change mitigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2017/jun/01/donald-trump-confirms-us-will-quit-paris-climate-deal>).

<a id="event-2017-06-01-1-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Bilderberg Conference.

**Archived source account.** The secretive Bilderberg Group meet in Chantilly, Virginia, for its annual conference.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-40125253>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-01-2-1"></a>

Context: United States immigration ban.

**Archived source account.** The Department of Justice asks the Supreme Court for expedited review of the Fourth Circuit Appeals Court's May 25 ruling that affirmed the Maryland district court decision to prevent implementation of revised Executive Order 13780, and let the travel ban take effect. The Appeals Court of the Ninth Circuit has not announced its decision on a similar ruling from Hawaii.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/06/01/politics/trump-travel-ban-supreme-court/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/06/02/us/politics/travel-ban-supreme-court-trump.html?mabReward=ACTM_TC4&amp;recp=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-01-3-1"></a>

Context: United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

**Archived source account.** Elon Musk quits as an official advisor to U.S. President Donald Trump in protest at the United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/technology/335984-elon-musk-steps-down-from-white-house-councils-after-trump-withdraws-from>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Gravitational-wave astronomy.

**Archived source account.** Scientists announce that the Advanced Laser Interferometer Gravitational-wave Observatory (LIGO) has made a third detection of gravitational waves, named GW170104. The signal beam, detected on 4 January 2017, apparently results from a merger of two black holes of 19 and 31 solar masses. Such detections are said to be progressively moving this emerging field in astronomy "from novelty to new observational science".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-40120680>).

### 2017-06-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090281496](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%202&oldid=1090281496>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-06-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Rock am Ring.

**Archived source account.** A terrorist threat results in the evacuation of tens of thousands of fans at the first day of the annual Rock am Ring music festival at the Zeppelinfeld in Nuremberg, Germany. Organizers say they hope the festival will resume Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40140968>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-06-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Health in South Sudan.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen young children die of "severe sepsis/toxicity" from contaminated vaccine during South Sudan's measles vaccination campaign. In one instance, a syringe containing vaccine stored without refrigeration was used for all the children over four days.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/contaminated-measles-vaccine-kills-15-kids-south-sudan-n767516>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-02-2-1"></a>

Context: United Nations Security Council election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Equatorial Guinea, Ivory Coast, Kuwait, Peru and Poland are elected to the United Nations Security Council for a two-year term beginning on January 1, 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/equatorial-guinea--kuwait--peru--poland--ivory-coast-elected-to-un-security-council-8908416>).

<a id="event-2017-06-02-2-3"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** As a result of North Korea's repeated missile tests, the United Nations Security Council expands its targeted sanctions against the country, adding to the U.N. blacklist four entities, including the Koryo Bank and the Army's Strategic Rocket Force, and 14 people, including the North's head of intelligence operations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-un-idUSKBN18T2X3>).

<a id="event-2017-06-02-2-5"></a>

Context: Russia–Turkey relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia lifts more trade sanctions it had placed on Turkey following the 2015 downing of a Russian fighter jet.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/economy/2017/06/03/russian-govt-lifts-further-trade-sanctions-on-turkey>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40134701>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Resorts World Manila attack.

**Archived source account.** At least 37 people are killed in a deliberately lit fire at Resorts World Manila in the Philippines. The perpetrator stole gaming chips and fired gun shots before committing suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/06/01/asia/resorts-world-manila-philippines>).

<a id="event-2017-06-02-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Resorts World Manila attack.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for the attack; however, authorities contend it is not terror related.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-resort-islamic-state-idUSKBN18T1NS>).

<a id="event-2017-06-02-3-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Five anti-government/anti-Taliban protestors are shot dead by police in Kabul, Afghanistan, after demanding that the government step down in the wake of the May 2017 Kabul attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-40131527>).

<a id="event-2017-06-02-3-6"></a>

Context: Penn State child sex abuse scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former Pennsylvania State University president Graham Spanier, former vice president Gary Schultz, and former athletic director Timothy Curley are sentenced to prison for covering up ex-coach Jerry Sandusky's criminal sexual acts, thereby letting him victimize more boys.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pennsylvania-sandusky-idUSKBN18T1BC>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-02-4-1"></a>

Context: United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

**Archived source account.** Disney CEO Bob Iger joins Elon Musk in resigning from President Trump's advisory councils in response to Trump's decision to withdraw the U.S. from the Paris Agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/business/news/paris-agreement-withdrawal-bob-iger-disney-ceo-donald-trump-elon-musk-advisory-council-tech-climate-a7768346.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Fine Gael leadership election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Leo Varadkar becomes the new party leader of Fine Gael, after winning 51 of 73 votes in the parliamentary party, and is expected to become Taoiseach (Prime Minister) of Ireland, which would make him the youngest and first openly gay man to be Taoiseach, as well as being the first of half-Indian descent.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sun](<https://www.thesun.ie/news/1082271/leo-varadkar-set-to-become-irelands-youngest-ever-and-first-gay-taoiseach-after-beating-simon-coveney-to-be-crowned-fine-gael-leader/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Moons of Jupiter.

**Archived source account.** Two of Jupiter's moons, S/2003 J 18 and S/2011 J 2 are recovered, and a small 1.5-kilometer outer moon (S/2016 J 1) is discovered, the first moon discovered around a major planet in 6 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Minor Planet Center](<http://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K17/K17L08.html>).

### 2017-06-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1224848798](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%203&oldid=1224848798>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-03-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / June 2017 Kabul attack.

**Archived source account.** According to the Interior Ministry, three blasts at a funeral attended by MPs and government figures in Kabul kill at least seven people and wound 119 more.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/03/kabul-explosions-afghanistan-people-killed-funeral-salim-ezadyar>).

<a id="event-2017-06-03-0-4"></a>

Context: 2017 London Bridge attack.

**Archived source account.** A van travelling at approximately 50 mi per hour ploughs into pedestrians on London Bridge; the three occupants then abandon the van and embark on a stabbing spree in Borough Market before being shot dead by officers of the Metropolitan Police. At least six civilians are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-40146916>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/london-bridge-police-respond-incident-1.4145144>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-06-03-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis meets with 400 children from towns hit by earthquakes in central Italy on August 24, 2016. A few children offer brief testimony about their experiences during the earthquake, which hit parts of central Italy and resulted in nearly 300 deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-hears-testimonies-of-earthquake-children-asks-them-to-trust-in-jesus-37881>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-06-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Turin stampede.

**Archived source account.** More than 1,500 people are injured when panic erupts among Juventus fans who are watching the 2017 UEFA Champions League Final on Piazza San Carlo in Turin, Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [BNO News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170603223951/http://bnonews.com/news/index.php/news/id5974>); [AFP](<https://twitter.com/AFP/status/871246349605285888>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-03-3-1"></a>

Context: Lesotho general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Lesotho go to the polls for an election, with a tight race predicted between the Democratic Congress, led by current Prime Minister Pakalitha Mosisili, and the All Basotho Convention, led by former prime minister Tom Thabane.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/lesotho-voting-election-2012-170603060926252.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Maltese general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Malta go to the polls for a snap election, with current Prime Minister Joseph Muscat and his Labour Party facing off against Forza Nazzjonali, led by Simon Busuttil. The election comes amid corruption allegations leveled against Muscat's associates.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malta-election-idUSKBN18U0CW>).

<a id="event-2017-06-03-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** CNN denies authenticity of footage documenting its employees manufacturing a protest using unrepresentative Muslim actors.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Times](<http://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2017/jun/5/brian-stelter-cnn-deny-network-staged-london-anti-/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-03-4-1"></a>

Context: SpaceX CRS-11.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX launches a Falcon 9 rocket with a shipment of food and supplies in a refurbished Dragon cargo capsule for the International Space Station. The mission reuses a Dragon cargo vessel that was previously flown in a September 2014 mission.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2017-06-spacex-blasts-cargo-recycled-spaceship.html>); [Space.com](<http://www.space.com/37072-spacex-first-used-dragon-launch.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-06-03-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 UEFA Champions League Final.

**Archived source account.** In football, Real Madrid defeats Juventus 4–1. The Spanish team becomes the first to win back-to-back titles since the competition became known as the Champions League, and to win their 12th title in the competition.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\!](<https://sports.yahoo.com/news/real-madrid-becomes-first-back-back-champions-league-winner-4-1-juventus-victory-204441236.html?soc_trk=gcm&amp;amp;soc_src=d9780ae9-562b-3ef5-9d83-c17f2088b031&amp;amp;.tsrc=notification-brknews>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-champions-final-idUSKBN18U0UY>).

<a id="event-2017-06-03-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alex Honnold climbs El Capitan in Yosemite National Park without ropes becoming the first person ever to free solo the route.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<https://www.nationalgeographic.com/adventure/article/most-dangerous-free-solo-climb-yosemite-national-park-el-capitan>).

### 2017-06-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090281771](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%204&oldid=1090281771>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-04-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 London Bridge attack.

**Archived source account.** In the early hours of Sunday morning, explosions are heard around London Bridge, believed to be controlled explosions carried out by the police.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<http://metro.co.uk/2017/06/04/three-explosions-heard-near-london-bridge-6682987/>).

<a id="event-2017-06-04-0-2"></a>

Context: 2017 London Bridge attack.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the attacks is seven, with at least 48 injured. Officials say that the three attackers were killed by the police.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/police-declare-major-incident-on-london-bridge-after-van-reported-to-hit-pedestrians/2017/06/03/6d1854c0-48a7-11e7-8de1-cec59a9bf4b1_story.html>); [AP](<http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2017-06-04-EU-Britain-London-Bridge-Attack-The-Latest/id-7c8eac7687534966aea1e18c3ba84c2a>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-40148737>).

<a id="event-2017-06-04-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The U.S.-backed Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) take control of the Baath Dam on the Euphrates, near the ISIL stronghold of Raqqa, and upon doing so, rename it "Freedom Dam".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-raqqa-idUSKBN18V0EX?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-06-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Marawi crisis.

**Archived source account.** Citizens remain trapped in Marawi, Philippines, after a ceasefire organised by the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) is broken. Up to 2,000 people remain in need of help after nearly two weeks without food.
