<a id="event-2017-06-04-0-8"></a>

Context: 2017 Resorts World Manila attack.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine police identifies the lone gunman as Jessie Javier Carlos, a local citizen, who was a debt-riddled former employee of the Department of Finance.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/171914-police-identify-gunman-resorts-world-attack>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/902507/resorts-world-manila-gunman-identified-as-jessie-javier-carlos>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-06-04-1-1"></a>

Context: One Love Manchester.

**Archived source account.** The charity concert organized by Ariana Grande in the wake of the Manchester Arena bombing is held in Manchester, England.

Source citations (as archived): [Variety](<https://variety.com/2017/music/news/ariana-grande-somewhere-over-the-rainbow-one-love-manchester-benefit-concert-watch-1202453634/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Bahrain.

**Archived source account.** Bahrain bans the independent Al-Wasat newspaper on grounds that it "sows division" in the Shia-majority kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/bahrain-bans-newspaper-sowing-division-153554750.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-04-3-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** All major parties suspend their campaigns following last night's terror attack in London. The general election, scheduled for June 8, is not expected to be postponed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/london-bridge-borough-market-attack-general-election-campaign-suspended-conservatives-labour-latest-a7771711.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Maltese general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Simon Busuttil of Forza Nazzjonali concedes defeat to the incumbent Joseph Muscat and his Labour Party, who are projected to win 54.9% of the popular vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Malta](<https://www.timesofmalta.com/articles/view/20170604/local/labour-expected-to-win-the-general-election-indications.649961>).

<a id="event-2017-06-04-3-5"></a>

Context: Cambodian communal elections, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters cast ballots to select representatives for rural and urban Cambodian precincts from, nationwide, 94,595 candidates for 11,572 council seats. Voter turnout was 85.74 percent with few reports of irregularities. According to early results, the opposition makes significant gains against the ruling party of Prime Minister Hun Sen.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Asia](<http://www.rfa.org/english/news/special/cambodia-commune-election2017/>); [Channel NewsAsia](<http://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/highly-satisfactory-voter-turnout-in-cambodia-commune-election-8911236>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cambodia-election-idUSKBN18V02J>).

### 2017-06-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1226057712](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%205&oldid=1226057712>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-05-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Orlando shooting.

**Archived source account.** A discharged 45-year-old former employee shoots and kills five people at a manufacturing business in Orlando, Florida, United States. The shooter took his own life afterwards. Eight others inside the workplace survived.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/06/05/us/orlando-fatalities/index.html>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/disgruntled-employee-kills-workplace-orlando-police/story?id=47838338>).

<a id="event-2017-06-05-0-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Brighton siege.

**Archived source account.** In Brighton, a suburb of Melbourne, Australia, a gunman kills one man and holds one woman hostage before he is shot dead by Victoria Police. The incident is being treated as an act of terrorism. Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant has claimed responsibility for the attack but Victoria Police claim that there is little evidence to suggest a connection.

Source citations (as archived): [Aus. Broadcasting Corp.](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-06-06/islamic-state-claims-responsibility-for-brighton-siege/8591540>); [Herald Sun](<http://www.heraldsun.com.au/news/law-order/emergency-crews-responding-to-explosion-in-brighton/news-story/432d22f46235bc4f810581d6cd5965d7>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-06-05-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 disasters in China.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed in an explosion at a petrochemical plant in Shandong, China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast-idUSKBN18W02E>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-05-2-1"></a>

Context: Australia–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Reports emerge of the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation's discovery of classified Australian documents, related to Chinese intelligence activity abroad, in the Canberra home of a woman allegedly acting on behalf of the Communist Party of China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/national/investigations/secret-asio-raid-uncovered-classified-documents-in-power-couples-canberra-apartment-20170602-gwjbrm.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-05-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Qatar diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Bahrain, Egypt, Libya, the Maldives, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and the internationally recognized government of Yemen sever diplomatic ties with Qatar, ordering Qatari citizens in those countries to be expelled as well as cutting all land, air and sea connections. "National security," "media incitement" and Qatar's support of Iran are variously cited.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/05/saudi-arabia-and-bahrain-break-diplomatic-ties-with-qatar-over-terrorism>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/8257ce650e224188a1884e34eabb5e90/4-Arab-nations-cut-diplomatic-ties-to-Qatar-as-rift-deepens>).

<a id="event-2017-06-05-2-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Qatar diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Iran, Turkey, and the United States call for the sides to peacefully resolve their differences.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gulf-qatar-idUSKBN18W0DQ>).

<a id="event-2017-06-05-2-6"></a>

Context: Montenegro–NATO relations.

#### Law and order

<a id="event-2017-06-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** After The Intercept publishes a classified NSA document describing Russian efforts to launch cyberattacks on U.S. voting software suppliers, the United States Department of Justice announces it had brought charges upon Reality Winner, the alleged leaker.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-leaks-idUSKBN18W2VE>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-05-4-1"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Turkish purges.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish interior ministry announces that 130 people, living outside the country and suspected of militant links, will lose their citizenship unless they return to Turkey within three months and meet government standards. Named suspects include U.S.-based cleric Fethullah Gülen, and Peoples' Democratic Party leaders Faysal Sariyildiz, Tuğba Hezer, and Özdal Üçer.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-security-citizenship-idUSKBN18W17D>).

<a id="event-2017-06-05-4-3"></a>

Context: United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-diplomacy-idUSKBN18W2NT?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=newsOne&amp;google_editors_picks=true>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-05-5-1"></a>

Context: GSAT-19.

**Archived source account.** Indian Space Research Organisation successfully launches communications satellite GSAT-19 through its heaviest rocket Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle Mark III.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/isros-most-powerful-rocket-gslv-mk-iii-places-gsat-19-communication-satellite-in-orbit/articleshow/59001591.cms>).

<a id="event-2017-06-05-5-3"></a>

Context: Moons of Jupiter.

**Archived source account.** Another satellite of Jupiter is announced, S/2017 J 1, just 3 days after the announcement of S/2016 J 1.

Source citations (as archived): [Minor Planet Center](<http://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K17/K17L47.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-05-5-5"></a>

Context: Apple Worldwide Developers Conference.

**Archived source account.** Apple announces iOS 11 in WWDC 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/live-blog/2017-06-01/apple-worldwide-developers-conference>); [9to5Mac](<https://9to5mac.com/2017/06/05/apple-unveils-ios-11-for-iphone-and-ipad/>).

### 2017-06-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1099497707](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%206&oldid=1099497707>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-06-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan / 2017 Herat bombing.

**Archived source account.** An explosion occurs near police offices and a mosque in Herat, killing at least ten people.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/reports-explosion-strikes-afghanistan-herat-170606105233269.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-06-0-5"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Syria / Battle of Raqqa (2017).

**Archived source account.** The United States-backed Syrian Democratic Forces launch an operation to capture Raqqa, ISIL's de facto Syrian capital.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-raqqa-idUSKBN18W29P>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-06-06-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Qatar diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines temporarily suspends sending workers to Qatar.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-40183085>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-06-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A Russian SU-27 fighter jet intercepts an American B-52 strategic bomber that was flying over international waters of the Baltic Sea parallel to the Russian border, and escorts the B-52 until it flew away from the border area. The United States military confirmed that the US Air Force B-52 was operating in international airspace, but had no further comment about the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-usa-bomber-idUSKBN18X166>); [EURACTIV](<http://www.euractiv.com/section/politics/news/russian-fighter-intercepts-us-bomber-over-baltic-sea/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-06-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Notre Dame attack.

**Archived source account.** A man who was yelling "This is for Syria" while attacking a police officer with a hammer near Notre-Dame de Paris, France is shot and wounded by another officer. Prosecutors open a terrorism probe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-attacks-france-idUSKBN18X1V5>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/b6dc8bc3cd34432b9386ea0f844de69f/The-Latest:-Police-shot,-injured-attacker-near-Notre-Dame>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40178183>).

<a id="event-2017-06-06-3-3"></a>

Context: Corruption in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazil's Superior Electoral Court reopens the illegal campaign funding case against President Michel Temer, who was the vice presidential candidate on former President Dilma Rousseff's ticket in 2014. Temer became president in August 2016 when Rousseff was impeached, and could be unseated if the court annuls the Rousseff–Temer election victory.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-politics-ticket-idUSKBN18X29O>); [Yahoo\!7 News](<https://au.news.yahoo.com/world/a/35780337/brazilian-president-faces-election-court-showdown/#page1>).

<a id="event-2017-06-06-3-5"></a>

Context: Sandy, Utah attack.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed in a shooting, including the perpetrator, and two others are injured in an apparent domestic dispute in Sandy, Utah.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/sandy-utah-shooting-leaves-two-adults-kindergartner-dead-live-updates/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-06-4-1"></a>

Context: Government of Uzbekistan.

**Archived source account.** Uzbekistan Deputy Prime Minister Rustam Azimov is dismissed by President Shavkat Mirziyoyev, who had earlier criticized Azimov for failing to control financiers' activities. He is replaced by former Deputy Finance Minister Jamshed Kuchkarev.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-uzbekistan-government-idUSKBN18X0R9?il=0>); [AKIpress news agency](<http://akipress.com/news:593286/>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-uzbekistan-politics-idUSKBN18S5FB>).

<a id="event-2017-06-06-4-3"></a>

Context: New Jersey gubernatorial election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** American voters in the state of New Jersey select party candidates to succeed term-limited incumbent Republican Chris Christie. Democrat Phil Murphy and Republican Kim Guadagno win nominations their parties' nominations.

Source citations (as archived): [Q13 FOX News](<http://q13fox.com/2017/06/06/chris-christie-deputy-ex-goldman-sachs-executive-win-primaries-in-gubernatorial-race/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in London.

<a id="event-2017-06-07-4-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-06-07-4-3"></a>

Context: 2017 clashes at the Turkish Ambassador's Residence in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** A U.S. House resolution unanimously passes 397–0 calling for all Turkish security guards involved in the May 16 clashes to be charged and prosecuted under United States law.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Human evolution fossils.

**Archived source account.** The oldest fossil records of Homo sapiens are discovered in Jebel Irhoud, Morocco, dated at between 300,000 and 350,000 years old. The earliest Homo sapiens fossils had been dated as 200,000 years old.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/speaking-of-science/wp/2017/06/07/oldest-homo-sapiens-fossils-discovered-in-morocco/?wpisrc=al_alert-hse&amp;wpmk=1>).

### 2017-06-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360452500](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%208&oldid=1360452500>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-08-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** North Korea test fires several missiles, believed to be anti-ship weapons. The test comes immediately after South Korea suspends further deployment of the THAAD anti-missile system.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/06/07/world/asia/south-korea-thaad-missile-defense-us.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab militants storm a military base in Puntland. The subsequent battle with the Somali military leaves at least 70 people dead. Somali officials called the attack the deadliest in the country in years.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/casualties-al-shabab-attack-puntland-army-base-170608102915346.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-0-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Tehran attacks.

**Archived source account.** Iranian Intelligence Ministry releases the names and other information about the five attackers of the day before.

Source citations (as archived): [PressTV](<http://www.presstv.ir/Detail/2017/06/08/524578/Iran-terror-attack>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-0-7"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** In its third strike near the town of Al-Tanf in recent weeks, the United States bombs Syrian government and allied troops, striking two out of three technical vehicles about 24 miles from the U.S. Coalition's At-Tanf base in Southern Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/06/07/politics/us-led-coalition-syria-strike-at-tanf/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-0-8"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** Shortly after bombing Syrian government and allied troops near Al-Tanf, the United States shot down an Iranian-made Syrian government drone that was flying toward U.S.-led coalition forces in southern Syria. There are no injuries or damage. An American official says this is first time forces supporting Damascus have attacked coalition troops.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-usa-syria-idUSKBN18Z2CP?il=0>); [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/us-drone-fired-on-us-backed-forces-near-syrian-rebel-camp/2017/06/08/ff23bdca-4c6a-11e7-987c-42ab5745db2e_story.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/06/07/politics/us-led-coalition-syria-strike-at-tanf/index.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-06-08-1-1"></a>

Context: Freedom of the press in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Montana congressman Greg Gianforte apologizes to journalist Ben Jacobs for the alleged body slam incident that occurred on May 24, and donates US$50,000 to the Committee to Protect Journalists.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/06/08/politics/gianforte-apologizes-guardian-reporter-letter/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-06-08-2-1"></a>

Context: United Nations Ocean Conference.

**Archived source account.** At a United Nations-Oceans summit, delegates from China, Indonesia, the Philippines and Thailand, four of the top polluters of plastic into the oceans, pledge to reduce their levels of oceanic plastic pollution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-40195664>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-2-3"></a>

Context: Verizon Wireless.

**Archived source account.** Yahoo\! shareholders officially approve its $4.48 billion sale to Verizon Wireless. Yahoo\! stock was up 8.5 percent shortly thereafter.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/yahoo-verizon-sale-approved-2017-6>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-2-5"></a>

Context: 115th United States Congress.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives pass a bill ending Dodd–Frank regulations. The bill now goes to the Senate where it is expected to not go through.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/finance/337004-house-passes-sweeping-bill-to-strip-post-recession-banking-rules>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-06-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Wildfires in South Africa.

**Archived source account.** Up to 10,000 people have been evacuated from Knysna Local Municipality on Garden Route in South Africa after wildfire destroyed 150 homes. The Wildfire is connected to the worst windstorm in 30 years, which already killed at least 8 people in Cape Town.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-40199270>); [ENCA](<https://www.enca.com/south-africa/knysna-toddler-dies-on-birthday>); [RTE](<https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2017/0608/881071-south_africa/>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/storm-kills-displaces-thousands-cape-town-170608052748704.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/06/07/world/africa/south-africa-cape-town-storm-fires.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-06-08-4-1"></a>

Context: Opioid epidemic.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Food and Drug Administration asks pharmaceutical manufacturer Endo International plc to withdraw its long-lasting (12 hours) opioid painkiller, Opana ER, from the market after an FDA panel concluded the drug's benefits no longer outweighed the risks of abuse. Endo is evaluating its options.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-endo-intl-opana-fda-idUSKBN18Z2SQ>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Qatar diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Saudi Arabia-led bloc against Qatar issues a "terror list" against the peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/saudi-led-bloc-issues-terror-list-170608221049889.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-08-6-1"></a>

Context: Hezbollah.

**Archived source account.** U.S. authorities charge two operatives, Samer El Debek, 37, of Dearborn, Michigan, and Ali Kourani, 32, of the Bronx, New York, belonging to the Lebanese Shiite militant group Hezbollah with terrorism offenses, accused of plotting to target American and Israeli targets in New York and Panama.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/us-foils-hezbollah-plot-attack-american-israeli-targets-new-york-and-panama-623432>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-6-3"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** An explosive device is hurled at the United States embassy in Kiev.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/world/explosive-device-u-s-embassy-kiev-article-1.3230345>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-6-5"></a>

Context: Eaton Township Weis Markets shooting.

**Archived source account.** A supermarket employee shoots and kills three fellow employees, then kills himself, in a closed Weis Markets store in Eaton Township in Northeastern Pennsylvania. One person escapes unharmed.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/weis-supermarket-employee-brought-two-guns-to-work-killed-3-and-self-cops/>); [The Times Leader](<http://thetimes-tribune.com/news/details-emerging-of-murder-suicide-at-wyoming-county-market-1.2203457>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-08-7-1"></a>

Context: United Kingdom general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Polls open in the United Kingdom, with Labour leader Jeremy Corbyn and incumbent Theresa May of the Conservatives battling in a tight race, according to final opinion polling, to become prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-election-idUSKBN18Y0PR>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-7-3"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** James Comey, the former FBI Director who was dismissed by President Donald Trump last month, appears before the United States Senate Select Committee on Intelligence. Comey says he believes he was fired because of the FBI investigation into the possible collusion between President Trump's campaign team and Russia's interference in the 2016 elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/jun/07/james-comey-trump-congress-statement>); [Reuters](<http://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-usa-trump-russia-idUKKBN18Z0HL?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-06-08-7-5"></a>

Context: United States withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

**Archived source account.** The state of Hawaii becomes the first state to enact a law, to document sea level rise and set strategies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, that aligns the state's goals with the Paris climate accord. Governor David Ige says the islands are seeing the impacts of climate change first-hand.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/hawaii-becomes-first-state-enact-law-align-goals-paris-climate-n769791>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-08-8-1"></a>

Context: IUCN Red List.

**Archived source account.** American actor Leonardo DiCaprio and Mexican president Enrique Peña Nieto meet to discuss the protection of the Vaquita porpoise.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-4583096/DiCaprio-Mexico-push-save-vaquita-porpoise.html>); [Quartz](<https://qz.com/1001606/leonardo-dicaprio-and-carlos-slim-are-trying-to-save-the-mexican-vaquita-a-tiny-porpoise-nearly-extinct-due-to-bureaucracy/>).

<a id="event-2017-06-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Road incidents in the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are injured, two seriously, when a car drives into several people in front of the Amsterdam Centraal station in the Netherlands. Police say the driver may have taken ill; they are not treating this as terrorism-related.

Source citations (as archived): [DutchNews.NL](<http://www.dutchnews.nl/news/archives/2017/06/eight-injured-in-incident-with-car-at-amsterdam-railway-station/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-netherlands-car-crowd-idUSKBN1910XT>).

<a id="event-2017-06-10-1-3"></a>

Context: Road incidents in Switzerland.

**Archived source account.** After finishing a hill-climb run on the trail in St. Gallen, Switzerland, The Grand Tour presenter, Richard Hammond failed to stop his Rimac Concept One, crashed it through a safety barrier and rolled over several times as it careened down the hill. It eventually came to a rest, upside-down, near the bottom. Hammond remained conscious during the accident and told first responders not to pull him out of the wreckage by his feet, as he thought he had broken his leg. Shortly after Hammond was removed from the Rimac, the wreckage burst into flames.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/2017/jun/11/richard-hammond-escaped-crashed-car-seconds-before-being-incinerated>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/tim-farron-resigns-liberal-democrats-leader-election-statement-announcement-a7790396.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-14-5-3"></a>

Context: Government of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Leo Varadkar becomes the first gay Taoiseach of the Republic of Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/06/14/532916075/irelands-first-openly-gay-prime-minister-formally-takes-office>).

<a id="event-2017-06-14-5-5"></a>

Context: 2017 vote of no confidence in the government of Mariano Rajoy.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Prime Minister, Mariano Rajoy, survives a no-confidence vote, presented by Podemos, as he is called to declare as a witness in the trial for Gürtel corruption scandal in 26 July.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/spain-pm-mariano-rajoy-survives-confidence-vote-170614142052248.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-14-6-1"></a>

Context: Two-headed animals.

**Archived source account.** The deceased body of a rare two-headed porpoise is located for the first time in the North Sea by Dutch fishermen.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<http://news.nationalgeographic.com/2017/06/two-headed-porpoise-found-first/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Man Booker International Prize.

**Archived source account.** David Grossman wins the Man Booker International Prize for his novel A Horse Walks Into a Bar.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/entertainment-arts-40286540>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Parliament of Japan.

**Archived source account.** The Japanese Diet passes an anti-terrorism law that has been accused by critics as a threat to freedom.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/15/japan-passes-brutal-new-terror-law-which-opponents-fear-will-quash-freedoms>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/06/15/asia/japan-abe-anti-conspiracy-bill/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-15-2-3"></a>

<a id="event-2017-06-15-2-5"></a>

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Government of Serbia.

**Archived source account.** Serbian president Aleksandar Vučić nominates Ana Brnabić as the next Prime Minister of Serbia. If confirmed by the National Assembly, Brnabić will become Serbia's first female and lesbian Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40297480>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2017-06-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Members of the U.S. Congress compete in the annual Congressional Baseball Game at Nationals Park. The Democrat team beats the Republican team 11–2, but lend the trophy to the Republicans until Rep. Steve Scalise recovers from wounds he received in a shooting the previous day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/virginia-shooting-baseball-idINKBN1970AY>).

### 2017-06-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1290090373](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2016&oldid=1290090373>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-16-0-1"></a>

Context: June 2017 Jerusalem attack.

**Archived source account.** In two simultaneous attacks near the Damascus Gate in Jerusalem, an Israeli policewoman is fatally stabbed; the three Palestinian assailants are shot dead. ISIL claims were questioned by Israeli authorities. As well, the PFLP and Hamas claim it was their members who did it.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKBN19805U>).

<a id="event-2017-06-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Defence says its forces may have killed ISIL's leader Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi in an airstrike, south of Raqqa on 28 May, and currently is seeking confirmation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/abu-bakr-al-baghdadi-dead-isis-leader-russia-raqqa-air-strike-killed-syria-islamic-state-chief-a7792801.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-06-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Whole Foods Market.

**Archived source account.** Amazon agrees to buy Whole Foods Market for $13.7 billion. The takeover deal is expected to be completed in the second half of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-40306099>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations, Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate passed by an overwhelming majority a bill ramping-up sanctions against Russia and against Iran. Language in the measure also reaffirms United States' commitment to NATO.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/powerpost/senate-overwhelmingly-passes-new-russia-and-iran-sanctions/2017/06/15/df9afc2a-51d8-11e7-91eb-9611861a988f_story.html?utm_campaign=EBB%206.16.17&amp;utm_medium=email&amp;utm_source=Sailthru&amp;utm_term=.eee9a04ee279>).

<a id="event-2017-06-16-2-3"></a>

Context: Djibouti–Eritrea relations.

**Archived source account.** Djiboutian foreign minister Mahamoud Ali Youssouf accuses Eritrea of occupying the disputed Doumeira Islands and Ras Doumeira peninsula after Qatari peacekeepers withdrew from the area.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/djibouti-accuses-eritrea-occupying-disputed-area-170616140840566.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-16-2-5"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces new restrictions on travel and business with Cuba, reversing policies of Cuban Thaw, implemented during the tenure of President Barack Obama.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/06/16/politics/trump-cuba-policy/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Shooting of Philando Castile.

**Archived source account.** Jeronimo Yanez, the police officer previously accused of manslaughter and reckless discharge of a firearm at Philando Castile, is acquitted of all charges.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/officer-who-shot-philando-castile-acquitted-manslaughter-charges-n771146>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Germany.

**Archived source account.** Former German Chancellor Helmut Kohl dies at the age of 87.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40307918>).

<a id="event-2017-06-16-5-3"></a>

Context: Business career of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Office of Government Ethics certifies President Donald Trump's financial report which discloses over $315.6 million in personal liabilities and exceeding $1.4 billion in assets as of mid-2017, for revenues of more than $594 million over 2016 and early 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-ethics-idUSKBN1972XM>).

### 2017-06-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1340238172](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2017&oldid=1340238172>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-17-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** At least one Afghan is killed and seven American soldiers wounded in an "insider attack" at Camp Shaheen, in the northern city of Mazar-i-Sharif. An earlier report that Americans had been killed is incorrect. The Taliban claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack-idUSKBN1980HJ>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/06/17/world/asia/afghanistan-us-soldiers-insider-attack.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-17-0-3"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A suspected terrorist bomb explosion in an Andino shopping mall's ladies bathroom in Bogotá, Colombia, kills three women and injures at least 11.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-blast-idUSKBN19900D>); [Colombia Reports](<https://colombiareports.com/terrorist-attack-bogota-shopping-center-kills-1-injures-least-11-mayor/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-06-17-1-1"></a>

Context: USS Fitzgerald and MV ACX Crystal collision.

**Archived source account.** The USS Fitzgerald, a United States Navy destroyer, collides with a merchant ship MV ACX Crystal off the coast of Japan at around 2:30 a.m. local time, with seven American sailors reported missing. The ship was taking on water and able to operate at limited propulsion.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/06/16/politics/us-navy-destroyer-collides-with-merchant-ship-japan/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-17-1-3"></a>

Context: Climate of Chile.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed as intense rains and snowstorms hit central and southern Chile. About 3,000 people are homeless, and hundreds of thousands have lost power.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-storm-idUSKBN1980UP>).

<a id="event-2017-06-17-1-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Portugal wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Wildfires in central Portugal kill at least 24 people and several firefighters are among 20 injured. The death toll so far is the largest due to a wildfire in Portugal since 1966.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40316934>).

<a id="event-2017-06-17-1-7"></a>

Context: Grenfell Tower fire.

**Archived source account.** The suspected death toll of the fire in North Kensington, London earlier in the week significantly increases, as the Metropolitan Police Service reports that a minimum of 58 people are missing and feared dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/06/17/grenfell-tower-58-people-missing-presumed-dead-london-fire/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Shooting of Philando Castile.

**Archived source account.** Minnesota State Patrol, after issuing three warnings, arrest 18 people who were blocking Interstate 94 in St. Paul. A peaceful protest started following Friday's acquittal of St. Anthony police officer Jeronimo Yanez, who was charged with manslaughter in the fatal shooting of Philando Castile.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/philando-castile-shooting-protesters-arrested-minnesota-officers-acquittal/>).

<a id="event-2017-06-17-2-3"></a>

Context: Bill Cosby sexual assault allegations.

**Archived source account.** The trial against comedian Bill Cosby at the Montgomery County Courthouse ends with a hung jury and the consequent declaration of a mistrial.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/bill-cosby-scandal/hung-jury-bill-cosby-sexual-assault-trial-ends-mistrial-n772106>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Vanuatu.

**Archived source account.** Baldwin Lonsdale, the President of Vanuatu, dies suddenly of a heart attack at age 67. Parliament Speaker Esmon Saimon takes his post as acting president.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-40313334>); [Radio New Zealand](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/333232/vanuatu-in-mourning-after-president-s-sudden-death>).

<a id="event-2017-06-17-3-3"></a>

Context: Political appointments of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Milwaukee County Sheriff David Clarke withdraws his name from consideration for an assistant secretary position at the Department of Homeland Security.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170618184252/http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/milwaukee-sheriff-clarke-rejects-homeland-security-position-48117690>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2017/06/17/milwaukee-sheriff-david-clarke-rescinds-acceptance-of-homeland-security-post/?utm_term=.23516357175a>).

Context: Murder of Nabra Hassanen.

#### Armed conflict and attack

<a id="event-2017-06-19-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Finsbury Park attack.

**Archived source account.** At least one person has been killed and ten injured after a van runs over pedestrians outside the Finsbury Park Mosque in the north London suburb of Finsbury Park. Police are investigating the act as a terrorist incident.

Context: United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2017/jun/19/brexit-talks-david-davis-michel-barnier-brussels-uk-eu>).

<a id="event-2017-06-19-2-3"></a>

Context: Piracy in the Sulu Sea.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines begin joint patrols in the pirate havens within the Celebes and Sulu Seas.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/world/regions/asia-pacific/173377-indonesia-malaysia-philippines-launch-joint-naval-patrols>).

<a id="event-2017-06-19-2-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** American student Otto Warmbier, who returned to the United States after serving 17 months in the North Korean prison system dies after returning from North Korea last week in a comatose state. His family has accused the Government of North Korea of torturing him.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-06-20/otto-warmbier-us-student-detained-in-north-korea-dies/8633216>); [AP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/us-student-freed-north-korea-204425775.html?soc_trk=gcm&amp;soc_src=d9780ae9-562b-3ef5-9d83-c17f2088b031&amp;.tsrc=notification-brknews>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-19-3-1"></a>

Context: Freedom of speech in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Slants win their case with the Supreme Court of the United States that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office's rejection of their trademark under the Lanham Act due to their name being "disparaging" is an unconstitutional violation of their free speech rights under the First Amendment.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/06/19/533514196/the-slants-win-supreme-court-battle-over-bands-name-in-trademark-dispute>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Personal information of about 200 million U.S. citizens has been exposed on the Internet since January when unsecured files were uploaded by Republican contractor Deep Root Analytics. The data, available via publicly accessible providers such as Amazon Web Services, included birth dates, home addresses, telephone numbers, religious affiliations, ethnicities, and political views. The problem was discovered by an UpGuard analyst.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-40331215>); [Salon](<http://www.salon.com/2017/06/19/nearly-200-american-voters-data-exposed-from-republican-contractors-unsecured-files/>).
