<a id="event-2017-06-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Westminster cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** Police in the United Kingdom are investigating a cyberattack on the Houses of Parliament after an attempt was made to gain unauthorised access to politicians' email accounts.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-40394074>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Papua New Guinean general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Polling places open in Papua New Guinea, and will remain open for two weeks, to elect all 111 members of the National Parliament. The People's National Congress led by Prime Minister Peter O'Neill is considered likely to maintain a governing coalition, despite uncertainty due to lack of opinion polling.

Source citations (as archived): [AAP](<http://www.news.com.au/national/breaking-news/papua-new-guineans-head-to-the-polls/news-story/96ffc5ea6c2820dbc7f2a5b2ea21e004>).

### 2017-06-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090409203](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2025&oldid=1090409203>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Syrian ceasefire line incidents during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Israel strikes two Syrian Army artillery positions and an ammunition truck in Quneitra Governorate, after stray shells from Syria land in the northern Golan Heights for a second day in a row.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-syria-idUSKBN19G0Q6>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-06-25-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Bahawalpur explosion.

**Archived source account.** Over 150 people die and dozens are injured, many critically, when an oil tanker truck overturns and explodes as people from surrounding villages gather around the truck to collect the spilling oil. The accident happened in Bahawalpur, eastern Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-south-asia-40396036>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/A/AS_PAKISTAN_DEADLY_FIRE?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/06/25/asia/deadly-oil-tank-explosion-pakistan/index.html>); [India Times](<http://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/123-killed-as-oil-tanker-exploded-in-pakistans-bahwalpur/articleshow/59306772.cms>).

<a id="event-2017-06-25-1-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Newcastle incident.

**Archived source account.** Six people are injured after a car ploughs into Eid al-Fitr worshippers in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. Police do not believe terrorism is involved.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/06/25/europe/newcastle-car-accident-eid/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2017/06/25/world/europe/25reuters-britain-newcastle.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-25-1-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Grenfell Tower fire.

**Archived source account.** External cladding samples from 60 high-rise apartment towers, from 25 different areas of the country, fail fire-resistance testing. Evacuation of thousands of apartments is underway as workers start to remove the deficient covering.

Source citations (as archived): [National Post](<https://nationalpost.com/news/world/u-k-testing-cladding-on-towers-after-grenfell-fire-and-all-60-checked-so-far-have-failed/wcm/e093d820-bc19-4301-8b1b-b1062bee264c>); [Liverpool Echo](<http://www.liverpoolecho.co.uk/news/liverpool-news/watch-cladding-removed-bootle-towers-13236838>).

<a id="event-2017-06-25-1-7"></a>

Context: Maritime incidents in 2017.

**Archived source account.** At least nine people are killed and about 30 others are missing after their multi-story tourist boat, carrying about 170 people, sinks in a reservoir in northwest Colombia near Medellín.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/25/tourist-boat-with-150-on-board-sinks-in-north-west-colombia>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/recreational-boat-with-150-aboard-sinks-near-colombian-city/2017/06/25/c9011844-59eb-11e7-aa69-3964a7d55207_story.html?utm_term=.f07b904c535a>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-25-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Qatar diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Bahrain News Agency publishes an official list of the demands from Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates and Egypt towards Qatar. Turkey says the demands on Qatar are unlawful.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/gulf/2017/06/25/Bahrain-officially-publishes-list-of-demands-conveyed-to-Qatar.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gulf-qatar-turkey-idUSKBN19G06H>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Albanian parliamentary election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Albania go to the polls in an election important to the country's European Union candidacy, with both the ruling Socialist Party and the rival Democratic Party looking to gain a majority in the country's parliament. Voting is extended by one hour because of Eid al-Fitr celebrations and 39 °C (102 °F) degree temperatures.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/albania-elections-parliament-rama-basha-european-union-nato/28577545.html>); [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170625145111/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/albania-votes-election-key-eu-48261989>).

<a id="event-2017-06-25-3-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Syria.

**Archived source account.** In the first declared visit to the town since the beginning of the war, President Bashar al-Assad attends the Eid al-Fitr prayer in Hama.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-assad-idUSKBN19G06K>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-06-25-4-1"></a>

Context: EuroBasket Women 2017.

**Archived source account.** In basketball, Spain defeats France 71–55 in the final to win the EuroBasket Women 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/wnba/2017/06/25/spain-wins-eurobasket-beating-france-in-final/103187608/>).

### 2017-06-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273651748](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2026&oldid=1273651748>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Colombian peace process.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations confirms that the FARC has completed its disarmament process, with former rebels due to make the transition to civilian life and the group to transform into a legal political party in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/06/colombia-farc-rebels-complete-disarmament-170626232629067.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Bella Bond murder case.

**Archived source account.** Michael P. McCarthy (ex-boyfriend of Bella's mother) is found guilty of second-degree murder in the killing of Bella Bond.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/06/26/baby-doe-case-massachusetts-man-convicted-2nd-degree-murder-in-killing-2-year-old.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-26-1-3"></a>

Context: Human rights in China.

**Archived source account.** Chinese political activist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Liu Xiaobo is released from prison on medical parole after being diagnosed with terminal liver cancer.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/26/nobel-laureate-liu-xiaobo-released-from-chinese-prison-after-cancer-diagnosis>).

<a id="event-2017-06-26-1-5"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States partially reinstates President Donald Trump's travel ban and invalidates certain injunctions that were put on the order by two federal appeals courts earlier. Final oral hearings concerning the legality of the Executive Order 13780 will be held in October 2017 at the Supreme Court.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-40409490>).

<a id="event-2017-06-26-1-7"></a>

Context: Unruly aircraft passengers.

**Archived source account.** Alaska Airlines removes 11 passengers from a Juneau, Alaska to Seattle, Washington flight, due to alleged unruly and uncooperative behavior. There were no arrests.

Source citations (as archived): [Atlanta Journal-Constitution](<http://www.ajc.com/news/national/passengers-removed-from-flight-for-disruptive-behavior-alaska-airlines-says/SumKK9ud3oIhtMbFw8mjVL/>); [Travel Pulse](<http://www.travelpulse.com/news/airlines/nearly-a-dozen-passengers-removed-from-alaska-flight.html>).

#### Media

<a id="event-2017-06-26-2-1"></a>

Context: CNN 2017 undercover videos controversy.

**Archived source account.** Three CNN journalists, Thomas Frank, Eric Lichtblau, and Lex Haris, resign after the publication of a Russia-related article involving President Donald Trump that was retracted.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170627163719/http://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/cnn-retracts-story-supposed-russian-meeting-48286362>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/blogs/erik-wemple/wp/2017/06/26/three-cnn-employees-resign-over-retracted-story-on-russia-ties>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Mongolian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Mongolians go to the polls to elect a new president. The centre-right Democratic Party's Battulga Khaltmaa wins a plurality of votes, but falls short of a majority, necessitating a second round.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mongolia-elections-idUSKBN19H238>).

<a id="event-2017-06-26-3-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Rodrigo Duterte.

**Archived source account.** President of the Philippines Rodrigo Duterte makes another lengthy absence from any public appearance after missing the Independence Day celebrations earlier in June. Rumors about his health continue to circulate within the minority although government officials deny any issues.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/173973-duterte-no-public-appearance-6th-straight-day>).

<a id="event-2017-06-26-3-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Israel.

**Archived source account.** The Jewish Agency for Israel Board of Governors cancels Monday's dinner with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to protest Sunday's decision by his cabinet to rescind plans for a mixed-gender prayer area at Jerusalem's Western Wall, a compromise agreement reached after three years of intense negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170626095301/http://abcnews.go.com/Lifestyle/wireStory/jewish-group-cancels-meeting-netanyahu-protest-48276666>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-06-26-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 America's Cup.

**Archived source account.** In sailing, Emirates Team New Zealand win the 35th America's Cup, 7–1, against Oracle Team USA.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/sport/news/article.cfm?c_id=4&amp;objectid=11882009>).

### 2017-06-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1340238181](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2027&oldid=1340238181>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian intelligence officer and head of a special forces unit, Maksym Shapoval, is assassinated in Kiev by car bomb.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40420339>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/27/ukraine-colonel-maksim-shapoval-killed-car-bomb-kiev>).

<a id="event-2017-06-27-0-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Venezuelan protests / 2017 Venezuelan constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Armed civilian groups attack the National Assembly building, after a clash between lawmakers and the Bolivarian National Guard (GNB), leaving various legislators and journalists injured. Opposition legislator and President of the Assembly Julio Borges blames President Nicolás Maduro for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Firstpost](<http://www.firstpost.com/world/venezuelan-parliament-attacked-by-armed-civilian-groups-several-legislators-and-reporters-injured-3752637.html>).

<a id="event-2017-06-27-0-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Venezuelan protests / 2017 Caracas helicopter incident.

**Archived source account.** A police helicopter strafes the Supreme Court and the Interior Ministry in what President Nicolás Maduro calls "an attack by terrorists seeking a coup". There are no reports of injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-idUSKBN19I2RV>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-06-27-1-1"></a>

Context: European Union competition law.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission imposes a record €2.42bn antitrust fine on internet giant Google for allegedly manipulating its search engine results.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-40406542>); [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/06/27/technology/business/google-eu-antitrust-fine/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Bosnian War and Bosnian genocide.

**Archived source account.** An appeals court in The Hague rules that Netherlands is partly to blame for the deaths of some 350 Muslim Bosnian men in the 1995 Srebrenica genocide and, in a move considered landmark, orders it to pay limited damages.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/06/27/court-rules-dutch-state-partly-blame-death-350-bosnian-muslims/>); [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40417019>).

<a id="event-2017-06-27-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Petya cyberattack.

**Archived source account.** A major ransomware cyberattack strikes companies across the globe and 80% of all infections were in Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-40416611>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Corruption in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian President Michel Temer is charged with corruption by Prosecutor General Rodrigo Janot. The case will now go to the Supreme Federal Court.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/27/brazils-president-michel-temer-charged-over-alleged-corruption>).

<a id="event-2017-06-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Efforts to repeal and replace Obamacare.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Republican Party's leadership, facing strong opposition to the Senate version of H.R. 1628, the American Health Care Act of 2017, postpones the planned vote on the bill, a setback to Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-healthcare-republican-idUSKBN19I11V>); [AP](<http://www.mercurynews.com/2017/06/27/budget-office-sees-22-million-fewer-covered-with-senate-bill/>).

<a id="event-2017-06-27-3-5"></a>

Context: Political appointments of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The White House announces that President Trump plans to nominate Textron Systems Chief Executive Ellen Lord for Under Secretary of Defense for Acquisition, Technology and Logistics. Textron Systems is a defense contractor.

Source citations (as archived): [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2017/06/27/trump-textron-ellen-lord/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Social networking service.

**Archived source account.** Facebook, Inc. announces that its social media service now has 2 billion regular users, more than a quarter of the world's population. Twitter, by comparison, has 328 million users as of April 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-facebook-users-idUSKBN19I2GG>).

### 2017-06-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076052768](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2028&oldid=1076052768>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-06-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Type 055 destroyer.

**Archived source account.** China's state-run Global Times newspaper reports the launching of the first Type 055 destroyer, a 10,000-ton "new generation" warship, at the Jiangnan Shipyard in Shanghai.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-defense-destroyer-idUSKBN19J0GX>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-06-28-1-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Hillsborough disaster.

**Archived source account.** Six people are charged with various offences including manslaughter by gross negligence following the Hillsborough disaster in 1989.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-merseyside-40419819>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-28-2-1"></a>

Context: China–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Fearing lack of payment, China National Petroleum Corporation stops selling oil to North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/china-suspends-fuel-sales-north-korea-amid-tense-times-2558704>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Nepalese local elections, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Nepalis vote in the second round of local elections, a major step in the near decade-long transition from monarchy to democratic government. The first round was held on May 14, and the final round is scheduled for September 18, after the monsoon season. Parliamentary elections are expected later this year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nepal-election-idUSKBN19J0DO>).

<a id="event-2017-06-28-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Venezuelan constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Venezuela bars Luisa Ortega Díaz, the chief prosecutor and outspoken critic of president Nicolás Maduro, from leaving the country and freezes her assets.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik](<https://sputniknews.com/latam/201706291055065824-venezuela-bans-chief-prosecutor/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-06-28-4-1"></a>

Context: NCAA Division I conference realignment.

**Archived source account.** The Horizon League announces that IUPUI (full name Indiana University – Purdue University Indianapolis) will join the conference on July 1. The Jaguars will move from the Summit League to replace Valparaiso University, moving from the Horizon to the Missouri Valley Conference on the same date.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS Sports](<http://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/the-horizon-league-picks-iupui-to-replace-valpo-and-might-add-more-teams-in-future/>).

### 2017-06-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256030860](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2029&oldid=1256030860>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-06-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Créteil mosque incident.

**Archived source account.** A man attempts to run over pedestrians outside a mosque in Créteil, France.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40452264>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-0-4"></a>

Context: Military intervention against ISIS / Battle of Mosul.

**Archived source account.** Iraq Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi declares the end of the Islamic State's self-declared caliphate following the capture of the Great Mosque of al-Nuri in Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-terror/iraqi-prime-minister-declares-end-isis-caliphate-iraq-n778341>); [Xinhua News Agency](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2017-06/30/c_136405376.htm>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-0-6"></a>

Context: RAMSI.

**Archived source account.** A farewell ceremony in Honiara ends the 14 year RAMSI mission in the Solomon Islands.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio New Zealand International](<http://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/334142/thousands-turn-out-to-farewell-ramsi>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-06-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Charra Pani cable car accident.

**Archived source account.** At least twelve people die and two others are injured after a cable car falls nearly 500 feet into a ditch in Charra Pani, Galyat, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Pakistan Point News](<https://www.pakistanpoint.com/en/pakistan/news/12-perish-as-cable-car-falls-156509.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Australia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Australia and the United States begin their month-long biennial joint military exercise, Talisman Saber, this year's being their largest ever, involving 33,000 U.S. and Australian troops on board amphibious assault ships.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-usa-military-idUSKBN19K0ID>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Taiwan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States plans to sell Taiwan $1.42 billion in arms, the first such sale under the administration of Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-taiwan-arms-idUSKBN19K2XO>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-2-5"></a>

Context: Bhutan–China relations, China–India relations.

**Archived source account.** Amid a stand-off between China and India in the Indian state of Sikkim, Bhutan protests to China over the construction of a road in the disputed territory of Doklam, a meeting point for all three countries' borders.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/bhutan-protests-against-chinas-road-construction>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Recognition of same-sex unions in Germany.

**Archived source account.** German same-sex couples may be able to marry after Chancellor Angela Merkel drops her opposition for a parliamentary vote.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40441712>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Argentina.

**Archived source account.** A car knocks down the security fences of the Pink House, the Presidential Palace of Argentina, and then stops in front of the building's gate. The authorities reported that the driver of the vehicle had psychiatric disorders and that, in addition, the security personnel present at the time of the incident was separated from his position. It was also learned that this fact took place on 21 June.

Source citations (as archived): [El Universo](<http://www.eluniverso.com/noticias/2017/06/29/nota/6255319/hombre-derriba-su-auto-vallas-metalicas-casa-rosada>); [Infobae](<http://www.infobae.com/politica/2017/06/29/echaron-a-custodios-de-la-casa-rosada-y-reforzaran-la-seguridad-tras-el-incidente-con-el-auto/>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-3-5"></a>

Context: Child sexual abuse in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Victoria Police charge Cardinal George Pell, the Prefect of the Secretariat for the Economy, and the third most senior official of the Catholic Church, with historic child sex offences. Pell will be required to attend hearings at the Melbourne Magistrates Court in Australia on July 19.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-06-29/cardinal-george-pell-charged-sexual-assault-offences/8547668>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-3-6"></a>

Context: Child sexual abuse in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Catholic Archdiocese of Sydney says Cardinal Pell "strenuously denies" these sexual assault charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-abuse-pell-catholic-idUSKBN19K072>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-3-8"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the assassination of Boris Nemtsov.

**Archived source account.** A jury trial convicts five individuals accused of working together to assassinate Boris Nemtsov. These individuals had been promised a bounty of 15 million Russian rubles. Critics say the original financiers and organizers of the crime have not been identified.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-nemtsov-idUSKBN19K1UI>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Gun laws in the Czech Republic.

**Archived source account.** The Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Republic passes a Czech Social Democratic Party-proposed amendment to the constitution, giving citizens the right to acquire, possess and carry firearms for the purpose of security. The constitutional amendment will now go to the Senate, where it is expected to pass.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40438378>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-4-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** After six days of debate, the House of Commons of the United Kingdom votes to approve, with 323 votes for and 309 against, the policies set out in the Queen's Speech. In order to avoid a 'regret' amendment, Chancellor of the Exchequer Philip Hammond says that England's National Health Service is to provide free abortions to women from Northern Ireland with funds from the Government Equalities Office.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/politics/queens-speech-passes-tory-abortion-10708542>).

<a id="event-2017-06-29-4-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Protests mark the 20th anniversary of the transfer of sovereignty over Hong Kong to China from the United Kingdom alongside the arrival of China's paramount leader Xi Jinping.

Source citations (as archived): [Hong Kong Free Press](<https://www.hongkongfp.com/2017/06/29/pictures-i-china-hongkongers-decry-ugly-handover-decorations-welcoming-xi-jinping/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-29-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** ISRO launches communications satellite GSAT-17 from French Guiana.

Source citations (as archived): [The Indian Express](<http://indianexpress.com/article/technology/science/isro-communication-satellite-gsat-17-launched-successfully-from-french-guiana-arianespace-4726984/>).

### 2017-06-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090410050](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20June%2030&oldid=1090410050>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2017-06-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** Lebanese Armed Forces are attacked by five suicide bombers and other militants during a raid of two Syrian refugee camps in Arsal near the Syrian border. The army reports a girl was killed in one of the suicide attacks, seven soldiers were also wounded, and 350 people, including several ISIL officials, were detained during the sweep.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-security-idUSKBN19L0E0>); [AP](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170710150044/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/suicide-bombers-hit-lebanons-border-area-troops-wounded-48367725>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-06-30-1-1"></a>

Context: China–India relations, Bhutan–China relations.

**Archived source account.** China informs India that it must withdraw its troops for any dialogue to occur as tensions rise between China and India and Bhutan over the disputed territory of Doklam.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Express](<http://www.financialexpress.com/india-news/china-asks-india-to-back-down-learn-from-historical-lessons/742139/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-06-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Recognition of same-sex unions in Germany.

**Archived source account.** The Bundestag votes to introduce same-sex marriage in Germany. With 393 votes in favor and 226 against, including Chancellor Angela Merkel, the law is expected to enter into force before the end of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jun/30/germany-poised-legalise-same-sex-marriage-bill-law>).

<a id="event-2017-06-30-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Bronx Lebanon Hospital attack.

**Archived source account.** A doctor thought to be formerly employed with the Bronx-Lebanon Hospital Center kills one and wounds five others at the facility in New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC New York](<http://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/Shooting-Bronx-Lebanon-Hospital-NYPD-431820163.html>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/new-york/nyc-crime/doctor-opens-fire-killing-1-bronx-lebanon-hospital-article-1.3291797>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-06-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of France.

**Archived source account.** France's National Front leader Marine Le Pen is under investigation for alleged misuse of European Union funding.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2017/06/30/french-far-right-leader-marine-le-pen-placed-under-formal-investigation-on>); [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/marine-le-pen-far-right-leader-france-charged-misuse-european-parliament-funds/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-06-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Colony collapse disorder.

**Archived source account.** A study funded by Bayer and Syngenta confirms that neonicotinoid insecticides kill queen and worker bees.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thesalt/2017/06/29/534852611/pesticides-are-harming-bees-but-not-everywhere-major-new-study-shows>).

<a id="event-2017-06-30-4-3"></a>

Context: Global warming.

**Archived source account.** A temperature of 53.7°C (128.7°F) is recorded during the 2017 heat wave in Ahvaz, Khuzestan Province, breaking Iran's previous record and becoming one of the highest temperatures ever recorded on Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/capital-weather-gang/wp/2017/06/29/iran-city-soars-to-record-of-129-degrees-near-hottest-ever-reliably-measured-on-earth/>).

<a id="event-2017-06-30-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs an executive order re-establishing the National Space Council, which was disbanded in 1993.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/speaking-of-science/wp/2017/06/30/trump-relaunches-the-national-space-council/?utm_term=.402f2fb0206c>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-06-30-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 UEFA European Under-21 Championship.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Germany defeats Spain 1–0 in the final to win the 2017 edition of the UEFA European Under-21 Championship.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/40451698>).


## July

### 2017-07-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256030874](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%201&oldid=1256030874>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-07-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Death and funeral of Helmut Kohl.

**Archived source account.** World leaders such as Bill Clinton, Emmanuel Macron, Theresa May, Dmitry Medvedev and Angela Merkel attend the memorial service for the former West German leader Helmut Kohl.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/07/01/world-leaders-bid-farewell-to-late-german-chancellor-kohl.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/helmut-kohl-dead-memorial-funeral-tributes-bill-clinton-russia-cold-war-german-reunification-merkel-a7818446.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Modena Park 2017.

**Archived source account.** Italian rock singer Vasco Rossi broke the world record of biggest ticketed concert with 220,000 paying guests hosted at Enzo Ferrari Park in Modena, Italy. (Previous record belonged to a-Ha with 198,000 paying guests, set in 1991 in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)

Source citations (as archived): [Venues Today](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170804220356/http://www.venuestoday.com/news/detail/italy-hosts-biggest-ticketed-concert-ever>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-07-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Freedom of speech in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** President of the Philippines Rodrigo Duterte threatens the Philippine Daily Inquirer with an exposé. The newspaper has been a long-time ally of the politically prominent Aquino family (ever since the 1986 EDSA People Power Revolution), as well as the minority opposition Liberal Party (of which the Vice President of the Philippines Leni Robredo is its prominent member); both have been consistent in their criticisms of the Duterty presidency and its policies since its inauguration in 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/174445-duterte-prieto-inquirer-mile-long>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-1-3"></a>

Context: Taxation in India.

**Archived source account.** India replaces its federal and state taxes with the Goods and Services Tax (GST), the most extensive tax reform since its independence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-40453774>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-07-01-2-1"></a>

Context: Marawi crisis.

**Archived source account.** More than 400,000 people displaced by the conflict are affected by disease outbreaks and psychological trauma.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/174462-marawi-clashes-displaced-persons>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-07-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Bhutan–China relations, China–India relations.

**Archived source account.** Amid growing tensions between China and India and Bhutan, China releases a map detailing pieces of land claimed by Bhutan and India as belonging to China. China claims, via the map, that territory up until Gipmochi belongs to China and claims it's supported by the 1890 Convention of Calcutta.

Source citations (as archived): [India Today](<http://indiatoday.intoday.in/story/china-releases-new-map-territorial-claims-stand-off-site/1/991733.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-07-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Law of Singapore.

**Archived source account.** Singapore implements a new law that bans foreigners from taking part in protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/foreigners-banned-as-singapore-holds-gay-rights-rally/story-TKdngV1OxXWbuXPpj1mFHK.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Little Rock nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** Arguments that lead to an exchange of gunfire at a concert at the Power Ultra Lounge in Little Rock, Arkansas, result in at least 28 people injured, one hospitalized in stable condition.

Source citations (as archived): [news.com.au](<http://www.news.com.au/world/gunman-shoots-dozens-in-nightclub-carnage-in-arkansas/news-story/a8449bb22047a5f19f61d3360e2ae6df>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-07-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Canada Day.

**Archived source account.** Canada celebrates the sesquicentennial (150-year) anniversary of the Canadian Confederation.

Source citations (as archived): [Canada.ca](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170823133719/http://canada.pch.gc.ca/eng/1468262573081>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Carrie Lam is sworn in as the first female Chief Executive of Hong Kong by Chinese Communist Party general secretary Xi Jinping amid protests against the 20th anniversary of the transfer of sovereignty to China.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/07/01/violent-clashes-erupt-hong-kong-new-leader-carrie-lam-sworn/>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Numerous U.S. states, including California, Mississippi, Kentucky and New York, reject requests for voter registration data from President Donald Trump's voter fraud commission.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/wonk/wp/2017/07/01/trump-says-states-are-trying-to-hide-things-from-his-voter-fraud-commission-heres-what-they-actually-say/>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-5-7"></a>

Context: Politics of New Jersey.

**Archived source account.** Amid a budget crisis, Governor Chris Christie shuts down the state government of New Jersey.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/01/politics/nj-government-shutdown-chris-christie/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-5-9"></a>

Context: Politics of Vatican City.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis ousts conservative cardinal Gerhard Ludwig Müller.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/01/world/europe/vatican-pope-doctrine-mueller.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-5-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Philip Greaves is sworn in as acting Governor-General of Barbados following the retirement of Sir Elliott Belgrave.

Source citations (as archived): [Barbados Today](<https://www.barbadostoday.bb/2017/07/01/sir-philip-sworn-in-as-acting-governor-general/>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2017-07-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Celebrities make a pilgrimage to Argentina for the wedding of soccer superstar Lionel Messi.

Source citations (as archived): [People](<http://people.com/celebrity/shakira-attends-lionel-messi-wedding/>).

<a id="event-2017-07-01-6-2"></a>

Context: 2017 British and Irish Lions tour to New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** In rugby union, the British and Irish Lions defeat the All Blacks 24–21 in the second test match.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/blog/2017/jul/01/all-blacks-lions-defeat-wellington-steve-hansen-sam-cane>).

### 2017-07-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364449124](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%202&oldid=1364449124>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-07-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Three suicide bombers in Damascus kill at least 21 people and wound 12 others.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jul/02/suicide-bomber-damascus-syria-tahrir-square>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-07-02-1-1"></a>

Context: London Fisheries Convention.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom announces it is withdrawing from the 1964 London Fisheries Convention, which allows several European countries to fish within 6 to 12 nautical miles of each other's coastlines.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-40471466>).

<a id="event-2017-07-02-1-3"></a>

Context: People on banknotes.

**Archived source account.** The Central Bank of Syria announces a new 2,000 Syrian lira (pound) bank note that will feature a portrait of President Bashar al-Assad, the President's first appearance on Syrian currency during his 17-years in office.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170702185245/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/syrian-president-bashar-assad-face-bank-note-48403548>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-02-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 disasters in Russia.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people are killed in Russia's Tatarstan Republic as a bus catches fire after colliding with a truck.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/07/02/20-dead-in-road-accidents-in-russia-14-as-bus-catches-fire.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-02-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six girls are killed and 24 others are injured after a passenger van caught fire near a bridge on the Chenab River, Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1342787/six-girls-of-a-family-killed-as-van-catches-fire-near-multan>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-07-02-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 electronics ban.

**Archived source account.** The United States lifts its ban on electronics in the cabin of flights from Abu Dhabi to the U.S.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-airlines-electronics-emirates-idUSKBN19N0UR>).

<a id="event-2017-07-02-3-3"></a>

Context: China–India relations, Bhutan–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Amid growing tensions between China and India and Bhutan over disputed land, the Bharatiya Janata Party supports the words of defence minster Arun Jaitley that "India of 2017 is different from India of 1962". It follows a warning from China to India that referenced the defeat of the latter during the 1962 Sino-Indian War.

Source citations (as archived): [DNA India](<http://www.dnaindia.com/india/report-arun-jaitley-s-statement-on-china-1962-war-self-explanatory-bjp-2489906>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-07-02-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Avignon shooting.

**Archived source account.** Two gunmen open fire near a mosque in Avignon, France, injuring eight people. Two of the victims were hospitalised.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40476825>); [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/avignon-france-mosque-shooting-2017-7>).

<a id="event-2017-07-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Law in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israel arrests Palestinian lawmaker Khalida Jarrar over allegations of her inciting of violence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/israel-detains-palestinian-lawmaker-on-security-allegations/2017/07/02/c4ae9436-5efc-11e7-aa69-3964a7d55207_story.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2017-07-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Manny Pacquiao vs. Jeff Horn.

**Archived source account.** In boxing, Jeff Horn of Australia defeats Senator Manny Pacquiao of the Philippines to win the WBO world welterweight belt.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-07-02/pacquiao-vs-horn-live-blog/8671230>).

<a id="event-2017-07-02-5-3"></a>

Context: 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup.

**Archived source account.** In football, Germany defeats Chile 1–0 in the final of the 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup in the Russian city of Saint Petersburg.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/S/SOC_CONFED_CUP_FINAL?SITE=AP&amp;SECTION=HOME&amp;TEMPLATE=DEFAULT>).

### 2017-07-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090410848](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%203&oldid=1090410848>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2017-07-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Battle of Mosul.

**Archived source account.** Three female ISIL suicide bombers kill 15 people and injure five in three separate incidents over the last two days as the fight for Mosul winds down.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/female-suicide-bombers-kill-iraqi-soldiers-fight-for-mosul/>).

<a id="event-2017-07-03-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed and six others are injured in a shooting in the French city of Toulouse.

#### Business and economy

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 China floods.

**Archived source account.** Floods in South China kill at least 15 people over the last few days with tens of thousands more being relocated. More rain is forecast in future days.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-flood-idUSKBN19O07X?feedType=RSS&amp;feedName=topNews&amp;utm_source=feedburner&amp;utm_medium=feed&amp;utm_campaign=Feed%3A+reuters%2FtopNews+%28News+%2F+US+%2F+Top+News%29>).

<a id="event-2017-07-03-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eighteen people are dead after a bus collides with a truck in the German state of Bavaria.

<a id="event-2017-07-03-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are injured when a taxi jumps a curb and hit a group of cabdrivers outside the taxi pool building at Logan International Airport in Boston, Massachusetts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://in.reuters.com/article/boston-crash-idINKBN19O297>); [The Boston Globe](<https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/2017/07/03/car-drives-into-group-pedestrians-boston/fN0UMCjbYhKMppWPTwfxNI/story.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-07-03-3-1"></a>

Context: China–India relations, Bhutan–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Amid growing tensions between China and India and Bhutan over the Doklam tri-junction, a spokesman on behalf of Bhutan via India Today urges India and China to "de-escalate the situation at the border and bring back normalcy". India and China have been locked in a military stand-off at the Doklam tri-junction since late June.

<a id="event-2017-07-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Greek–Turkish relations.

**Archived source account.** The Greek Coast Guard opens fire on a Turkish-flagged cargo vessel in the Aegean Sea.

<a id="event-2017-07-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of New Jersey.

**Archived source account.** Governor Chris Christie is caught sunbathing with his family on a beach he had ordered closed for the fourth of July holiday. The beach was closed to the public amid a state budget crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Boston Globe](<https://web.archive.org/web/20180130075347/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics/photos-show-christie-lounging-at-nj-state-beach-closed-due-to-government-shutdown/ar-BBDDIE6?li=BBnb7Kz&amp;ocid=iehp>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2017/07/03/chris-christie-enjoyed-a-closed-beach-then-got-flamed-but-he-definitely-did-not-get-a-tan/?utm_term=.561fb246f075>); [New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection](<http://www.state.nj.us/dep/parksandforests/>).

### 2017-07-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090416189](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%204&oldid=1090416189>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-04-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A garment factory boiler explosion in Dhaka, Bangladesh, kills 10 people and injures dozens.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bangladesh-blast-idUSKBN19P0A0?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-07-04-0-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Approximately fifty migrants are feared drowned off the coast of Morocco. Three men were rescued near Alboran Island near the coast of Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40496707>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-07-04-1-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea test-launches what is presumed to be its first intercontinental ballistic missile 933 kilometers into the Sea of Japan within Japan's Exclusive Economic Zone. An American expert theorizes the ICBM, which reached an altitude of 2,802 km, could potentially reach the U.S. state of Alaska.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-07-04/north-korea-launches-ballistic-missile%3A-south-korea/8676404>); [Xinhua News Agency](<http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2017-07/04/c_136416688.htm>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-idUSKBN19P02W>).

<a id="event-2017-07-04-1-3"></a>

Context: China–India relations, Bhutan–China relations.

**Archived source account.** Amid a stand-off between China and India over the Doklam tri-junction, China tells India that former Indian prime minister Jawaharlal Nehru accepted the Convention of Calcutta which China is using to support its territorial claims. Tensions have been rising between China and India and Bhutan over Doklam since China began constructing a road in the disputed territory in mid-June.

Source citations (as archived): [News18](<http://www.news18.com/news/world/nehru-accepted-1890-treaty-india-using-bhutan-to-cover-up-entry-china-1450635.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-07-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2016–17 Rohingya persecution in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** A mob of at least a hundred Rakhine Buddhists in Sittwe, Rakhine State, Myanmar, attack seven Rohingya men from Dapaing Camp for internally displaced persons, killing one and severely injuring another. The Rohingya men were being escorted by police to Sittwe's docks to purchase boats, but were attacked despite armed guards being present.

Source citations (as archived): [The Irrawaddy](<https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/breaking-mob-kill-rohingya-muslim-rakhine.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-idUSKBN19P1O8>).

<a id="event-2017-07-04-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 cyberattacks on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** As part of an investigation into the recent cyberattacks, the servers of Ukraine's most popular accounting software company, M.E.Doc, are seized by Ukrainian police.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/ukrainian-software-firm-s-servers-seized-after-cyber-attack-n779531>).

<a id="event-2017-07-04-2-5"></a>

Context: CNN controversies.

**Archived source account.** CNN is accused of threatening to reveal the personal identity of a Reddit user who made a GIF depicting United States President Donald Trump tackling a man to the ground, with CNN's logo superimposed on the man's face. The GIF was modified and posted on Trump's Twitter feed.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/05/business/media/cnn-trump-tweet.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-07-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Landtag of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern elects Manuela Schwesig as state Minister President with 40-29 votes.

#### Society

<a id="event-2017-07-05-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A group of people are arrested in the Peruvian village of Muqui, located in the Andes, after they painted a wall with allusive symbols and messages to the far-left terrorist organization, Shining Path, responsible for crimes against humanity in Peru from 1980 to 1992. Police later clarified that the true intentions of the arrested, some of them students of a technical training institute, were to make a short film.

Source citations (as archived): [La República](<http://larepublica.pe/sociedad/892525-junin-detienen-estudiantes-que-realizaban-pintas-subversivas-para-filmar-un-cortometraje>); [Diario Correo](<http://diariocorreo.pe/edicion/huancayo/confirman-que-detenidos-por-pintas-de-sl-son-estudiantes-760127/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-07-06-2-1"></a>

The company's shares continue to drop.

Context: Mongolian presidential election, 2017.

Opponents of the government plan to hold their own unofficial referendum on the Maduro government on July 16.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<http://www.ndtv.com/india-news/2-amarnath-yatra-pilgrims-killed-in-terror-attack-in-jammu-and-kashmirs-anantnag-1723037>); [The Indian Express](<http://indianexpress.com/article/india/two-amarnath-pilgrims-killed-four-injured-in-terror-attack-in-anantnag-kashmir/>).

**Archived source account.** A large fire breaks out at the Camden Markets in North West London, with over 70 firefighters and 10 firetrucks attending the scene. No casualties have been reported.

<a id="event-2017-07-10-6-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-07-11-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Visas given to potential entrepreneurs who are foreigners will be significantly reduced prompting fears and criticism from Silicon Valley. Many of those given visas are from India.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/us-expected-to-scrap-visa-program-for-entrepreneurs/3936958.html>); [U.S. News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/best-countries/articles/2017-07-10/donald-trumps-america-first-policy-may-jeopardize-the-dreams-of-indians>).

<a id="event-2017-07-11-5-2"></a>

Context: Visa policy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Homeland Security reportedly plans to restrict student visa holders, most of whom are from China, from staying in the United States for over a year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/overseas-students-would-face-close-scrutiny-under-proposal-floated-at-dhs/2017/07/10/393b5cc0-6282-11e7-a4f7-af34fc1d9d39_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-11-5-4"></a>

Context: United Kingdom–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump Administration announces this year's presidential state visit to the United Kingdom is delayed until at least 2018. Both the White House and 10 Downing Street state the two countries had been unable to agree on a 2017 date. This planned visit has drawn protests in the United Kingdom since February, and more than 1.8 million signatures on a petition to Parliament to cancel the meeting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-britain-idUSKBN19W28G>); [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/donald-trumps-state-visit-to-the-uk-has-been-delayed-until-2018-2017-7>); [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/trump-eyes-swift-uk-trade-deal-state-visit/news-story/89430722f5b07e64c692eccfd13c311e>).

**Archived source account.** Scientists at the Chinese Academy of Sciences successfully teleport a photon from a ground station in Tibet to a satellite orbiting Earth at distance of 500km away. It is the first time an object has been teleported from the planet into space.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-07-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/wonk/wp/2017/07/14/white-house-releases-sensitive-personal-information-of-voters-worried-about-their-sensitive-personal-information/>); [The New York magazine](<http://nymag.com/selectall/2017/07/funny-emails-sent-to-kobachs-election-integrity-commission.html>).

Context: Aftermath of the Mamasapano clash.

**Archived source account.** Former President of the Philippines Benigno "Noynoy" Aquino III is indicted (among others) by the Office of the Ombudsman for his failure in handling the 2015 Mamasapano clash, which resulted in the deaths of 44 members of the Special Action Forces of the Philippine National Police. Aquino's legal team has vowed to appeal for a motion for reconsideration; as well as the group Volunteers Against Crime and Corruption (representing the victims' families), against what they call a "weak case" (citing Aquino's charges of "graft" &amp; "usurpation of authority", instead of "reckless imprudence resulting in multiple homicide")

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<http://www.rappler.com/nation/175603-noynoy-aquino-indicted-graft-mamasapano-ombudsman>); [ABC News.go](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170717061748/http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/philippines-leader-faces-charges-role-clash-48631698>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-idUSKBN19Z1R7?il=0>); [U.S. State Department](<http://live.reuters.com/Event/Live_US_Politics/989297085>).

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict, 2017 Temple Mount crisis.

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Reuters reports protests over metal detectors and the under-50 restriction after two officers were killed, identifying the contested shrine’s Muslim and Jewish names.

Editorial date: 2017-07-21. Checked: 2026-10-21. The original attributed context and restriction are supported.

Evidence: [Reuters via The Daily Star](<https://www.thedailystar.net/world/3-palestinians-killed-amid-tensions-jerusalem-1436752>).

Original source account: Several thousand Palestinians protest Israel's installation of metal detectors and a ban on Muslim men under the age of 50 in response to the killing of two Israeli policemen last Friday at a contested Jerusalem holy place, known to Muslims as the Noble Sanctuary and to Jews as the Temple Mount.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-07-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Salvador Dalí.

**Archived source account.** The remains of surrealist painter Salvador Dalí are exhumed following a Madrid court order on settling the paternity claim of a woman who is allegedly the painter's natural daughter. Various experts contest the claim, noting Dalí's sexual eccentrism (including a public boast about his "impotency") and that the action being against the state (Dalí bequeathed his estate to Spain). If proven, this woman could assume part of Dalí's estate.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40677828>).

<a id="event-2017-07-22-3-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-07-22-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Russian air force bombards the city of Madan and Zor Shamr Camp, south and east of Raqqa, Syria, with cluster bombs, killing six civilians and wounding 19 others. Nearby Alburamadan town was also struck; there are no reports of casualties.

There is speculation the attack may be linked to recent events at Jerusalem's Al-Aqsa Mosque. Another Jordanian man was killed inadvertently.

Source citations (as archived): [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/news/archive/2017/07/israeli-embassy-attack/534612/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-jordan-israel-security-idUSKBN1A80SE?il=0>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-40700467>).

**Archived source account.** Nine men are found dead inside a tractor-trailer parked outside a Walmart store in the American city of San Antonio, Texas, in what authorities call a case of "ruthless" human trafficking. Thirty people, many in critical condition and suffering from heat stroke and exhaustion, were removed from the non-air conditioned trailer which also lacked a water supply.

Previous attempts to recover the bells have all failed so far.

**Archived source account.** At least five people are injured, two seriously, after a man attacks people with a chainsaw in Schaffhausen, Switzerland. A manhunt is underway for the suspect.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/24/europe/switzerland-chainsaw/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Deportation from the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Judge for the Eastern District of Michigan, Mark A. Goldsmith, halts for 90 days the mass deportation from the United States of more than 1,400 Iraqi nationals, including Chaldean Christians, to allow the plaintiffs time to appeal their cases. The American Civil Liberties Union petitioned for the injunction stating these people would face persecution in Iraq where they are considered ethnic and religious minorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-iraqis-idUSKBN1AA04Z>); [Detroit Free Press](<http://www.freep.com/story/news/2017/07/25/detroit-judge-halts-deportation-iraqis-detained-ice/505321001/>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/federal-judge-blocks-mass-deportation-iraqis-n786181>).
