<a id="event-2017-07-24-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of China.

**Archived source account.** The Chinese Central Commission for Discipline Inspection announces that current Politburo member Sun Zhengcai is under investigation for violating party discipline. Sun is the fourth sitting Politburo member since 1990 to fall from power.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/24/world/asia/china-xi-jinping-sun-zhengcai.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-24-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Poland.

**Archived source account.** Polish President Andrzej Duda announces he will veto two judicial reform bills passed by Poland's parliament, which the European Commission said would result in sanctions, and which have generated continuous demonstrations across the country. The ruling Law and Justice Party needs to put together a three-fifths majority to override the veto.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/24/world/europe/poland-president-duda-veto-courts.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40703909>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-judiciary-idUSKBN1A915E>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-07-24-6-1"></a>

Context: Lunar water.

**Archived source account.** Brown University researchers discover that a substantial amount of water may be present beneath the surface of the Moon.

Source citations (as archived): [Space](<https://www.space.com/37596-moon-interior-could-have-water.html>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/24/us/moon-water-study/index.html>).

### 2017-07-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1222654061](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%2025&oldid=1222654061>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-07-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / 2017 Temple Mount crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli government says it will remove metal detectors and some cameras recently installed at the entrances to the Temple Mount in Jerusalem that resulted in a wave of protests and some deaths. Instead, less obtrusive surveillance means will be used.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/24/world/middleeast/israel-jordan-aqsa-temple-mount-violence.html>); [Haaretz](<http://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/1.803266>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-idUSKBN1A92Q5>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Kurt Volker, U.S. special representative for Ukraine, says in a BBC News interview that the White House is considering arming Ukrainian government forces fighting Pro-Russian militants with defensive weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-40712385>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-07-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Microsoft Paint.

**Archived source account.** Amid a public backlash, Microsoft reneges on its decision to end its Paint program and states that it will be placed on its app store rather than bundled with future editions of Windows.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/news/microsoft-paint-dead-windows-coming-back-download-how-to-app-store-3d-a7858536.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-1-3"></a>

Context: Adobe Flash.

**Archived source account.** Adobe Systems announces it will stop updating and distributing its multimedia software platform Flash by the end of 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-adobe-systems-flash-idUSKBN1AA22R>); [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/07/25/technology/adobe-killing-flash/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-1-5"></a>

Context: Jimmy Choo Ltd.

**Archived source account.** Michael Kors buys Jimmy Choo for US$1.2 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/25/business/dealbook/jimmy-choo-michael-kors.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-1-7"></a>

Context: Alternative fuel vehicles.

**Archived source account.** Following a similar move in France, the United Kingdom is to ban the sale of petrol and diesel cars by 2040 in order to reduce air pollution. A new tax will also be levied on diesel car drivers in 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/petrol-and-diesel-cars-banned-from-uk-roads-by-2040-10962075>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-25-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 heat wave in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Firefighters battle wildfires across southern France, including one in Corsica.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20170725-firefighters-struggle-battle-wildfires-across-southern-france-corsica>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-2-2"></a>

Context: 2017 heat wave in Europe.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis halts the fountains of The Vatican amidst a drought in Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/pope-francis-shuts-off-vatican-fountains-in-response-to-rome-italy-drought/>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-07-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Chronic traumatic encephalopathy.

**Archived source account.** A study, published in the Journal of the American Medical Association, finds that 99 percent of the brains donated for scientific research by deceased National Football League players show signs of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE), the disease identified in autopsies of numerous NFL players who have committed suicide, and the subject of the 2015 movie Concussion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-nfl-cte-idUSKBN1AA2BW>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/25/health/cte-nfl-players-brains-study/index.html>); [JAMA](<http://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2645104>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-07-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Jordan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Jordanian authorities release a video of a Jordanian Air Force sergeant shooting United States soldiers.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/24/us/video-shows-us-soldiers-surrendering-before-fatal-shooting-in-jordan.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-4-3"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Navy says the USS Thunderbolt fired a warning shot at an Iranian patrol boat after it came within 150 yards of the U.S. ship.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/us-navy-ship-fires-multiple-warning-shots-iranian/story?id=48835417>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-4-5"></a>

Context: United States embargoes.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives votes in favor of economic sanctions against Russia for its interference in the 2016 U.S. election, and against Iran and North Korea for their weapons programs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/powerpost/house-prepares-to-pass-sanctions-bill--and-set-up-veto-dilemma-for-trump/2017/07/25/ece80164-7138-11e7-8839-ec48ec4cae25_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-07-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Efforts to repeal Obamacare.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate votes to open debate on repealing and possibly replacing Obamacare.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/senate-sets-sights-skinny-repeal-obamacare-tuesday-s-voting-n786296>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-5-2"></a>

Context: Efforts to repeal Obamacare.

**Archived source account.** The Senate votes against the Better Care Reconciliation Act of 2017 amendment.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2017/07/25/us/politics/senate-votes-repeal-obamacare.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-25-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Documents that were previously sealed and withheld from the public pertaining to the John F. Kennedy assassination are released.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. National Archives](<https://www.archives.gov/research/jfk/2017-release>).

### 2017-07-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1162238775](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%2026&oldid=1162238775>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-07-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Holy Name of Jesus cathedral in Raleigh, North Carolina is dedicated. The groundbreaking took place on January 3, 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [WRL.com Capitol Broadcasting](<https://www.wral.com/catholics-celebrate-joyful-historic-day-with-raleigh-cathedral-opening/16842265/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-07-26-1-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** According to the Defense Ministry, between 26 and 30 military personnel are dead and over 80 Taliban militants have been either killed or wounded amid intense fighting at a military base in Kandahar Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/afghanistan-attack-kandahar-taliban/28638763.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-26-1-3"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** A U.N. peacekeeping helicopter crashes during a mission in northern Mali, resulting in the death of two German pilots within.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/german-army-helicopter-crashes-in-mali-on-un-mission/a-39847702>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-26-2-1"></a>

Context: French Riviera.

**Archived source account.** Wildfires prompt the evacuation of 12,000 people along the French Riviera, while more than 4,000 firefighters and French Armed Forces personnel backed by 19 water-bomber planes are mobilised to extinguish the flames.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jul/26/france-wildfires-corsica-cote-d-azur-holiday>).

<a id="event-2017-07-26-2-3"></a>

Context: History of Mumbai.

**Archived source account.** At least 17 people are killed in a building collapse in the Indian city of Mumbai with at least 13 injured and twelve people unaccounted for.

Source citations (as archived): [AP/PA](<http://www.milfordmercury.co.uk/news/national/15434567.Death_toll_in_Mumbai_building_collapse_rises_to_17/>).

<a id="event-2017-07-26-2-5"></a>

Context: Ohio State Fair.

**Archived source account.** At least one person is killed and several others injured after the Fire Ball ride at the Ohio State Fair malfunctions while operating.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/26/us/ohio-state-fair-ride-incident/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-07-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Alaska.

**Archived source account.** A woman is killed aboard the Emerald Princess cruise ship as it sails to a port of call in Juneau, Alaska, U.S. The passengers are detained while the FBI investigates. Authorities suspect the incident is related to domestic violence.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<http://www.9news.com/mobile/article/news/fbi-investigating-death-from-domestic-dispute-on-cruise-ship/459712377>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-07-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Sexual orientation and gender identity in the United States military.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump tweets that transgender Americans will not be allowed to serve "in any capacity" in the United States Armed Forces.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/343847-trump-calls-for-ban-on-transgender-individuals-in-military>).

<a id="event-2017-07-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Efforts to repeal Obamacare.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate rejects "repeal only" propositions of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act. United States President Donald Trump lashes out at Republican Senator Lisa Murkowski, who voted against the proposal.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/26/us/politics/health-care-senate-vote.html?_r=0>).

<a id="event-2017-07-26-4-5"></a>

Context: Corruption in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Prime Minister, Mariano Rajoy, testify in Audiencia Nacional as a witness in the framework of the investigation into the Gürtel corruption scandal, of the illegal financing of his party. He is the first PM in Spain in service to attend a trial. Although he benefited from this corruption scheme, he denied any knowledge. This situation prompted a no-confidence motion against Rajoy's government, which was debated on 13 June and defeated as expected on 14 June

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40728431>).

<a id="event-2017-07-26-4-6"></a>

Context: Corruption in Spain.

**Archived source account.** Pío García-Escudero, the President of the Senate also testify as a witness in the same investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.es/espana/abci-garcia-escudero-citado-declarar-juicio-gurtel-201707051240_noticia.html>).

### 2017-07-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626620](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%2027&oldid=1104626620>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-07-27-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine's domestic intelligence service, the SBU, reports that the March 2017 explosions at Balakliia military base in Eastern Ukraine were caused by a drone carrying a ZMG-1 thermite grenade. The explosions resulted in 1 death and 5 injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [Popular Mechanics](<http://www.popularmechanics.com/military/weapons/news/a27511/russia-drone-thermite-grenade-ukraine-ammo/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-07-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Chantiers de l'Atlantique.

**Archived source account.** France nationalises the STX Europe-owned Chantiers de l'Atlantique shipyard in Saint-Nazaire, Pays de la Loire, to prevent Italian shipbuilding firm Fincantieri taking majority control. Italian Minister of Economy and Finances Pier Carlo Padoan calls the French decision to nationalise the shipyard "grave and incomprehensible".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-stx-m-a-fincantieri-france-idUSKBN1AC16H>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-07-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Electronic cigarette.

**Archived source account.** A new study, published in the The BMJ medical journal, finds that electronic cigarettes may help smokers stop their habit. The researchers found that a substantial increase in e-cigarette use among American adult smokers was associated with a statistically significant increase in the smoking cessation rate.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Health/cigarettes-smokers-quit/story?id=48886292>); [The BMJ](<http://www.bmj.com/content/358/bmj.j3262>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-07-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Russia and the United Nations.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin appoints Vasily Nebenzya to be the new Permanent Representative of Russia to the United Nations following the sudden death of Vitaly Churkin in February.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/ Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/russia-new-un-representative-nebenzya-putin/28643069.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-27-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Venezuelan protests.

**Archived source account.** At least three protesters are killed across the country amid clashes with police as a two-day national strike called by the opposition begins.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/07/killed-venezuela-opposition-strike-begins-170727051242154.html>).

<a id="event-2017-07-27-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Anna Johansson and Anders Ygeman resign in the wake of controversy surrounding a 2015 data leak of the Swedish Transport Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.eu/article/sweden-data-breach-privacy-security-stefan-lofven/>).

### 2017-07-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1260735471](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%2028&oldid=1260735471>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-07-28-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Hamburg attack.

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and four others are injured in a knife attack in an Edeka supermarket in Barmbek in the German city of Hamburg. Mayor Olaf Scholz said the attack was motivated by "hate". The attacker is reported to have shouted "Allahu Akbar" before attacking.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40757119>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-07-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Appeals Court Judge Patricia Millett rejects the Federal Aviation Administration argument that seat size is unimportant when passengers exit a plane in an emergency, and orders the FAA to set minimum standards for the space airlines give passengers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-planes-idUSKBN1AD28Y>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-07-28/u-s-court-rebukes-faa-over-incredible-shrinking-airline-seat>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Barcelona train crash.

**Archived source account.** A passenger train crashes into a buffer stop at Barcelona França railway station, injuring 54 people, five seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40750343>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-07-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Charlie Gard case.

**Archived source account.** Charlie Gard, an infant with a rare genetic condition known as mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome, dies at the age of 11 months.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-40752120>); [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/terminally-ill-charlie-gard-dies-in-hospice-10965654>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-07-28-4-2"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction / 2017 North Korean missile tests.

**Archived source account.** North Korea launches an intercontinental ballistic missile that flies 620 miles horizontally in about 45 minutes, landing in the Sea of Japan, according to Japan, South Korea and the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/us-detects-north-korean-missile-launch/story?id=48908129>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-idUSKBN1AD1ZB>).

<a id="event-2017-07-28-4-4"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Treasury Department imposes sanctions on six Shahid Hemmat Industrial Group satellite companies following a recent Iranian rocket launch that the U.S. says breached United Nations Security Council Resolution 2231.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-iran-satellite-sanctions-idUSKBN1AD289>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/28/politics/new-iran-sanctions/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-07-28-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act replacement proposals.

**Archived source account.** The American Health Care Act of 2017, an attempt to repeal the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, fails passage in the United States Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-healthcare-idUSKBN1AC1G0>).

<a id="event-2017-07-28-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Pakistan, Nawaz Sharif resigns after the Supreme Court disqualifies him from holding public office following a verdict that he had been dishonest in not disclosing his employment in the Dubai-based Capital FZE company in his nomination papers.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn (Pakistan)](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1348191>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-40750671>).

<a id="event-2017-07-28-5-5"></a>

Context: Political appointments by Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces Homeland Security Secretary John F. Kelly will be White House Chief of Staff, replacing Reince Priebus.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/president-trump-tweets-john-kelly-chief-staff/story?id=48916035>); [Twitter](<https://twitter.com/realDonaldTrump/status/891038014314598400>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/28/us/politics/reince-priebus-white-house-trump.html>).

### 2017-07-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1090434422](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20July%2029&oldid=1090434422>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-29-0-1"></a>

Context: South African Premier Division.

**Archived source account.** Two people die and 17 others are injured in a stampede at the First National Bank Stadium in Soweto, near Johannesburg, South Africa, during a soccer match between Orlando Pirates and Kaizer Chiefs.

Source citations (as archived): [Mail and Guardian](<https://mg.co.za/article/2017-07-29-soweto-derby-two-dead-in-fnb-stadium-stampede>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-40765349>).

**Archived source account.** A fire forces the evacuation of more than 22,000 concertgoers at the Tomorrowland music festival at the Parc de Can Zam in Barcelona, Spain. There were no serious injuries. This is the first time the festival has been held in Spain; Belgium had been the home since 2005.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/life/music/2017/07/30/20-000-fans-flee-huge-fire-tomorrowland-edm-festival-barcelona/523666001/>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/fire-tomorrowland-festival-barcelona-forces-22-000-evacuate-n787846>).

<a id="event-2017-07-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Poland in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Union's executive branch sends a formal notice to Poland expressing their concern that the new "discretionary" powers given to the country's justice minister threaten the independence of the courts in violation of EU laws. Poland has a month to respond.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/eu-executive-branch-files-complaint-poland-48924145>); [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/poland-politics-eu-idINKBN1AE0EF>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-07-29-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Islamic inspired bomb plot on Australian aeroplane.

**Archived source account.** Australian federal police conduct raids in four separate suburbs of Sydney, detaining individuals and confiscating materials involved in a suspected terrorist plot to bomb an aircraft.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2017/jul/29/counter-terrorism-police-raid-properties-in-four-sydney-suburbs>).

<a id="event-2017-07-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** Monsignor Arnel Lagarejos, a Catholic priest from the Roman Catholic Diocese of Antipolo, Philippines was arrested in Marikina for sexually abusing a 13-year-old girl, by inviting her to a motel with a 16-year-old pimp.

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/918633/priest-arrested-for-trafficking-minor-in-marikina>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-07-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Kenyan general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** A man wielding a machete attacks the home of Kenya's Deputy President William Ruto, injuring one guard, 10 days before national elections. Ruto and his family were not home at the time. The assailant fled to a farm complex, reportedly hiding in an unfinished building. There are other media reports that gunmen also struck the home.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/africa/kenyan-media-unknown-gunmen-attack-kenyan-vps-home/2017/07/29/4cd29d5e-747d-11e7-8c17-533c52b2f014_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kenya-attacks-idUSKBN1AE0FO>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-07-29-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Charles Kuonen Bridge in the Swiss Alps in Randa, Switzerland, opens. At 1,621 feet (494 meters), it is the longest pedestrian suspension bridge in the world.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/31/design/longest-pedestrian-suspension-bridge-switzerland/index.html>); [Condé Nast Traveler](<http://www.cntraveler.com/story/charles-kuonen-suspension-bridge-opens>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-07-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Floods in India.

**Archived source account.** Following heavy rain in July 2017, the Gujarat state of India was affected by a severe flood resulting in more than 200 deaths.

<a id="event-2017-07-30-1-2"></a>

<a id="event-2017-07-30-3-3"></a>

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-08-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Danish royal consorts.

**Archived source account.** Denmark's Prince Henrik announces he won't be buried next to Queen Margrethe II in the Roskilde Cathedral where Danish royals have been buried since 1559. Context: Economy of the United States.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Dubai skyscraper fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire at the 79-story Dubai Torch Tower in the United Arab Emirates, which forced nighttime evacuations, was under control in a few hours with no serious injuries immediately reported. The building's exterior was still being renovated from a fire in February, 2015, which investigators had blamed, at least in part, to flammable siding, echoing the findings of this past June's Grenfell Tower fire in London.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/03/world/middleeast/torch-tower-dubai-fire.html>); [The National](<https://www.thenational.ae/uae/torch-tower-blaze-475-residents-evacuated-after-fire-starts-on-26th-floor-1.616755>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in New York (state).

**Archived source account.** Former pharmaceutical company executive Martin Shkreli is convicted of three counts of securities fraud in a federal court in Brooklyn, New York.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-crime-shkreli-idUSKBN1AK27F>).

<a id="event-2017-08-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** A former Volkswagen executive pleads guilty to defrauding the United States and violating the Clean Air Act.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-40829900>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-08-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Rwandan presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Rwanda go to the polls to elect their president. Paul Kagame, incumbent since 2000, referred to the election as a formality, despite challenges from the Democratic Greens' Frank Habineza and independent Philippe Mpayimana. Kagame is re-elected with 98.66 of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-40822530>); [Sky News](<http://www.skynews.com.au/news/politics/international/2017/08/05/rwanda-s-kagame-wins-presidential-election.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-04-4-3"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Socorro Flores Liera, Mexico's deputy foreign minister for Latin America and the Caribbean, speaks during an interview with Reuters in Mexico City, that during the first half of 2017, 1,420 Venezuelans have sought asylum in Mexico, a nearly four-fold jump compared to the 361 total Venezuelan asylum applicants for all of 2016, as the result of Venezuela's deepening political and economic crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-venezuela-migration-idUSKBN1AL0QC>).

### 2017-08-05

#### Disasters and accidents

Context: 2017 V-22 Osprey crash.

**Archived source account.** Searches are underway for three members of the United States Marine Corps missing after a MV-22 Osprey crashed off the coast of the Australian state of Queensland. Twenty three of the twenty six people on board have been rescued.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-05-2-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-08-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Mauritanian constitutional referendum, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Mauritania participate in a referendum on whether to amend the Constitution of Mauritania, with the abolition of the Senate and addition of red bands to the flag of Mauritania among the most significant proposed changes. The OCHR has criticised Mohamed Ould Abdel Aziz's government for apparent suppression of opposition protests.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/video/news/2017/08/mauritanians-fear-dictatorship-referendum-vote-170804135119576.html>).

**Archived source account.** Venkaiah Naidu elected as India's 13th Vice-President of India.

Context: 2017 Venezuelan constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least 56 African migrants drown in the Red Sea while traveling from the Horn of Africa to Yemen. Human traffickers had forced 300 people aboard two boats into the sea.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/least-56-dead-smugglers-throw-300-african-migrants-153712561.html>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-08-11-3-1"></a>

Context: Gorakhpur hospital deaths.

**Archived source account.** Over the past two days, 30 children from Baba Raghav Das Medical College have died, allegedly due to lack of oxygen supply to the wards.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/11/world/asia/30-children-die-in-indian-hospital-over-2-days-critics-cite-oxygen-shortage.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-08-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Cambodia–Laos relations.

**Archived source account.** According to Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen, 30 Laotian soldiers cross the border into Steung Treng Province despite repeated requests for them to leave. Hun Sen gives Laos a six-day ultimatum to withdraw the soldiers or face a military response.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/08/cambodia-pm-ultimatum-laos-invasion-170811095815240.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-11-4-3"></a>

Context: Peru–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** Shortly after Peruvian President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski called Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro a "dictator" in response to the Venezuelan constitutional crisis, Peru expels Venezuela's ambassador to Peru to protest Venezuela's recent formation of an all-powerful constituent assembly that has been widely condemned as a power grab by Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-peru-idUSKBN1AR2B7>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-08-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Kenyan general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The Kenyan electoral commission announces that President Uhuru Kenyatta has won re-election. Kenyatta leads ODM candidate Raila Odinga by more than 1.4 million votes. The opposition National Super Alliance rejects this finding as fraudulent.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/08/11/542798477/it-s-official-kenyan-president-wins-re-election-but-will-opposition-concede>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kenya-election-idUSKBN1AR0SK>).

<a id="event-2017-08-11-5-3"></a>

Context: Military of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Because of a recent pair of deadly crashes, the U.S. Marine Corps will ground its flight operations for 24 hours for an operational reset. The suspensions will be spread out over the next two weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-marines-idUSKBN1AR2HZ>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/11/us/marines-order-brief-groundings-and-safety-reviews.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-11-5-5"></a>

Context: Unite the Right rally.

**Archived source account.** A white nationalist rally called "Unite the Right" takes place in Charlottesville, Virginia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://us.cnn.com/2017/08/12/us/charlottesville-white-nationalists-rally/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-12-0-8"></a>

### 2017-08-14

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-08-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Big Ben.

**Archived source account.** London's Big Ben, atop Elizabeth Tower, will fall silent for four years beginning 21 August while essential repair works are performed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-40922169>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/just-a-few-more-bongs-for-big-ben-before-london-bell-is-silenced-for-four-years/2017/08/14/b61c59f2-80ef-11e7-902a-2a9f2d808496_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-14-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** American stuntwoman Joi 'SJ' Harris is killed in a motorcycle crash in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, while filming for Deadpool 2.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hollywood Reporter](<http://www.hollywoodreporter.com/heat-vision/deadpool-2-stuntwoman-who-died-shoot-gets-identified-1029726>).

<a id="event-2017-08-14-0-5"></a>

Context: Removal of Confederate monuments and memorials.

**Archived source account.** During a protest in Durham, North Carolina, to show solidarity with the events in Charlottesville, Virginia, a Confederate monument was pulled down and destroyed; a woman has been arrested and charged in connection with the event.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/08/14/us/confederate-statue-pulled-down-north-carolina-trnd/index.html>).

#### Disaster and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-14-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Sierra Leone mudslides.

**Archived source account.** A mudslide triggered by heavy rain near Sierra Leone's capital Freetown, kills at least 350 people with the death toll expected to rise as high as 500.

Source citations (as archived): [Central Queensland Radio](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170815140650/https://www.4ro.com.au/news/national-news/94309-sierra-leone-mudslide-claims-350-lives>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-40926187>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-08-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Japanese war crimes.

**Archived source account.** The National Archives of Korea has received a donation of around 6,000 records showing the forced mobilization of Koreans during Korea's colonial occupation by the Empire of Japan, some of them involving details about the controversial Hashima Island. The government agency plans to publish the records online after classification.

Source citations (as archived): [KBS World Radio](<http://world.kbs.co.kr/english/news/news_Po_detail.htm?No=129377>).

<a id="event-2017-08-14-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The International Institute for Strategic Studies releases a report arguing that North Korea has acquired a high-performance liquid-propellant engine for its missile program, probably from illicit networks in Russia and Ukraine, likely produced by Yuzhmash facilities. Ukraine denies the allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-ukraine-idUSKCN1AU1C9>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/14/world/asia/north-korea-missiles-ukraine-factory.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in France.

**Archived source account.** A 13-year-old girl is killed when a car is deliberately driven into a pizza restaurant's sidewalk cafe in Sept-Sorts, France. At least 12 other people are injured, four critically. The driver is arrested. Police do not believe the incident was terrorism-related.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<http://www.cbsnews.com/news/young-girl-killed-car-plows-into-pizzeria-france/>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/girl-killed-seine-et-marne-france-paris-car-slams-into-crowd-pizzeria-a7893481.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-14-3-3"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Senate Majority Leader Vicente "Tito" Sotto III has lashed out at UN special rapporteurs headed by Agnes Callamard, in his privilege speech calling them "helicopter experts" for offering "solutions" to a decades-old problem of a country "they are not even familiar with".

Source citations (as archived): [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/922648/senate-majority-leader-vicente-sotto-iii-united-nations-agnes-callamard/>).

Context: 2016–17 Rohingya persecution in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** India announces that it is to deport an estimated 40,000 Rohingya refugees including 14,000 of those registered with the U.N. refugee agency. In the months leading up to the announcement, a string of anti-Rohingya protests had been held in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-india-idUSKCN1AU0UC>).

<a id="event-2017-08-14-4-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Deputy Prime Minister of Australia Barnaby Joyce is revealed to have unknowingly held dual citizenship with New Zealand since his election, which may have rendered him ineligible for candidacy under section 44 of the Constitution of Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-08-14/barnaby-joyce-is-a-new-zealand-citizen-nz-government-confirms/8804620>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-40921373>).

**Archived source account.** California and San Francisco sue the United States Federal government over its opposition towards sanctuary cities.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2017/08/14/california-trump-sanctuary-city-grant-lawsuit-241623>).

<a id="event-2017-08-15-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Unite the Right rally.

**Archived source account.** During a press conference at Trump Tower in New York City, which was intended to announce an executive order on infrastructure policy, President Donald Trump defended his August 12 remarks about the Charlottesville rally, placing "blame on both sides" for the incidents at the rally and criticizing what he referred to as the "alt-left," equating them with white supremacists and neo-Nazis on the right.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trump-lashes-alt-left-charlottesville-fine-people-sides/story?id=49235032>); [NBC News](<http://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/trump-defends-all-sides-comment-n793001>).

**Archived source account.** Alliance for American Manufacturing president Scott Paul, AFL–CIO president Richard Trumka and the union's former chief of staff Thea Lee resign from President Trump's American Manufacturing Council due to their disagreements with Trump's response to the rally. Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/08/14/intel-ceo-quit-trumps-manufacturing-council.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/15/business/trump-councils-ceos.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-17-1-1"></a>

Context: Fires in Alaska.

**Archived source account.** A large fire continues to burn at the Peter Pan Seafoods fish processing plant in Port Moller, Alaska, on the Alaska Peninsula. Much of the facility has been destroyed, and the plant is out of commission. Power is out in the village.

Source citations (as archived): [King 5](<http://www.king5.com/mobile/article/news/local/peter-pan-seafoods-fish-processing-plant-damaged-by-fire/464946607>).

<a id="event-2017-08-17-1-3"></a>

Context: USS Fitzgerald and MV ACX Crystal collision.

**Archived source account.** The US Navy has announced that about a dozen sailors of the USS Fitzgerald are to be disciplined in the aftermath of the collision with a container ship last June, where 7 crew members died.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-40970860>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-08-17-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 China–India border standoff.

**Archived source account.** An English-language Chinese propaganda video from Xinhua, entitled The Spark: 7 Sins of India about the Doklam stand-off involving China, India and Bhutan, goes viral and sparks anger within India.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-40957719>).

<a id="event-2017-08-17-2-3"></a>

Context: South Africa–Zimbabwe relations.

**Archived source account.** The South African Police Service issues a red alert at the country's borders to prevent First Lady of Zimbabwe Grace Mugabe from leaving the country. She is wanted on charges of "assault with intent to cause grievous bodily harm" on a 20-year-old woman in a hotel room in Johannesburg.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-40958959>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed and 48 are arrested by the Philippine National Police Manila Police District in consecutive anti-drug operations in Manila within 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [Manila Times](<http://www.manilatimes.net/25-dead-over-24-hours-one-time-big-time-police-operations-manila/344991/>).

<a id="event-2017-08-17-3-3"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War / Shooting of Kian Loyd delos Santos.

**Archived source account.** Kian Loyd delos Santos, a 17-year old Grade 11 student, was shot dead by police after trying to escape an antidrug operation in Caloocan.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/metro/622230/grade-11-student-killed-during-anti-drug-op-in-caloocan/story/>).

<a id="event-2017-08-17-3-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Hong Kong.

**Archived source account.** Hong Kong opposition activists Alex Chow, Joshua Wong, and Nathan Law are sentenced between six to eight months in prison and barred from holding office until 2022 as the Hong Kong government imposes harsher punishments on the individuals for their role in the Umbrella Movement.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/politics/article/2107216/occupy-activists-joshua-wong-and-nathan-law-jailed-hong-kong>).

<a id="event-2017-08-17-3-7"></a>

Context: International Criminal Court investigation in Mali.

**Archived source account.** The International Criminal Court has ruled that Ahmad al-Faqi al-Mahdi is liable for about € 2.7 million in personal damages for the destruction of Timbuktu's heritage sites, and that the victims (including Mali itself and the international community) be paid "individual, collective, and symbolic" reparations. The Trust Fund for Victims is to decide until 16 February 2018 how the amount will be paid (the Court has also recognized that the penniless al-Mahdi would be unable to pay).

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.afp.com/en/news/205/icc-rules-jihadist-liable-27-mn-euros-timbuktu-destruction>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-08-17-4-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump has ended his planned Presidential Advisory Council on Infrastructure after only a month, coming a day after two other advisory councils, the Strategic and Policy Forum and the American Manufacturing Council, were scrapped. No reason was given.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2017/08/17/politics/trump-ends-council-on-infrastructure/index.html>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-08-17/trump-is-said-to-abandon-plan-for-council-on-infrastructure>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-08-17-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Unite the Right rally.

**Archived source account.** Internet firm CloudFlare ceased CDN support for the neo-Nazi, white supremacist website The Daily Stormer, after The Daily Stormer claimed that the company supported their cause. The Daily Stormer website had already lost web-hosting services by the domain register GoDaddy and Google

Source citations (as archived): [Cloudflare's Official Blog](<https://blog.cloudflare.com/why-we-terminated-daily-stormer/>); [CNN Money](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/08/17/technology/business/cloudflare-drops-daily-stormer/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-17-5-3"></a>

Context: LIGO/Virgo gravitational wave detection..

**Archived source account.** A gravitational wave signal called GW170817 is observed by the LIGO/Virgo-collaboration. A Neutron star collision triggered the gravitational waves which "also created heavy elements such as gold, platinum and lead".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/10/16/world/neutron-star-collision-gravitational-waves-light/index.html>).

### 2017-08-18

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-08-18-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 Barcelona attacks.

**Archived source account.** Catalan police in the coastal town of Cambrils kill five suspected terrorists in a counter-terror operation to stop a second van attack. The police reported the attackers were wearing explosive vests, however they were later discovered to be fakes.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-40971004>).

<a id="event-2017-08-18-0-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Turku stabbing.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are reportedly killed, and several others wounded in a stabbing in Turku, Finland. Police said they arrested one person after a shootout and had launched a manhunt for other possible attackers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-finland-stabbing-idUSKCN1AY1IS>); [HS](<http://www.hs.fi/kotimaa/art-2000005331688.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-08-18-1-1"></a>

Context: Removal of monuments and memorials.

**Archived source account.** The 145-year-old Roger B. Taney Monument outside Maryland State House in Annapolis, Maryland, is removed overnight by authorities. Maryland Governor Larry Hogan called on Wednesday for the monument to be taken down immediately.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-protests-statues-idUSKCN1AY0UC>).

<a id="event-2017-08-18-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Joseon Dynasty-era royal seals which were repatriated last July from the U.S. after being illegally taken out by an American soldier during the Korean War, are on exhibit at the National Palace Museum of Korea.

<a id="event-2017-08-18-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Workers at two British McDonald's restaurants overwhelmingly vote to authorize a strike over working conditions and the use of zero-hour contracts, which would be the first such labor action against the fast-food chain in the U.K.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2017/aug/18/mcdonalds-employees-vote-to-strike-over-pay-and-zero-hours-concerns>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-08-18/staff-at-two-u-k-mcdonald-s-restaurants-vote-for-first-strike>).

Context: August 2017 Nepal and India floods.

**Archived source account.** Flooding in South Asia has displaced tens of thousands of people and resulted in an estimated 500 deaths across India, Bangladesh, and Nepal.

<a id="event-2017-08-18-4-3"></a>

Context: Political appointments by Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.miamiherald.com/entertainment/celebrities/article167952232.html>); [India-West](<http://www.indiawest.com/news/global_indian/kal-penn-jhumpa-lahiri-among-members-who-resign-from-trump/article_a23e4540-844f-11e7-9798-3be4036534a2.html>); [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2017/08/18/Presidential-arts-committee-resigns-en-masse-after-Charlottesville/6441503096571/>).

### 2017-08-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1260735499](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20August%2019&oldid=1260735499>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-08-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Russia.

**Archived source account.** A 23-year-old stabs and injures eight people in the Russian city of Surgut, before being killed by police. ISIL claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [South Front](<https://southfront.org/isis-claimed-responsibility-stabbing-attack-russias-surgut/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-stabbing-idUSKCN1AZ0A6>).

<a id="event-2017-08-19-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A day after a Russian sponsored ceasefire with a rebel group agreed a halt of fighting in the last opposition enclave in the capital, Syrian government airplanes and artillery strike rebel-held eastern Damascus suburbs and Ghouta with barrel bombs, killing at least five civilians in the towns of Hamouriya and Zalamka with several case of suffocation from rockets filled with chlorine that were fired at the front lines of Jobar and Ain Terma.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2017-08-19/syrian-army-pounds-rebel-areas-near-damascus-after-russian-brokered-truce>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-ceasefire-idUSKCN1AZ0Q8>); [SN4HR](<http://sn4hr.org/blog/2017/08/19/civilians-killed-syrian-regime-forces-hamouriya-town-damascus-suburbs-august-19/>).

<a id="event-2017-08-19-0-5"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon.

**Archived source account.** The Lebanese Armed Forces launches operation Fajr al-Joroud, and on the first day recaptures 30 km of territory near the Lebanon–Syria border formerly occupied by ISIS militants. Twenty ISIS militants were killed and 10 Lebanese soldiers were wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2017/Aug-19/416465-live-coverage-army-launches-fajr-al-joroud-operation-against-daesh.ashx>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-08-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Religion in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan holds a state funeral for German-born Catholic nun Ruth Pfau, known as "Pakistan's Mother Teresa," who devoted her life to eradicating leprosy in the South Asian country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-nun-idUSKCN1AZ0AA>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2017.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.4 earthquake strikes west of the Pacific Island of Tonga. There are no immediate reports of casualties or damage.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tonga-quake-idUSKCN1AZ021?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-19-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Khatauli train derailment.

**Archived source account.** A train derails near Khatauli, Uttar Pradesh, India, resulting in at least 23 deaths and 156 injuries.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/india-train-derailment-idINKCN1AZ0G2?il=0>); [Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-08-20/train-derails-in-india-at-least-20-killed/8824086>).

<a id="event-2017-08-19-2-5"></a>

Context: US Navy losses in World War II.

**Archived source account.** The wreckage of the USS Indianapolis heavy cruiser, torpedoed by the Imperial Japanese Navy submarine I-58 and sunk in 1945 after delivering parts for the Little Boy atomic weapon, is discovered on the floor of the North Pacific Ocean. Only 317 of the U.S. Sailors/Marines who survived the sinking were finally rescued after 4–5 days in shark-infested waters.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/08/19/us/uss-indianapolis-wreckage-found/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-19-3-1"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Ain al-Hilweh conflict.

**Archived source account.** Renewed clashes between Islamist extremists and the Fatah-supported Joint Palestinian Security Force at the Ain al-Hilweh Palestinian refugees camp, near Sidon, Lebanon, wound three more Palestinians.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Star](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2017/Aug-22/416739-new-ain-al-hilweh-clashes-break-out.ashx>); [Naharnet](<http://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/234451-ain-el-hilweh-rocked-by-fierce-clashes-for-sixth-day>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-08-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Tourism in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Viacom International Media Networks has announced it will no longer pursue a Nickelodeon underwater theme park and resort in Palawan, Philippines. The project, announced last January, attracted controversy due to criticisms from environmentalist groups who fear the resort might destroy the area's marine ecosystem, home to two UNESCO World Heritage sites.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/business/08/22/17/viacom-withdraws-from-nickelodeon-project-in-palawan>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Maritime incidents in 2017.

**Archived source account.** The passenger ship Comandante Ribeiro sinks in the Xingu River near Porto de Moz, Brazil, with the loss of at least ten lives.

Source citations (as archived): [Shipwreck Log](<https://www.shipwrecklog.com/log/2017/08/comandante-ribeiro/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Triple talaq in India.

**Archived source account.** The "triple talaq", an Islamic practice allowing men to divorce instantly, is declared unconstitutional by the Supreme Court of India.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/aug/22/india-supreme-court-bans-islamic-instant-divorce-triple-talaq>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-08-22-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 NBA season transactions.

**Archived source account.** In the NBA, the Cleveland Cavaliers and Boston Celtics swap All-Star point guards, with Isaiah Thomas going to the Cavaliers and Kyrie Irving to the Celtics. The Celtics also send the Cavaliers forward Jae Crowder, center Ante Žižić, and a 2018 first-round draft pick that they had previously obtained from the Brooklyn Nets.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/20421382/cleveland-cavaliers-send-kyrie-irving-boston-celtics-deal-including-isaiah-thomas>).

<a id="event-2017-08-23-2-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-08-23-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A passenger train collided with a dump truck on the line at Auraiya, India, and was derailed. Twenty-five people were injured.

<a id="event-2017-08-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Disappearance of Kim Wall.

**Archived source account.** A headless dismembered torso found washed ashore in Copenhagen two days ago is identified as Kim Wall. According to a police spokesperson, the body was deliberately mutilated and had metal attached to it so that it would not float.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://web.archive.org/web/20170826013200/http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/danish-police-identify-torso-as-missing-submarine-journalist/ar-AAqzgvj?li=BBnb7Kz>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-40922750>).

Context: Angolan legislative election, 2017.

<a id="event-2017-08-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Iran–Qatar relations.

**Archived source account.** Qatar restores diplomatic ties with Iran. Tehran welcomes the move.

<a id="event-2017-08-24-2-3"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

Investigators are exploring whether some form of sonic attack was directed at diplomats' homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cuba-diplomacy-idUSKCN1B42MJ>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-08-25-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand announces the stationing of three more non-combat military personnel in Afghanistan, boosting its military commitment to 13.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-newzealand-afghanistan-idUSKCN1B502E?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Four gunmen attack a Shiite mosque in Kabul, Afghanistan, killing at least 20 people.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/latest-explosions-reported-shiite-mosque-kabul-49413088>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-0-5"></a>

Context: Rohingya insurgency in Western Myanmar / 2016–17 Northern Rakhine State clashes.

**Archived source account.** Government officials in Myanmar report that 12 security personnel (ten policemen, one soldier and one immigration officer) and 59 Rohingya insurgents were killed overnight during coordinated attacks by insurgents on at least 26 police posts and an army base in Rakhine State.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-41046729>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/37103be49dd249af8f2e7297b599fb41/Myanmar:-25-dead-in-militant-attacks-on-police,-border-posts>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-0-7"></a>

Context: 2017 Northern India riots.

**Archived source account.** Riots erupt in Panchkula and later spread to other parts of the Northern Indian state of Haryana, as well as the state of Punjab and the Indian capital of New Delhi, after a special CBI court found the Dera Sacha Sauda chief Gurmeet Ram Rahim Singh guilty of rape. At least 28 people have been killed and 250 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hindu](<http://www.thehindu.com/news/national/other-states/live-updates-dera-sacha-sauda-chief-convicted-in-rape-case/article19558757.ece>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2017/08/25/indias-guru-of-bling-convicted-of-rape/>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-0-9"></a>

Context: American involvement in the Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** United States-supported Somali forces shoot and kill 10 Somalis, including three children, in Lower Shebelle's Bariire village near Mogadishu. While the Somalia government reports the other dead were members of the al Shabaab militia, Lower Shabelle deputy governor Ali Nur Mohamed says the victims were all civilians, farm owners, workers and their children. The U.S. Africa Command says they are investigating these civilian casualties reports.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-security-idUSKCN1B523H>); [Garowe Online](<http://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/conflicting-accounts-emerge-in-wake-of-raid-in-somalia>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-0-10"></a>

Context: American involvement in the Somali Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two British police officers were assaulted with a sword while trying to arrest a man outside Buckingham Palace.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-security-buckinghampalace-idUSKCN1B52K3>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-0-12"></a>

Context: August 2017 Brussels attack.

**Archived source account.** A Somali man has been shot dead after attacking soldiers with a machete in Brussels, in what prosecutors are treating as a terror attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41057304>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2017-08-25-1-1"></a>

Context: Culture in Toronto.

**Archived source account.** Toronto's Sheraton Cadwell Orchestras closes and its management resigns following public backlash to a fat-shaming email that said only "physically fit and slim" singers would be featured in shows.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/lifestyle/2017/08/25/orchestra-closes-after-backlash-over-fat-shaming-singers.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-41054254>); [Global News](<http://globalnews.ca/news/3694284/sheraton-cadwell-orchestras-resignation-weight-email/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-08-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Environment of Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian President Michel Temer abolishes the 46,000 km2 National Reserve of Copper and Associates (Renca) ecological reserve, which spans the borders of Amapá and Pará states in northern Brazil. More than 20 domestic and multinational firms have expressed an interest in accessing the area's deposits of gold, copper, tantalum, iron ore, nickel and manganese.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2017/aug/24/brazil-abolishes-huge-amazon-reserve-in-biggest-attack-in-50-years>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** In anticipation of Hurricane Harvey, residents from Corpus Christi to Galveston, Texas, and workers from Gulf of Mexico oil platforms are evacuating the region. The storm makes landfall between Port Aransas and Port O'Connor as a Category 4 hurricane around 11 p.m. EDT (0300 UTC, August 26) as the strongest storm to hit the United States mainland since 2004. The National Hurricane Center predicts Harvey will linger over Texas for days, dumping \{\{convert\|15\|–\|25\|in\|cm\}\}, and as much as 35 in of rain on some parts of the state.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/08/25/us/hurricane-harvey/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-storm-harvey-nhc-idUSKCN1B409K>); [National Hurricane Center](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCDAT4+shtml/250235.shtml>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-3-2"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** Oil prices rise in anticipation of Harvey's impact on production in the Gulf of Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-global-oil-idUSKCN1B503E?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-3-4"></a>

Context: Accidents and incidents involving helicopters.

**Archived source account.** An American UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter on a training mission crashes off the coast of Yemen with six aboard, five of whom have been rescued. The search continues for the other U.S. service member.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-yemen-crash-idUSKCN1B6054>); [Military.com](<http://www.military.com/daily-news/2017/08/26/uh60-black-hawk-crashes-yemen-1-service-member-missing.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Sanctions against North Korea.

**Archived source account.** The Cabinet of Japan imposes sanctions on various companies in China and Namibia for their business relations with North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<http://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2017/08/25/national/politics-diplomacy/japan-freeze-assets-chinese-namibian-firms-step-u-s-sanctions-targeting-north-korea>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Yingluck Shinawatra.

**Archived source account.** Thailand's Supreme Court issues an arrest warrant for former Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra, who didn't appear in court for the verdict in her negligence trial regarding a rice subsidy program for farmers. The court also issued a statement questioning her attorney's report that she is unwell and a potential flight risk, citing the lack of a physician's certificate. The reading of the verdict has been rescheduled to September 27. Sources within Shinawatra's party Pheu Thai Party have said that she has allegedly fled the country, though not saying where to, in response current prime minister Prayuth Chan-ocha has ordered the border checkpoints to be closely monitored to prevent Shinawatra leaving the country if she has not already.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-politics-idUSKCN1B50AR>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/yingluck-shinawatra-trial-supreme-court-seeks-arrest-of-former-prime-minister-20170825-gy42xb.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/24/world/asia/thailand-yingluck-shinawatra-trial-verdict-arrest-warrant.html>); [BBC Asia](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-41046993>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-5-3"></a>

Context: 2016 South Korean political scandal.

**Archived source account.** Lee Jae-yong (Jay Y. Lee), the vice-chairman of the Samsung Group is sentenced to five years for graft for his involvement in the 2016 South Korean political scandal that led to the impeachment of President of South Korea Park Geun-hye.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-08-25/samsung-heir-sentenced-to-five-years-prison-on-graft-conviction>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-samsung-lee-idUSKCN1B41VC>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-5-5"></a>

Context: Volkswagen emissions scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former Volkswagen engineer James Liang is sentenced by U.S. District Court Judge Sean Cox to 40 months in prison and a $200,000 fine for his role in the decade-long scheme to cheat on federal emissions tests for diesel-powered cars sold in the United States. He is the first company employee sent to prison in the scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/25/business/volkswagen-engineer-prison-diesel-cheating.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-volkswagen-emissions-sentencing-idUSKCN1B51YP>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-5-7"></a>

Context: Donald Trump presidential pardons.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump pardons former sheriff of Maricopa County, Arizona, Joe Arpaio.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/president-trump-grants-pardon-to-former-sheriff-joe-arpaio-of-arizona/2017/08/25/84878658-89f2-11e7-96a7-d178cf3524eb_story.html>); [Reason](<http://reason.com/blog/2017/08/25/trumps-pardon-of-former-sheriff-joe-arpa>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-08-25-6-1"></a>

Context: Political appointments by Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Deputy Assistant to the President Sebastian Gorka resigns expressing unhappiness with the direction of the Trump administration’s foreign policy.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/national/trump-aide-sebastian-gorka-resigns-white-house-article-1.3443137>); [The Federalist](<http://thefederalist.com/2017/08/25/breaking-sebastian-gorka-resigns-from-trump-administration/>).

<a id="event-2017-08-25-6-3"></a>

Context: Sexual orientation and gender identity in the United States military.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump issues a presidential memorandum that stops funding of sex reassignment procedures for military personnel, and that denies entry of transgender individuals into the military. President Trump announced this policy change via Twitter in late July. Two LGBT rights organizations filed a federal lawsuit two weeks ago arguing this policy change is unconstitutional because it denies transgender service members equal protection and due process.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/trump-directs-pentagon-to-implement-ban-on-transgender-service-members-bans-sex-reassignment-surgery/2017/08/25/c8c604d8-89e4-11e7-9ce7-9e175d8953fa_story.html?utm_term=.7ed979afbe85>); [AP](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/military/lawsuit-opposes-trump-s-ban-transgender-military-service-n791241>).

Context: Environmental policy of the Donald Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency announces, effective in 2019, it will no longer sponsor the Climate Leadership Awards program that honors voluntary corporate actions to combat global warming.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-climatechange-epa-idUSKCN1B52PK>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/energy-environment/348026-epa-cancels-sponsorship-of-climate-leadership-awards>).

Harvey is expected to maintain tropical storm strength, with heavy rains and flooding, for at least four days.
