<a id="event-2017-08-26-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean military reports North Korea has fired several short-range projectiles into the sea from its eastern Kangwon province. The U.S. military says three short-range missile launches either exploded on launch or failed in flight.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-idUSKCN1B52Q2?il=0>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-usa-military-idUSKCN1B52SI>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Trial of Yingluck Shinawatra.

**Archived source account.** Senior members of the Pheu Thai Party report former Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra left Thailand last week ahead of the verdict in her negligence trial. She is in Dubai where her brother, Thaksin Shinawatra, lives.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-politics-yingluck-idUSKCN1B603U>).

<a id="event-2017-08-26-2-3"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of sympathizers attend the funeral procession of a teenager killed allegedly due to the ongoing drug purge in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/over-a-thousand-join-funeral-procession-for-slain-philippine-teenager-kian-loyd-delos>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-08-26-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Women's Rugby World Cup.

**Archived source account.** The Women's Rugby World Cup concludes with New Zealand defeating England 41–32 in the final.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/rugby-union/41049719>).

<a id="event-2017-08-26-3-3"></a>

Context: Great Alaska Shootout.

**Archived source account.** The University of Alaska Anchorage (UAA) announces that the 2017 Great Alaska Shootout, a national college basketball tournament, will be the final competition of the 40-year-old series. UAA blames economic conditions for the termination of the long running, national competition.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/20448486/great-alaska-shootout-end-2017>).

### 2017-08-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076041480](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20August%2027&oldid=1076041480>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-08-27-0-2"></a>

Context: Rohingya insurgency in Western Myanmar / 2016–17 Northern Rakhine State clashes, 2016–17 Rohingya persecution in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Dozens of Rohingya Muslims fleeing renewed violence in Rakhine State are detained by Bangladeshi and Burmese authorities after they attempt to cross the border from Myanmar to Bangladesh. Many were en route to Kutupalong Refugee Camp, a refugee camp in Ukhia, Bangladesh, mostly inhabited by Rohingya refugees.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/2108458/harrowing-accounts-myanmar-security-forces-firing-terrified>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War / Battle of Tal Afar (2017).

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi Army announces it is in full control of the Iraqi Turkmen city of Tal Afar in the Nineveh Governorate, after eight days of clashes with ISIL militants inside the city.

Source citations (as archived): [Rudaw](<http://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/iraq/27082017>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** A car bomb in Helmand Province kills up to 13 people, including Afghan Army soldiers and civilians, and wounds 18 others, according to government spokesman Omar Zwak.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-attack-idUSKCN1B70RK?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Hurricane Harvey in the American city of Houston, Texas, rises to three with several more days of heavy rain causing "catastrophic" floods to come.

Source citations (as archived): [Houston Chronicle](<http://www.chron.com/local/education/campus-chronicles/article/Harvey-impacts-Texas-Latest-tropical-weather-11953474.php>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-1-2"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** The entire Texas National Guard is activated by Texas Governor Greg Abbott for search and rescue operations, as weather forecasters stated that Harvey would move back over the Gulf of Mexico and restrengthen.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/08/27/us/harvey-impact-by-the-numbers-trnd/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-1-4"></a>

Context: Maritime incidents in 2017.

**Archived source account.** A dry cargo vessel broke in two in the Black Sea off Turkey’s northwest coast, television images showed early on Sunday, while the 11-man crew was rescued. Leonardo, a \{\{convert\|114\|meter\|feet\}\}-long dry cargo ship flagged from Mongolia, started buckling and broke in two while on anchor off Istanbul’s Kilyos coast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-ship-sinking-idUSKCN1B70DE?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-1-6"></a>

Context: Mountaineering deaths in Austria.

**Archived source account.** Five people were killed and one seriously injured after a mountain accident on Sunday in the Austrian state of Salzburg.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-austria-accident-idUSKCN1B70EP?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-1-8"></a>

Context: 2017 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Pakhar hits Hong Kong and Macau with sustained winds of 100 km/h and heavy rain, four days after deadly Typhoon Hato passed through the area.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-asia-storm-idUSKCN1B60SA>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-1-10"></a>

Context: Chemical haze near East Sussex coast.

**Archived source account.** Police issued a warning and evacuation orders after a unknown chemical "haze" leaves over 200 people on Britain's south coast, between the towns of Eastbourne and Birling Gap, suffering irritation to their eyes and throats.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-haze-idUSKCN1B70UD?il=0>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-sussex-41070002>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-08-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Pakistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan postpones a visit from U.S. acting Assistant Secretary of State Alice Wells, its foreign ministry says, as some protest President Donald Trump's accusations that Pakistan is harbouring terrorists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-usa-idUSKCN1B70Q8?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-08-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** President of Guatemala Jimmy Morales announced Sunday he is expelling the head of the International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala (CICIG), a U.N. anti-corruption commission that is investigating the president's campaign financing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/L/LT_GUATEMALA_UN_PRESIDENT>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-3-2"></a>

Context: Politics of Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court suspends the order made by President Jimmy Morales to expel the U.N. anti-corruption commission head.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guatemala-corruption-idUSKCN1B70PT?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** Health Minister Lucrecia Hernández Mack and her deputies announce Sunday they have resigned.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/L/LT_GUATEMALA_UN_PRESIDENT_THE_LATEST?>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-27-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Berkeley protests.

**Archived source account.** Far-right protesters and thousands of far-left counter-protesters clash in Berkeley, California, leading to the arrest of at least 14 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-berkeley-protests-20170827-story.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-08-27-5-1"></a>

Context: Floyd Mayweather Jr. vs. Conor McGregor.

**Archived source account.** In boxing, Floyd Mayweather Jr. defeats mixed martial artist Conor McGregor in the 10th round by technical knockout to improve to 50–0, breaking Rocky Marciano's 61-year-old record.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/boxing/story/_/id/20471276/floyd-mayweather-defeats-conor-mcgregor-tko-10th-round>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-5-4"></a>

Context: Baseball / 2017 Major League Baseball season.

**Archived source account.** Giancarlo Stanton of the Miami Marlins becomes the newest member of the 50 home run club, reaching the milestone during the Marlins' 6–2 win over the San Diego Padres.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/recap?gameId=370827128>).

<a id="event-2017-08-27-5-6"></a>

Context: Baseball / 2017 Little League World Series.

**Archived source account.** The Kitasuna Little League from the Tokyo, Japan district of Kōtō wins the 2017 Little League World Series, defeating the U.S. champions from Lufkin, Texas 12–2 in a game stopped after five innings due to the LLWS mercy rule. It is the Kitasuna league's third LLWS crown in the last six years, and the 11th title overall for Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/sports/llws17/story/_/id/20479589/japan-beats-texas-little-league-world-series-title>).

### 2017-08-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1076041426](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20August%2028&oldid=1076041426>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-08-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Syrian Civil War spillover in Lebanon / Qalamoun offensive (July–August 2017).

**Archived source account.** ISIL militants and their families, estimated to be around 600 people, begin to leave their strongholds on the Lebanon–Syria border and Qalamun Mountains for the Deir ez-Zor Governorate under Syrian military escort. A ceasefire was reached between warring parties yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-lebanon-syria-idUSKCN1B80PR?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-28-1-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** At least eight people have died in the American state of Texas with 30,000 residents in the city of Houston expected to seek temporary shelter.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-fg-houston-harvey-20170828-story.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-08-28-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 China–India border standoff.

**Archived source account.** India and China agree to end a two month-long stand-off with the withdrawal of Indian troops. The stand-off began in June after China began constructing a road in the disputed territory of Doklam which is claimed by both China and Bhutan.

Source citations (as archived): [news.com.au](<http://www.news.com.au/world/breaking-news/india-china-end-himalaya-border-standoff/news-story/9fdb6d5d04c8378bcf52d5fa46310a42>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Same-sex marriage in Chile.

**Archived source account.** Chilean President Michelle Bachelet sends a bill to Congress for the legalization of same-sex marriage in Chile and adoption by same-sex couples, two years after recognizing civil unions for both same-gender and different-gender couples.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-chile-lgbt-idUSKCN1B81IA?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Investigations concerning Niels Högel, a German nurse already convicted for murdering two of his patients, revealed that the number of people killed while in his care is significantly higher, reaching at least 84, with some estimates being even higher. This makes Högel the serial killer with the highest known victim count in modern German history.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/28/world/europe/niels-hogel-german-nurse-killed-at-least-86-patients-officials-say.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-28-3-5"></a>

Context: Crime in New Mexico.

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed and four are hospitalized in a shooting in a library in the U.S. town of Clovis, New Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-newmexico-shooting-idUSKCN1B82II?>).

<a id="event-2017-08-28-3-7"></a>

Context: Crime in Mexico.

**Archived source account.** Mexican authorities say two suspected thieves died after a mob beat them and four others in Tlatlauquitepec, Puebla, Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/L/LT_MEXICO_MOB_VIOLENCE?>).

### 2017-08-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1115476995](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20August%2029&oldid=1115476995>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-08-29-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills five people at the entrance of a Kabul Bank subsidiary near the Embassy of the United States in Kabul. The Taliban claims their attack targeted soldiers and police withdrawing their salaries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast-idUSKCN1B90H4>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-08-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Television in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Sky UK stops broadcasting Fox News in the United Kingdom after 15 years due to low audience figures.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-41087659>).

<a id="event-2017-08-29-1-3"></a>

Context: Banking in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Berkshire Hathaway Inc has become the largest shareholder of Bank of America by exercising its right to acquire 700 million shares at a steep discount, more than tripling an investment it made six years ago. Bank of America on Tuesday announced the exercise of the warrants, which gave Berkshire, controlled by Warren Buffett, the right to buy the bank’s shares for about $7.14 each. Bank of America shares closed down 14 cents at $23.58 on the same day.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-berkshire-bank-of-america-idUSKCN1B92LE?il=0>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from Hurricane Harvey reaches 30 as Sylvester Turner, the mayor of Houston, Texas, introduces a curfew to deter looters.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/29/us/hurricane-harvey-storm-flooding.html?emc=edit_na_20170829&amp;nl=breaking-news&amp;nlid=66213151&amp;ref=cta>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-08-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis, North Korean August 2017 missile launch over Japan.

**Archived source account.** North Korea fires a Hwasong-12 ballistic missile which flies 2,700 km, passing over Hokkaido, northern Japan, prompting the activation of the nationwide J-Alert warning system. This is first time since 2009 that a North Korean missile has passed over Japanese territory.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy-defence/article/2108697/north-korea-fires-another-missile-over-japan-reports>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/north-korea-japan-missile-over-test-launch-kim-jong-un-trump-latest-news-updates-a7917401.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-29-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis, North Korean August 2017 missile launch over Japan.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Nikki Haley says North Korea's launch of a missile over Japan was "absolutely unacceptable and irresponsible" and that North Korea has "violated every single U.N. Security Council resolution that we've had, and so I think something serious has to happen."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-usa-haley-idUSKCN1B91Q8?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-29-3-4"></a>

Context: 2017 clashes at the Turkish Ambassador's Residence in Washington, D.C..

**Archived source account.** A grand jury in Washington, D.C. has issued indictments for 19 people, including 15 identified as Turkish security officials, for attacking protesters in May 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_UNITED_STATES_TURKEY_INDICTMENTS?SITE=TNMOR>).

<a id="event-2017-08-29-3-6"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Libyan Navy rescues nearly 500 migrants in three operations in the seas west of the capital Tripoli.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-libya-idUSKCN1B91E4?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-08-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Germany.

**Archived source account.** The Landtag of the Free State of Saxony has lifted the immunity of Frauke Petry, Party Chair in the Alternative for Germany party, opening the way for prosecutors to pursue possible perjury charges against her concerning statements made to a committee of the Saxony parliament about how the party’s campaign for the 2014 election was financed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-election-afd-idUSKCN1B91F3?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-29-4-3"></a>

Context: Sexual orientation and gender identity in the United States military.

**Archived source account.** Defense Secretary James Mattis announces that transgender troops in the military will continue to serve pending the results of a study started in June to assess the Pentagon's ability to fight and win wars.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2017/08/29/mattis-orders-pentagon-allow-transgender-troops-continue-serving-pending-study/614711001/>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/348484-mattis-halts-trump-transgender-policy-pending-study>).

### 2017-08-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1110379918](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20August%2030&oldid=1110379918>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-08-30-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** At least 11 Afghan civilians are killed and 16 wounded when a NATO helicopter attacked a house where Taliban insurgents had taken shelter in Logar Province, east of Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-casualties-idUSKCN1BA1VQ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-08-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / American-led intervention in Syria.

**Archived source account.** CJTF–OIR jets destroy a section of road, blocking the path of a convoy carrying ISIL evacuees from the Lebanon–Syria border en route to Abu Kamal in the Deir ez-Zor Governorate. The convoy, carrying 308 militants and 331 civilians according to Hezbollah, is now effectively stranded in Syrian government-controlled territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-convoy-idUSKCN1BA1SW>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-30-1-2"></a>

Context: 2017 South Asian floods / 2017 Mumbai flood.

**Archived source account.** At least 14 people are killed in the Indian city of Mumbai as nearly a month's average rainfall fell yesterday during the worst monsoon in years. More than 1,200 people have been killed across India, Nepal and Bangladesh.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/08/30/floods-hit-mumbai-worst-monsoon-years-kills-1200-across-south/>); [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/us-india-monsoon-idINKCN1BA0GH>).

<a id="event-2017-08-30-1-4"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** Tropical storm Harvey (hurricane earlier this month) makes its second landfall, this time in the U.S. state of Louisiana. The New York Times reports local officials say the death toll since last Friday is now 38. Moving northeast, Harvey is expected to gradually weaken to a tropical depression by tonight.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/29/us/harvey-texas-louisiana.html?emc=edit_na_20170830&amp;nl=breaking-news&amp;nlid=80824687&amp;ref=headline&amp;_r=0>); [Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/harvey-houston-hurricane-tropical-storm-south-texas-deadly-flooding-impacts>); [The New York Times²](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/30/us/hurricane-harvey-flooding-houston.html?src=trending&amp;module=Ribbon&amp;version=context&amp;region=Header&amp;action=click&amp;contentCollection=Trending&amp;pgtype=article>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-08-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Childhood leukemia.

**Archived source account.** The Food and Drug Administration has approved the first treatment that genetically engineers patients' own blood cells to destroy acute lymphoblastic leukemia. The approval makes Novartis the proprietor of the first gene therapy to hit the U.S. market.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_MED_CANCER_GENE_THERAPY?SITE=AP&amp;>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-08-30-3-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Hungary has decided to extend the state of emergency declared last year because of the increased migration to and through the country. Government spokesman Zoltán Kovács stated that strict border controls were still needed because the "threat of terrorism in Europe has increased".

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/E/EU_EUROPE_MIGRANTS?SITE=AP&amp;>).

<a id="event-2017-08-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in California.

**Archived source account.** A shooting at a motel in Sacramento County, California, leaves a Sacramento County Sheriff's Department deputy dead and two California Highway Patrol officers injured. The suspect is later arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/california-deputy-killed-two-others-wounded-shootout-hotel-n797676>); [The Sacramento Bee](<http://www.sacbee.com/news/local/article170257237.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-08-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Fast radio bursts.

**Archived source account.** Researchers at the Breakthrough Listen initiative announce they have detected 15 new powerful fast radio bursts (FRB) from FRB 121102, located in a dwarf galaxy about three billion light-years from Earth. FRB 121102 was first detected in 2012, and gained further attention after FRBs were detected from there again in 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2145822-weve-just-seen-15-new-mysterious-cosmic-radio-bursts-from-space/>); [Phys](<https://phys.org/news/2017-08-distant-galaxy-high-energy-radio.html>).

### 2017-08-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1260735507](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20August%2031&oldid=1260735507>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-08-31-0-1"></a>

Context: Wells Fargo account fraud scandal.

**Archived source account.** Wells Fargo reports finding an additional 1.4 million potentially fake bank and credit card accounts, bringing the total problematic accounts to approximately 3.5 million.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/08/31/investing/wells-fargo-fake-accounts/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-08-31-1-2"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey / 2017 Arkema plant explosion.

**Archived source account.** A series of small explosions occur at the Arkema chemical plant in Crosby, Texas, and according to the company more are expected, after floodwaters shut down the cooling systems that kept the chemicals stable. Houston Methodist San Jacinto Hospital in Baytown, Texas treated 21 first responders for chemical exposure. Residents living within a 1.5 mi radius of the plant are evacuated.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/hurricane-harvey/harvey-danger-major-chemical-plant-near-houston-likely-explode-facility-n797581>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-41104451>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/31/us/harvey-houston-texas-flood.html>); [The New York Times²](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/08/31/us/texas-chemical-plant-explosion-arkema.html>).

<a id="event-2017-08-31-1-3"></a>

Context: Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** A Harris County Flood Control District official says at the height of the flooding, 70 percent of the county’s 1,800 square miles, which includes the city of Houston, was covered with at least 1.5 feet of water, an area larger than the state of Rhode Island.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2017/08/31/harveys-wrath-moves-across-the-louisiana-texas-border-as-water-recedes-in-houston/?utm_term=.e9e1f32359d2>).

<a id="event-2017-08-31-1-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2016–17 Northern Rakhine State clashes.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-six bodies of women and children are recovered after three boats carrying ethnic Rohingya fleeing violence in Myanmar sink in the Naf River in Bangladesh's Cox's Bazar District.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/boats-carrying-fleeing-rohingya-sink-in-bangladesh-26-dead/2017/08/31/5f5809e0-8eaf-11e7-9c53-6a169beb0953_story.html?utm_term=.b0d3254d4b90>).

<a id="event-2017-08-31-1-7"></a>

Context: Building collapses in 2017.

**Archived source account.** A rickety multi-story apartment building collapses in the Indian city of Mumbai resulting in at least 24 deaths with at least 12 people missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Houston Chronicle](<http://www.houstonchronicle.com/sports/rockets/article/Tilman-Fertitta-to-buy-Rockets-for-record-2-2-12173412.php>); [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/20588603/tilman-fertitta-agrees-purchase-houston-rockets-record-price-22-billion>).

### 2017-09-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1289386807](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20September%206&oldid=1289386807>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-09-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Pastoral visits of Pope Francis.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis arrives in Colombia for a five-day visit. In early 2016, Francis promised he would visit the South American country once a civil war peace agreement was in place.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/09/05/europe/pope-colombia-preview/index.html>); [Independent Catholic News](<http://www.indcatholicnews.com/news/33332>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-09-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals.

**Archived source account.** Business leaders from various U.S. companies, including Facebook, Marriott International, JPMorgan Chase, and Microsoft, lobby to members of Congress to work on a permanent solution for DREAMers to stay legally in the country, many of whom are their employees.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2017/09/05/trump-daca-dreamers-ceo-business-leaders-242342>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-1-3"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Federal Reserve Vice Chair Stanley Fischer announces he will resign in mid-October, eight months before his term expires.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-fed-fischer/feds-fischer-resigns-leaving-trump-earlier-chance-to-shape-central-bank-idUSKCN1BH21R>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-09-06-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 disasters in the United States.

**Archived source account.** An Arizona Air National Guard F-16 crashes near Safford, Arizona, killing the pilot.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/f16-crash-accident-arizona-safford-air-national-guard-162nd-wing/>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-2-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Irma.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Irma makes first landfall on Barbuda, Saint Martin, and Anguilla in the northeastern Leeward Islands. Irma has maintained 185 mph winds for 24 hours, setting another record for Atlantic and eastern Pacific storms.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/hurricane-irma-slams-caribbean-florida-face-direct-impacts/story?id=49645643>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2017/sep/06/hurricane-irma-caribbean-islands-category-5-storm?page=with:block-59afd634e4b046d20d3e8a02#block-59afd634e4b046d20d3e8a02>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/09/06/us/hurricane-irma-puerto-rico-florida/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Irma.

**Archived source account.** At least seven people are killed on the islands of Barbuda, St. Barts and St. Martin. Heavy rain and Category 5 winds hit the Virgin Islands and Puerto Rico’s northeast coast.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/09/06/us/hurricane-irma-puerto-rico-florida/index.html>); [KCRA-TV](<http://www.kcra.com/article/path-of-irma/12182287>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-41182991>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-2-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Irma.

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Antigua and Barbuda Gaston Browne says the island of Barbuda has been almost entirely wiped out by Hurricane Irma and is "barely habitable", with "90 percent" of all structures destroyed.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/hurricane-irma-destroys-90-percent-structures-vehicles-barbuda/story?id=49665358>); [Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/island-barbuda-left-a-rubble-11124904>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-2-8"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Katia.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane watches are issued for the state of Veracruz on Mexico's Gulf coast. Category 1 Katia (75 mph/120 km/h) is about 185 miles off the Mexican coast, slowly moving at 3 mph.

Source citations (as archived): [Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/storms/hurricane/news/tropical-depression-thirteen-tropical-storm-katia>); [The Times-Picayune](<http://www.nola.com/hurricane/index.ssf/2017/09/hurricane_katia_forms_gulf_of.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-09-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Bangladesh–Myanmar relations, 2016–17 Northern Rakhine State clashes.

**Archived source account.** Bangladesh accuses the Myanmar Army of laying landmines on the border between both countries to prevent the return of fleeing Rohingya refugees. Myanmar denies the Bangladeshi claims.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-41176488>); [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/09/myanmar-laying-landmines-bangladesh-border-reports-170906014211124.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-bangladesh-landmines/exclusive-bangladesh-protests-over-myanmars-suspected-landmine-use-near-border-idUSKCN1BH04F>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-09-06-4-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Justice dismisses complaints by Slovakia and Hungary about EU migration policy, upholding Brussels’ right to force member states to take in asylum seekers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-easteurope/eu-court-dismisses-hungary-slovak-case-against-taking-refugees-idUSKCN1BH0VR>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-09-06-5-1"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017.

**Archived source account.** A last minute presentation to the Parliament of Catalonia results in the formal approval of a referendum concerning independence from Spain after tense discussions. Though the country's president urges the government to ignore the bill, parliament is expected to vote in favor of an independence vote. For the approval of this law, the Speaker, Carme Forcadell breaks the regulations of the Parliament, placing the camera outside the law and violating the rights of the opposition.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-41177428>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-5-3"></a>

Context: Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen states and the District of Columbia file suit challenging President Donald Trump’s decision to end the Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program, arguing, in part, that federal government has reneged on the promise to protect young immigrants who came forward and registered with the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-ny/states-file-lawsuit-challenging-trump-decision-on-dreamers-idUSKCN1BH1HS>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/politics/la-dreamers-decision-live-updates-washington-state-says-it-will-join-with-1504720942-htmlstory.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-5-5"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump, siding with Democrats, reaches a deal with congressional leaders of both parties to extend the U.S. debt limit and fund the federal government until Dec. 15, as well as provide Harvey disaster relief.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-congress/trump-backs-democrats-on-debt-limit-in-rare-bipartisan-deal-idUSKCN1BH24F?il=0>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/09/06/us/politics/house-vote-harvey-aid-debt-ceiling.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-06-5-7"></a>

Context: Social media in the United States presidential election, 2016.

**Archived source account.** Facebook tells congressional investigators an operation, traced to a Russian company seeking to target voters, spent $100,000 on thousands of U.S. ads promoting divisive social and political messages during the 2016 U.S. election.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/4930532/facebook-russian-acocunts-2016-election/>); [The Washington post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/facebook-says-it-sold-political-ads-to-russian-company-during-2016-election/2017/09/06/32f01fd2-931e-11e7-89fa-bb822a46da5b_story.html>).

### 2017-09-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031014](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20September%207&oldid=1256031014>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-09-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** It is suspected that Israeli jets bomb a military research facility near the city of Masyaf, Hama Governorate, killing at least two Syrian Army soldiers. The facility was rumoured to contain chemical weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/israeli-airstrikes-target-syrian-research-center-linked-to-chemical-weapons/2017/09/07/2230abda-93a5-11e7-b9bc-b2f7903bab0d_story.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/sep/07/israel-airstrike-syria-chemical-weapons-facility>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-09-07-1-1"></a>

Context: Education in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Saturday's ACT U.S. college entrance exam test is cancelled at some of its international test centers because of leaks of test materials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-college-cheating/act-cancels-some-college-entrance-exams-after-test-leak-idUSKCN1BI29P>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-09-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Identity theft in the United States.

**Archived source account.** More than 143 million people in the U.S. may have had their social security and driver's license numbers compromised due to a data breach on the credit rating firm Equifax.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/09/07/business/equifax-cyberattack.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/technology/equifax-hack-hits-credit-histories-of-up-to-143-million-americans/2017/09/07/a4ae6f82-941a-11e7-b9bc-b2f7903bab0d_story.html>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_EQUIFAX_CYBERATTACK?SITE=TNMOR>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-2-3"></a>

Context: Business in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Amazon.com announces bidding for a second headquarters campus in North America, to house 50,000 workers and cost $5 billion USD

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/09/07/technology/amazon-headquarters-north-america.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-2-5"></a>

Context: Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen states sue the Trump administration over potential violations of the Due Process Clause as a result of actions concerning the rescindment of the DACA program.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/09/07/549047054/states-sue-to-block-daca-termination-citing-trumps-racial-animus>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-09-07-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Irma.

**Archived source account.** Irma has killed at least 14 people. The storm, still at Category 5 strength with maximum sustained winds of 175 mph (280 km/h), is moving west-northwest at 16 mph (26 km/h). It has reached the dual-country island of Hispaniola and is forecast to pass over the Turks and Caicos Islands as it heads towards The Bahamas and Cuba. The eye did not directly hit Puerto Rico; still casualties are reported and around two-thirds of its 3.4 million population are without electricity.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-storm-irma/millions-in-florida-evacuate-as-hurricane-irma-pounds-cuba-idUSKCN1BG0KL?il=0>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/2017/live-updates/weather/hurricane-irma-a-monster-storms-devastating-path/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-41194959>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Irma.

**Archived source account.** Florida's electric utility company says it will shut down its Turkey Point and St. Lucie nuclear power plants before Irma comes ashore.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-storm-irma-nuclearpower/florida-nuclear-plants-to-shut-ahead-of-hurricane-irma-idUSKCN1BI2IA>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-3-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Irma.

**Archived source account.** Georgia Governor Nathan Deal issues a mandatory evacuation order for the state's Atlantic Coast and the I-95 corridor.

Source citations (as archived): [eTurboNews](<https://eturbonews.com/163821/georgia-governor-nathan-deal-hurricane-irma-mandatory-evacuation-order>); [Georgia's Irma page](<http://irma.georgia.org/hurricane/>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-3-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Chiapas earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 8.1 earthquake is recorded 96 kilometers (60 miles) south of Pijijiapan, Chiapas, Mexico. This is Mexico's strongest quake since the 8.0 earthquake that hit the Greater Mexico City area in 1985. At least 26 deaths have been recorded.

Source citations (as archived): [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us2000ahv0#executive>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/402449-mexico-quake-death-toll/>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-4-1"></a>

Context: Mexico–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Mexico expels the ambassador of North Korea in the country over the recent nuclear weapons testing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/the-latest-seoul-us-adds-launchers-to-anti-missile-system/2017/09/06/e835d278-936f-11e7-8482-8dc9a7af29f9_story.html>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/K/KOREAS_TENSIONS_THE_LATEST?SITE=TNMOR>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-4-3"></a>

Context: Qatar–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Qatar announces it will donate USD$ 30 million to help people in Texas recover from Harvey.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_QATAR_HARVEY?SITE=TNMOR>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-09-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Australian Marriage Law Postal Survey.

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Australia rejects the challenge against the postal survey on same-sex marriage, allowing the survey to begin in mid-September as planned.

Source citations (as archived): [SBS World News](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2017/09/07/high-court-rules-favour-same-sex-marriage-postal-survey>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-5-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of Education Betsy DeVos plans to change the sexual assault guidelines on college campuses created by the previous administration.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2017/09/07/betsy-devos-to-revamp-obama-era-schools-sexual-assault-policy-242444>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_CAMPUS_SEXUAL_ASSAULT?SITE=TNMOR>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-5-5"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13780.

**Archived source account.** The United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit rejects the Trump administration arguments regarding the travel ban on grandparents, cousins and others with a bona fide relationship in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2017/09/07/court-rejects-trump-administration-attempt-to-include-extended-family-in-travel-ban-242461>); [AP](<http://hosted.ap.org/dynamic/stories/U/US_TRAVEL_BAN?SITE=TNMOR>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-5-7"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spain plans to sue leading members of the Catalan Parliament over the proposed independence referendum in Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/09/spain-bring-charges-catalan-parliamentarians-170907114832071.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/spain-blocks-catalan-independence-vote-threatens-charges-idUSKCN1BI1GQ>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-5-8"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spain's Constitutional Court suspends the Catalan Parliament's independence referendum law to give the court time to consider whether the vote would breach the country's constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41196677>); [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/europe/spanish-court-suspends-catalonia-independence-vote-plan-36111316.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-5-9"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Catalan parliament approves after tense discussions the Law of juridical transition and foundation of the Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [Catalan News](<http://www.catalannews.com/politics/item/catalan-parliament-passes-transition-law>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-5-11"></a>

Context: 2017 Arkema plant explosion, Hurricane Harvey.

**Archived source account.** Seven first responders file a $1 million lawsuit against the Arkema chemical company for failing to warn them in advance about the environmental dangers from the plant explosion. The seven people, six police officers and an emergency worker, remain under a doctor's care.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2017/09/07/First-responders-sue-owner-of-chemical-plant-that-exploded-during-Hurricane-Harvey/4891504828161/>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-09-07/harvey-responders-say-they-were-sickened-by-arkema-plant-blaze>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-09-07-6-1"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Senate investigates Paolo Duterte, the son of current Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte, in an alleged methamphetamine smuggling scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg News](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-09-07/duterte-s-son-denies-meth-smuggling-claims-as-case-rivets-manila>).

<a id="event-2017-09-07-6-3"></a>

Context: Anti-government protests in Togo, 2017.

**Archived source account.** For the second consecutive day, hundreds of thousands of Togolese protest against President Faure Gnassingbé's 50-year family dynasty. Parliament is set to consider presidential term limits when it reconvenes in October.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-togo-protests/protesters-mass-for-second-day-to-demand-exit-of-togos-leader-idUSKCN1BI1UT>); [X News Press](<http://xnewspress.com/2017/09/mass-protests-in-togo-for-constitutional-reform/>).

Shkreli was convicted of fraud in August and is awaiting sentencing.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/09/13/news/shkreli-bond/index.html>).

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Maria makes landfall on Dominica as a category 5 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 160 mph (260 km/h). Maria is the second category 5 hurricane to make landfall at that intensity in the 2017 season, making this and 2007 the only seasons on record to feature this occurrence.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCUAT5+shtml/190133.shtml>).

<a id="event-2017-09-19-0-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Central Mexico earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 7.1 earthquake strikes Mexico, killing at least 220 people and collapsing several buildings in Mexico City and widespread evacuations, hours after a yearly earthquake drill in commemoration of the 1985 Mexico City earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [KTLA](<http://ktla.com/2017/09/19/preliminary-magnitude-7-1-earthquake-strikes-near-puebla-mexico-usgs/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-09-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 72nd session of the United Nations General Assembly.

**Archived source account.** The 72nd session of the United Nations General Assembly commences its General Debate at the United Nations headquarters in Manhattan, New York.

Source citations (as archived): [amNewYork](<http://www.amny.com/news/politics/united-nations-general-assembly-in-nyc-what-to-know-about-this-year-s-session-1.14176862>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-09-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Louisiana.

**Archived source account.** Two African-American men are killed in separate incidents near Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and a third home is shot at in what local and federal officials call racially-motivated crimes. A local man is arrested on suspicion of the murders.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/white-baton-rouge-man-arrested-deaths-black-men/>); [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/us/articles/2017-09-19/white-man-arrested-in-killings-of-two-black-men-in-louisiana>).

<a id="event-2017-09-19-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spain's Guardia Civil raid private delivery offices in the Catalan city of Terrassa, searching for and confiscating envelopes suspected of containing voting cards for the upcoming Catalan independence referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41325663>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-09-19-3-1"></a>

Context: Mobile operating system.

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc. releases the iOS 11 update for most current models of the iPhone and iPad.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/09/19/technology/gadgets/ios-11-release-features/index.html>).

### 2017-09-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031032](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20September%2020&oldid=1256031032>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-09-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Federal Reserve announces its benchmark interest rate will not change this month, though it expects an increase by the end of the year, along with three increases in 2018 and two in 2019. The Federal Reserve also says its balance sheet reduction program will begin in October.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/09/20/fed-approves-october-reversal-of-historic-stimulus-leaves-rates-unchanged.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-09-20-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Central Mexico earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Searches continue for possible survivors of the magnitude 7.1 earthquake that hit central Mexico yesterday. By mid-afternoon, 52 people are rescued while at least 226 people have been killed and another 800 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/la-fg-mexico-earthquake-20170919-story.html>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/mexicans-dig-rubble-seeking-survivors-quake-kills-149-49969811>).

<a id="event-2017-09-20-1-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Maria.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Maria makes landfall on Puerto Rico as a Category 4 hurricane. Effects are disastrous and the entire island loses power. Seven deaths are reported on Puerto Rico, along with two on Guadeloupe. Puerto Rican Governor Ricardo Rosselló declares a 6:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. curfew through Saturday.

Source citations (as archived): [NHC](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2017/al15/al152017.public_a.017.shtml>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-storm-maria/hurricane-maria-slams-puerto-rico-with-high-rains-storm-surge-idUSKCN1BT1RW>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/09/20/hurricane-maria-path-latest-news-live-puerto-rico-virgin-islands/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2017/09/20/hurricane-maria-takes-aim-at-puerto-rico-with-force-not-seen-in-modern-history/>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/09/20/us/hurricane-maria-puerto-rico.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-20-1-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Maria.

**Archived source account.** Now a Category 2 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 110 mph, Maria is moving toward the northeastern coast of the Dominican Republic, and is forecast to affect the Turks and Caicos Islands and the southeastern Bahamas Thursday night and northern Haiti Friday.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT5+shtml/202038.shtml?>).

<a id="event-2017-09-20-1-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Maria.

**Archived source account.** The National Hurricane Center predicts Puerto Rico's total rainfall through Saturday will be \{\{convert\|20\|–\|30\|in\|cm\}\} inches with 35 in in isolated areas. The Virgin Islands will receive an additional \{\{convert\|3\|to\|5\|in\|cm\}\}.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center²](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT5+shtml/210259.shtml?>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-09-20-2-1"></a>

Context: U.N. Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons Treaty.

**Archived source account.** Fifty countries (50) sign the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, adopted on 7 July 2017, at the United Nations headquarters in New York City. The world's nuclear-weapon states oppose the measure. \{\{Dead link\|date=April 2020 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/50-nations-ink-un-nuclear-ban-treaty-opposed-by-big-powers/ar-AAshC8R?ocid=spartandhp&amp;ffid=gz>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nuclear-un/dozens-of-states-sign-nuclear-weapons-ban-treaty-at-united-nations-idUSKCN1BV1QJ>); [United Nations](<https://treaties.un.org/doc/Publication/CN/2017/CN.475.2017-Eng.pdf>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-09-20-3-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** California Attorney General Xavier Becerra files suit in federal court against U.S. President Donald Trump's proposed plan for a wall along the U.S.–Mexico border.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/94a5ab1078e648beb2d1a5017b8005ae/California-sues-Trump-administration-to-prevent-border-wall>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/351547-california-to-sue-over-trumps-border-wall>).

<a id="event-2017-09-20-3-3"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Spanish police raid Catalan government offices and arrest Catalan officials as part of the effort to halt a banned referendum on independence. Catalan President Carles Puigdemont says, "The Spanish state has by all rights intervened in Catalonia’s government and has established emergency rule."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/spanish-police-raid-catalan-government-to-halt-banned-referendum-idUSKCN1BV0U0>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/09/20/world/europe/catalonia-referendum-spain.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-20-3-5"></a>

Context: Philippine Drug War, Human rights in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Speaking to government workers at the presidential palace in Manila, President Rodrigo Duterte orders police to kill his eldest son, Paulo Duterte, if drug trafficking allegations against him are proven true, and adds that those who carried out the execution would be protected from prosecution.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/rodrigo-duterte-philippines-police-kill-son-drug-allegatinos-true-president-paolo-manila-china-a7959121.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-09-20-4-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Saudi Arabia lifts its 2013 ban on internet calls, effective midnight local time (21:00 UTC).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-telecoms-ban/saudi-arabia-to-lift-ban-on-internet-calls-idUKKCN1BV128>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-09-20-5-1"></a>

Context: Long-term effects of global warming.

**Archived source account.** MIT physics professor Daniel Rothman's mathematical formula, published in the peer-review journal Science Advances, predicts a sixth mass extinction may be set to occur within 10,000 years if by the year 2100 current carbon dioxide emissions are not reduced, and a critical amount of carbon (310 gigatons) is added to the oceans.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2017-09-mathematics-sixth-mass-extinction.html>); [Science Advances](<http://advances.sciencemag.org/content/3/9/e1700906>).

### 2017-09-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091332179](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20September%2021&oldid=1091332179>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-09-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian and Syrian warplanes carry out airstrikes in southern Idlib, killing three civilians and wounding others.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://www.iraqinews.com/arab-world-news/russian-syrian-warplanes-bombard-idlib-3rd-day/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-09-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Google strikes a $1.1bn (£822m) deal with Taiwan's HTC to expand its smartphone business.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-41343586>).

<a id="event-2017-09-21-1-3"></a>

Context: Economy of China.

**Archived source account.** China's credit rating has been downgraded by Standard &amp; Poor's (S&amp;P) because of worries over the rapid build up of debt in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-41349662>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-09-21-2-1"></a>

Context: European migration crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least five migrants have died and ninety are missing after their boat sinks off the western coast of Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2017-09-21/some-100-migrants-missing-after-shipwreck-off-libyas-coast>).

<a id="event-2017-09-21-2-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Maria.

**Archived source account.** Maria, now a Category 3 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 125 mph (205 km/h), is passing offshore of the northern coast of the Dominican Republic, expected to impact the Turks and Caicos Islands and southeastern Bahamas later tonight and Friday.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT5+shtml/212356.shtml?>).

<a id="event-2017-09-21-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Maria.

**Archived source account.** Casualty reports indicate at least 15 people have been killed on Dominica and two on Guadeloupe. The casualty report for Puerto Rico is now two deaths, including a man from a capsized boat near Vieques, Puerto Rico. Power remains out for an estimated 3.4 million Puerto Ricans as the energy grid is all but destroyed. Guajataca Dam in Puerto Rico will experience an "imminent dam break" according to the National Weather Service which will threaten 70,000 residents. In addition, more than 95 percent of the island’s wireless cell sites are out of service.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/09/21/us/hurricane-maria-puerto-rico.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-21-2-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Maria.

**Archived source account.** Puerto Rico is forecast to get an additional 4 in to 8 in of rain through Saturday, on top of the several feet of rain that has fallen on parts of the island. Caguas has received the most, 37.9 in. The NHC expects 8 in to 16 in rain for the Dominican Republic, Turks and Caicos, and Mayaguana in the southeast Bahamas.

Source citations (as archived): [National Hurricane Center](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT5+shtml/212356.shtml?>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/09/21/us/hurricane-maria-puerto-rico.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-21-2-8"></a>

Context: 2017 Central Mexico earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Rescuers are focusing on 10 collapsed buildings where people may still be alive. Mexico City Mayor Miguel Ángel Mancera reports the death toll is now at least 273, with 50 people still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-quake/mexico-focuses-on-10-buildings-in-search-for-quake-survivors-273-dead-idUSKCN1BW0YK>).

<a id="event-2017-09-21-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces new sanctions on North Korea over its nuclear weapons program.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-41354664>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-09-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Protests against Rodrigo Duterte.

**Archived source account.** Coinciding with the 45th anniversary of the declaration of martial law in 1972 by the late Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos, nationwide protests are conducted by various groups against the government's implementation of war on drugs and the ongoing martial law in the whole of Mindanao under the administration of President Rodrigo Duterte.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/182868-philippines-protest-rallies-martial-law-45th-anniversary>).

<a id="event-2017-09-21-4-3"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Facebook agrees to disclose ads that ran in the U.S. in 2016 from accounts associated with a Russian entity known as the Internet Research Agency to United States Congressional investigators. Earlier, this information was provided to Special Counsel Robert Mueller.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/report-facebook-to-reveal-ads-purchased-by-russians-to-influence-election/?google_editors_picks=true>); [Facebook](<https://newsroom.fb.com/news/2017/09/providing-congress-with-ads-linked-to-internet-research-agency/>).

<a id="event-2017-09-22-1-1"></a>

### 2017-09-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1336206229](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20September%2023&oldid=1336206229>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-09-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Beatification.

**Archived source account.** The Venerable Rev. Father Stanley Rother, a priest of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Oklahoma City (born in Okarche, Oklahoma), is beatified at the Cox Convention Center in Oklahoma City by Cardinal Angelo Amato, head of the sainthood Congregation in the Roman Curia and Pope Francis's delegate. Rother, who became a missionary, was assassinated in July 1981 in the poor rural village of Santiago Atitlan, Guatemala, and is the first Catholic martyr born a citizen of the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2017/09/23/us/ap-us-rel-vatican-us-martyr-the-latest.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Apocalypticism.

**Archived source account.** Conspiracy theorist and book author David Meade predicted that a mythological rogue planet known as Nibiru (sometimes known as Planet X) would collide with Earth and that the world would end on this day.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/science/2017/09/15/biblical-prophecy-claims-world-will-end-on-sept-23-christian-numerologists-claim.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-09-23-1-1"></a>

Context: Mount Agung seismic activity.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people on the Indonesian island of Bali flee from their homes due to concerns over Mount Agung erupting. The alert status for the volcano was increased to the highest level possible the day before.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/09/23/fearing-eruption-thousands-in-bali-flee-from-mount-agung.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-23-1-3"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2017.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.2 earthquake strikes the central Mexican state of Oaxaca, killing at least five people and damaging housing and infrastructure already damaged by Tuesday's 2017 Central Mexico earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/mexico-hit-by-new-62-magnitude-earthquake-11049403>); [Time and AP](<http://time.com/4954628/strong-new-earthquake-shakes-buildings-in-mexico-city/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-quake/latest-deadly-quake-volcanic-ash-spread-alarm-in-mexico-idUSKCN1BY0FI>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-09-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis.

**Archived source account.** China limits petroleum exports and bans imports of textiles from North Korea as part of new sanctions following the latest nuclear test.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-41370722>).

<a id="event-2017-09-23-2-2"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis.

**Archived source account.** An earthquake is detected in North Korea that China's earthquake authority believes is due to a North Korean nuclear test. South Korea states that it could be a natural earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-09-23/quake-detected-in-north-korea-china-south-divided-on-cause/8978286>).

<a id="event-2017-09-23-2-4"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis / North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Air Force bombers, escorted by fighter jets, fly in international airspace over waters east of North Korea. A Pentagon spokesperson says this flight's route was the farthest north of the peninsula's Demilitarized Zone of any U.S. aircraft in the 21st century.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/pentagon-says-u-s-fighter-jets-stage-show-response-north-n804161>).

<a id="event-2017-09-23-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis / North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho, at the United Nations General Assembly, says his country targeting the U.S. mainland is becoming more likely given the U.S. President's escalating rhetoric over their military programs. After this speech, U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres met with Ri to express his concern with this situation.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-china-quake/north-korea-says-rockets-to-u-s-inevitable-as-u-s-bombers-fly-off-north-korean-coast-idUSKCN1BY0BS>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/north-korea-united-nations-general-assembly-live-updates/>).

<a id="event-2017-09-23-2-7"></a>

Context: Iran and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** Iran successfully tests the Khorramshahr missile.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://au.news.yahoo.com/world/a/37198606/iran-tests-new-missile-defying-us-warnings/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-09-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in London.

**Archived source account.** Acid attacks around a mall and tube station in Stratford, East London, leave 6 injured. A 15-year-old is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/09/23/stratford-acid-attack-six-people-injured-attack-london-station/>).

Context: 2017 New Zealand general election.

**Archived source account.** Voters in New Zealand go to the polls, electing all members of their House of Representatives and the consequent Prime Minister.

<a id="event-2017-09-23-4-2"></a>

Context: 2017 New Zealand general election.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Bill English of the National Party wins a plurality of votes, but not enough for a majority, as the Labour Party led by Jacinda Ardern makes significant gains. Winston Peters becomes a kingmaker with his third-placed New Zealand First party, able to form a coalition government with either major party.

### 2017-09-24

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Russian military intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A shooting at a church in Nashville, Tennessee, leaves one dead and seven injured. The suspected shooter is arrested.

Context: Crime in Indiana.

#### Politics and elections

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Homeland Security plans to collect the social media information of all immigrants, including green card holders and naturalized citizens, beginning on October 18, 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/homeland-security-plans-to-collect-immigrants-social-media-info/>).

<a id="event-2017-09-26-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twitter is experimenting with doubling its 140 character limit to 280 characters for all languages except Japanese, Chinese and Korean.

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Commerce Department imposes preliminary anti-subsidy duties on Bombardier Inc. CSeries jets following American rival Boeing's claims of unfair Canadian subsidies. The penalty is on hold pending the U.S. International Trade Commission's final decision, expected in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-boeing-bombardier/u-s-slaps-steep-duties-on-bombardier-jets-after-boeing-complaint-idUSKCN1C138W>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/us-moves-to-impose-tariffs-on-canadian-jet-maker-siding-with-boeing/2017/09/26/9f67cf9e-a2ea-11e7-ade1-76d061d56efa_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Women's rights in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** The king of Saudi Arabia issues a decree allowing women to be issued driving licenses by June 2018. Saudi Arabia is the world's last sovereign state that does not allow women to drive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/sep/26/saudi-arabias-king-issues-order-allowing-women-to-drive>); [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/09/26/saudi-arabia-allow-women-drive/>).

<a id="event-2017-09-26-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball corruption scandal.

**Archived source account.** The office of the United States Attorney for the Southern District of New York announces that 10 individuals, including assistant coaches at four NCAA Division I men's basketball programs—Arizona, Auburn, Oklahoma State, and USC—have been arrested on federal corruption charges. The accused are alleged to be part of a scheme by which coaches accepted bribes to steer NBA-bound college players toward certain agents and financial advisers. Court documents also allege that an apparel company later identified as Adidas paid $100,000 to the family of an unnamed player to ensure his signing with an unnamed Division I school, which was later confirmed as the University of Louisville.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/20824193/ncaa-basketball-coaches-10-charged-fraud-corruption>).

<a id="event-2017-09-27-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball corruption scandal.
