Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2017-09-tsunami-enabled-hundreds-aquatic-species.html>).

### 2017-09-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031058](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20September%2029&oldid=1256031058>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-09-29-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Somalia.

**Archived source account.** Al-Shabaab militants attack a military base outside the Somalian capital Mogadishu, with 15 soldiers reported dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-attacks/militants-attack-somali-military-base-kill-at-least-15-idUSKCN1C40CY>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-09-29-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Mumbai stampede.

**Archived source account.** At least 22 people are killed and over 30 are seriously injured in a rush hour stampede on a footbridge between the Parel and Elphinstone Road railway stations in the Indian city of Mumbai.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-stampede/indian-railway-rush-hour-stampede-kills-at-least-15-official-idUSKCN1C40NF?il=0>); [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/mumbai-news/elphinstone-railway-station-stampede-at-overbridge-several-injured-1756677>).

<a id="event-2017-09-29-1-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Central Mexico earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A Mexico City borough president says previous officials ignored warnings that unauthorized construction work had damaged the structural integrity of several buildings in the city. The overall death toll from the magnitude 7.1 quake which hit Sept. 19 now stands at at least 358 people.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/4d56fc67f60d47c3874a431a6b217e24>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-09-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Iraqi Kurdistan independence referendum, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Iraq's federal government halts all international flights to and from Iraqi Kurdistan until Kurdish security forces hand over control of Erbil International Airport and Sulaimaniyah International Airport. The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) calls the ban "illegal".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-41440747>).

<a id="event-2017-09-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department removes all families of employees and nonessential personnel from Cuba following apparent sonic attacks that injured 21 personnel on the island. Cuba denies any involvement and has authorized the FBI to travel to the island to help the ongoing investigation into the causes.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/09/29/politics/us-cuba-sonic-attacks-pulls-out-diplomats/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-09-29-3-1"></a>

Context: UK Independence Party leadership election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Henry Bolton wins UKIP leadership, taking over the position from Paul Nuttall, who resigned after the party's poor performance in the last general election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-41447568>).

<a id="event-2017-09-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Tom Price resigns as the Secretary of Health and Human Services in the midst of a scandal over his use of private planes.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/09/29/politics/tom-price-resigns/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-09-29-3-5"></a>

Context: Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping.

**Archived source account.** Sun Zhengcai is expelled from the Communist Party of China after the results into the internal disciplinary investigation are announced by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/china-communist-party-expels-former-star-sun-zhengcai/2017/09/29/e8e22c78-a506-11e7-b573-8ec86cdfe1ed_story.html?utm_term=.9d383c45ed2a>).

<a id="event-2017-09-29-3-6"></a>

Context: Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping.

**Archived source account.** Reverberations from the Sun Zhengcai case are said to have ensnared a number of senior officials from Chongqing, including former Organization Department head Zeng Qinghong (female). 14 out of 43 delegates to the 19th Party Congress from Chongqing are said to have lost their eligibility.

Source citations (as archived): [SCMP](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/2113515/dozen-more-chongqing-officials-could-be-caught-sun>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-09-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Gene therapy.

**Archived source account.** The journal Protein &amp; Cell publishes Sun Yat-sen University research describing the use of gene therapy in the removal of a version of the inherited blood disorder beta-thalassemia from an artificially-created nuclear transfer-type of cloning-model system of human oocytes. Collectively, this study demonstrated the feasibility of curing this and a range of other inherited diseases using the same genome editing technology of CRISPR.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-41386849>); [Protein &amp; Cell](<https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s13238-017-0475-6>).

### 2017-09-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091441210](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20September%2030&oldid=1091441210>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2017-09-30-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Edmonton attack.

**Archived source account.** In Edmonton, Alberta, Canada, near Commonwealth Stadium, a man drives into a police officer and then stabs the officer. The suspect fled the scene and was later arrested that night following a police pursuit, where four pedestrians were hit by the suspect in a rental truck. Police are investigating the incident as an act of terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [Edmonton Journal](<https://edmontonjournal.com/news/crime/heavy-police-presence-near-commonwealth-stadium-officers-checking-vehicles>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-attacks/canadian-police-probe-car-attacks-stabbing-as-acts-of-terrorism-idUSKCN1C61FP>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-09-30-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 disasters in Romania.

**Archived source account.** A fire at a retirement home in Bucharest, Romania, leaves one person dead and 19 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2017/09/30/world/europe/ap-eu-romania-retirement-home-fire.html?mcubz=3>).

<a id="event-2017-09-30-1-3"></a>

Context: 2017 disasters in DR Congo.

**Archived source account.** A military transport plane crashes after take-off from N'djili Airport in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing all 12 Russian crew members. \{\{Dead link\|date=September 2019 \|bot=InternetArchiveBot \|fix-attempted=yes \}\}

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.msn.com/en-au/news/world/military-plane-crash-in-congo-kills-dozens/ar-AAsEEnZ>).

<a id="event-2017-09-30-1-5"></a>

Context: Human stampede.

**Archived source account.** A crowd surge collapses a barrier during a soccer match at Stade de la Licorne in Amiens, France, injuring twenty-nine people, five of them seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://sports.yahoo.com/football-29-hurt-french-stadium-barrier-collapse-213328285--sow.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-09-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Thailand, Rohingya persecution in Myanmar (2016–present).

**Archived source account.** Thailand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs says it is "closely following the situation" in Rakhine State and offers aid for the governments of Myanmar and Bangladesh.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-myanmar-rohingya/thailand-says-closely-watching-myanmar-crisis-ready-to-provide-aid-idUSKCN1C60XN?il=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-09-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of protesters march through Dublin to demand Ireland to change its abortion laws, and anti-abortion activists stage counter-demonstrations. A pro-choice rally is held outside the Irish embassy in London.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41452712>).

<a id="event-2017-09-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Nazism in Sweden.

**Archived source account.** About 600 members of the Swedish neo-Nazi group Nordic Resistance Movement march through Gothenburg, and 10,000 people hold a counter-demonstration. More than 50 people are arrested and several people are injured during the protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/neo-nazi-rally-in-sweden-ends-in-clashes-between-police-and-counterprotesters/2017/09/30/711bb76e-a5ff-11e7-b573-8ec86cdfe1ed_story.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-09-30-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 AFL Grand Final.

**Archived source account.** The Australian rules football club Richmond Football Club defeats the Adelaide Football Club in the 2017 AFL Grand Final by 108 points to 60. Dustin Martin won the Norm Smith Medal for best on ground after having won the 2017 Brownlow Medal for the best and fairest player in the competition.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-09-30/afl-grand-final-dustin-martin-completes-record-breaking-season/9004402>); [ABC Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-09-30/joy-for-tigerland-as-richmond-ends-37-year-drought-at-mcg/9004358>).


## October

### 2017-10-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087453328](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%201&oldid=1087453328>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces claim to have shot down a U.S. MQ-9 Reaper drone over the Yemeni capital Sana'a. Footage released by Saba News Agency appears to show crowds gathering around the wreckage of an aircraft.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-usa/yemen-houthis-say-have-shot-down-u-s-surveillance-drone-state-news-agency-idUSKCN1C619H?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Marseille stabbing.

**Archived source account.** A knife-wielding man at Saint Charles train station in Marseille, France, kills two women. Police kill the suspect and are treating the attack as a terrorist incident. ISIL claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/10/01/europe/marseille-knife-attack-train-station/index.html>); [Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-4938248/Police-shoot-dead-knife-wielding-man-Marseille-station.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Anglophone problem (Cameroon).

**Archived source account.** Soldiers in Buea and Bamenda, Cameroon, shoot dead a total of at least eight people during various protests by Anglophone separatists.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cameroon-politics/at-least-eight-dead-amid-cameroon-anglophone-protests-idUSKCN1C61R6?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Islamic State group seizes the Al-Qaryatain town in the central province of Homs in a surprise attack against Syrian government forces.

Source citations (as archived): [First Post](<http://www.firstpost.com/world/islamic-state-seizes-al-qaryatain-town-in-central-syria-in-surprise-attack-shows-monitor-4099721.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-0-9"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** A gunman opens fire in Paradise, Nevada, at the Mandalay Bay Resort and Casino from the upper floors down upon a Jason Aldean outdoor concert, with at least 59 people dead and 527 others injured. Authorities believe the lone gunman is dead.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/02/us/las-vegas-shooting.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-10-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Monarch Airlines goes into financial bankruptcy administration, suspending all flights, cancelling 300 thousand bookings, and leaving tens of thousands of passengers stranded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-monarch-airlines-licence/britains-monarch-airlines-goes-bust-leaving-thousands-stranded-idUSKCN1C70FQ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Skanska USA implodes the Old Kosciuszko Bridge in New York City after 78 years of connecting Brooklyn and Queens.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<http://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/Implosion-of-Kosciuszko-Bridge-This-Weekend-448503353.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Vanuatu begins evacuating 11,000 islanders from the island of Ambae because of the erupting volcano Manaro Voui which pollutes the water.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-vanuatu-volcano/dunkirk-style-evacuation-as-vanuatu-volcano-pollutes-drinking-water-idUSKCN1C6141>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-01-3-1"></a>

Context: O. J. Simpson robbery case.

**Archived source account.** Nevada prison authorities release former NFL player O. J. Simpson on parole after serving nine years for a 2007 Las Vegas armed robbery. Previously, a jury had acquitted Simpson of the 1995 murder of his ex-wife Nicole Brown Simpson and her friend Ron Goldman.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/10/01/us/oj-simpson-released-from-prison/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, Operation Anubis, Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government of Catalonia holds a public referendum on whether their region should gain independence from Spain, despite the Spanish courts and government declaring the vote illegal and deploying police to deter voters. Catalan President Carles Puigdemont says Catalonia "has won the right to become an independent state."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41457238>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/catalan-independence-referendum-people-hurt-clashes-police-violence-right-to-statehood-a7977651.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-4-2"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, Operation Anubis, Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spanish riot police clash with some protesters in various cities and towns, with 844 people and 33 police reported injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/police-fire-rubber-bullets-at-voters-in-barcelona-as-catalonia-poll-turns-violent-11062579>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/catalonia-independence-poll-spanish-police-scuffle-defiant-voters-n806291?cid=eml_nbn_20171001>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-41461032>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/catalan-independence-referendum-people-hurt-clashes-police-violence-right-to-statehood-a7977651.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, Operation Anubis, Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Mayor of Barcelona Ada Colau calls on Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy to resign following the police crackdown on Catalan protestors which has left hundreds injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2017/10/01/spain-catalonia-all-the-red-lines-have-been-crossed-says-barcelona-mayor>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-4-4"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, Operation Anubis, Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Guardia Civil riot police officers and Catalonia's Mossos d'Esquadra clash in Sant Joan de Vilatorrada as tensions rise between the rival police forces.

Source citations (as archived): [The Spain Report](<https://www.thespainreport.com/articles/1171-171001171141-civil-guard-and-catalan-police-fight-in-catalan-town>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-4-5"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, Operation Anubis, Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government of Catalonia declares that the "yes"-to-independence-vote has won a landslide victory.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/5341651334024917ad52c0cfa96c3cfd/%22Yes%22-side-wins-Catalonia-independence-vote-marred-by-chaos>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-4-6"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, Operation Anubis, Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Catalans defy police orders to leave polling places.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/5341651334024917ad52c0cfa96c3cfd/Catalans-assemble-in-polling-stations-defying-police-orders>).

<a id="event-2017-10-01-4-8"></a>

Context: New Democratic Party leadership election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Canada's left-leaning New Democratic Party elects Jagmeet Singh its leader.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/02/canadas-jagmeet-singh-becomes-first-non-white-politician-to-lead-major-party>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-10-01-5-1"></a>

Context: U.S. national anthem protests (2016–present).

**Archived source account.** Some players throughout the National Football League hold demonstrations before or during the U.S. national anthem. These demonstrations include kneeling, raising fists, or praying, as a show of unity or protest of social and racial injustice.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/01/us/nfl-protests/index.html>).

### 2017-10-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1180484376](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%202&oldid=1180484376>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** The Luxor Hotel is placed on lockdown due to a bomb threat.

Source citations (as archived): [Express](<http://www.express.co.uk/news/world/861169/las-vegas-shooting-mandalay-bay-resort-luxor-hotel-bomb-threat>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** The death toll rises to at least 59 people with an additional 527 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/02/us/las-vegas-shooting.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/morning-mix/wp/2017/10/02/police-shut-down-part-of-las-vegas-strip-due-to-shooting/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** Authorities name the shooter, who killed himself before police arrived at his room in the Mandalay Bay casino and hotel, as 64-year-old Nevada resident Stephen Paddock. Police find 23 guns in Paddock's hotel room, and 19 more at his Mesquite, Nevada, home.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/10/02/las-vegas-gunman-suspect-is-stephen-paddock-64-of-mesquite.html>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/guns-loaded-high-capacity-magazines-found-vegas-shooters/story?id=50228093>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** The attack is the deadliest mass shooting in recent U.S. history.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2017/oct/02/las-vegas-two-dead-in-mandalay-bay-casino-shooting-latest-updates>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** Stephen Paddock's former neighbors in Reno, Nevada, describe him as having a possible gambling problem.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/las-vegas-gunman-stephen-paddock-neighbors-say-recluse-675584>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** CBS fires Hayley Geftman-Gold, vice president and senior counsel of strategic transactions at CBS, for a social media post stating that she did not have sympathy for the shooting's victims because "country music fans often are Republican gun toters".

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/entertainment/2017/10/02/top-cbs-lawyer-no-sympathy-for-vegas-vics-probably-republicans.html>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/media/353495-cbs-executive-fired-after-saying-las-vegas-victims-didnt-deserve-sympathy>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-7"></a>

Context: 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** Without providing evidence, ISIL claims responsibility for the attack. U.S. law enforcement say they have found no evidence linking the perpetrator with international terrorist groups.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/las-vegas-shooting-isis-claim-no-proof-stephen-paddock-linked-terror-group/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Two suicide bombers attack a police station in the Al-Midan neighbourhood of Damascus, killing at least 15 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-damascus/deadly-twin-suicide-attack-hits-damascus-police-station-idUSKCN1C71GK?il=0>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-10-02-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** After suffering a cardiac arrest in his Malibu, California home, American singer and songwriter Tom Petty dies at the UCLA Medical Center in Santa Monica, California, at the age of 66.

Source citations (as archived): [Rolling Stone](<https://www.rollingstone.com/music/news/tom-petty-rock-iconoclast-who-led-the-heartbreakers-dead-at-66-w506651>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-10-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize committee awards Americans Jeffrey C. Hall, Michael Rosbash, and Michael W. Young the prize for their work on molecular mechanisms that control circadian systems.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/live/2017/oct/02/the-2017-nobel-prize-in-physiology-or-medicine-live>); [Nobel Prize.org](<https://www.nobelprize.org/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-10-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Egypt–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-thousand North Korean rocket propelled grenades are seized off the coast of Egypt by American forces after being purchased by Egyptian business executives for $23 million (E£406 million/₩20 billion).

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/egypt/1.815268>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Thailand–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Thai Prime Minister Prayut Chan-o-cha meets with U.S. President Donald Trump in the Oval Office. Trump says he wants to lower the U.S. trade deficit with Thailand.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-thailand/trump-says-wants-to-reduce-u-s-trade-deficit-with-thailand-idUSKCN1C729U?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Russian presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Russian opposition leader and hopeful presidential candidate Alexei Navalny is sentenced in Moscow to 20 days detention for organizing unauthorized public meetings. This is Navalny's third jail term this year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-politics-navalny/kremlin-critic-navalny-jailed-for-third-time-this-year-idUSKCN1C72CX>); [RT](<https://www.rt.com/politics/405477-navalny-arrest-unathorized-rallies/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Ecuador.

**Archived source account.** Ecuador's Supreme Court orders that Vice President Jorge Glas be jailed for his alleged acceptance of bribes from the Odebrecht construction company. Prior to this, Glas had been free but barred from leaving the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/37565594bd7945ca824e7ace08316fbe/Ecuador&#x27;s-vice-president-jailed-during-bribery-investigation>).

<a id="event-2017-10-02-4-5"></a>

Context: Assassination of Kim Jong-nam.

**Archived source account.** Two women charged with the assassination of Kim Jong-nam plead not guilty in a Malaysian court because they thought it was a TV prank. Kim Jong-nam was the eldest son of deceased North Korean leader Kim Jong-il and the half-brother of current North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-41464331>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Canada.

**Archived source account.** After her appointment by Prime Minister of Canada Justin Trudeau, former astronaut Julie Payette, in an installment ceremony, becomes the 29th Governor General of Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/payette-governor-general-investiture-1.4313299>).

### 2017-10-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357885292](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%203&oldid=1357885292>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2017-10-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** ISIL releases video footage of two alleged Russian soldiers it captured. However, Russia denies the claims.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/isis-release-video-captured-russia-soldiers-moscow-denies-losing-syria-677106>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-10-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Hydraulic fracturing in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Scottish Government Energy Minister Paul Wheelhouse announces that he will seek an indefinite ban (an existing moratorium has been in place since 2015) on crude oil recovery in Scotland by means of the process of hydraulic fracturing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-41484153>).

<a id="event-2017-10-03-1-3"></a>

Context: Yahoo\! data breaches.

**Archived source account.** Yahoo\! reports that all three billion of its accounts were hacked in the August 2013 data theft.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yahoo-cyber/yahoo-says-all-three-billion-accounts-hacked-in-2013-data-theft-idUSKCN1C82O1>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Maria death toll controversy.

**Archived source account.** Puerto Rico Governor Ricardo Rosselló's office reports that the number of deaths related to Hurricane Maria has risen to 34.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-puertorico-casualties/death-toll-in-puerto-rico-from-hurricane-maria-more-than-doubles-to-34-idUSKCN1C900B>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-10-03-3-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia Judge Ellen S. Huvelle awards Amir Mirza Hekmati, a U.S. Marine who was imprisoned in Iran as a falsely accused CIA spy, a default judgment of $63 million for his ordeal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/us-judge-orders-iran-to-pay-63-million-to-ex-marine-tortured-imprisoned-four-years/2017/09/29/26aa9a0a-a54c-11e7-8cfe-d5b912fabc99_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration, through the Department of State and Secretary of State Rex Tillerson, expels 15 Cuban diplomats, after pulling half of its own embassy staff from Havana on Sept. 29, due to the alleged failure of Cuba to take appropriate steps to protect American personnel against the mysterious health attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cuba-diplomacy/u-s-expels-15-cuban-diplomats-drawing-protest-from-havana-idUSKCN1C81UE>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-03-4-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis / Catalan general strike.

**Archived source account.** Pro-independent trade unions, businesses, and schools in Catalonia hold a general strike to protest Spanish police brutality during the October 1 independence referendum.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/10/03/catalonia-goes-on-strike-as-calls-for-declaration-of-independence-grow.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-03-4-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis / Catalan general strike.

**Archived source account.** King Felipe VI addresses a message to the Nation in an exceptional speech, since it has only happened five times in 40 years of democracy amid the escalation of tension Catalonia is suffering. Noting the seriousness of the situation, condemns the irresponsibility of the Generalitat of Catalonia in wanting to break the unity of the country, the society and the legality.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/03/king-felipe-catalan-authorities-have-scorned-all-spaniards-with-referendum>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/spains-king-condemns-catalan-leaders-as-thousands-take-to-streets-idUSKCN1C80UK>).

<a id="event-2017-10-03-4-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Portugal.

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister of Portugal Pedro Passos Coelho steps down as the leader of the opposition Social Democratic Party in local elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.eu/article/portugals-opposition-leader-pedro-passos-coelho-steps-down-after-election-defeat/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-03-4-7"></a>

Context: Abortion in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. House of Representatives passes legislation (Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act) which would criminalize abortions made 20 weeks into a pregnancy, except for cases endangering the mother's life, rape, or incest.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/03/politics/house-vote-abortion-after-20-week-ban/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-03-4-9"></a>

Context: Politics of Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Former President of Iraq, Jalal Talabani, dies at the age of 83. He was the first non-Arab president of Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-kurds-talabani/kurdish-leader-and-ex-iraqi-president-jalal-talabani-dies-state-tv-idUSKCN1C81J6>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41486847>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-03-5-1"></a>

Context: Nobel Prize in Physics.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize committee awards Americans Rainer Weiss, Barry Barish, and Kip Thorne the Nobel Prize in Physics for their work in the LIGO Scientific Collaboration that discovered gravitational waves.

Source citations (as archived): [Nobel Prize.org](<https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/2017/press-release/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/speaking-of-science/wp/2017/10/03/nobel-prize-in-physics-won-by-rainer-weiss-barry-barish-and-kip-thorne/>).

### 2017-10-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1286987208](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%204&oldid=1286987208>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / Hawija offensive (2017).

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi Army and allied paramilitary fighters storm the ISIL-held city of Hawija in the Kirkuk Governorate. Hawija is one of the last remaining ISIL strongholds in Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-41501664>).

<a id="event-2017-10-04-0-5"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Maghreb / 2017 Tongo Tongo ambush.

**Archived source account.** An apparent ambush in Niger near the Malian border leaves three U.S. Special Forces soldiers and five Nigerien soldiers dead during a joint patrol.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/u-s-confirms-attack-on-joint-patrol-in-niger-no-word-on-u-s-casualties-idUSKBN1C9310?il=0>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/three-u-s-soldiers-killed-niger-suspected-ambush-n807821>).

<a id="event-2017-10-04-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Russian military jets target makeshift rubber dinghies and boats carrying dozens of families fleeing the town of al-Ashara along the western banks of the Euphrates that lies south of Deir Ezzor city, killing at least 60 civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<http://www.middleeasteye.net/news/russian-jets-kill-civilians-fleeing-across-euphrates-syrian-opposition-108491042>).

<a id="event-2017-10-04-0-8"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to the Russian Defense Ministry's spokesman Major General Igor Konashenkov, ISIL has undertaken several attacks on Syrian positions from U.S.-controlled areas, implying that the recent well-coordinated actions of the terrorists indicate that they somehow possess intelligence data that could only be obtained as a result of air reconnaissance.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2017/10/04/russia-says-is-attacks-in-syria-come-from-location-near-us-forces.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-04-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The human rights group, Physicians for Human Rights, accuses Russia and the Syrian government of mounting the "worst string of attacks" on hospitals in Syria since April despite an agreement on "de-escalation" zones, saying it believes either Russian or Syrian government jets were behind at least five air raids on three hospitals in September in rebel-held Idlib province.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/09/rights-group-condemns-attacks-syrian-hospitals-170928072406051.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian police detain fugitive Italian former left-wing guerrilla and convicted murderer Cesare Battisti, as he was attempting to flee across the border into Bolivia to avoid extradition back to Italy and facing his life sentence prison term for four murders in the 1970s.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-italy-battisti/brazilian-police-detain-italian-fugitive-battisti-idUSKBN1C92QO?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-04-1-3"></a>

Context: Cybercrime.

**Archived source account.** U.S. fast-food chain operator Sonic Drive-In may have had a malware attack at some of its drive-in outlets and may have allowed hackers to access customers’ debit and credit card information.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyber-sonic/drive-in-chain-sonic-says-payment-cards-possibly-hacked-idUSKBN1C92S8>).

<a id="event-2017-10-04-1-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** Monday, October 2, the day following the shooting, is now the saddest officially recorded day on Twitter, according to the Hedonometer, which has been measuring happiness since 2008. The increased use of negative words such as "shooting" and "gun" after the shooting resulted in a score of 5.77 on the 9-point scale, where one indicates pure sadness and nine indicates pure happiness.

Source citations (as archived): [Vox](<https://www.vox.com/science-and-health/2017/10/5/16426140/las-vegas-shooting-sad-mood-twitter>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy deploys the 41st Logistic Support Group of the Spanish Armed Forces in Catalonia to support riot police in Barcelona.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sun](<https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/4609188/catalonia-independence-referendum-spain-carles-puigdemont/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Committee awards Swiss Jacques Dubochet, German Joachim Frank, and British Richard Henderson the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing cryo-electron microscopy for the high-resolution structural determination of biomolecules in a solution.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/live/2017/oct/04/the-2017-nobel-prize-in-chemistry-to-be-announced-live>).

### 2017-10-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256158508](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%205&oldid=1256158508>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017) / Hawija offensive (2017).

**Archived source account.** The Iraqi Army fully retakes the city of Hawija in the Kirkuk Governorate from ISIL. Fighting continues to the north and east of the city as Iraqi troops continue anti-ISIL operations in the Hawija District.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/05/iraqi-army-claims-recapture-islamic-state-isis-held-areas-hawija>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-10-05-1-1"></a>

Context: Nobel Prize in Literature.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Committee awards Japanese-born British novelist Kazuo Ishiguro the Nobel Prize in Literature for his "novels of great emotional force, has uncovered the abyss beneath our illusory sense of connection with the world."

Source citations (as archived): [Nobelprize.org](<https://www.nobelprize.org>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-10-05-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Energy infrastructure firm TransCanada abandons two Canadian pipeline projects.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-41488956>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-05-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Tropical Storm Nate.

**Archived source account.** In Nicaragua, flooding from Tropical Storm Nate, kills at least fifteen people. In Costa Rica, the storm kills at least seven people with fifteen missing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/latest-tropical-storm-nate-forms-off-coast-nicaragua-50298746>).

<a id="event-2017-10-05-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Tropical Storm Nate.

**Archived source account.** Oil and gas companies evacuate production platforms in the Gulf of Mexico. Louisiana Governor John Bel Edwards declares a state of emergency in anticipation of Tropical Storm Nate. He says southeast Louisiana should prepare for a "direct hit" this weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/latest-tropical-storm-nate-forms-off-coast-nicaragua-50298746>); [NOLA](<http://www.nola.com/hurricane/index.ssf/2017/10/tropical_storm_nate_gov_john_b.html>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/louisiana-preps-for-possible-hurricane-as-nate-eyes-coast/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-05-3-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Florida Governor Rick Scott declares a state of emergency for North Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [Orlando Sentinel](<http://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/topstories/governor-declares-state-of-emergency-for-northern-part-of-florida-as-tropical-storm-nate-looms/ar-AAsXA9G?li=AA4ZnC&amp;ocid=spartanntp&amp;ffid=gz>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-10-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Saudi Arabia relations.

**Archived source account.** King Salman of Saudi Arabia visits Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Moscow Kremlin. They discuss oil prices and the Syrian Civil War.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-saudi-terror/russia-saudi-arabia-cement-new-friendship-with-kings-visit-idUSKBN1CA1QU?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-05-5-1"></a>

Context: Janaúba Tragedy.

**Archived source account.** In the town of Janaúba, Minas Gerais state, Brazil, a recently dismissed security guard set fire to a childcare center, killing at least four children and a teacher and leaving 25 others, mostly children aged four and five, injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-41515503>).

<a id="event-2017-10-05-5-3"></a>

Context: Cybercrime.

**Archived source account.** Alleged Russian government-backed hackers stole highly classified U.S. cyber secrets in 2015 from the National Security Agency after a contractor put information on his home computer. The entrance to the computer was speculated to have possibly been through an installed Kaspersky Lab antivirus. U.S. rules governing federal computers now ban installation of Kaspersky Lab software.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cyber-nsa/russian-hackers-stole-u-s-cyber-secrets-from-nsa-wsj-idUSKBN1CA2DO>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-05-6-1"></a>

Context: LGBT employment discrimination in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration, through the Department of Justice, reverses an Obama-era policy which used Title VII of the Civil Rights Act to protect transgender employees from discrimination.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/sessions-doj-reverses-obama-era-transgender-work-protections/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-05-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Governor Jerry Brown signs legislation to make California a sanctuary state. Next January, this law will prevent police from inquiring about immigration status during routine interactions, and will reduce law enforcement cooperation with U.S. immigration officers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-california-politics/california-governor-signs-sanctuary-state-bill-idUSKBN1CA2LU>).

### 2017-10-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256158520](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%206&oldid=1256158520>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-06-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, Russian airstrikes kill at least 14 civilians, including three children, as they cross the Euphrates river near the ISIL-held city of Mayadin in eastern Syria while fleeing the village of Mahkan.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<http://www.trtworld.com/mea/russia-air-strikes-kill-at-least-14-civilians-in-syria-monitor-11132>).

<a id="event-2017-10-06-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Jaysh al-Islam Islamist rebels launch a successful counter-attack in the East Ghouta region of rural Damascus, targeting the points they lost to the Syrian government over the course of seven days near the town of Hawsh Dawahra, and recovering all of the lost territories.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Masdar News](<https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/jaysh-al-islam-reverses-syrian-armys-gains-east-ghouta/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-10-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Harvey Weinstein sexual misconduct allegations.

**Archived source account.** American film producer Harvey Weinstein (including Pulp Fiction, Clerks, The Crying Game, and Sex, Lies, and Videotape) answers allegations made by a report in The New York Times that he had settled eight sexual harassment claims made over three decades. Multiple Democratic recipients of Weinstein's political donations give the funds to women's charities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-people-harvey-weinstein-politics/weinstein-on-indefinite-leave-as-company-investigates-allegations-idUSKBN1CB2UQ>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-10-06-2-1"></a>

Context: AIM (software).

**Archived source account.** AIM's owner, Oath Inc., announces it will discontinue AOL Instant Messenger service on December 15, 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/talkingtech/2017/10/06/rip-aim-aol-instant-messenger-dies-december/739076001/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-06-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spain's third largest bank, CaixaBank, announces it is moving its legal base out of Catalonia to Valencia. This follows a similar move yesterday by Catalan banking group Banco Sabadell who announced they are moving their headquarters to Alicante in response to growing political insecurity in Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/06/catalonia-business-independence-spanish-government>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A train hits a bus on a crossing in Vladimir, Russia, killing at least 19 people on the bus. No train passengers were injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41522748>).

<a id="event-2017-10-06-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indian Air Force Mi-17 helicopter ferrying military officials crashes in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, a remote mountain region near the border with China, killing all seven personnel on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-crash/indian-military-helicopter-crashes-near-china-border-seven-dead-idUSKBN1CB0JJ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-06-3-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Tropical Storm Nate.

**Archived source account.** Tropical Storm Nate heads for the Gulf Coast of the United States after causing dozens of deaths in Central America and severe flooding in the Nicaraguan town of Rivas.

Source citations (as archived): [News Limited](<http://www.news.com.au/video/id-5348771529001-5600595509001/severe-flooding-in-nicaragua-as-nate-blows-through>).

<a id="event-2017-10-06-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Mexican military Bell 412 model helicopter crashes northeast of the town of El Salto in the mountainous state of Durango, seriously injuring one military member aboard and likely killing seven others.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-military/mexico-military-helicopter-crashes-in-northern-state-seven-presumed-dead-idUSKBN1CC01M?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-10-06-4-1"></a>

Context: Nobel Peace Prize.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Committee awards the global civil society coalition of The International Campaign to Abolish Nuclear Weapons the Nobel Peace Prize "for its work to draw attention to the catastrophic humanitarian consequences of any use of nuclear weapons and for its ground-breaking efforts to achieve a treaty-based prohibition of such weapons".

Source citations (as archived): [Nobel Prize.org](<https://www.nobelprize.org/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41524583>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-06-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Unnamed White House officials believe White House Chief of Staff John F. Kelly's personal cellphone was hacked, possibly since December 2016. Kelly was Secretary of Homeland Security from January 20 to July 31, 2017, when he moved to his current position.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2017/10/05/john-kelly-cell-phone-compromised-243514>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-kelly/white-house-chief-of-staffs-personal-cellphone-compromised-politico-idUSKBN1CB030>).

<a id="event-2017-10-06-5-2"></a>

Context: Birth control in the United States, List of executive actions by Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** A Trump administration executive order reverses an Obamacare policy which mandated that employers and insurers provide their employees with birth control, regardless of one's "religious beliefs" or "moral convictions".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-41528526>).

### 2017-10-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087455637](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%207&oldid=1087455637>).

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

<a id="event-2017-10-07-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Saudi national opens fire at the Al-Salam Royal Palace in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, killing two guards and injuring three others. Security guards shoot and kill the gunman.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<http://www.arabnews.com/node/1173966/saudi-arabia>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41540379>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-07-1-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Hurricane Nate.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Nate makes landfall near the mouth of Mississippi River and near Biloxi, Mississippi, as a Category 1 hurricane with maximum sustained winds of 85 mph.

Source citations (as archived): [WJLA](<http://wjla.com/news/nation-world/hurricane-nate-makes-landfall-as-category-1-storm>).

<a id="event-2017-10-07-1-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season / Aftermath of Hurricane Maria.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Communications Commission approves Google's plan to restore some cell phone service in hurricane-hit Puerto Rico with Project Loon balloons.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/10/07/google-gets-go-ahead-restore-cell-phone-service-puerto-rico/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-07-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion at a liquefied natural gas depot leads to a second explosion at a gas station in Legon, a suburb of the Ghanaian capital Accra, killing at least seven people and injuring sixty-eight more.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/10/07/official-ghana-gas-station-explosions-kill-number-people.html>); [StarrFM](<http://starrfmonline.com/2017/10/07/massive-gas-explosion-madina/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-07-1-7"></a>

Context: 2017 Madagascar plague outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Since August 1, another round of pneumonic, bubonic, and septicemic plague spreads in Madagascar, killing at least 45 people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/to-your-health/wp/2017/10/05/black-death-outbreak-strikes-madagascar-killing-30-and-triggering-panic/?utm_term=.044a2d0a91dd>); [Relief Web](<https://reliefweb.int/report/madagascar/plague-outbreak-madagascar-external-situation-report-02-9-october-2017>).

<a id="event-2017-10-07-1-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car mounts the pedestrian sidewalk near the Natural History Museum on Exhibition Road, and injures 11 people. London police believe the incident is not terror related. They arrested the driver but later released him.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-41541165>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-07-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Russian protests.

**Archived source account.** Russian police arrest 290 protesters calling on President Vladimir Putin to resign.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-opposition-navalny-protests/on-putins-birthday-opposition-activists-protest-call-for-him-to-quit-idUSKBN1CC0ES>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/08/europe/russia-protest-navalny-putin/index.html>).

### 2017-10-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1328666914](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%208&oldid=1328666914>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-08-0-1"></a>

### 2017-10-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087455942](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%209&oldid=1087455942>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-10-09-0-1"></a>

Context: Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences.

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize committee awards American Richard Thaler the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel "for his contributions to behavioral economics." His work focuses on the psychology of the human conflict of what we plan for the financial present versus what we plan for the future.

Source citations (as archived): [Nobel Prize.org](<https://www.nobelprize.org/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-41549753>).

<a id="event-2017-10-09-0-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Kobe Steel falsification of data scandal.

**Archived source account.** Japan's third-biggest steelmaker, Kobe Steel, admits to falsification of product data. About four percent of the aluminum and copper products that it shipped from September 2016 to August 2017 were falsely labeled as meeting the specifications requested by 200 customers, including Toyota Motor Corp, Central Japan Railway Company, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Mazda Motor Corp, and Subaru Corp.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-kobe-steel/kobe-steel-under-the-gun-after-firm-admits-data-falsification-idUSKBN1CF006>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-09-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire at the Sindika Trade Center, a construction materials shopping center in the northwestern edge of Moscow, Russia, forces the evacuation of at least 3000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-41556638/blaze-engulfs-shopping-centre-in-moscow>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-market-fire/russian-firefighters-use-helicopters-to-extinguish-market-fire-idUSKBN1CD0PK>).

<a id="event-2017-10-09-1-2"></a>

Context: October 2017 Northern California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** More than a dozen wildfires around Mendocino, Napa, Sonoma, and Yuba counties in California, kill at least ten people, destroy at least 1500 homes and businesses, and force 20 thousand people to evacuate. The Governor of California, Jerry Brown, declares a state of emergency.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/ccdb7cae5fc74236b164c82b6d22fed5/Wind-whipped-wildfires-sweep-through-California-wine-country>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2017/10/09/fast-moving-wildfires-ravage-northern-californias-wine-country/?utm_term=.1566b7d92d3c&amp;wpisrc=al_alert-national&amp;wpmk=1>); [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/western-wildfires/one-killed-major-wildfires-ignite-overnight-across-northern-california-n809206?cid=eml_nbn_20171009>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-09-2-1"></a>

Context: Bosnian War.

**Archived source account.** The presiding judge Šaban Maksumić of the Sarajevo, Bosnian war crimes court acquits former Bosnian military officer Naser Orić of the charge of killing three Bosnian Serb prisoners of war during the Bosnian War. In July 2008, the Appeals Chamber of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia in the Netherlands acquitted Orić for failing to prevent the deaths of five Bosnian Serb detainees and the mistreatment of eleven other detainees from late 1992 to early 1993.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bosnia-warcrimes-srebrenica/srebrenicas-muslim-defender-cleared-of-crimes-serbs-protest-idUSKBN1CE0SK>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2017/oct/09/iceland-qualify-world-cup-smallest-nation>).

<a id="event-2017-10-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Peru.

**Archived source account.** The Peruvian Pedro Pablo Kuczynski Administration, through the Ministry of Justice, appoints a new head to the Direction of Presidential Graces, which is believed to be a first step towards granting a pardon to 79-year-old former president Alberto Fujimori (1990-2000), although President Kuczynski has denied it. In April 2009, a three-judge panel had sentenced Fujimori for acts of corruption, human rights violations, and various others crimes. Fujimori, who has been in jail since 2007 and whose health has deteriorated, including alleged tongue cancer, has applied for a pardon unsuccessfully on two occasions.

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-10-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Gene therapy.

**Archived source account.** A panel of external experts to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration unanimously vote that the benefits of the gene replacement treatment made by Spark Therapeutics of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, called voretigene neparvovec (trade name, Luxturna), which treats Leber's congenital amaurosis (LCA), a form of hereditary blindness, outweigh its risks. The treatment, which targets a specific disease-causing mutation, is designed to treat individuals who have two mutated copies of a gene called RPE65 and consists of a virus injected into the eye loaded with a normal copy of the RPE65 gene. Further, this technique utilizing adeno-associated virus as a vector may, in the future, be used for the treatment of heart disease and also mutations other than LCA, including some cancers.

Source citations (as archived): [Nature](<http://www.nature.com/news/fda-advisers-back-gene-therapy-for-rare-form-of-blindness-1.22819>); [MIT Technology Review](<https://www.technologyreview.com/s/609075/fda-vote-sets-stage-for-gene-therapys-future/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-12-5-4"></a>

Context: Beating of DeAndre Harris.

**Archived source account.** DeAndre Harris, a black man beaten by white supremacists during the Unite the Right rally, turns himself in to Charlottesville after he is served an arrest warrant for an alleged attack on a white supremacist during the same rally.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-41599533>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-12-6-1"></a>

Context: Fatah–Hamas reconciliation process.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian factions, Hamas and Fatah, sign a unity deal in Cairo, that is also publicly supported by the governments of Egypt and Saudi Arabia. The Fatah-controlled Palestinian National Authority (PNA), along with Israel, currently govern the West Bank. According to the signatories of the deal, the PNA will take administrative control of the Gaza Strip, and, along with Hamas, police its borders. The signatories consider the agreement a first step, and, if productive, plan to meet next month to address the remaining issues. The government of Israel opposes any involvement by Hamas in a Palestinian government.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/12/world/middleeast/palestinians-fatah-hamas-gaza.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41591450>).

<a id="event-2017-10-12-6-3"></a>

Context: Trumpcare Executive Order.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs an executive order allowing the sale of health insurance plans that are exempt from some Obamacare regulations including purchases effective across state lines.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-41599532>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-12-7-1"></a>

Context: Asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2017.

**Archived source account.** As predicted by NASA, the Apollo-group-type asteroid 2012 TC4 (approximately 15 m in diameter) passes a distance of \{\{convert\|0.0003352\|AU\|km mi\|abbr=on\}\} from Earth, well within the Moon's orbit.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/asteroid-close-flyby-2012-tc4-1.4347501>); [NASA](<https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/sbdb.cgi?sstr=2012TC4;cad=1#cad>).

<a id="event-2017-10-13-2-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-10-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Cybercrime.

**Archived source account.** U.S.-based Hyatt Hotels discovers another (the other much larger one being in 2015) unauthorized access to payment card information at certain Hyatt-managed locations worldwide between March 18 and July 2, at a total of 41 properties in 11 countries.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hyatt-hotels-cyber/hyatt-hotels-discovers-card-data-breach-at-41-properties-idUSKBN1CH2WP>).

<a id="event-2017-10-13-3-3"></a>

Context: MS-13.

**Archived source account.** Police in Chimaltenango, Guatemala capture Ángel Gabriel Reyes Marroquin, a leader of the notorious Mara Salvatrucha, or MS-13, street gang. Prosecutors say he is connected to the deaths of at least 287 people. In 2014 Reyes escaped while facing charges including murder from a maximum security prison. Currently, he was also wanted for an August 17 armed attack on Roosevelt Hospital in Guatemala City in which seven people were shot dead.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-41619802>); [BBC](<http://bbcspain.localizer.co/news/world-latin-america-40959833>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Gravitational-wave astronomy, GW170817.

**Archived source account.** Scientists announce that the LIGO and VIRGO gravitational wave observatories detected for the first time gravitational waves from the merger of two neutron stars. The event coincided with a short gamma ray burst GRB 170817A detected by the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope, leading to SSS17a, the immediate follow-up observations by the Hubble Space Telescope and numerous ground-based telescopes. This confirms the theory according to which neutron star mergers are the cause of at least some short gamma-ray bursts.

Source citations (as archived): [LIGO press release](<https://www.ligo.caltech.edu/page/press-release-gw170817>); [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2017/10/16/16471616/gravitational-waves-ligo-virgo-neutron-stars-merger-multi-messenger-astronomy>).

Context: Wireless security, KRACK.

**Archived source account.** Researchers discover a vulnerability in the WPA2 protocol, leaving devices running Microsoft Windows, Mac OS, iOS, Android, Linux and OpenBSD operating systems vulnerable to attack over wireless connections.

Source citations (as archived): [Ars Technica](<https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2017/10/severe-flaw-in-wpa2-protocol-leaves-wi-fi-traffic-open-to-eavesdropping/>).
