<a id="event-2017-10-19-2-4"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 New Zealand general election.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand First leader Winston Peters chooses to create a minority coalition with the Labour Party and form the sixth Labour government.

Source citations (as archived): [NZ Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=11933639>).

<a id="event-2017-10-19-2-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 New Zealand general election.

**Archived source account.** Jacinda Ardern, the leader of the Labour Party, will be the next prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [Newshub](<http://www.newshub.co.nz/home/election/2017/10/nz-s-new-government-nz-first-chooses-labour.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists studying flying insects in nature reserves and protected areas of western Germany report a decline of more than 75% of the population in about three decades.

Source citations (as archived): [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/science/archive/2017/10/oh-no/543390/>); [PLOS One](<http://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0185809>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-10-19-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Major League Baseball postseason.

**Archived source account.** The Los Angeles Dodgers defeat the defending World Series champion Chicago Cubs 11–1 in Game 5 of the National League Championship Series, winning the series 4–1. This will be the Dodgers' first World Series appearance since 1988.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/recap?gameId=371019116>).

### 2017-10-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087113715](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2020&oldid=1087113715>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-20-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Battle of Raqqa (2017).

**Archived source account.** The Syrian Democratic Forces announce the "total liberation" of Raqqa, previously the de facto capital of ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/20/middleeast/raqqa-syria-isis-total-liberation/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-20-0-4"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Two suicide bomber attacks, one on a Shia mosque in Kabul and one on a Sunni mosque in Ghor Province, kill approximately 60 people. Approximately 180 people have been killed in bombing attacks this week.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-41699320>).

<a id="event-2017-10-20-0-6"></a>

Context: Insurgency in Egypt (2013–present).

**Archived source account.** Sixteen members of the Egyptian Police have died in a clash with Islamic militants from the Hasm Movement. More than fifteen militants have been killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Ahram](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/280154/Egypt/Politics-/-policemen-killed,--injured-in-Western-Desert-shoo.aspx>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-20-1-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Malawi.

**Archived source account.** Police in Malawi arrest 140 people after nine people were lynched for suspected vampirism.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malawi-violence/malawi-arrests-140-in-clampdown-after-vampirism-killings-idUSKBN1CP192?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-20-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis and Archbishop Charles Scicluna of Malta express sorrow over the death of Daphne Caruana Galizia, an investigative journalist who died in a car bomb attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Catholic News Agency](<https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/catholic-leaders-lament-assassination-of-maltese-journalist-10764>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Czech legislative election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in the Czech Republic go to the polls to elect new members of the Chamber of Deputies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41691098>).

<a id="event-2017-10-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The European Union heads of state prepare to start negotiations on a future UK–EU trade agreement in December, depending on progress with the financial "exit bill" negotiations by then.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu/britains-may-wins-brexit-reprieve-faces-tough-weeks-ahead-idUSKBN1CO36F>).

### 2017-10-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1333992480](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2021&oldid=1333992480>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-21-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Somalia / 14 October 2017 Mogadishu bombings.

**Archived source account.** The death toll in Somalia's deadliest terror attack rises up to 358, making it the fifth-deadliest terror attack worldwide.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Independent](<http://www.independent.ie/world-news/africa/death-toll-in-somalia-terror-attack-rises-to-358-36246960.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-0-4"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the Sahel.

**Archived source account.** Gunmen coming from Mali kill 13 gendarmes and injure five on a base in western Niger.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/gunmen-kill-13-niger-gendarmes-in-attack-near-mali-border-idUSKBN1CQ0DI?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills at least 15 people in Kabul.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/10/21/asia/afghanistan-conflict/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-21-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 UK and Ireland windstorm season.

**Archived source account.** Storm Brian, the third windstorm of the season, causes severe flash flooding in Ireland and coastal flooding in parts of England and Wales, although disruption is not as severe as initially expected.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-41704779>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-1-3"></a>

Context: Helicopter accidents and incidents.

**Archived source account.** A helicopter carrying five people crashes into Kenya's Lake Nakuru.

Source citations (as archived): [Capital FM](<https://www.capitalfm.co.ke/news/2017/10/chopper-5-board-crashes-lake-nakuru/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-1-5"></a>

Context: Landslides in Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** At least two people are dead and twelve missing after a landslide on the Malaysian tourist island of Penang.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC.ca](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/malaysia-landslide-1.4365760>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-10-21-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Madagascar plague outbreak.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from an outbreak of plague in Madagascar nears 100. So far, there have been 911 cases recorded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-10-22/red-cross-warns-stigma-could-worsen-madagascar-plague-outbreak/9073586>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Czech legislative election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The ANO movement of billionaire Andrej Babiš wins a sizeable plurality of seats in the Chamber of Deputies, but falls short of a majority.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/21/world/europe/andrej-babis-ano-czech-election.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-3-2"></a>

Context: Czech legislative election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The three next largest parties become the Civic Democratic Party, the Czech Pirate Party, and the far-right Freedom and Direct Democracy, as support for the governing Czech Social Democratic Party collapses.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<http://www.dw.com/en/czech-trump-and-insurgent-parties-benefit-from-voting-hurricane-in-czech-republic-election/a-41061893>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-3-4"></a>

Context: Argentine legislative election, 2017; Santiago Maldonado case.

**Archived source account.** Parties in Argentina halt their election campaigns due to the appearance of a body thought to be Santiago Maldonado, an indigenous rights activist who disappeared at the beginning of August 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/18/argentina-body-found-midterm-election-campaign>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-3-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Iraqi–Kurdish conflict.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi forces complete the takeover of Kirkuk Governorate, which is outside the autonomous zone accorded by the Constitution of Iraq. Grand Ayatollah Ali al-Sistani calls for the state to protect Kurds in northern Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-kurds-clash/iraqi-forces-complete-kirkuk-province-takeover-after-clashes-with-kurds-idUSKBN1CP0PT>).

<a id="event-2017-10-21-3-8"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Prime Minister of Spain, Mariano Rajoy, activates Article 155 of the Constitution of Spain. This will put Catalonia under the direct control of the central government, removing the regional government and completely limit the power of the Parliament of Catalonia. The regional police and media will also be under its control.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/21/world/europe/spain-catalonia-mariano-rajoy.html>).

### 2017-10-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091447789](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2022&oldid=1091447789>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills 13 people and injures five others in the northeast Nigerian city of Maiduguri. According to the police, 13 more civilians were injured in separate attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/suicide-bomber-kills-13-others-in-northeast-nigerian-city-police-official-idUSKBN1CR0XZ?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian man in the occupied West Bank is arrested and questioned for a few hours by Israeli police after Facebook mistranslates his Arabic-language message saying "good morning" into Hebrew for "attack them".

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<http://news.sky.com/story/man-arrested-by-israeli-police-after-writing-good-morning-on-facebook-11093578>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Japanese general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Shinzō Abe is re-elected prime minister as his Liberal Democratic Party-led coalition wins 312 seats and retains its two-thirds supermajority in the 465-member House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-41711369>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-election/abe-to-push-reform-of-japans-pacifist-constitution-after-election-win-idUSKBN1CQ0UW>).

<a id="event-2017-10-22-2-3"></a>

Context: Slovenian presidential election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Slovenia go to the polls to elect their president. Opinion polls predict that the independent incumbent Borut Pahor will retain the largely ceremonial role despite being challenged by noted actor and comedian Marjan Šarec.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-10-21/slovenia-s-instagram-president-on-track-to-new-term-in-election>).

<a id="event-2017-10-22-2-5"></a>

Context: Argentine legislative election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Argentina go to the polls to elect half of the members of the Chamber of Deputies and Senate. Cambiemos, the national government coalition led by president Mauricio Macri, got a clear victory in the four most populated provinces and the city of Buenos Aires. Former president Cristina Fernández de Kirchner ran for senator of Buenos and ended second, leading the opposition.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/congress/argentina-election-gives-president-a-legislative-majority/2017/10/22/ccea5a36-b78f-11e7-9b93-b97043e57a22_story.html?utm_term=.0377e5e41c21>).

<a id="event-2017-10-22-2-8"></a>

Context: Referendums in Italy / Lombard autonomy referendum, 2017 and Venetian autonomy referendum, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Set on the same day, two regions of Italy hold non-binding referendums aimed to decide whether citizens want greater autonomy or not.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41712263>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-10-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Major League Baseball postseason.

**Archived source account.** The Houston Astros defeat the New York Yankees 4–0 in the seventh and deciding game of the American League Championship Series, thereby advancing to the World Series for the second time in team history and the first as an American League team.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/mlb/recap?gameId=371021118>).

### 2017-10-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 807078939](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2023&oldid=807078939>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Battle of Marawi.

**Archived source account.** The Philippines Armed Forces declares an end to military operations in the southern city of Marawi after 5 months of fighting.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-militants/philippines-declares-battle-with-islamist-rebels-over-in-marawi-city-idUSKBN1CS0F5>).

<a id="event-2017-10-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Palmyra Coordination Committee reports that 67 bodies, victims of summary execution by ISIL, were found in Al-Qaryatayn in the Homs Governorate in central Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/at-least-67-civilians-found-dead-in-syria-town-taken-from-is/ar-AAtVzZK?li=AA4Zpp&amp;ocid=spartandhp>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** Typhoon Lan makes landfall in the Shizuoka Prefecture of Japan, causing at least two deaths and 10 injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<http://news.abs-cbn.com/overseas/10/23/17/2-dead-as-typhoon-slams-into-japan-after-election-day>).

### 2017-10-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273651822](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2024&oldid=1273651822>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany.

**Archived source account.** German police find guns and ammunition in a raid on suspected Islamist militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-security-raids/german-police-find-guns-ammunition-in-raid-of-suspected-islamist-militant-idUSKBN1CU0W3?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Indonesia arrests nine with alleged Islamic State links.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-indonesia-security/indonesia-arrests-nine-with-alleged-islamic-state-links-idUSKBN1CU0BH?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-24-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six crew from a German ship are kidnapped in Nigerian waters.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-kidnapping/six-crew-from-german-ship-kidnapped-in-nigerian-waters-idUSKBN1CT1OZ?il=0>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-10-24-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission scraps the draft legislation that would have permitted the EBA regulator to order "too big to fail" banks to split off their trading activities, citing "no foreseeable agreement" in sight on criteria. The draft was supposed to be the EU's answer to the United States' Volcker Rule.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-banks-regulations/eu-scraps-its-answer-to-u-s-volcker-rule-for-banks-idUSKBN1CT285?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-24-1-3"></a>

Context: Banking in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Vice President Mike Pence casts the tie-breaking vote late Tuesday night to repeal a rule that would have made it easier for Americans to sue their banks and credit card companies.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/24/politics/senate-cfpb-arbitration-repeal/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-10-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs an executive order which allows U.S. to resume its refugee program, with a 90-day review period for 11 countries identified as "high risk".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/oct/24/trump-refugee-ban-end-immigration-executive-order>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Ransomware.

**Archived source account.** Security researchers report on the outbreak of the ransomware nicknamed Bad Rabbit, which has affected computer networks throughout the world, with Russia and Ukraine being the worst affected.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/what-bad-rabbit-petya-style-ransomware-attack-hits-russia-ukraine-2605724>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-41740768>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-24-4-1"></a>

Context: 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** The week-long Communist Party congress in Beijing draws to an end, with General Secretary Xi Jinping set to become its most influential leader since Party Chairman Mao Zedong.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-41730948>).

<a id="event-2017-10-24-4-3"></a>

Context: United States Senate elections, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Republican Senator Jeff Flake, a vocal critic of the Trump administration from Arizona announces that he will not run again in 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<http://www.politico.com/story/2017/10/24/flake-retiring-after-2018-244114>).

<a id="event-2017-10-24-4-5"></a>

Context: Nuclear power in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Republican leaders in the U.S. House of Representatives launch an investigation into the Obama administration's decision in 2010 to allow Rosatom to purchase Canada-based Uranium One.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/la-na-nunes-uranium-20171024-story.html>).

### 2017-10-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091447951](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2025&oldid=1091447951>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-10-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Congressional Gold Medal.

**Archived source account.** The Congressional Gold Medal is awarded to Filipino American veterans of World War II more than 70 years after the end of that war.

Source citations (as archived): [Manila Bulletin](<https://news.mb.com.ph/2017/10/26/us-congressional-gold-medal-awarded-to-filipino-wwii-vets/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Floodings in Burgas Province, Bulgaria, claim 3 victims.

Source citations (as archived): [Novinite](<http://www.novinite.com/articles/184625/3+People+Have+Died+After+Torrential+Rains+in+the+South-East+Bulgarian+District+of+Burgas.>); [Radio Bulguria](<http://bnr.bg/en/post/100889089/bulgarian-government-allocates-500000-euros-to-help-burgas-after-deadly-floods>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-25-2-1"></a>

Context: 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China.

**Archived source account.** At the National Congress of the Communist Party of China, Xi Jinping assumes his second term as General Secretary (China's paramount leader), and the political theory Xi Jinping Thought is written into the party's constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-china-41730948>); [Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/24/xi-jinping-mao-thought-on-socialism-china-constitution>); [Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/10/24/china-lifts-xi-jinpings-status-powerful-leader-decades/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-25-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Crown Prince Mohammad bin Salman of Saudi Arabia announces that a majority of Saudis want a return to moderate Islam. 70% of the kingdom is made up of residents under the age of 30 who welcome the idea of new reforms.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41747476>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-25-3-1"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** A parked scooter explosion in Kiev, thought to be an assassination attempt on Ukrainian Radical MP Ihor Mosiychuk, kills his bodyguard and one more man. Mosiychuk, political scientist Vitaliy Bala and a woman are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [DigitalJournal](<http://www.digitaljournal.com/news/world/ukraine-lawmaker-wounded-in-assassination-attempt/article/506002>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Interstellar comet.

**Archived source account.** The discovery of an asteroid with a record high eccentricity, A/2017 U1, is announced. It is almost certainly the first known example of an interstellar object. While initially thought to be a comet, it is now considered an asteroid.

Source citations (as archived): [IAU Minor Planet Center](<http://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K17/K17UI1.html>).

### 2017-10-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256158537](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2026&oldid=1256158537>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-10-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Twitter bans all ads from Russian news agencies RT and Sputnik based on U.S. intelligence's conclusion that both attempted to interfere with the 2016 U.S. presidential election on behalf of the Russian government.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/twitter-is-banning-all-ads-from-russian-news-agencies-rt-and-sputnik-2017-10>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Tangerang fireworks disaster.

**Archived source account.** An explosion in a fireworks plant located west of the Indonesian capital Jakarta kills at least 47 and injures 35.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-10-26/indonesia-fireworks-factory-explosion-kills-27-injures-35/9090478>).

<a id="event-2017-10-26-1-3"></a>

Context: Rail accidents in 2017.

**Archived source account.** Four people (three military conscripts and a train passenger) are killed and four conscripts are injured after a passenger train collides with an off-road military truck in Raseborg, Finland.

Source citations (as archived): [Yle](<https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/train_collides_with_military_vehicle_in_the_south_four_dead/9901431>).

<a id="event-2017-10-26-1-5"></a>

Context: Helicopter accidents and incidents.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Mi-8 helicopter crashes into the sea off Svalbard with eight people reported missing. A search and rescue operation is underway.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-41766433>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** At least two Catalan officials defect from the ruling Junts pel Sí party as Catalan president Carles Puigdemont cancels a speech regarding snap elections. Puigdemont plans to draw back from declaring independence from Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-10-26/catalonia-is-said-to-lean-toward-elections-not-independence-j98c78kx>).

<a id="event-2017-10-26-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Mark Rutte presents his third cabinet. It took a record 225 days of negotiations to form the government composed of VVD, D66, CDA and CU.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/netherlands-dutch-pm-mark-rutte-and-government-sworn-in-after-record-coalition-talks/a-41126473>).

<a id="event-2017-10-26-2-5"></a>

Context: IRS targeting controversy.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration's Department of Justice settles two lawsuits which alleged that the Obama administration's Internal Revenue Service targeted conservative groups.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/26/us/politics/irs-tea-party-lawsuit-settlement.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-26-2-7"></a>

Context: Assassination of John F. Kennedy.

**Archived source account.** Nearly 3,000 files related to the assassination of President John F. Kennedy in 1963 have been released, while U.S. President Donald Trump orders others to be withheld citing national security concerns. The documents were scheduled for release today in a 1992 law.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-41771923>).

<a id="event-2017-10-26-2-9"></a>

Context: Kenyan presidential election, October 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Kenya go to the polls following the annulment of the results in the Kenyan general election. The President of Kenya Uhuru Kenyatta wins with a 98% majority following an opposition boycott.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-10-31/kenya-president-kenyatta-wins-98-percent-of-vote/9101968>).

<a id="event-2017-10-26-2-11"></a>

Context: Sakharov Prize.

**Archived source account.** Venezuela's democratic opposition wins the Sakharov Prize, the European Union's top human rights award.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-41760899>).

### 2017-10-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127424055](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2027&oldid=1127424055>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-10-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Kazakh alphabets.

**Archived source account.** President Nursultan Nazarbayev of Kazakhstan announces that the Kazakh language will begin using a Latin script, rather than the current Cyrillic script.

Source citations (as archived): [Official site of the Kazakh presidency](<http://www.akorda.kz/ru/legal_acts/decrees/o-perevode-alfavita-kazahskogo-yazyka-s-kirillicy-na-latinskuyu-grafiku>); [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/nazarbaev-signs-language-decree-latin-cyrillic/28819174.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-10-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Burundian unrest (2015–2018).

**Archived source account.** Burundi becomes the first country to leave the International Criminal Court amid accusations the government committed crimes against humanity, including torture of political opponents. Burundi has accused the ICC of deliberately targeting Africans for prosecution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-41775951>).

<a id="event-2017-10-27-1-3"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States releases a list of 39 Russian military companies and intelligence agencies targeted by economic sanctions under the Countering America's Adversaries Through Sanctions Act.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/state-dept-gives-congress-list-of-russia-sanction-targets/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-27-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Special Counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** A federal grand jury approves the first charges from special counsel Robert Mueller's investigation into Russia's interference in the 2016 federal elections. The charges are sealed by a court order.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/27/politics/first-charges-mueller-investigation/index.html>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/357604-first-charges-filed-in-special-counsel-muellers-russia-probe-report>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017, Catalan Republic (2017), 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Catalonia declares independence from Spain as the Catalan Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/27/europe/catalonia-independence-spain/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-27-3-2"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017, Catalan Republic (2017), 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Catalonia votes and starts a "constituent" process towards independence from the Kingdom of Spain. The Senate of Spain votes to permit direct rule according to article 155 of the Spanish Constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41780116>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/10/27/560357561/spains-prime-minister-asks-for-direct-rule-authority-over-catalonia>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia-independence/catalan-parliament-declares-independence-from-spain-idUSKBN1CW1WO>).

<a id="event-2017-10-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017, Catalan Republic (2017), 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The euro drops to a three-month low after the declaration is made.

Source citations (as archived): [Fund Strategy](<https://www.fundstrategy.co.uk/euro-muted-catalonia-declares-independence/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-global-forex/euro-poised-for-worst-week-in-2017-on-dovish-ecb-catalonia-vote-idUSKBN1CW01U>).

<a id="event-2017-10-27-3-4"></a>

Context: Catalan independence referendum, 2017, Catalan Republic (2017), 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Spain Mariano Rajoy dissolves the Parliament of Catalonia, dismisses the Government of Catalonia and calls a regional election for December 21. He also fires the police chief, announces the takeover of regional ministries by national ministries and closes overseas representations of Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/spain-sacks-catalan-government-after-independence-declaration-idUSKBN1CW0VF?il=0>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/10/27/world/europe/spain-catalonia-puigdemont.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-27-3-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Australian parliamentary eligibility crisis.

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Australia finds that Deputy Prime Minister Barnaby Joyce of the National Party and several senators were ineligible for the 2016 federal election.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-10-27/live-blog-high-court-delivers-judgement-on-citizenship-seven/9085032>).

<a id="event-2017-10-27-3-7"></a>

Context: 2017 Australian parliamentary eligibility crisis.

**Archived source account.** The government led by Prime Minister of Australia Malcolm Turnbull loses its one-seat majority unless Joyce wins a by-election in the Division of New England.

Source citations (as archived): [9 News](<http://www.9news.com.au/national/2017/10/27/14/21/citizenship-seven-barnaby-joyce-high-court-booted-from-parliament>).

### 2017-10-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 851252249](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2028&oldid=851252249>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-28-0-1"></a>

Context: 28 October 2017 Mogadishu bombings.

**Archived source account.** Two car bombs kill at least 25 people, mostly police officers, near the national theater area in Mogadishu, Somalia, two weeks after a similar attack killed hundreds. Islamist group Al-Shabaab claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-violence-blast/huge-blast-in-somalias-capital-mogadishu-reuters-witness-idUSKBN1CX0GQ>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 19 people are killed and 16 others are injured when a bus skids off the road in the Dhading District and falls into the Trishuli River in central Nepal.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/at-least-19-dead-in-central-nepal-bus-accident-police/ar-AAu9qD1?ocid=spartandhp>).

<a id="event-2017-10-28-1-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Tropical storm warnings are issued for western Cuba and the northwestern Bahamas, and tropical storm warnings are announced for coastal South Florida in the U.S., as a strengthening Tropical Storm Philippe treks north-northeast with maximum sustained winds at 35 mph (55 km/h).

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/en-CA/canada/news/news/2017-10-28-tropical-depression-eighteen-tropical-storm-philippe>); [National Hurricane Center](<http://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT3+shtml/281750.shtml?>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-28-2-1"></a>

Context: Black Lives Matter.

**Archived source account.** A "White Lives Matter" gathering takes place in Shelbyville, Tennessee, with 200+ WLM protestors met by 700+ counter-protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2017/10/28/2-tennessee-towns-brace-white-nationalist-rallies-counter-protests/809645001/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-28-2-3"></a>

Context: Icelandic parliamentary election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Iceland go to the polls to elect 63 members of the Althing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41787919>).

### 2017-10-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1346154291](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2029&oldid=1346154291>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Northern Rakhine State clashes.

**Archived source account.** More than 2,000 people march in Yangon to show support for the military, urging the military to secure the country's sovereignty, protect national security and stop illegal intruders (referring to the Rohingya people).

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/thousands-march-support-myanmar-military-50792867>).

<a id="event-2017-10-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** In coordination with Libya’s internationally recognized government, American special operations forces and FBI agents capture Mustafa al-Imam, a militant who allegedly was involved in the 2012 Benghazi attack, at an unknown location in Libya.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2017/10/30/us-captures-key-militant-in-benghazi-attack.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-29-1-1"></a>

Context: October 2017 Northern California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Archives from Hewlett-Packard founders William Hewlett and David Packard are among those destroyed by fires in a Santa Rosa neighborhood.

Source citations (as archived): [Quartz](<https://qz.com/1114733/the-79-year-history-of-silicon-valleys-first-technology-startup-hewlett-packard-hp-was-destroyed-in-the-santa-rosa-fires/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-29-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A pickup truck crashes into an Amish horse-drawn buggy, killing three preteen children and injuring six other passengers in Bushnell Township, Michigan. Police say the survivors' injuries are life-threatening.

Source citations (as archived): [The Detroit News](<http://www.detroitnews.com/story/news/local/michigan/2017/10/29/buggy-crash-kills-three-children/107144232/>); [FOX17](<http://fox17online.com/2017/10/29/3-children-killed-when-pickup-hits-amish-buggy/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/da97835aa6a54a3bb75cc86340271e5c/Michigan-police:-Buggy-crash-kills-3-kids,-injures-6-others>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Iraqi Kurdistan.

**Archived source account.** Massoud Barzani, the president of the Kurdistan Region in Iraq since 2005, announces that he will step down after November 1. The Iraqi Kurdistan Parliament now has to redistribute the authorities of the presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/2017/10/30/barzani-step-down-kurdish-leader-iraq>).

<a id="event-2017-10-29-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of supporters for a unified Spain gather in Barcelona, the capital and largest city of Catalonia, in one of the biggest shows of force against Catalan independence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/hundreds-of-thousands-of-pro-spanish-demonstrators-turn-out-in-barcelona/2017/10/29/2513413a-bc92-11e7-8444-a0d4f04b89eb_story.html?utm_term=.9dde645d43ff>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia-poll/hundreds-of-thousands-march-for-unified-spain-poll-shows-depths-of-division-idUSKBN1CY072>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-10-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 FIA Formula One World Championship.

**Archived source account.** After a first-lap collision and a ninth-place finish in the Mexican Grand Prix, Lewis Hamilton becomes the fifth driver to win four FIA Formula One World Championship titles.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2017/oct/29/lewis-hamilton-formula-one-world-title-mexico-grand-prix-f1>).

<a id="event-2017-10-29-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 World Rally Championship.

**Archived source account.** Sébastien Ogier clinches his fifth successive World Rally Championship title, finishing third in the 2017 Wales Rally GB.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/motorsport/41795914>).

<a id="event-2017-10-29-3-5"></a>

Context: 2017 WTA Finals.

**Archived source account.** Danish tennis player Caroline Wozniacki wins the WTA Finals defeating American Venus Williams in the final match, 6–4, 6–4.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/41795680>).

### 2017-10-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359118522](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2030&oldid=1359118522>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** The IDF destroys a partly-completed tunnel from the Gaza Strip border near the town of Khan Yunis that crossed into Israeli territory, killing seven Hamas militants. Several more died in the rescue efforts.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-palestinians-israel-tunnel/seven-killed-as-israel-destroys-tunnel-dug-under-gaza-border-idUSKBN1CZ1SL?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-10-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A U.N. and Syrian Arab Red Crescent interagency convoy brings food and medical aid to 40,000 people on the verge of starvation in the towns of Kafr Batna and Saqba in the Eastern Ghouta suburb of Damascus for the first time since June 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-aid/convoy-rolls-into-damascus-suburbs-with-aid-for-40000-u-n-idUSKBN1CZ1PO>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-30-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Special Counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** Paul Manafort and Rick Gates surrender to the FBI after both are indicted on multiple charges stemming from the investigation into the Donald Trump presidential campaign's possible associations with the Russian government. The two men—who respectively served as manager and deputy manager of the campaign from March to August 2016—are being charged on twelve counts, which include conspiracy against the U.S., money laundering and failing to register as foreign agents.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2017/10/30/report-former-trump-campaign-chair-paul-manafort-charged-russia-probe-told-surrender-feds/812424001/>).

<a id="event-2017-10-30-2-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Special Counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** George Papadopoulos, who worked as a foreign policy adviser for the Trump campaign, is also revealed to have plead guilty on October 5 to making false statements to FBI agents about contacts that he had with the Russian government during the campaign.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/politics/la-na-timeline-george-papadopoulos-indictment-20171030-htmlstory.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-30-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Special Counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** Tony Podesta, brother of John Podesta, resigns from the Podesta Group lobbying firm. A spokesperson for the group says they are cooperating with the Special Counsel's team.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-podesta/u-s-lobbyist-tony-podesta-leaves-firm-amid-manafort-probe-idUSKBN1CZ28D?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-10-30-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis, Catalan Republic (2017).

**Archived source account.** The Spanish attorney general, José Manuel Maza, requests a lawsuit against (former) Catalan government members, seeking charges of sedition, rebellion and embezzlement. The Catalan parliament is formally dissolved.

Source citations (as archived): [San Francisco Chronicle](<http://www.sfgate.com/news/crime/article/The-Latest-Ousted-leader-leaves-Catalans-12316417.php>).

<a id="event-2017-10-30-2-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis, Catalan Republic (2017).

**Archived source account.** A Spanish government source says that Carles Puigdemont and part of his cabinet has fled to Belgium to escape prosecution. International media agree the situation in Catalonia—under direct Spanish rule—is quiet.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/work-resumes-normally-in-catalonia-as-spain-enforces-direct-rule-idUSKBN1CZ0IP?il=0>); [El Diario](<http://www.eldiario.es/politica/Puigdemont-Belgica-justicia-euroorden-detencion_0_702730131.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-30-2-7"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis, Catalan Republic (2017).

**Archived source account.** A Belgian federal government source says Puigdemont and about five ministers would attend a "private reception" in Brussels by the N-VA party. Prime Minister Charles Michel (MR) has no comment. Interior Minister Jan Jambon (N-VA) says he "knows nothing". N-VA replies that it "did not invite \[them\]".

Source citations (as archived): [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/binnenland/puigdemont-in-brussel-op-uitnodiging-van-n-va-druk-overleg-tussen-kabinetten-michel-jambon-en-francken~a99e8163/>); [7sur7](<http://www.7sur7.be/7s7/fr/40422/Referendum-en-Catalogne/article/detail/3296928/2017/10/30/Carles-Puigdemont-a-Bruxelles-la-N-VA-dement-l-avoir-invite.dhtml>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Women's rights in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Starting in 2018, women will be allowed to attend sports events in stadiums in Saudi Arabia for the first time in the country's history, officials say.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41798481>).

<a id="event-2017-10-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Transgender personnel in the United States military.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia blocks President Donald Trump's proposed ban on new transgender recruits in the U.S. military.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/defense/357827-court-partially-blocks-trumps-directive-on-transgender-military-ban>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Carbon dioxide in Earth's atmosphere.

**Archived source account.** Concentrations of carbon dioxide (\{\{CO2\}\}) in the Earth's atmosphere surged by a record amount in 2016, according to the World Meteorological Organization.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-41778089>).

### 2017-10-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091448402](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20October%2031&oldid=1091448402>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-10-31-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Lower Manhattan attack.

**Archived source account.** Eight people are killed and at least 11 others injured when a man in a rented pickup truck drives down a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan. The 29-year-old suspect, later identified as Uzbekistani immigrant Sayfullo Saipov, is shot and taken into custody by police. Police are treating this incident as an act of terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Post](<https://nypost.com/2017/10/31/several-people-shot-in-downtown-manhattan/>); [AP](<https://apnews.com/aa83dfe6157f4214a5e92efaba4142c9>); [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2017/10/31/New-York-truck-crash-that-killed-8-treated-as-terrorism/7791509478474/>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/nyc-terrorist-attack/least-one-person-dead-incident-lower-manhattan-n816166?cid=eml_nbn_20171031>).

<a id="event-2017-10-31-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing in Afghanistan's capital Kabul kills at least 8 civilians and leaves numerous wounded. The Islamic State claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast/blast-hits-afghan-capital-kabul-numerous-casualties-idUSKBN1D01GS>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-10-31-1-1"></a>

Context: North Korea tunnel collapse.

**Archived source account.** A tunnel under construction at North Korea's nuclear test site collapses, killing as many as 200 workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Yonhap News Agency](<http://m.yna.co.kr/mob2/en/contents_en.jsp?cid=AEN20171031012000315>).

<a id="event-2017-10-31-1-3"></a>

Context: Road accidents in 2017.

**Archived source account.** A car accident on highway 400 involving 14 vehicles, including two tanker trucks, results in three deaths near Barrie, Ontario. Police suspect distracted driving to be the cause.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/beta/news/canada/toronto/highway-400-fatal-pileup-cookstown-1.4381540>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-10-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Utah.

**Archived source account.** A shooting on the campus of the University of Utah leaves one student dead. A suspect is taken into custody.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/10/31/us/university-utah-student-killed-suspect-wanted-colorado/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-10-31-2-3"></a>

Context: Crime in California.

**Archived source account.** At an elementary school in Riverside, California, police shoot a parent who reportedly took a teacher hostage.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-riverside-classroom-barricade-20171031-story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-10-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** U.S. senators question lawyers representing Facebook, Twitter and Google about Russian activity on their platforms during the 2016 United States presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-41821359>).

<a id="event-2017-10-31-3-3"></a>

Context: Virginia gubernatorial election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The Latino Victory Fund withdraws an anti–Ed Gillespie political advertisement because of scenes which loosely resemble a recent terror attack in New York City. The ad was originally meant to improve Ralph Northam's standing with minority voters.,

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/politics/controversial-political-ad-pulled-new-york-terror-attack-article-1.3603015>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/virginia-politics/new-anti-gillespie-ad-sparked-by-worries-about-northams-appeal-to-minorities/2017/10/31/94867870-be59-11e7-8444-a0d4f04b89eb_story.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-10-31-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** A Minotaur-C rocket launches from Vandenberg Air Force Base, California, and deploys 10 commercial Earth-imaging satellites for Planet Labs. It is the first successful mission for the Minotaur-C, formerly known as Taurus, since 2004.

Source citations (as archived): [Spaceflight 101](<http://spaceflight101.com/minotaur-c-launches-ten-satellites-for-planet>).


## November

### 2017-11-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1162239283](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20November%201&oldid=1162239283>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-11-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A Saudi-led coalition airstrike on a market in Sahar District in Yemen's northern Saada Governorate, which is under Houthi control, kills at least 26 people, according to medics and local officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-air-strike/saudi-led-air-strike-kills-26-people-in-yemen-medics-idUSKBN1D13Y7>).

<a id="event-2017-11-01-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Two fuel tankers are bombed in the Afghan town of Charikar, killing at least 15 people and injuring at least 27.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-tanker/at-least-15-killed-in-afghanistan-tanker-explosion-idUSKBN1D15HK>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-11-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Rock climbing in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa National Park's board votes unanimously to ban climbing on Uluru, sacred to the Anangu people, in Australia's Northern Territory, from October 2019, due to Indigenous concerns over respect for the sacred site and for the safety of tourists.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsch Welle](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2017/11/01/australia-bans-tourists-climbing-iconic-rock-uluru/820174001/>).

<a id="event-2017-11-01-1-3"></a>

Context: NPR controversies.

**Archived source account.** Citing "inappropriate behavior", Michael Oreskes resigns from his position as senior vice president of news at NPR after three journalists accuse him of sexual harassment.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/11/01/media/michael-oreskes-npr/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-11-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** A Belgian lawyer representing Carles Puigdemont announces his client will not return to Spain to answer charges against him. Spanish prosecutors could order a European Arrest Warrant if Puigdemont fails to appear in court.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-41829341>).

<a id="event-2017-11-01-2-3"></a>

Context: Thornton shooting.

**Archived source account.** A gunman opens fire in a Walmart in Thornton, Colorado, killing three people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/11/02/colorado-shooting-mass-casualties-walmart-thornton>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-11-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Japanese general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Shinzō Abe is officially reinstated as Prime Minister of Japan following the election on 22 October 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-politics/japans-abe-re-elected-prime-minister-after-big-election-win-idUSKBN1D13LP?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-11-01-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Australian parliamentary eligibility crisis.

**Archived source account.** President of the Australian Senate, Stephen Parry, announces he will resign, effective 2 November 2017, after confirming he holds dual British-Australian citizenship.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-41827970>).

<a id="event-2017-11-01-3-5"></a>

Context: States of emergency in France.

**Archived source account.** France declares the end of the country's state of emergency which was enforced as a reaction to the November 2015 Paris attacks. The state of emergency gets replaced with a new counterterrorism law signed by President Emmanuel Macron.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/france-state-of-emergency-end-terror-attacks-paris-isis-terrorism-alerts-warning-risk-reduced-a8029311.html>).

<a id="event-2017-11-01-3-7"></a>

Context: 2017 Westminster sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** Michael Fallon resigns as the United Kingdom's Secretary of State for Defence amid controversy over reports he touched a female journalist inappropriately in 2002.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-41838682>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-11-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Genetically modified organism.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency reports weed killer dicamba, used in fields with genetically modified crops, has damaged more than 3.6 million acres of normal soybean crops in 25 states this year.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/11/01/business/soybeans-pesticide.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-11-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 World Series.

**Archived source account.** In baseball, the Houston Astros defeat the Los Angeles Dodgers 5–1 in the seventh and deciding game of the World Series. It is the first World Series title for the Astros, who had lost 111 games just four seasons earlier. The Astros' George Springer, who set records for most extra-base hits (8) and total bases (29) in a single World Series, and tied the record for most home runs in a single World Series (5), is named series MVP.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/01/sport/world-series-game-7/>); [CBS Sports](<https://www.cbssports.com/mlb/news/game-7-springer-sets-world-series-records-for-extra-base-hits-and-total-bases/>).

<a id="event-2017-11-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Judge Lamela sends preventive detention to eight of the ministers of the Government of Catalonia (Junqueras, Forn, Borràs, Romeva, Mundó, Bassa, Rull, Turull) due to an alleged crime of sedition and rebellion. The ninth Santi Vila, minister of Enterprise and Knowledge, leaves the jail the next day after payment of a bail, being the only one who was given this opportunity.

<a id="event-2017-11-02-4-2"></a>

Context: Donald Trump on social media.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump's main social media account is suspended for 11 minutes. Twitter blames the incident on an employee and says it is "taking steps to prevent this from happening again."

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/nov/02/trump-twitter-account-offline>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-41880153>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/11/05/world/paradise-papers.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-11-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Border incidents involving North Korea.

**Archived source account.** A Korean People's Army soldier defects to South Korea via the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). He was shot and injured by fellow North Korean soldiers as he crossed to the South Korean side at Panmunjom, and has been taken to hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-41967841>).

<a id="event-2017-11-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The BBC reveals that a secret deal in mid-October allowed hundreds of ISIL fighters and their families, including some of their "most notorious members", escape from Raqqa in a convoy that was between 6 to 7 km long. The United States government confirms that the deal with ISIL was made and that the evacuations took place. The possibility of a deal was previously reported as early as October 14.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/resources/idt-sh/raqqas_dirty_secret>); [Rudaw](<http://www.rudaw.net/english/middleeast/syria/15102017>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/oct/14/last-isis-fighters-in-raqqa-seek-deal-to-leave-former-capital-in-syria>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-11-13-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Iran–Iraq earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the earthquake in Iraq and Iran exceeds 400 with over 7,000 injured. The death toll is expected to rise further in coming days.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/death-toll-in-iran-iraq-earthquake-tops-300-state-media-says/2017/11/13/990c7fe6-c84c-11e7-b0cf-7689a9f2d84e_story.html?utm_term=.78719677d05a&amp;wpisrc=al_news__alert-world--alert-national&amp;wpmk=1>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-11-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Military of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Twenty-three European Union countries sign a defence integration pact known as the Permanent Structured Cooperation. NATO members Denmark, Portugal and the United Kingdom (withdrawal from EU underway), and non-NATO members Malta and Ireland, opt out.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-defence/eu-signs-defense-pact-in-decades-long-quest-idUSKBN1DD0PX>).

<a id="event-2017-11-13-2-3"></a>

Context: Colombian peace process.

**Archived source account.** The Foreign Affairs Ministers of the European Union unanimously vote to remove the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) from its list of designated terrorist groups.

Source citations (as archived): [Colombia Reports](<https://colombiareports.com/eu-removes-colombias-demobilized-farc-rebels-terror-list/>).

<a id="event-2017-11-13-2-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** RT America registers with the U.S. Department of Justice as a foreign agent in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-usa-media-restrictions-rt/russias-rt-america-registers-as-foreign-agent-in-u-s-idUSKBN1DD25B>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-11-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump selects Eli Lilly's American division president and former HHS deputy secretary Alex Azar to be Secretary of Health and Human Services, replacing Tom Price who resigned on September 29.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trump-announces-alex-azar-tom-prices-replacement-department/story?id=51112984>).

<a id="event-2017-11-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Somaliland general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Somaliland vote for their next president.

Source citations (as archived): [The National](<http://www.thenational-somaliland.com/2017/11/14/somaliland-holds-peaceful-presidential-election/>).

<a id="event-2017-11-13-3-5"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Yemenis protest a blockade on Yemen led by a Saudi Arabian coalition.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20171113-thousands-protest-sanaa-yemen-against-saudi-blockade-famine>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-11-13-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 FIFA World Cup qualification.

**Archived source account.** Italy fails to qualify (for the first time since 1958) for 2018 FIFA World Cup after being defeated by Sweden in the UEFA Second Round.

Source citations (as archived): [Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/sport/football/international/italy-qualify-world-cup-in-60-years-play-off-defeat-sweden-2018-a8053271.html>).

### 2017-11-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1116155143](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20November%2014&oldid=1116155143>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-11-14-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Soldiers directing traffic and at least six APCs have been spotted around Harare, a day after General Constantino Chiwenga intervened in attempt to prevent a purge within the ruling ZANU-PF party. The party has accused the general of treason.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zimbabwe-politics/soldiers-on-harare-streets-as-ruling-party-accuses-zimbabwe-army-chief-of-treason-idUSKBN1DE1NG>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-11-14-1-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Iran–Iraq earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Iranians are forced to spend a second night outdoors in near-freezing temperatures after an earthquake hit the country's western border with Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-41977714>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-11-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Seminole Heights serial killer.

**Archived source account.** Police in Florida link a fourth unsolved murder to an unknown serial killer targeting the Seminole Heights area of Tampa, Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/14/us/tampa-seminole-heights-unsolved-killings/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-11-14-2-3"></a>

Context: Rancho Tehama shootings.

**Archived source account.** Five people, including the gunman, are killed and several others injured following a shooting at an elementary school and other locations on Rancho Tehama, California. The alleged gunman was shot and killed by police.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-norcal-elementary-school-shooting-20171114-story.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/11/14/564117257/at-least-3-reported-dead-after-shooting-at-school-other-locations-in-California>).

### 2017-11-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1116265629](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20November%2015&oldid=1116265629>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-11-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Works by Leonardo da Vinci.

**Archived source account.** Salvator Mundi, a painting generally attributed to Leonardo da Vinci, is sold at auction Christie's in New York City for US$450.3 million; setting a new record for the sale of an original work of art.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2017/nov/15/leonardo-da-vinci-salvator-mundi-auction>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-11-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Cyclone Numa.

**Archived source account.** Flash floods on the outskirts of the Greek capital Athens kill at least 16 people and injure dozens more after a severe thunderstorm.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-11-16/flash-floods-on-athens-outskirts-leave-at-least-14-dead/9155636>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/nov/15/deadly-flash-floods-cause-biblical-damage-in-athens>).

<a id="event-2017-11-15-1-2"></a>

Context: Cyclone Numa.

**Archived source account.** Numa is an example of a rare Mediterranean tropical-like cyclone, or "medicane". These uncommon tropical-like systems form over much cooler oceans than typical tropical cyclones.

Source citations (as archived): [The Weather Channel](<https://weather.com/en-GB/unitedkingdom/weather/news/rare-tropical-storm-forming-mediterranean>); [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/capital-weather-gang/wp/2017/11/16/this-is-whats-behind-the-dramatic-deadly-flooding-in-greece/?utm_term=.5dc63fd98d4c>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-11-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Rancho Tehama shootings.

**Archived source account.** Authorities discover the murdered wife of spree killer Kevin Janson Neal under the floorboards of their home, raising the death toll to six with ten others wounded in eight separate shootings.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-tehama-shooting-20171115-story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-11-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Zimbabwe Defence Forces troops seize control of the Zimbabwe Broadcasting Corporation headquarters as explosions are heard in the capital Harare amid reports of a coup against President Robert Mugabe.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zimbabwe-politics-broadcaster/soldiers-take-over-zimbabwe-state-broadcaster-zbc-staff-idUSKBN1DE36B?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-11-15-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** A high-ranking representative of the Zimbabwe National Army broadcast a military statement calling on the various sectors of society to keep calm and support the country's development.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/nov/15/the-situation-has-moved-to-another-level-zimbabwe-army-statement-in-full>).

<a id="event-2017-11-15-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Finance Minister Ignatius Chombo is among those people detained overnight in Zimbabwe.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2017/nov/15/zimbabwe-army-control-harare-coup-robert-mugabe-live>).

<a id="event-2017-11-15-3-5"></a>

Context: Australian Marriage Law Postal Survey.

**Archived source account.** The outcome of the Australian Marriage Law Postal Survey is announced with 61.6% voting yes to allow same-sex marriage with 79.5% of Australian voters participating.

Source citations (as archived): [Canberra Times](<http://www.canberratimes.com.au/federal-politics/political-news/samesex-marriage-vote-results-and-live-coverage-as-postal-survey-verdict-announced-20171114-gzl182.html>).

<a id="event-2017-11-15-3-7"></a>

Context: 2017 United Nations Climate Change Conference.

**Archived source account.** High level statespersons from France, Germany and other nations speak at the 2017 United Nations Climate Change Conference in Bonn.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/latest-activists-disrupt-german-coal-power-plant-51163758>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-11-15-4-1"></a>

Context: GW170608.

**Archived source account.** LIGO announces it has detected gravitational waves from the merger of two black holes.

Source citations (as archived): [LIGO Caltech](<https://www.ligo.caltech.edu/news/ligo20171115>).

<a id="event-2017-11-17-2-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-11-17-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least five people are killed at a demonstration in Nairobi after supporters of Raila Odinga and members of the National Super Alliance clash with the Kenya Police.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-11-18-0-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-11-18-0-2"></a>

<a id="event-2017-11-18-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of people celebrate the expected downfall of Robert Mugabe in the streets of Harare.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-42035981>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zimbabwe-politics-harare/ecstatic-zimbabweans-flood-harare-to-celebrate-expected-mugabe-downfall-idUSKBN1DI08B?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-11-18-2-5"></a>

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-11-20-1-1"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2017.

**Archived source account.** A 7.0 magnitude undersea earthquake strikes east of New Caledonia's Loyalty Islands in the South Pacific Ocean. Tsunami warnings for New Caledonia and Vanuatu are cancelled. There are no immediate reports of damage.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/oceania/tsunami-warning-after-7-0-pacific-earthquake-1.2127205>); [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/us-newcaledonia-quake/small-tsunamis-detected-in-new-caledonia-and-vanuatu-after-magnitude-7-undersea-quake-idINKBN1DJ0W0>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us2000brlf#executive>).

<a id="event-2017-11-20-3-1"></a>

<a id="event-2017-11-20-3-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/trump-administration-to-end-provisional-residency-protection-for-50000-haitians/2017/11/20/fa3fdd86-ce4a-11e7-9d3a-bcbe2af58c3a_story.html>).

**Archived source account.** After the United Kingdom withdrawal from the European Union referendum, the European Medicines Agency (EMA) will relocate to Amsterdam and the European Banking Authority (EBA) to Paris from London.

**Archived source account.** The Georgia Dome, former home of the NFL's Atlanta Falcons and the NCAA's Peach Bowl, is imploded after 25 years of use.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin signs into law amendments that allow foreign media outlets in Russia to be listed as foreign agents. Earlier this month, RT America has been forced to be registered as a foreign agent in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/25/world/russia-foreign-agents-law-media/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-usa-media-restrictions/russias-putin-signs-foreign-agents-media-law-idUSKBN1DP0I2?il=0>).

Context: Aftermath of 2017 Zimbabwean coup d'état.

**Archived source account.** Former Zimbabwe finance minister Ignatius Chombo, who was arrested during Operation Restore Legacy, is charged in Harare Magistrate’s Court with three counts of fraud, abuse of power, and corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-zimbabwe-politics/ousted-zimbabwe-finance-minister-chombo-in-court-over-corruption-charges-idUSKBN1DP07N>); [The Citizen](<https://citizen.co.za/news/news-africa/1740487/former-zim-finance-minister-chombo-in-harare-court-on-fraud-charges/>).

However, soon after the U.S. issued its arrest warrant, Russian authorities also sought his extradition. The Russian charge accuses Nikulin of stealing from an online money transfer company back in 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/25/europe/us-russia-extradition-fight/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-11-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Queensland state election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The Australian Labor Party leads the tight race with three-quarters of the votes counted. Pauline Hanson's One Nation party has yet to confirm victory in any contest; the nationalists are projected to win just one seat though they may poll better overall than the predicted 20 percent. Official results may not be known for several days.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-election-queensland/nationalists-facing-wipe-out-in-australian-state-election-idUSKBN1DQ06E>).

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/nation/nationnow/la-na-reno-shooting-20171128-story.html>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2017/11/30/police-identify-reno-high-rise-gunman-killed-by-swat-team.html>); [Mercury News](<http://www.mercurynews.com/2017/11/30/police-identify-reno-high-rise-gunman-killed-by-swat-team/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-11-28-2-1"></a>

Context: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate Budget Committee votes to move the Trump administration's tax bill to the full U.S. Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/gop-tax-bill-senate-budget-committee-vote-2017-11>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-11-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** A Soyuz-2.1b's Fregat upper stage malfunctions during Meteor-M No.2-1's launch from the Vostochny Cosmodrome. The status of the satellite and 18 other payloads is unknown, as they are either stranded in a wrong orbit or they reentered the atmosphere and crashed in the ocean.

Source citations (as archived): [Spaceflight Now](<https://spaceflightnow.com/2017/11/28/russian-weather-satellite-and-18-secondary-payloads-feared-lost/>).

<a id="event-2017-11-28-3-3"></a>
