**Archived source account.** YouTube removes thousands of child abuse videos related to Elsagate.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/youtube-cracks-down-disturbing-videos-children/>).

### 2017-11-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 851264359](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20November%2029&oldid=851264359>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-11-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2017 in archaeology.

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists from the University of Leicester announce the discovery of evidence that Julius Caesar's invasion of Britain started in Pegwell Bay, Kent.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-42155888>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-11-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Corporate bankruptcies.

**Archived source account.** Cumulus Media files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy reorganization and enters into a restructuring agreement with some of its lenders to reduce more than $1 billion of the debt accrued by the Atlanta-based radio broadcasting group since its 2011 purchase of Citadel Broadcasting, towards the end of a 30-day period for the company to secure a financing plan after defaulting on a $23.6-million debt payment on November 1. In a statement, Cumulus representatives said that the company expects all operations, programming and sales for its 459 radio stations across the U.S. to continue as normal during the restructuring process.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cumulus-media-bankruptcy/cumulus-media-files-for-bankruptcy-protection-idUSKBN1DU08U>); [Atlanta Journal-Constitution](<http://radiotvtalk.blog.ajc.com/2017/11/29/atlanta-based-cumulus-media-files-chapter-11-bankruptcy-protection/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2017-11-29-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Philippine dengue vaccination crisis.

**Archived source account.** Sanofi Pasteur made a statement that its product Dengvaxia poses higher risks to people without prior dengue infection.

Source citations (as archived): [Sanofi Pasteur](<http://mediaroom.sanofi.com/sanofi-updates-information-on-dengue-vaccine/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-11-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Euthanasia in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Victoria becomes the first state to pass euthanasia legislation.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2017-11-29/euthanasia-passes-parliament-in-victoria/9205472>).

<a id="event-2017-11-29-3-3"></a>

Context: International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia.

**Archived source account.** Retired Croatian Army general Slobodan Praljak, upon hearing at a UN tribunal that the international tribunal upheld his war crime conviction, drinks a small vial that apparently contained poison, and later dies in a hospital in The Hague.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/11/29/world/europe/bosnian-war-croatia.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/law/2017/nov/29/un-war-crimes-defendant-claims-to-drink-poison-at-trial-in-hague-slobodan-praljak>).

<a id="event-2017-11-29-3-5"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** NBC News announces that it has terminated their employment of Matt Lauer after a female employee filed a complaint about him conducting "inappropriate sexual behavior in the workplace".

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/11/29/media/matt-lauer/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/11/29/business/media/nbc-matt-lauer.html>).

<a id="event-2017-11-29-3-6"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Garrison Keillor, the former host of A Prairie Home Companion, is fired from Minnesota Public Radio after the public broadcaster discloses that it had become aware of allegations of "inappropriate behavior with an individual who worked with him".

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/lifestyle/style/garrison-keillor-ex-host-of-a-prairie-home-companion-dropped-by-minnesota-public-radio-after-allegations-of-improper-behavior/2017/11/29/5fa1256c-d52c-11e7-b62d-d9345ced896d_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-11-29-4-1"></a>

Context: Donald Trump on social media, Islamophobia in the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump re-tweets three anti-Muslim videos that were originally tweeted by Jayda Fransen, the deputy leader of British far-right political party Britain First, prompting international condemnation and criticism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-42166663>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/11/29/us/politics/trump-anti-muslim-videos-jayda-fransen.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2017/nov/29/trump-account-retweets-anti-muslim-videos-of-british-far-right-leader>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/11/29/politics/donald-trump-retweet-jayda-fransen/index.html>); [MSNBC](<http://www.msnbc.com/morning-joe/watch/president-trump-re-tweets-shocking-anti-muslim-videos-from-british-leader-1105877059637>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2017/11/29/trump-retweets-inflammatory-and-unverified-anti-muslim-videos/>).

### 2017-11-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1266066256](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20November%2030&oldid=1266066256>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-11-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 14 October 2017 Mogadishu bombings.

**Archived source account.** A Somali committee determined that the death toll of the twin bombing in Mogadishu last October is way higher than expected, rising up to 512. This makes the attack the third-deadliest terrorist attack worldwide.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-blast-toll/death-toll-from-somalia-truck-bomb-in-october-now-at-512-probe-committee-idUSKBN1DU2IC>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-11-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American producer Russell Simmons announces his resignation from his companies after a sexual assault allegation was made by screenwriter Jenny Lumet against him.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/music/2017/nov/30/russell-simmons-steps-down-from-companies-after-new-sex-assault-allegation>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-11-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Economy of South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The Bank of Korea raises interest rates for the first time in more than six years by lifting borrowing costs to 1.50 percent from 1.25, citing economic recovery.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.afp.com/en/news/205/s-korea-raises-interest-rate-first-time-six-years-doc-uq17z3>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-economy-rates/south-korea-raises-rates-for-first-time-in-six-years-flags-job-market-risks-idUSKBN1DT3DN>).

<a id="event-2017-11-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** The International Committee of the Red Cross is buying 750,000 liters of diesel fuel to help provide clean water for a million people living in Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42170809>).

<a id="event-2017-11-30-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A rare minor earthquake centered 7 mi northeast of Dover, Delaware, is felt throughout the Mid-Atlantic United States.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/51-magnitude-earthquake-detected-off-east-coast/story?id=51495824>).

<a id="event-2017-11-30-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** José Inés García Zarate, a suspect in a 2015 shooting in San Francisco, is acquitted of murder charges and found guilty of being a felon in possession of a firearm.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/jose-ines-garcia-zarate-san-francisco-pier-killing-suspect-found-n823351>).


## December

### 2017-12-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127424059](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%201&oldid=1127424059>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: 2017 Peshawar Agriculture Directorate attack.

**Archived source account.** Four attackers storm the Directorate of Agricultural Training Institute in Pakistan and exchange fire with police and army personnel. The four attackers are killed in the attack, and at least 12 people are killed and 35+ are injured. Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Arab News](<http://www.arabnews.com/node/1202191/world>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Economics of bitcoin.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission gives a go-ahead for Bitcoin futures to trade on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange and Chicago Board Options Exchange.

Source citations (as archived): [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2017/12/01/bitcoin-price-cme-cftc-futures>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2017-12-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Philippine dengue vaccination crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Department of Health temporarily suspends a school-based dengue vaccination program after Dengvaxia vaccine maker Sanofi Pasteur made a statement that its product poses higher risks to people without prior dengue infection.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/190056-doh-stops-dengue-vaccination-program-dengvaxia-sanofi>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://technology.inquirer.net/69907/pharma-firm-issues-caution-anti-dengue-vaccine-sanofi-dengvaxia-vaccine-health-dengue>).

<a id="event-2017-12-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Links between Trump associates and Russian officials.

**Archived source account.** Michael Flynn, former U.S. National Security Advisor to President Donald Trump, pleads guilty to one count of making a false statement to the FBI about his contacts with Russian officials. It is also announced that Flynn will cooperate with Robert Mueller's Special Counsel investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/12/01/us/politics/michael-flynn-guilty-russia-investigation.html>); [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/news/politics/michael-flynn-pleads-guilty-lying-fbi-russia-contacts-article-1.3670115>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 Honduran general election.

**Archived source account.** The government of Honduran President Juan Orlando Hernández, who is seeking re-election, imposes a ten-day curfew after allegations of electoral fraud and calls for an election recount resulted in violent protests across the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/honduras-announces-curfew-restrictions-amid-vote-protests-51528193>).

<a id="event-2017-12-01-4-3"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/11/30/asia/japan-emperor-akihito-abdication-intl/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-12-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 100-megawatt Tesla Powerpack system, which is the world's largest lithium-ion battery, is launched in Jamestown, South Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2017/dec/01/south-australia-turns-on-teslas-100mw-battery-history-in-the-making>).

<a id="event-2017-12-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Voyager program.

**Archived source account.** Voyager 1 successfully fires backup maneuvering thrusters, that had previously remained inactive for 37 years. Those thruster firings are to keep the spacecraft's antenna pointed at Earth, which is vital to maintain communications.

Source citations (as archived): [Ars Technica](<https://arstechnica.com/science/2017/12/after-37-years-voyager-has-fired-up-its-trajectory-thrusters/>).

**Archived source account.** Turkey's deputy foreign minister Bekir Bozdağ warns of a "major catastrophe" if the U.S. moves its embassy to Jerusalem as planned in the Jerusalem Embassy Act. The last six-month presidential waiver delaying the move was signed on June 1.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/arab-world-warns-us-not-to-recognize-jerusalem-as-israeli-capital/a-41631128>); [The Daily Mail](<http://www.dailymail.co.uk/wires/afp/article-5143479/Five-questions-potential-US-declaration-Jerusalem-Israels-capital.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-1-5"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis.

**Archived source account.** South Korea and the United States launch their largest-ever annual joint aerial drill.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/latest-news/n-korea-vows-retaliation-over-drills/news-story/ce6aa5e330c553c1e807d5f5665421db>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-1-6"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korea crisis.

**Archived source account.** A high-level United Nations delegation led by Department of Political Affairs head Jeffrey D. Feltman travels to North Korea for talks this week. It will be the first such diplomatic visit in six years.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/04/north-korea-un-jeffrey-feltman-visit>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-1-8"></a>

Context: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017.

**Archived source account.** France puts the concern on the E.U. Ecofin agenda that the current version of the United States fiscal act would unduly penalize E.U. companies by taxing their U.S. operations beyond locally produced value added.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Figaro](<http://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-eco/2017/12/04/97002-20171204FILWWW00138-la-france-veut-saisir-l-ue-du-projet-de-reforme-fiscale-us.php>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-1-10"></a>

Context: Executive Order 13769.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the United States rules that the act banning most people from eight countries, six of them Muslim-majority, to travel to the United States can take full effect pending legal challenges.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/national-news/articles/2017-12-04/supreme-court-allows-third-trump-travel-ban-into-effect>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The British government suspends payments to the so-called Free Syrian Police after a BBC Panorama investigation revealed that the cash has been diverted to the Salafist rebel groups of Nour al-Din al-Zenki and Jabhat al-Nusra, police officers being hand-picked by these groups, dead people appearing on the payroll and some police officers participating in summary executions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-42217132>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-2-3"></a>

Context: Murder of Daphne Caruana Galizia.

**Archived source account.** Malta arrests 10 people over the investigative journalist's murder on October 16.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/04/europe/daphne-caruana-galizia-arrests-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The prosecutor in a Brussels court repeats the demand to extradite Carles Puigdemont and four other former Catalan officials to Spain. The defense says that the adduced facts are "not punishable" under Belgian law. The judge delays the decision until December 14.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico.eu](<https://www.politico.eu/article/catalonia-independence-carles-puigdemont-decision-extradition-scheduled-for-december-14/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-2-6"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Spain grants six former Catalan officials bail of €100,000 each. Four other people, Oriol Junqueras, Joaquim Forn and two leading activists, remain in jail over the "risk of re-offending".

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-12-04/catalonia-s-former-vice-president-to-stay-in-jail-for-election>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-2-8"></a>

Context: Investigation of Apple's transfer pricing arrangements with Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc. and Ireland agree on an interim deal to put €13 billion in an escrow fund for the repayment of back taxes, starting early 2018. Still, both parties refute that the alleged "sweetheart" corporate tax deals were illegal. In 2016, the European Commission found that an unfair advantage of €13 billion is to be reimbursed.

Source citations (as archived): [Silicon Republic](<https://www.siliconrepublic.com/companies/apple-tax-ireland-escrow>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-04-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Eurogroup selects Mário Centeno, Portugal's Minister of Finance, to succeed Jeroen Dijsselbloem as their next president.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-eurogroup-president-mario-centeno-20171204-story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-3-2"></a>

Context: Federal lands in Utah.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs executive orders shrinking the Bears Ears National Monument area by 85% and the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument by half.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2017/12/04/trump-shrinks-utah-monuments-created-by-obama-clinton.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-04-3-4"></a>

Context: Roy Moore sexual abuse allegations.

**Archived source account.** Debbie Wesson Gibson, one of the women accusing Roy Moore of sexual misconduct, shares evidence of their relationship when she was 17 to the press.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/woman-shares-new-evidence-of-relationship-with-roy-moore-when-she-was-17/2017/12/04/0c3d1cde-d903-11e7-a841-2066faf731ef_story.html?utm_term=.b5256e735ed8>).

### 2017-12-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091450491](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%205&oldid=1091450491>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-12-05-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The last King of Romania, Michael I, dies at the age of 96.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42234880>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-romania-king/romanias-former-king-michael-dies-in-switzerland-at-age-of-96-idUSKBN1DZ1JC>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A summer 1941 Simon Templar (The Saint) novel by Leslie Charteris, titled The Saint's Second Front, describing a military attack by Japan on America—and subsequently rejected from publication for political reasons—emerges at a private auction after the work was presumed lost.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sun](<https://www.thesun.co.uk/news/5073032/brit-book-which-predicted-the-attack-on-pearl-harbour-rediscovered-75-years-after-it-was-barred-from-publication/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eurofighter GmbH offers Belgium a national cyber defense network—suggesting telecommunications security on par with United Kingdom intelligence, which would save Belgium €1.6 billion per year—in exchange for buying 34 of their multirole combat aircraft, the Eurofighter Typhoon.

Source citations (as archived): [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/binnenland/eurofighter-biedt-cyberbeveiliging-voor-telecom-in-ons-land-als-belgie-voor-zijn-straaljagers-kiest~a2decffc/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-05-2-2"></a>

Context: 2017 California wildfires / Thomas Fire.

**Archived source account.** Due to persistent high winds, a fire begins and quickly spreads—at a rate of up to one acre per second—near Santa Paula, California, covering now at least 50,000 acres, crawling into the edges of Ventura and cutting power to 260,000 homes. 7,700 houses are under mandatory evacuation.

Source citations (as archived): [LA Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-school-fire-20171204-story.html>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/05/us/ventura-county-fire-california/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-2-4"></a>

Context: Cyclone Ockhi.

**Archived source account.** Gujarat and Maharastra are on high alert because of Cyclone Ockhi.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/mumbai/cyclone-ockhi-rain-hits-mumbai/liveblog/61918257.cms>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-2-6"></a>

Context: Meerbusch train crash.

**Archived source account.** A passenger train runs into the rear of a freight train at Meerbusch, Germany. Forty-seven people are injured, three seriously.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42246087>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Positions on Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan tells Donald Trump that Turkey might cut ties with Israel if the United States unilaterally recognizes Jerusalem as its capital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42232158>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-3-2"></a>

Context: Positions on Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** According to a Palestinian spokesman, Donald Trump calls Mahmoud Abbas, "outlining his intentions" to move the U.S. embassy to Jerusalem. The Palestinian President warns him against the dangers of such a step and says that he will continue reaching out to world leaders to prevent it from happening.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/05/politics/trump-abbas-us-embassy-jerusalem/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-3-4"></a>

Context: Gulf Cooperation Council, Qatar–Saudi Arabia proxy conflict.

**Archived source account.** At a GCC summit in Kuwait City, the United Arab Emirates announce a political and military alliance with Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/05/uae-saudi-arabia-alliance-gulf-relations-gcc>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-3-6"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Russia names Voice of America, Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty and seven affiliated news media as foreign agents. The move comes after the United States government ordered the Russian government-funded television network RT America to register as a foreign agent.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/russia-names-9-media-organizations-as-foreign-agents-including-voice-of-america/2017/12/05/7aac7eb4-d98d-11e7-a841-2066faf731ef_story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** As police arrive at the stateless Mikheil Saakashvili's house in Kiev to detain him, Saakashvili goes up on the roof to protest verbally. Police then detain him and try to take him away in a blue minivan while hundreds of people block the street. Finally the supporters free him out of the van. Bespeeching the cameras again, he rails against corruption, against Petro Poroshenko and urges Ukrainians to "be afraid of nothing".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/05/former-georgian-president-mikheil-saakashvili-is-detained-in-ukraine>); [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2017-12-05/former-georgian-president-saakashvili-detained-in-kiev>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-saakashvili/saakashvili-supporters-free-him-from-police-van-after-detention-in-kiev-idUSKBN1DZ0VU>); [Interfax Ukraine](<http://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/467179.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-4-2"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Prosecutor General of Ukraine Yuriy Lutsenko claims in a briefing that Saakashvili received $500,000 from the fugitive Serhiy Kurchenko for his activities in Ukraine. He also says Severion Dangadze, an associate of Saakashvili's Movement of New Forces, had been arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Interfax Ukraine](<http://en.interfax.com.ua/news/general/467130.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-4-4"></a>

Context: 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spain withdraws the international arrest warrant for five former Catalan officials now residing in Belgium. The charges of sedition and rebellion, however, remain.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42237377>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-4-6"></a>

Context: Recognition of same-sex unions in Austria.

**Archived source account.** Austria's Constitutional Court rules that the government cannot discriminate against same-sex couples' right to marry.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/12/05/world/europe/austria-gay-marriage.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-05-5-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Honduran general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** After several days of violent protests due to allegations of electoral fraud, Honduran police have announced that they will not enforce a government-mandated curfew.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/04/honduras-election-board-refrains-from-declaring-winner-as-violence-continues>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-5-3"></a>

Context: 2017 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Representative John Conyers (D-Mich.) steps down amid allegations of sexual harassment.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2017/12/05/567160325/conyers-resigning-amid-sexual-harassment-allegations>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-12-05-6-1"></a>

Context: Reinforcement learning.

**Archived source account.** In just a few hours, DeepMind's AI AlphaZero learn to master both chess and shogi, beating top chess software Stockfish and Elmo without domain knowledge.

Source citations (as archived): [Critical Hit](<http://www.criticalhit.net/gaming/deepminds-ai-teaches-play-chess-four-hours-beats-top-chess-software/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-05-7-1"></a>

Context: Sri Lankan cricket team in India in 2017–18, Smog in Delhi.

**Archived source account.** Sri Lankan fast bowler Suranga Lakmal vomits and is taken off the field while levels of harmful pollutants exceed World Health Organization safe limits 12 times. Later in the game Indian pacer Mohammed Shami also vomits. December 3 already saw the first forced break in play in international cricket history.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/05/sri-lankan-bowler-suranga-lakmal-vomits-in-delhi-cricket-match-polluted-air>).

<a id="event-2017-12-05-7-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Winter Olympics, Doping in Russia.

**Archived source account.** A 14-person International Olympic Committee panel bans Russia from the Winter Olympics in PyeongChang, South Korea, after a report finds evidence of systemic doping cheating in the 2014 Winter Olympics. Any "clean" Russian athletes will compete under the name "Olympic Athletes from Russia" (OAR) and the Olympic flag.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! Sports](<https://sports.yahoo.com/russia-banned-2018-winter-olympics-pyeongchang-183735604.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** UNICEF reports that as many as 17 million babies worldwide face potential brain development issues due to their exposure to toxicity levels more than six times higher than considered safe in air.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-1"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump recognizes Jerusalem as the capital of Israel and says the U.S. starts the process of moving its embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. The United States Department of State issues an internal travel warning to Israel, Jerusalem and the West Bank until December 20. The U.S. embassy in Amman temporarily suspends routine public services and stops embassy travel around Jordan. Embassies in Berlin and London issue vigilance warnings to U.S. citizens.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/06/politics/president-donald-trump-jerusalem/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel-cable/u-s-asks-officials-to-defer-travel-to-israel-west-bank-to-december-20-idUSKBN1E02HU>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-middle-east-42255592>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-2"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu praises the announcement as a "historic landmark."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42246564>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-3"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** President of the State of Palestine Mahmoud Abbas says the move undermines the U.S. position as a peace mediator while the Palestinian Islamist group Hamas says that the decision would "open the gates of hell on U.S. interests in the region."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42250340>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-4"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** The Arab League calls it "a dangerous measure that would have repercussions" and also questions the future role of the U.S. as a "trusted mediator" in peace talks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42250340>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-5"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Protests against the decision break out in Jordan, State of Palestine, and Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42259443>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel/trump-recognizes-jerusalem-as-israels-capital-defying-allies-and-foes-idUSKBN1E01PS>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-6"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** The decision draws critical reaction from key U.S. allies that include the EU, France, Germany and the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-jerusalem-israel-capital-declaration-20171206-story.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42250340>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-7"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis urges respect for the status quo for Jerusalem and calls for "wisdom and prudence" to avoid further conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pope-francis-urges-status-quo-jerusalem-calls-wisdom-51608418>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-8"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Secretary-General of the United Nations António Guterres criticizes the announcement, saying that it "would jeopardise the prospect of peace for Israelis and Palestinians".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42259443>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-9"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Eight of the 15 current United Nations Security Council members call to hold an urgent meeting on the U.S. decision. The meeting is expected for December 8.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42259443>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/07/jerusalem-un-security-council-us-recognition-jerusalem-donald-trump-israel-capital>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-11"></a>

Context: Suspected sonic attack on the United States Embassy in Havana.

**Archived source account.** Investigators discover brain abnormalities in the victims. They are now carefully not using the term "sonic" to describe the attacks and there is growing skepticism it was caused by a sonic device, with the sound heard by victims being a by-product of the brain damage. The white matter of the brains showed changes which doctors believe could not be caused by sound.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/doctors-identify-brain-abnormalities-cuba-attack-patients-110255428--politics.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-3-13"></a>

Context: Sanctions against North Korea.

**Archived source account.** An Institute for Science and International Security study indicates that (between March 2014 and September 2017) a total of 49 countries violated United Nations sanctions against North Korea to varying degrees.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/12/06/news/north-korea-sanctions-countries-violation/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Government Accountability Office starts a study into the (currently unregulated) length of freight trains.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-train-safety/growing-length-of-u-s-freight-trains-in-federal-crosshairs-after-crashes-gao-idUSKBN1E01B9>).

<a id="event-2017-12-06-6-2"></a>

Context: ULAS J1342+0928.

**Archived source account.** A study published in Nature and the Astrophysical Journal Letters describes the discovery of the most distant supermassive black hole ever, around 13.1 billion light years away.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2017/12/6/16738652/quasar-supermassive-black-hole-early-universe-big-bang>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-06-7-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 UEFA Champions League.

**Archived source account.** In football, Cristiano Ronaldo becomes the shared all-time top scorer in the UEFA Champions League group stage and he is the first person to score in all six group stage matches, by adding to Real Madrid C.F.'s 3–2 win against Borussia Dortmund. With a 7–0 victory over FC Spartak Moscow, Liverpool F.C. is the fifth English club to qualify for the knockout phase; a first too.

Source citations (as archived): [De Standaard](<http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20171206_03229576>); [Gazet van Antwerpen](<http://www.gva.be/cnt/dmf20171206_03229149/champions-league-liverpool-swingt-naar-groepswinst-en-record-ronaldo-pakt-record-en-zege-met-real>).

### 2017-12-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1218716410](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%207&oldid=1218716410>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Positions on Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** The Czech Republic recognizes West Jerusalem as Israel's capital "in practice".

Source citations (as archived): [Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs](<http://www.mzv.cz/jnp/en/issues_and_press/mfa_statements/x2017_12_06_mfa_statement_jerusalem.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-0-2"></a>

Context: Positions on Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte expresses interest in moving his country's embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/1.827208>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-0-4"></a>

Context: Greek–Turkish relations.

**Archived source account.** The President of Turkey embarks on a two-day state visit of Greece. Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's démarche is a first in 65 years.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/07/turkish-president-erdogan-to-make-landmark-visit-to-greece>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-turkey-erdogan-treaty/greek-president-tells-turkeys-erdogan-no-treaty-revision-idUSKBN1E1186>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-0-6"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis, Treaty on European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission orders Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary to court over their refusal to incorporate more refugees. This is the third step in a process that may lead to fines and loss of the countries' voting rights in the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [De Standaard](<http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20171207_03230108>); [Die Zeit](<http://www.zeit.de/politik/ausland/2017-12/eu-kommission-verklagt-ungarn-tschechien-und-polen>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-0-8"></a>

Context: Economic globalization.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen countries ask the World Trade Organization a mandate to negotiate binding rules on e-commerce, days after India turned down negotiations.

Source citations (as archived): [Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/foreign-trade/pressure-on-india-as-15-countries-seek-e-commerce-talks-at-wto/articleshow/61972141.cms>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-07-1-1"></a>

Context: Same-sex marriage in Australia.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Australia votes to make same-sex marriage legal in Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<http://www.theaustralian.com.au/national-affairs/politicsnow-ssm-bill-decided-today-citizenship-saga-continues/news-story/642ba787fcb52a24f08d61be8ac650d7>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-1-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Aztec High School shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three people, including the gunman, are killed in a school shooting at Aztec High School in New Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [MSN](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/crime/sheriff-3-dead-in-new-mexico-school-shooting/ar-BBGmBdU?&amp;ocid=ientp>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-1-5"></a>

Context: 2016–17 purges in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Peoples’ Democratic Party’s co-chair Selahattin Demirtaş remains behind bars until the next hearing, scheduled for February 14, 2018. He risks 142 years in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [Turkey Purge](<https://turkeypurge.com/court-rules-keep-pro-kurdish-opposition-leader-selahattin-demirtas-behind-bars>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-1-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the AMIA bombing.

**Archived source account.** In a 491-page ruling, a court indicts former President of Argentina Cristina Fernández for treason and orders for her arrest for "trying to cover up Iran's possible role in the 1994 bombing of a Jewish community center that killed 85 people". Former foreign affairs minister Héctor Timerman is also concerned. Both have previously denied wrongdoing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-argentina-fernandez/argentinas-fernandez-charged-with-treason-judge-orders-arrest-idUSKBN1E11Q4>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-07-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** United States Senator Al Franken announces that he will resign "in the coming weeks" amid sexual harassment allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/5053057/al-franken-resigns-senate-seat-minnesota/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-2-2"></a>

Context: 2017 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** Arizona Congressman Trent Franks announces that he will resign on January 31, 2018. This announcement comes after two of his employees filed a complaint about his conduct, and the House Ethics Committee opened a sexual harassment investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2017/12/07/rep-trent-franks-r-ariz-expected-to-resign.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-2-4"></a>

Context: Nepalese legislative election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Nepal go to the polls for the second round of a historic legislative election. The turnout is 67%, up from 65% in the first round.

Source citations (as archived): [Foreign Affairs](<https://www.foreignaffairs.com/articles/nepal/2017-12-07/election-nepal-decades-making>); [Economic Times](<https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/international/world-news/nepal-clocks-67-voter-turnout-in-final-phase-of-historic-poll/articleshow/61970116.cms>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-2-6"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Germany.

**Archived source account.** The Social Democratic Party congress votes to start talks on "whether and in what form" to support a new federal government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/the-latest-german-social-democrats-back-talks-on-government/2017/12/07/54ec7fa6-db79-11e7-a241-0848315642d0_story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-07-2-8"></a>

Context: Politics of Poland.

**Archived source account.** Polish Prime Minister Beata Szydło resigns just hours after surviving an opposition no-confidence motion. She will be replaced by Finance Minister Mateusz Morawiecki, according to the ruling Law and Justice party.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42272808>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-07-3-1"></a>

Context: UEFA Euro 2020.

**Archived source account.** Eurostadium in Brussels, Belgium, is unselected as a host for the UEFA Euro 2020 football competition, ceding its place for group stage matches to Wembley Stadium in London, England. Prime Minister of Belgium Charles Michel says the city made the error of wanting to build a stadium outside its territory.

Source citations (as archived): [voetbalnieuws.be](<http://www.voetbalnieuws.be/news/268000/kogel-door-de-kerk-uefa-heeft-beslist-over-eurostadion>); [VRT](<https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/nl/2017/12/07/reynders-over-eurostadion---begrijp-niet-waarom-brussels-gewest-/>).

### 2017-12-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031217](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%208&oldid=1256031217>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-08-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian jets carry out airstrikes in a village in the northwestern Idlib Governorate, where a de-escalation zone exists, killing at least five civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [World Bulletin](<http://www.worldbulletin.net/middle-east/196699/russian-airstrikes-kill-5-civilians-in-syria>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-0-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Semuliki attack.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Allied Democratic Forces militants in North Kivu, DR Congo, kill at least 15 United Nations peacekeepers, mostly Tanzanian, and five Congolese soldiers, and wound 53 other people. An unknown number of the rebels are killed. Over 90 peacekeepers have been killed since the mission started in 1999.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/08/peacekeepers-killed-in-attack-on-un-base-in-dr-congo>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-08-1-1"></a>

Context: Japan–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union and Japan announce that they concluded negotiations on a trade deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-eu-trade/eu-japan-conclude-worlds-largest-free-trade-agreement-idUSKBN1E21BT>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-08-2-1"></a>

Context: December 2017 Southern California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump approves California's request for an emergency declaration, allowing the Federal Emergency Management Agency to coordinate disaster relief efforts across five Southern California counties.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/california/la-me-southern-california-wildfires-live-trump-approves-california-s-emergency-1512750251-htmlstory.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-08-3-1"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Russia's Minister of Foreign Affairs Sergei Lavrov says that the recognition of Jerusalem as Israel's capital by the United States "runs counter to common sense."

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-russia-jerusalem/russias-lavrov-u-s-decision-on-jerusalem-contradicts-common-sense-idUSKBN1E21EH>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-3-2"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Clashes erupt in Bethlehem and Hebron. Dozens of people throw stones at Israel Defense Forces who reply with tear gas and water cannon. More than 200 people are wounded. One person was killed. The Health Minister of the Palestinian National Authority named the man killed on the Gaza Strip border.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42278644>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel/palestinians-muslims-worldwide-hold-day-of-rage-over-jerusalem-idUSKBN1E211I>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-3-3"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Demonstrators across the Arab and Muslim worlds take to the streets on Friday, holy day, expressing solidarity with the Palestinians and outrage at the U.S. move.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel/palestinians-muslims-worldwide-hold-day-of-rage-over-jerusalem-idUSKBN1E211I>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-3-4"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** 14 of the 15 United Nations Security Council members denounce the United States' stance on Jerusalem.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/fourteen-of-15-security-council-members-denounce-u-s-stance-on-jerusalem-1512777971>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-3-6"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union and the United Kingdom reach agreement on the first stage of Brexit including the status of the border between the U.K. and Ireland.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/08/europe/brexit-theresa-may-britain/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-3-8"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korean crisis, Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The Japanese Minister of Defense says that his country is to procure medium-range missiles. This purchase is controversial for a country that renounced the right to wage war.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-japan/japan-to-acquire-air-launched-missiles-able-to-strike-north-korea-idUSKBN1E20YR>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-3-10"></a>

Context: Treaty on European Union, Politics of Poland.

**Archived source account.** Poland's Sejm approves controversial judiciary changes amid accusations of threat to democracy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/08/polish-mps-pass-supreme-court-bill-criticised-as-grave-threat>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-08-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Japan.

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed in a rampage involving swords near the Tomioka Hachiman Shrine in Japan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2017/12/08/national/crime-legal/man-apparently-fatally-stabs-two-women-tokyo-shrine-kills/>); [The Asahi Shimbun](<http://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/AJ201712080036.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** Trent Franks, a United States representative for Arizona's 8th congressional district, announces his immediate resignation, following allegations that he asked a female staffer to be a surrogate mother for him. Franks previously announced that he would resign from Congress in January 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [KSAZ-TV](<http://www.fox10phoenix.com/news/arizona-news/ap-rep-trent-franks-is-resigning-from-congress>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-5-3"></a>

Context: 2018 United States federal budget.

**Archived source account.** Trump signs a continuing resolution to prevent a government shutdown for another two weeks. Congress has until December 22 to hash out differences over funding DACA, CHIP, tax reform, and military funding within the limits of the Budget Control Act of 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2017/12/08/president-trump-signs-short-term-spending-bill-to-keep-government-running-through-dec-22.html>); [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/politics/articles/2017-12-07/house-senate-pass-continuing-resolution-to-fund-government-through-dec-22>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-5-5"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The White House announces that Deputy National Security Advisor Dina Powell will leave the Trump administration early 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/363970-wapo-dina-powell-leaving-white-house>).

<a id="event-2017-12-08-5-7"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Mikheil Saakashvili is arrested again by the National Police of Ukraine. He was on the run since December 5. He has been leading anti-corruption rallies against Petro Poroshenko.

Source citations (as archived): [RTL Nieuws](<https://www.rtlnieuws.nl/buitenland/michail-saakasjvili-nu-wel-opgepakt-door-oekraiense-geheime-dienst>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42289481>).

### 2017-12-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031235](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%209&oldid=1256031235>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-09-0-1"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of people protest on the West Bank and in Gaza for the third day in a row.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42294409>).

<a id="event-2017-12-09-0-3"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017), American-led intervention in Iraq (2014–present), Iraq–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Iraq announces that its war against Islamic State (IS) is over. The United States Department of State welcomes the end of the "vile occupation" and says that the fight continues.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42291985>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-12-09-1-1"></a>

Context: Egyptology.

**Archived source account.** Archaeologists in Egypt display items, including figurines, masks and a mummy, from one of two previously unexplored tombs, Kampp 150 and Kampp 161, in the ancient Nile city of Luxor.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42295162>); [National Geographic](<https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2017/12/egypt-tomb-mummy-naga-archaeology-ancient/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-09-1-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times reports that Donald Trump spends at least four hours a day watching the news on television. He watches CNN, Fox News and MSNBC.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/364094-trump-watches-at-least-four-hours-of-tv-per-day-report>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-09-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The 1.6-hectare populated hamlet of Alwine in Uebigau-Wahrenbrück district, Germany, is sold for 140,000 € at a public auction.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.nation.co.ke/news/world/German-village-Alwine-sold-Sh16m/1068-4221622-vknt4e/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-09-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017 MLS Cup.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Toronto win their first MLS Cup defeating the Seattle Sounders 2–0 in the final, becoming the first MLS team to complete the domestic treble.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://au.sports.yahoo.com/league/a/38226450/altidore-vazquez-seal-mls-cup-for-toronto/>).

### 2017-12-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087130301](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2010&oldid=1087130301>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** A 24-year-old Palestinian stabs and seriously wounds an Israeli security guard at Jerusalem's Central Bus Station. The attacker is arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel/palestinian-stabs-israeli-in-jerusalem-anti-trump-protest-flares-in-beirut-idUSKBN1E40FQ>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/israeli-police-security-guard-seriously-wounded-in-stabbing-at-jerusalems-central-bus-station/2017/12/10/379b5094-dda9-11e7-b2e9-8c636f076c76_story.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/israel-jerusalem-bus-station-security-guard-stabbing-police-palestinians-us-embassy-donald-trump-a8102096.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-12-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War.

**Archived source account.** An Iraqi military parade in Baghdad celebrates final victory over the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant. Prime Minister Haider al-Abadi declares December 10 an annual national holiday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-iraq-parade/iraq-holds-victory-parade-after-defeating-islamic-state-idUSKBN1E407Z>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-10-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** New evacuations are ordered as the fires spread toward a string of California coastal cities. Santa Ana winds and rugged mountain terrain continue to hamper firefighting efforts. Authorities report the Thomas Fire is only 15 percent contained.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-thomas-fire-santa-barbara-fire-20171210-story.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-wildfires/california-wildfire-rages-toward-scenic-coastal-communities-idUSKBN1E40CE>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Iran.

**Archived source account.** The spying charge death sentence against Vrije Universiteit Brussel guest-lecturer Ahmadreza Djalali is now executable, since his Iranian lawyer did not appeal the verdict and sentence within the required three-week limit.

Source citations (as archived): [De Standaard](<https://translate.google.com/translate?sl=nl&amp;tl=en&amp;js=y&amp;prev=_t&amp;hl=en&amp;ie=UTF-8&amp;u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.standaard.be%2Fcnt%2Fdmf20171210_03234786&amp;edit-text=>); [VRT](<https://www.microsofttranslator.com/bv.aspx?from=&amp;to=en&amp;a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.vrt.be%2Fvrtnws%2Fnl%2F2017%2F12%2F10%2Flot-van-iraanse-vub-gastdocent-lijkt-bezegeld%2F>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-10-4-1"></a>

Context: Venezuelan presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, who is up for re-election, bans the main opposition parties, Justice First, Democratic Action and Popular Will from running in next year's presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-42304594>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-12-10-5-1"></a>

Context: Severe acute respiratory syndrome.

**Archived source account.** Scientists at the Wuhan Institute of Virology trace the source of the deadly 2002–04 SARS virus outbreak, which killed 774 people in 37 countries, to a colony of cave-dwelling horseshoe bats in China's Yunnan province.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/10/sars-virus-bats-china-severe-acute-respiratory-syndrome>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-10-6-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Premier League.

**Archived source account.** Manchester City beat local rivals Manchester United 2–1 at Old Trafford to set a new record for successive victories in English top-flight games, breaking the record of 13 successive league wins in a single season set by Chelsea, Arsenal, Preston North End and Sunderland.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<http://metro.co.uk/2017/12/10/manchester-city-break-chelsea-arsenal-record-victory-manchester-united-7148001/>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/42212593>).

### 2017-12-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031261](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2011&oldid=1256031261>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: 2017 New York City Subway bombing.

<a id="event-2017-12-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** A £6 billion ($8 billion) deal to sell 24 Eurofighter Typhoons to Qatar is announced.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-42302767>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-11-3-1"></a>

Context: December 2017 Southern California wildfires.
