#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Transgender personnel in the United States military.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District Judge Colleen Kollar-Kotelly denies a Trump administration request to enforce the ban on transgender troops while this case is under appeal, thereby reaffirming her order that requires the U.S. military to accept transgender recruits effective January 1, 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-military-transgender/u-s-military-must-accept-transgender-recruits-by-jan-1-judge-rules-idUSKBN1E52C9>).

<a id="event-2017-12-11-4-3"></a>

Context: 2016 Turkish coup d'état attempt and following purges in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkey's state news agency announces that prosecutors in Istanbul have requested life sentences against six people, including journalist brothers Ahmet and Mehmet Altan and chronicler Nazli Ilicak. One of the accusations is reportedly "having committed a crime in the name of a terror organization without being a member of it."

Source citations (as archived): [Yenisafak](<http://www.yenisafak.com/en/news/life-sentences-sought-for-feto-terror-suspects-2880354>); [RTBF](<https://www.rtbf.be/info/monde/detail_putsch-manque-en-turquie-prison-a-vie-requise-pour-des-journalistes?id=9786493>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Hezbollah political activities.

**Archived source account.** Hassan Nasrallah, the Secretary-General of Hezbollah, vows to return to Israel. Tens of thousands of people demonstrate in South Beirut.

Source citations (as archived): [VRT](<https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/nl/2017/12/11/hezbollah-leider-belooft-focus-terug-op-israel-te-richten/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-11-5-3"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian opposition leader Mikheil Saakashvili is freed from detention following Judge Larysa Tsokol's dismissal of prosecutors’ house arrest request.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-saakashvili-court/ukrainian-judge-frees-saakashvili-from-detention-idUSKBN1E52BM>).

<a id="event-2017-12-11-5-5"></a>

Context: Politics of India.

**Archived source account.** Rahul Gandhi is elected unopposed as the head of the opposition Congress Party. On 16 January 2018, he is to take over the reins from his mother Sonia Gandhi, who held the position for 19 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/12/rahul-gandhi-rise-gandhi-family-scion-171211112550054.html>); [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/rahul-gandhi-elected-congress-president-unopposed/articleshow/62021172.cms>).

<a id="event-2017-12-11-5-7"></a>

Context: Politics of France.

**Archived source account.** Corsican nationalists demand talks with the French government after a convincing win in the second round of elections for a reformed regional government in Corsica.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/11/macron-corsica-dilemma-nationalists-election-gains-france>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-12-11-6-1"></a>

Context: British Antarctic Territory.

**Archived source account.** Mount Hope, in a disputed region of Antarctica, is found to be the highest mountain in territory claimed by the United Kingdom. Ben Nevis in Scotland is the highest mountain in the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-42238262>).

<a id="event-2017-12-11-6-3"></a>

Context: Space policy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs the "Space Policy Directive 1" that establishes the foundation for a crewed mission to the Moon, while also maintaining a longer-term NASA goal of landing a man on Mars.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-space/trump-wants-to-send-u-s-astronauts-back-to-moon-someday-mars-idUSKBN1E51QP>).

<a id="event-2017-12-11-6-5"></a>

Context: Male homosexuality.

**Archived source account.** The Y-linked protein NLGN4Y transfer from an older brother to a younger by transfer through the mother's womb, the mother's bloodstream, and her created antibodies reaching her next male fetus' brain, together appear to influence the gayness of the next brother.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/11/health/men-older-brothers-gay-study/index.html>); [PNAS](<http://www.pnas.org/content/early/2017/12/05/1705895114>).

### 2017-12-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091451034](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2012&oldid=1091451034>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-12-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Unibail-Rodamco agrees to purchase shopping mall owner Westfield Corporation for $15.7 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/westfield-sells-itself-for-157-billion-2017-12>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion and fire at the Gas Connect Austria pipeline hub in Baumgarten an der March kills one person and injures 21. Service to Hungary, Slovenia, Croatia and Italy is suspended. Italy declares a state of emergency.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-austria-blast/deadly-blast-at-austrian-pipeline-hub-slashes-gas-flow-to-italy-idUSKBN1E614W>); [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/italy-declares-state-of-emergency-following-deadly-explosion-at-austrian-pipeline/a-41752272>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Peru.

**Archived source account.** A 22-year-old student is found dead inside the National University of San Marcos, of Lima, and the most important and oldest of Peru. Everything seems to indicate that he had been killed. Authorities have identified a possible suspect, who is also a student at the university.

Source citations (as archived): [La República](<http://larepublica.pe/sociedad/1157268-hallan-muerto-a-estudiante-en-san-marcos>); [ATV](<http://www.atv.pe/actualidad/asesino-de-erik-arena-sierra-estaria-identificado-344211>); [América Televisión](<http://www.americatv.com.pe/noticias/actualidad/san-marcos-estudiante-hallado-muerto-pertenecia-al-tercio-superior-n302991>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2017-12-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Regulation of chemicals.

**Archived source account.** Reacting to a petition from more than a million EU citizens, the European Commission releases a 16-page report on glyphosate. It adopts a renewal of the approval of glyphosate for a 5-year period and plans to improve the science reviewing process.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.lefigaro.fr/flash-eco/2017/12/12/97002-20171212FILWWW00205-la-commission-officialise-le-renouvellement-du-glyphosate.php>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian opposition urges Russian president Vladimir Putin to put pressure on Syrian president Bashar al-Assad in order to "rescue" the Geneva peace talks and begin face-to-face bilateral talks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/12/syrian-opposition-urges-russia-to-rescue-un-peace-talks>).

<a id="event-2017-12-12-4-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Rwanda, Foreign relations of France.

**Archived source account.** Rwanda steps up pressure on France to admit alleged complicity in the 1994 genocide by publishing a report by law firm Cunningham Levy Muse.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/ffcbc7ea-df59-11e7-a8a4-0a1e63a52f9c>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-12-5-1"></a>

Context: Government of San Francisco.

**Archived source account.** Mayor of San Francisco Ed Lee dies of an apparent heart attack. Supervisor London Breed becomes acting Mayor.

Source citations (as archived): [SFGate](<http://www.sfgate.com/politics/article/Supervisor-London-Breed-becomes-SF-mayor-upon-Ed-12423909.php>).

<a id="event-2017-12-12-5-3"></a>

Context: United States Senate special election in Alabama, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Alabama go to the polls to fill the United States Senate seat vacated by current United States Attorney General Jeff Sessions. The race is between Roy Moore (R) and Doug Jones (D).

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/12/politics/alabama-senate-race/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-12-5-4"></a>

Context: United States Senate special election in Alabama, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The Associated Press declares Doug Jones the winner.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.nytimes.com/elections/results/alabama-senate-special-election-roy-moore-doug-jones>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-12-12-6-1"></a>

Context: Climate change in the Arctic.

**Archived source account.** This year's Arctic Report Card reveals that the plunge in sea ice extent as well as the amount of ocean surface warming is unprecedented in at least the last 1,500 years.

Source citations (as archived): [Mashable](<http://mashable.com/2017/12/12/arctic-ice-melt-warming-unprecedented-1500-years-report-card/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-12-7-1"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Marshall Faulk, Ike Taylor, and Heath Evans are suspended from the NFL Network due to allegations of sexual harassment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/early-lead/wp/2017/12/12/nfl-network-suspends-marshall-faulk-ike-taylor-heath-evans-over-sexual-harassment-claims/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-12-7-3"></a>

Context: 2017 EAFF E-1 Football Championship.

**Archived source account.** South Korea beats North Korea 1–0 in Tokyo. The Japanese authorities gave the North Korean players a special visa to enable their participation in the event that was formerly known as the East Asian Cup.

Source citations (as archived): [Sporza](<http://sporza.be/cm/sporza/voetbal/buitenland/1.3113172>).

### 2017-12-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1245753782](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2013&oldid=1245753782>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** At least 30 people are reported to have been killed in Saudi-led coalition air strikes on a rebel military police camp in Yemen's capital, Sanaa.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42338359>).

<a id="event-2017-12-13-0-3"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Militant Palestinians fire rockets towards Israel from the Gaza Strip. The Israel Defense Forces say that the Iron Dome system intercepted two missiles, while one rocket fell in a flat open area and nobody was hurt.

Source citations (as archived): [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/israel-palestina/militante-palestijnen-vuren-opnieuw-raketten-op-israel-af~a473f9e9/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-13-0-4"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The leader of Hamas, Ismail Haniyeh, calls for a new revolt or intifada.

Source citations (as archived): [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/israel-palestina/militante-palestijnen-vuren-opnieuw-raketten-op-israel-af~a473f9e9/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-12-13-1-1"></a>

Context: Rohingya persecution in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Dublin City Councillors vote 59–2 to revoke the Freedom of the City of Dublin given to Myanmar's Aung San Suu Kyi for her apparent failure to protect the Rohingya minority from violence. Singer Bob Geldof returned his Freedom one month ago, protesting that Suu Kyi also held the honour.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/14/aung-san-suu-kyi-has-freedom-of-dublin-award-revoked>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/nov/13/bob-geldof-renounces-honour-also-held-by-aung-san-suu-kyi>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Marine Corps Air Station Futenma.

**Archived source account.** A 17-pound (8 kg) CH-53E transport helicopter window lands on school grounds in Okinawa, Japan, marking the second time in less than a week that an American aircraft part has fallen on a school there. Today, a child sustains "minor injuries". The United States Marine Corps apologizes.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/International/marine-corps-apologizes-aircraft-part-falls-2nd-japanese/story?id=51760688>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Proclamation No. 216.

**Archived source account.** The Congress of the Philippines votes to approve President Rodrigo Duterte's request to extend the declaration of martial law in Mindanao until December 31, 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.afp.com/en/news/23/philippines-duterte-wins-extra-year-martial-law-powers-doc-v43kn3>).

<a id="event-2017-12-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** Ecuadorian Vice President Jorge Glas is sentenced to six years imprisonment for financial corruption involving the Brazilian construction company Odebrecht. The decision will not be enforced until the court confirms the ruling. The court's decision can be appealed. \{\{in lang\|es\}\}

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-42346881>); [El Universo](<https://www.eluniverso.com/noticias/2017/12/13/nota/6525058/jorge-glas-sentenciado-como-culpable-6-anos-prision-caso-odebrecht>).

<a id="event-2017-12-13-3-5"></a>

Context: Rohingya insurgency in Western Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Two Reuters journalists are arrested in Myanmar for trying to illegally obtain official documents. They were reporting about the Rohingya Muslim community in Rakhine State.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/12/13/world/asia/myanmar-rakhine-reporters.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Minnesota Governor Mark Dayton announces the appointment of Lt. Gov. Tina Smith to replace resigning Sen. Al Franken in the United States Senate.

Source citations (as archived): [St. Paul Pioneer Press](<http://www.twincities.com/2017/12/13/full-text-of-minn-gov-mark-dayton-naming-tina-smith-to-replace-al-franken/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-13-4-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Theresa May suffers a 309–305 defeat, her first, in the House of Commons when MPs from both major parties approve an amendment to the Brexit bill subjecting a Brexit agreement to a preliminary vote by Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2017/dec/13/tory-brexit-rebels-inflict-major-defeat-on-theresa-may>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-42346192>).

<a id="event-2017-12-13-4-5"></a>

Context: 2017 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** Kentucky state legislator Dan Johnson, who had been accused of sexual assault of a teenager, dies of a gunshot wound, an apparent suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/6e4609918fea4cef81b1052540e346d7/Ky.-lawmaker-accused-of-assault-dies-in-apparent-suicide>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Road cycling.

**Archived source account.** \{\{UCI team code\|SKY\|2017\}\} professional cyclist Chris Froome returns a non-negative result for asthma medication salbutamol, during the Vuelta a España in September.

Source citations (as archived): [Cyclingnews.com](<http://www.cyclingnews.com/news/chris-froome-returns-adverse-analytical-finding-for-salbutamol/>).

### 2017-12-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1260735513](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2014&oldid=1260735513>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Internal armed conflict in Colombia, Paramilitarism in Colombia, Illegal drug trade in Colombia.

**Archived source account.** Colombia's biggest narcotics gang, Clan del Golfo (AGC), declares a cease-fire in effect since December 13. They say the gesture is meant "to contribute to a full, total and lasting peace." The Colombian government says that it welcomes the move but also that it will continue their pressure on the organization.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA Network](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/world/636617/colombia-s-biggest-drug-gang-announces-ceasefire/story/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-14-1-1"></a>

Context: Proposed acquisition of 21st Century Fox by Disney.

**Archived source account.** The Walt Disney Company announces its intent to acquire a large portion of 21st Century Fox for $52.4 billion, pending regulatory approval.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/disney-fox-deal-combines-two-of-worlds-biggest-entertainment-giants-live-updates/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-14-1-3"></a>

Context: Economy of Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli company Teva Pharmaceutical, the world's largest generic drug manufacturer, is restructuring in order to pay off debt, and will be cutting its work force by about a quarter.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-teva-pharm-ind-restructuring/teva-pharm-to-lay-off-a-quarter-of-workforce-suspends-dividend-idUSKBN1E81ML>).

<a id="event-2017-12-14-1-5"></a>

Context: Net neutrality in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Communications Commission votes 3-to-2 to dismantle its net neutrality regulations.

Source citations (as archived): [Wired](<https://www.wired.com/story/after-fcc-vote-net-neutrality-fight-moves-to-courts-congress>); [Wired](<https://www.wired.com/story/read-fcc-net-neutrality-dissent/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Perpignan crash.

**Archived source account.** A train crashes into a school bus at a level crossing in the Arrondissement of Perpignan in France, killing six pupils on the bus.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42358075>).

<a id="event-2017-12-14-2-3"></a>

Context: Southern California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** A firefighter is killed while battling the Thomas Fire, the second death linked to the fourth largest wildfire in California history.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2017/12/14/california-firefighter-killed-during-response-to-historic-thomas-fire/?utm_term=.1d8b63caafb7>).

<a id="event-2017-12-14-2-5"></a>

Context: West Wind Aviation Flight 280.

**Archived source account.** A plane crash in Fond-du-Lac, Saskatchewan, causes 24 injuries and 1 death.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/saskatchewan/passenger-in-fond-du-lac-plane-crash-has-died-family-says-1.4465220>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2017-12-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Health education in Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Justice of Guatemala rules not to allow the implementation of a usage manual from the Procuratorate of Human Rights for talks and workshops about sexuality due to the document's views on abortion, which, except risk for mother's life, is illegal in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Prensa Libre](<http://www.prensalibre.com/guatemala/comunitario/manual-de-reproduccion-sexual-de-la-pdh-promovia-el-aborto>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Nikki Haley, the U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations, accuses Iran of violating the 2015 nuclear deal by allegedly supplying the missile fired last month on Saudi Arabia from Yemen. Iran refutes the claim as based on "fabricated" evidence.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg News](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-12-14/haley-says-missile-parts-prove-iran-is-violating-un-resolutions-jb6u2ik9>).

<a id="event-2017-12-14-4-3"></a>

Context: Somalia–United States relations, Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** The U.S. government cuts aid to some Somali military units for allegedly misusing funds.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/14/politics/us-aid-somalia/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-14-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis accepts the diplomatic credentials of new ambassadors to the Holy See from Azerbaijan, Chad, India, Liechtenstein, New Zealand, Swaziland, and Yemen. In his welcoming address, the Pope mentions "the key role that dialogue plays in enabling diversity".

Source citations (as archived): [Vatican Press Office](<https://press.vatican.va/content/salastampa/en/bollettino/pubblico/2017/12/14/171214c.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-14-5-1"></a>

Context: Education in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Attorneys general for California, New York, Illinois, and Massachusetts sue the Trump Administration's Department of Education for not granting loan relief to students defrauded by for-profit schools.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-education-loans/u-s-states-sue-trump-administration-for-not-granting-student-loan-relief-idUSKBN1E831A>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-14-6-1"></a>

Context: Operation Car Wash.

**Archived source account.** The main opposition party of Peru, Popular Force, which has the absolute majority in Congress, gives the president Pedro Pablo Kuczynski less than 24 hours to present his resignation. This comes after it revealed that he received large sums of money from the Odebrecht construction company, through a financial advisory firm of his property, in exchange of the concession of important infrastructures for the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-peru-odebrecht-kuczynski/peru-opposition-demands-presidents-immediate-resignation-idUSKBN1E82RL>).

<a id="event-2017-12-14-6-3"></a>

Context: Donald Trump's political appointments.

**Archived source account.** Michael Dourson, University of Cincinnati College of Medicine professor, withdraws his nomination for an assistant administrator position with the Environmental Protection Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/white-house/trump-s-controversial-pick-epa-post-withdraws-nomination-n829596>).

### 2017-12-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091451260](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2015&oldid=1091451260>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict, United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Palestinians and the Israeli army scuffle in Jerusalem, Bethlehem and at the Qalandia border crossing over the status of Jerusalem. Clashes are also reported in Gaza, Ramallah, Hebron and Qalqilya. In conflicts where Israeli law enforcement used live ammunition and Palestinians threw rocks, two Palestinians died in Gaza while 150 were wounded and two more were killed in the West Bank while a further 10 were wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians/israeli-troops-kill-four-palestinians-wound-160-in-protests-over-jerusalem-idUSKBN1E91T3>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-15-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Beate Uhse AG, supplier of the Pabo erotica catalog, files for bankruptcy in Germany. Only the holding company restructures in order to secure refinancing with the creditors. Beate Uhse-Rotermund opened the first sex shop in 1962, in Flensburg, under the name "Institut für Ehehygiene" ("Institute for marriage hygiene").

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/german-sex-shop-company-filing-for-protection-from-creditors/2017/12/15/32e46d72-e184-11e7-b2e9-8c636f076c76_story.html?utm_term=.4779da1449b6>).

<a id="event-2017-12-15-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In an effort to avert strikes, the Irish low-cost carrier Ryanair reverses its long-standing policy of refusing to recognize pilots' labour unions.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Daily News](<http://www.nydailynews.com/newswires/news/business/about-face-ryanair-recognizes-unions-avert-strikes-article-1.3699471>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-15-2-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Java earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.5 earthquake strikes the island of Java causing massive damage along with two confirmed deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/earthquake-hits-java-indonesia-tsunami-warning-issued-51817284>).

#### Health and medicine

<a id="event-2017-12-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Child sexual abuse in Australia.

**Archived source account.** A 17-volume report detailing children's experiences of sexual abuse in Australian institutions is published. It concludes that the issue is systemic and "not a case of a few rotten apples". It contains 189 new recommendations, for a total of 406. This report finalizes a five-year Royal Commission inquiry.

Source citations (as archived): [Ten News](<https://tenplay.com.au/news/national/december-2017/royal-commission-into-child-sex-abuse-makes-189-new-recommendations>).

<a id="event-2017-12-15-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The most recent U.S. government statistics show a marked increase in the yearly number of deaths by drug overdose. The number for end May 2017 is 66,324, up 17% when compared to the previous 12-month period.

Context: Foreign policy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** President Trump suggests that the United States could withhold foreign aid for countries that vote in favor of a United Nations resolution calling on the U.S. to withdraw its recognition of Jerusalem as Israel's capital.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/365825-trump-suggests-us-will-cut-off-aid-for-countries-that-vote-for-un>).

<a id="event-2017-12-20-1-3"></a>

Context: China–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea's coast guard says it fired 249 warning shots over a group of Chinese fishing boats "swarming around" one of its patrol ships in South Korean waters.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/south-korea-chinese-finish-boats-warning-shots-illegal-fishing-waters-a8119871.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Poland in the European Union, Judiciary reforms in Poland.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission invokes Article 7 of the European Treaty against E.U. member Poland, denouncing recent judiciary reforms putting it under the political control of the ruling majority and citing "serious risk to the independence of the judiciary and the separation of powers".

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<http://www.lemonde.fr/europe/article/2017/12/20/l-europe-declenche-une-procedure-sans-precedent-contre-le-gouvernement-polonais_5232406_3214.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/20/eu-process-poland-voting-rights>).

<a id="event-2017-12-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Cannabis in New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Terminally ill patients in New Zealand are now able to take medicinal cannabis.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Zealand Herald](<http://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=11963230>); [Newshub](<http://www.newshub.co.nz/home/politics/2017/12/government-rules-terminally-ill-people-allowed-to-smoke-cannabis.amp.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-20-2-5"></a>

Context: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate and House of Representatives pass the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017, which sends it to United States President Donald Trump for signing. This comes after a previous and different version of this legislation was passed by the House yesterday. The law removes the individual insurance mandate from Obamacare.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/republicans-expected-pass-tax-reform-measure/story?id=51870650>).

<a id="event-2017-12-20-2-7"></a>

Context: Israel–Palestine relations.

**Archived source account.** 16-year-old Palestinian Ahed Tamimi, daughter of Bassem al-Tamimi, is arrested on December 19 in a pre-dawn raid on her home in Nabi Salih by the Israeli army after being suspected of assaulting an Israeli soldier. Later in the day, her mother Nariman is allegedly arrested too when visiting her daughter at a police station.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/12/palestinian-ahed-tamimi-arrested-israeli-forces-171219174834758.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-20-2-9"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump commutes the prison sentence of Sholom Rubashkin, who in 2009 was sentenced to 27 years in prison for bank fraud and money laundering.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation-now/2017/12/20/trump-commutes-sentence-kosher-meatpacking-executive/971719001/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-12-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Institutes of Health lifts a three-year ban on scientists experimenting with lethal viruses in the United States, saying the potential benefits of disease preparedness outweigh the risks.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-42426548>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-20-4-2"></a>

Context: Association football / Belgian First Division A.

**Archived source account.** Reigning Belgian champion R.S.C. Anderlecht agrees to be sold to the highest bidder, Marc Coucke, just before a January 1 fiscal deadline.

Source citations (as archived): [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/sport/voetbal/belgisch-voetbal/anderlecht/verrassing-van-formaat-marc-coucke-koopt-anderlecht~a692e041/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-20-4-4"></a>

Context: Association football / Expansion of Major League Soccer.

**Archived source account.** Major League Soccer announces that Nashville has been selected to host a new MLS franchise. No definite timetable for the team's first season has been set.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/soccer/major-league-soccer/story/3318519/mls-confirms-nashville-will-be-home-to-its-latest-expansion-franchise>).

### 2017-12-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 851271417](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2021&oldid=851271417>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-21-0-1"></a>

Context: December 2017 Melbourne car attack.

**Archived source account.** Nineteen people are injured after a car crashes into pedestrians at the corner of Flinders Street and Elizabeth Street in Melbourne, Australia. The driver is arrested. Victoria Police believe that the incident was a "deliberate act" but not terrorism-related.

Source citations (as archived): [The Age](<http://www.theage.com.au/victoria/live-pedestrians-hit-by-suv-in-melbourne-cbd-20171221-h08u1c.html>); [The Observer](<https://www.gladstoneobserver.com.au/news/evil-act-melbourne-attack-had-mental-health-drug-i/3296579/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Border incidents involving North and South Korea.

**Archived source account.** A Korean People's Army soldier defects to South Korea after crossing the Korean Demilitarized Zone (DMZ). South Korean border guards fired warning shots at North Korean troops who approached the Military Demarcation Line, in search of the missing soldier. He is the fourth North Korean soldier to defect this year.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea/shots-fired-at-dmz-as-north-korean-soldier-defects-to-south-idUSKBN1EF036>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2017-12-21-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The wreckage of the HMAS AE1, the first submarine to serve in the Royal Australian Navy, is found near the Duke of York Islands after a 103-year search.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-42435428>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Papa John's Pizza founder John Schnatter announces he will step down from his position as CEO on January 1, 2018. The move comes two months after he criticized NFL leadership over national anthem protests by NFL players. He will be succeeded by COO Steve Ritchie.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-biz-papa-johns-founder-out-20171221-story.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-21-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alphabet Inc. announces Executive Chairman Eric Schmidt, who has been chief executive of Google/Alphabet since 2001, will step down in January 2018. Schmidt will continue to serve on Alphabet's board of directors.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/alphabet-ericschmidt/alphabets-eric-schmidt-to-step-down-as-executive-chairman-idINKBN1EG0AE>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-21-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A ferry sinks off the coast of Luzon in the Philippines with 251 passengers on board. At least four people are reported to have died. The toll is expected to rise, as many are still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2017/12/21/572513913/philippine-coast-guard-scrambles-to-rescue-hundreds-after-ferry-capsize>).

<a id="event-2017-12-21-3-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Jecheon fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire at a fitness center in Jecheon, South Korea, kills at least 29 people and leaves 26 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rappler.com/world/regions/asia-pacific/191954-dead-sauna-fire-south-korea>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-21-4-1"></a>

Context: United Nations General Assembly resolution ES-10/L.22.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations General Assembly votes 128–9, with 35 abstentions, in a nonbinding resolution to demand that the United States rescind its December 6th declaration on unilaterally recognizing the holy and contested city of Jerusalem as Israel's capital.

Source citations (as archived): [Canoe.com](<http://canoe.com/news/world/foreign-affairs-spokesman-says-canada-will-abstain-from-u-n-vote-denouncing-trump-jerusalem-declaration>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Slender Man stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Judge Michael Bohren rules Anissa Weier will spend 25 years in institutional care after she was previously found not guilty by reason of mental disease or defect of the 2014 stabbing of her classmate.

Source citations (as archived): [WITI](<http://fox6now.com/2017/12/21/1-of-2-girls-accused-in-slenderman-stabbing-to-be-sentenced/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-21-6-1"></a>

Context: Catalan regional election, 2017 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Catalonia go to the polls for a snap election called by the Spanish government after the former regional government unsuccessfully declared independence.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42435684>).

<a id="event-2017-12-21-6-3"></a>

Context: Elections in Cuba.

**Archived source account.** The Cuban Parliament approves moving the country's municipal elections to March, and the presidential election to April, when President Raúl Castro is expected to step down.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/raul-castro-stepping-leader-cuba-2018/story?id=51932114>).

<a id="event-2017-12-21-6-5"></a>

Context: Government shutdown in the United States.

**Archived source account.** House and Senate pass a continuing resolution bill to avert a government shutdown until January 19, 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2017/12/21/572541406/congress-scrambles-to-keep-government-running-before-friday-deadline>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2017-12-21-7-1"></a>

Context: Life expectancy.

**Archived source account.** The United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports life expectancy in 2016 in America declined for the second year in a row because of the opioid crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-healthcare-cdc/u-s-life-expectancy-fell-in-2016-as-opioid-overdoses-surged-cdc-idUSKBN1EF1TF>).

### 2017-12-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1091451712](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2022&oldid=1091451712>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** After 1,000 days of civil war in Yemen, eight million people are at risk of starvation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-middle-east-42442463/starvation-in-sanaa-1000-days-of-yemen-s-civil-war>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Protests on U.S. recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Two Palestinians are shot dead and about 60 others are wounded by Israeli troops gunfire as thousands protest along the Gaza border fence, in all seven West Bank cities and in East Jerusalem, against the U.S. declaration.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-israel-palestinians/two-palestinians-killed-in-anti-us-protests-after-u-n-vote-on-jerusalem-gaza-ministry-idUSKBN1EG1GC>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2017-12-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Economics of bitcoin.

**Archived source account.** The digital cryptocurrency Bitcoin loses a third of its value within 24 hours.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2017/12/22/investing/bitcoin-plunges-below-14k/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** CSX Corporation names chief operating officer Jim Foote its new chief executive officer, succeeding E. Hunter Harrison who died last week. Harrison had started a restructuring campaign less than a year ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-csx-ceo/csx-names-foote-as-ceo-following-death-of-harrison-idUSKBN1EG22Y?il=0>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-1-4"></a>

Context: Apple Inc. litigation.

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc. faces backlash and lawsuits after admitting to slowing down the speed on some of their older phones deliberately.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/apple-iphone-slowdown-sparks-fraud-lawsuit/>); [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/two-class-action-lawsuits-apple-iphone-throttling-2017-12>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-22-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Coast Guard reports that 252 passengers and crew have been rescued while five people were killed when a ferry capsized Thursday east of Manila.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-ferry/philippines-coast-guard-rescues-252-passengers-from-capsized-ferry-idUSKBN1EG08F?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-22-3-1"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas says he will not accept any U.S. plan for peace with Israel, because it recognized Jerusalem as Israel's capital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42453530>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-3-3"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council unanimously imposes new sanctions on North Korea that caps refined petroleum product imports to 500,000 barrels a year, a 90 percent cut, and demands the repatriation of North Koreans working abroad within 24 months.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles/u-n-security-council-imposes-new-sanctions-on-north-korea-idUSKBN1EG0HV>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-3-5"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. agrees to supply Ukraine with more lethal weapons, now including Javelin anti-tank missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.nydailynews.com/newswires/news/national/officials-lethal-weapons-headed-ukraine-article-1.3716611>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-22-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Federal Bureau of Investigation arrests Everitt Aaron Jameson, a 25-year-old former Marine, on suspicion of planning a terrorist attack in the Pier 39 area over Christmas.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-42462463>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** American police shoot dead an Egyptian man after he opened fire on them. Police described it as an apparent terror attack.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/videos/us/2017/12/24/pennsylvania-police-shootings-dhs-nd.>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-22-5-1"></a>

Context: Catalan regional election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Pro-independence parties retain their absolute majority in the regional parliament, while the unionist Citizens party secures the highest number of seats.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42451100>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-5-2"></a>

Context: Catalan regional election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The political situation means that there is no clarity as to which party is given the right to form the government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42450745>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-5-3"></a>

Context: Catalan regional election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** The voter turnout reaches a record high for a Catalan regional election of over 83%.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalan-separatists-win-election-in-rebuke-to-spain-and-eu-idUSKBN1EE2WW>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-5-5"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom's Home Office confirms the return of the blue British passport after the UK leaves the European Union. The new passports will be issued from October 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-42443253>).

<a id="event-2017-12-22-5-7"></a>

Context: Tax reform in the United States.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump signs the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 into law.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/22/politics/trump-sign-tax-bill-mar-a-lago/index.html>).

### 2017-12-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1184087885](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2023&oldid=1184087885>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-23-0-2"></a>

Context: 2017 Pacific typhoon season / Tropical Storm Tembin.

**Archived source account.** More than 200 people are dead in the southern Philippines as a result of floods and mudslides caused by Severe Tropical Storm Vinta.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-asia-storm-philippines/nearly-90-dead-in-philippine-mudslides-flooding-as-storm-hits-officials-idUSKBN1EH05A>).

<a id="event-2017-12-23-0-4"></a>

Context: London Zoo fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire breaks out at a café and shop at the London Zoo. An aardvark is killed and four meerkats are missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky](<https://news.sky.com/story/london-zoo-fire-70-firefighters-tackle-cafe-blaze-11181845>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-fire-zoo/aardvark-dies-in-blaze-at-london-zoo-meerkats-missing-idUSKBN1EH08I>).

<a id="event-2017-12-23-0-6"></a>

Context: December 2017 Southern California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** The Thomas Fire becomes the largest in Californian state history.

<a id="event-2017-12-23-0-8"></a>

Context: 2017 Davao City mall fire.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-seven people, mostly call centre workers, are missing and presumed dead in a fire in the Davao City Mall in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [The Express](<https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/896241/Philippines-fire-mall-Davao-City-flames>); [The Free Press Journal](<http://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/37-feared-dead-in-philippine-mall-blaze/1192687>).

**Archived source account.** Thirty-three people are killed and 15 injured as a bus falls 65 feet into the river in Rajasthan, Western India.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-23-1-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of France.

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron says he will help strengthen the military forces of the G5 Sahel fighting Islamist militants in the Northern Mali conflict.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-sahel/macron-france-ready-to-strengthen-force-in-sahel-fighting-islamists-idUSKBN1EH0JX?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-23-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A mail carrier from Dublin, Ohio, (told that he would lose his job) allegedly kills 2 of his supervisors.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/police-ohio-postal-worker-kills-boss-postal-inspector-51969085>); [The Columbus Dispatch](<http://www.dispatch.com/news/20171223/police-naked-carrier-kills-supervisor-in-dublin-post-office-then-kills-another-co-worker>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-23-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Previously secret documents from Alan Ewen Donald, the United Kingdom's ambassador to China between 1988 and 1991, regarding the Tiananmen Square protests of 1989, are released after being declassified in October, putting the death toll from the protests at 10,000 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-42465516>).

<a id="event-2017-12-23-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Peru president Alberto Fujimori is taken, from prison, to a local hospital for treatment for abnormally low blood pressure.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-peru-fujimori/perus-fujimori-taken-to-hospital-from-prison-in-ambulance-local-tv-idUSKBN1EH0QD?il=0>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-23-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 La Liga.

**Archived source account.** For a record third time in a row, FC Barcelona wins the El Clásico away match versus Real Madrid C.F.. With a 3–0 score, they extend their lead over Real Madrid at the top of La Liga to 14 points.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2017/dec/23/real-madrid-v-barcelona-el-clasico-live>).

### 2017-12-24

#### Disasters and accidents

Context: Typhoon Tembin.

Context: Positions on Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** Guatemalan President Jimmy Morales says he will move his country's Israeli embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** China's AVIC AG600, the world's largest amphibious aircraft, makes its maiden flight. State-owned Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) has spent almost eight years developing the aircraft, which is designed to carry out marine rescues and battle wildfires.

### 2017-12-25

**Archived source account.** More than 70 civilians are believed to have been killed in two-days of airstrikes by the Royal Saudi Air Force targeting Houthi forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/12/saudi-raids-kill-70-yemeni-civilians-48-hours-171225130825534.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-25-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 19 people are killed and 25 others injured in a jeepney-bus collision in La Union, Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/25/asia/philippines-bus-crash-tembin-vinta/index.html>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/955018/breaking-accident-road-dead-jeepney-bus-partas-agoo-la-union>).

<a id="event-2017-12-25-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A public transport bus crashes into Slavyansky Bulvar subway station entrance in Moscow, Russia, killing four and injuring eleven.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42479316>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Russian presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Central Election Commission refuses to register opposition leader Alexei Navalny as a candidate in the presidential election due to a previous embezzlement conviction, which he claims is politicized. Navalny has called for his supporters to boycott the upcoming election in response.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42479909>).

### 2017-12-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 851273147](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2026&oldid=851273147>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** According to emergency services and the Houthi-owned Al Masirah, Saudi Arabian coalition air strikes kill 15 people and wound 60 at al-Shahra souq, a popular market in Taiz Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2017/12/killed-saudi-raids-yemen-taiz-171226123235901.html>); [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/zeker-15-doden-bij-luchtaanval-op-markt-in-jemen~a700d5c9/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** Seven Israeli chess players are denied travel visas to the Rapid and Blitz Chess Championships in Saudi Arabia as the two countries have no diplomatic relations. Players from Qatar and Iran are given last-minute visas, while Ukrainian champion Anna Muzychuk refuses to participate because she does not want to wear an abaya.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42484987>).

<a id="event-2017-12-26-1-3"></a>

Context: Russia–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** Forty Syrian rebel and opposition groups reject Russia's offer to attend peace talks in late January 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2017/12/26/syria-rebels-opposition-reject-russia-proposed-talks.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Sinai Insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen militants accused of carrying out attacks in 2013 during the Sinai Insurgency are hanged in Egypt. The last mass execution in the country took place in 2015, when six jihadists were executed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42483537>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Liberian general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Liberia will elect a new president in a run-off election between vice-president Joseph Boakai and former footballer George Weah. Weah is elected with 60% of the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-42507405>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-42481278>).

<a id="event-2017-12-26-3-3"></a>

Context: Mining industry of Morocco.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of Moroccans protest working conditions in Morocco's coal pits.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20171227-morocco-thousands-protest-coal-mines-death-northern-city-jerada-two-brothers>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2017-12-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Doping in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Grigory Rodchenkov, the person who exposed Russia's systematic doping of Olympic athletes, is warned by U.S. officials that Russian agents may be inside the United States looking for him, and that new security measures must be taken to ensure his safety.

Source citations (as archived): [UPROXX](<http://uproxx.com/news/russia-doping-whistleblower-fears-for-life-putin/>); [BBC Sport](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/42487917>).

### 2017-12-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104626648](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2027&oldid=1104626648>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-27-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Donbass, Minsk II.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine exchanges hundreds of prisoners with the Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42493270>).

<a id="event-2017-12-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Perekrestok supermarket bombing.

**Archived source account.** A bomb goes off in a supermarket in the Russian city of Saint Petersburg, injuring at least 10 people. Police say they are treating the blast as an attempted terror attack. Social media accounts linked to ISIL have claimed responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-blast/blast-rips-through-supermarket-in-russias-st-petersburg-agencies-idUSKBN1EL1DF>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-27-1-1"></a>

Context: Israel–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel's Transportation Minister Yisrael Katz says that the new underground railroad terminal in the Jewish Quarter in the Old City of Jerusalem (part of East Jerusalem) will be named in honor of U.S. President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Israel-News/New-Western-Wall-train-station-to-be-named-after-Trump-520135>).

<a id="event-2017-12-27-1-3"></a>

Context: Positions on Jerusalem.

**Archived source account.** The Iranian Parliament votes 207–0 to declare Jerusalem the "everlasting capital" of Palestine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-votes-to-declare-jerusalem-everlasting-capital-of-palestine/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-27-1-5"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea is building its first operational ballistic missile submarine on an “accelerated schedule,” according to the US-Korea Institute of Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies.

Source citations (as archived): [The Christian Science Monitor](<https://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Military/2017/1227/With-submarine-program-N.-Korea-signals-surge-toward-full-nuclear-deterrence>).

### 2017-12-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1246161718](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2028&oldid=1246161718>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2017-12-28-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021) / December 2017 Kabul suicide bombing.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing at a Shi‘ite cultural center and news agency in Kabul, Afghanistan, kills 41 people and injures 84 others. ISIL-affiliated Amaq News Agency says this group is responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-blast-claim/islamic-state-claims-kabul-suicide-bomb-attack-online-statement-idUSKBN1EM0VR>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/28/asia/kabul-attack-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2017-12-28-0-5"></a>

Context: Libyan Civil War (2014–present) / Battle of Benghazi (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** The Libyan National Army declares full control of Benghazi, the country's second largest city, after retaking the last district held by Islamist militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security/eastern-libyan-forces-say-they-fully-control-benghazi-idUSKBN1EM1Q1>).

<a id="event-2017-12-28-0-7"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The White Helmets reports that Syrian government and Russian warplanes, using rockets and internationally-banned weapons - including vacuum bombs, repeatedly strike residential areas in the town of Al-Lataminah and six villages in Idlib province, killing 22 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/syrian-crisis/2017/12/28/22-killed-by-regime-russian-airstrikes-in-syrias-idlib>).

#### Culture and media

<a id="event-2017-12-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Barack Obama and Hillary Clinton are voted the most admired man and woman in the United States, according to Gallup's annual poll.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2017/12/27/politics/barack-obama-hillary-clinton-gallup/index.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve people are dead in an apartment fire in The Bronx area of New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://finance.yahoo.com/news/latest-12-dead-bronx-fire-including-child-031647739.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** United States consular missions in Turkey and the Embassy of Turkey, Washington, D.C. announce they will resume visa services.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20171228-us-turkey-lift-reciprocal-visa-restrictions>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** In Mandaluyong, Philippines, law enforcers mistakenly fired at a Mitsubishi Adventure, which they thought carried suspects in a previous shooting incident, resulting in two people dead and two others injured. As a result, 10 police officers were relieved from the post.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<http://www.philstar.com/nation/2017/12/29/1772812/mandaluyong-police-probe-fatal-case-mistaken-identity>); [Philippine Daily Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/955892/breaking-police-cordon-off-part-of-shaw-blvd-after-shooting-incident>).

<a id="event-2017-12-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Same-sex marriage in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Oregon Court of Appeals upholds a $135,000 fine against the owners of Sweet Cakes by Melissa in Sweet Cakes by Melissa v. Oregon Bureau of Labor and Industries for refusing to make a wedding cake for a same-sex couple. A similar case, Masterpiece Cakeshop v. Colorado Civil Rights Commission has reached the Supreme Court of the United States with a decision expected in June 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/feature/nbc-out/court-rules-against-oregon-bakers-who-refused-make-gay-wedding-n833321>).

<a id="event-2017-12-28-4-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Wichita, Kansas swatting.

**Archived source account.** Police shoot and kill a man in Wichita, Kansas, after a hoax emergency call sends them there.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42523045>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-28-5-1"></a>

Context: Liberian general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** With 98 percent of the votes counted, Liberia’s National Elections Commission announces these unofficial results show Senator George Weah, a former Pro footballer, defeating vice president Joseph Boakai, 61.5 to 38.5 percent, in the runoff of October's presidential election, to succeed Ellen Johnson Sirleaf, the first female Liberian president.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2017/12/28/world/africa/george-weah-liberia-election.html>).

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed in two coordinated attacks targeting Coptic Christians in Egypt. Two of the victims are killed by a gunman in a Coptic-owned appliance store in the Helwan area of Cairo. The gunman then moves to a church where he kills a further six civilians and a policeman before being arrested.

Context: Kamala Mills fire.

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed in a rooftop restaurant fire in Mumbai, India.

Context: 2017 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Anti-government demonstrators have taken to the streets of Iran for a second day, with protests being held in a number of cities.

<a id="event-2017-12-29-3-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Mali.

### 2017-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1182853896](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2017%20December%2031&oldid=1182853896>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2017-12-31-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A large number of fireworks accidentally go off in a barge at a New Year's Day show in Terrigal, NSW, Australia, causing thousands to be evacuated from the beach by police and the two people on the barge to suffer minor injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-42531996>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A truck collision in western Kenya kills at least 36 people and injures 18.

Source citations (as archived): [The Standard](<https://www.standardmedia.co.ke/article/2001264584/at-least-30-dead-18-hurt-in-migaa-bus-truck-collision>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-0-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Sydney Seaplanes crash.

**Archived source account.** A DHC-2 Beaver seaplane crashes into the Hawkesbury River near Sydney, killing at least six people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-42527530>); [CTV NEWS](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/dozens-killed-in-head-on-collision-between-bus-and-truck-in-kenya-1.3740658>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-0-5"></a>

Context: 2017 Nature Air Cessna 208 Caravan crash.

**Archived source account.** Twelve people, including all 10 American passengers, are killed when their single-propeller plane crashes in a mountainous area near Punta Islita, in Guanacaste Province, Costa Rica. The pilot was former President Laura Chinchilla's cousin.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/costa-rica-plane-crash-several-dead-live-updates/>); [AFP and The Tico Times](<http://www.ticotimes.net/2017/12/31/plane-crash-causes-still-unknown-in-costa-rica-pilot-was-cousin-to-ex-president-chinchilla>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-0-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire consumes a multi-story parking garage in Liverpool, England, destroying about 1,400 cars parked there, most for an international horse show in the adjacent Liverpool Echo Arena. No injuries are reported, and all horses and pet dogs were moved to safety.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-fire/blaze-destroys-hundreds-of-cars-melts-floors-of-liverpool-parking-garage-idUSKBN1EQ163>); [AP and CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/u-k-parking-garage-fire-destroys-1400-cars/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2017-12-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres issues "a red alert for our world," saying that conflicts have deepened, global anxieties about nuclear weapons have increased, inequalities have grown, and nationalism and xenophobia are on the rise. Guterres calls for global unity to overcome these growing challenges.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2017/12/31/us/un-secretary-general-2018-message-intl/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2017-12-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Copper Canyon Apartment Homes shooting.

**Archived source account.** Five Douglas County, Colorado sheriff's deputies are shot, one fatally, and two civilians are injured at a domestic disturbance call. The suspect was also killed.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/colorado-shooting-douglas-county-highlands-ranch-denver-today-live-updates/>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-2-3"></a>

Context: Law of China.

**Archived source account.** China announces that its ivory trade is now illegal. In 2015, Mainland Chinese President Xi Jinping and then-U.S. President Barack Obama announced "near-complete" ivory bans for each country. America's ivory ban went into effect in June 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [National Geographic](<https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2017/12/wildlife-watch-china-ivory-ban-goes-into-effect/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2017-12-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of India.

**Archived source account.** Indian film superstar Rajinikanth, who has a huge following in the country and is one of Asia's highest paid actors, has announced he is entering politics.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-42527290>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-3-3"></a>

Context: 2017 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Iran blocks access to Telegram and Instagram as the largest anti-government protests since 2009 continue.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/dec/31/protesters-who-spread-fear-and-violence-will-be-confronted-says-iran>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-3-5"></a>

Context: Palestine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Palestine recalls its envoy to the United States for "consultations," following President Trump's recognition of Jerusalem as the capital of Israel. Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas says that he will not accept any U.S. peace plan in the wake of Trump's move.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42531102>).

<a id="event-2017-12-31-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017 NFL season, 2017 Cleveland Browns season.

**Archived source account.** In American football, the Cleveland Browns becomes the second team in the NFL, along with the Detroit Lions to have a winless season.
